AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 将可再生公地资源形式化为约束马尔可夫博弈（CMG）和约束多智能体MDP（CM-MDP），引入设计师指定的耗竭预算；(2) 提出非平稳拉格朗日策略序列框架：在每个epoch用共享乘子定价消耗后的惩罚世代问题，执行求解得到的平稳策略，然后根据测得的预算偏差更新价格；(3) 引入"平均epoch"解概念，用于带折扣奖励和终端成本的重置（reset）回合；(4) 证明奖励独立的可行性证书（Proposition 1）、合作可行性与近似最优性（Proposition 2）、采样成本扩展（Theorem 2），以及约束纳什证书（Theorem 1），后者涉及价格离散项量化通过epoch重新分配预算的偏差；(5) 在Gordon-Schaefer渔业模型中使用受限IPPO（独立个体奖励）和MAPPO（团队奖励）进行实验。
AI.result: 理论结果：(1) Proposition 1给出了奖励独立的可行性证书——如果乘子增长为亚线性，则平均epoch可行性成立；(2) Proposition 2证明了在严格可行性条件下，乘子有界且平均奖励接近可行混合的最优值；(3) Theorem 2将结果扩展到无偏采样成本，给出几乎处处log M增长和固定置信度的有限样本界；(4) Theorem 1给出有限序列约束纳什证书，包含额外价格离散项G·Δ_M，量化epoch间预算重分配带来的单边改进。实验结果：在多个预算设置下，PPO-PI学习器在显示窗口中能实现接近目标的消耗水平；紧预算实现强库存保护，大预算允许更大消耗并提供更高收益；MAPPO在ε=0.6时价格接近零，与该宽松预算下持续价格压力很小一致。论文还识别出渔业环境中均匀单边Slater条件失败的结构性原因——任何单边反应都无法在对手单位努力下满足预算，但联合戒除可严格可行。
AI.conclusion: 本文为公地悲剧提供了一个基于约束马尔可夫博弈/CM-MDP的拉格朗日策略序列框架，将资源保护量化为设计师指定的耗竭预算。理论保证了在适当求解器精度和乘子更新假设下，无约束问题的解可产生满足预算的合作策略。平均epoch解概念使策略可变化并仍满足约束（通过epoch间消耗约束补偿）。渔业实验展示了预算如何通过变化的策略塑造终端库存、收获回报和价格适应。论文明确了什么该约束是证据、什么不是——紧预算下的接近目标消耗是有用的实证证据，但显示窗口中的偏移既不证实也不否定完整序列平均可行性，且实际实现（密集单边奖励整形和有上限PI反馈）偏离了理论分析中的精确终端成本拉格朗日和无上限投影更新。该方法为资源保护提供了明确的定量目标和评估学习智能体使用公地所生成策略的数学基础。

title: Human-AI Collaboration: From Paradoxes to Patterns
comment: This is the author's version of the work. It is posted here for your personal use. Not for redistribution. The definitive Version of Record will be published in 33rd Conference on Pattern Languages of Programs (PLoP 2026)
summary: Evidence shows that humans and AI systems perform better together, by collaborating, than alone. This paper examines two key design dimensions of human-AI collaboration (autonomy and initiative) and explores the collaboration patterns that they generate. Documenting these patterns starts with identifying the underlying problems and solutions, followed by examining the internal tensions within the problems. The paper uses a paradox perspective to analyze those tensions. It describes a process for surfacing the tensions and mapping the underlying paradoxes. It also illustrates how the pattern descriptions can be derived from mapping these paradoxes. Finally, the paper documents four human-AI collaboration patterns: Instruction, Delegation, Assistance, and Co-creation.

AI.tldr: 本文从自主性(autonomy)和主动性(initiative)两个设计维度出发,运用悖论理论(paradox perspective)分析了人机协作中的内在矛盾,最终归纳出四种人机协作模式:指令(Instruction)、委托(Delegation)、协助(Assistance)和共同创造(Co-creation)。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明人类与AI系统协作的表现优于各自单独工作,但如何系统地设计和管理这种人机协作仍缺乏清晰的理论框架。作者希望通过深入分析人机协作中的内在张力,弥补这一理论空白,为实际应用提供指导。
AI.method: 采用悖论理论(paradox perspective)作为分析框架,首先识别协作中的关键设计维度(自主性与主动性),进而挖掘其中的问题与解决方案,分析问题内部的张力,提出张力梳理与悖论映射的方法,并从悖论映射中推导出模式描述。
AI.result: 通过悖论映射过程,文档化了四种人机协作模式:(1) Instruction(指令模式);(2) Delegation(委托模式);(3) Assistance(协助模式);(4) Co-creation(共同创造模式)。每种模式对应不同的自主性与主动性配置组合。
AI.conclusion: 人机协作可以系统性地通过自主性与主动性两个维度加以理解和设计。利用悖论视角揭示协作中的内在张力,能够推导出可操作的协作模式,为开发高效的人机协作系统提供了理论基础和实践指南。

title: AVIO: Learning to Add and Remove Sounding Objects in Audiovisual Scenes
summary: Adding or removing a sounding object requires coordinated changes to visual content and sound while preserving the surrounding scene. Yet paired supervision for localized non-speech audiovisual editing remains limited, as visual and acoustic edits must target the same object and isolate its sound from overlapping sources. To address this gap, we introduce \textit{AVIOBench}, a dataset comprising 37.9 hours of paired audiovisual examples spanning 1{,}878 target-object names. AVIOBench links the visual presence and acoustic contribution of each target object through a shared identity and visual mask. Our automated pipeline uses visual grounding and cross-modal consistency to select target-sound removal candidates, then jointly refines the audiovisual pairs to improve perceptual quality and cross-modal consistency. Building on this dataset, we propose \textit{AVIO}, which adapts a pretrained text-to audiovisual generation model through source-conditioned feature modulation to jointly learn object addition and removal. A reference-frame curriculum gradually reduces reference conditioning during training, enabling one model to perform instruction-only editing with optional visual guidance. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate effective audiovisual object removal and addition, with optional reference guidance providing appearance and placement control for addition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AVIOBench（37.9 小时、1878 类目标对象的声音-视觉配对数据集）和 AVIO 模型，专注于在音视频场景中添加和移除发声对象，并保持周围场景不变。AVIO 基于预训练的文本到音视频 DiT，通过源条件特征调制实现对象级编辑，并采用参考帧课程学习支持仅文本或文本加参考帧的引导。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频编辑数据集和模型缺乏对非语音发声对象的局部配对监督，视觉和声学编辑必须针对同一对象并将其声音与重叠源分离，这一挑战限制了应用。
AI.method: 1) AVIOBench 构建：通过视觉接地（SAM3）和跨模态一致性筛选目标对象，使用 EffectErase 进行视觉修复，SAM-Audio 进行音频分离，再通过 LTX-2 进行联合音视频细化；2) AVIO 模型：基于 JavisDiT++ 引入源条件 AdaLN 特征调制对齐源-目标特征，采用参考帧课程（100K 步逐步降低参考条件概率）实现添加/移除统一建模；3) 训练方式：添加与移除 1:1 双向联合训练，流匹配损失。
AI.result: 在 1425 测试对上，AVIO 在视觉编辑上 PSNR 达 20.06（移除）和 19.22（添加），在音频 KL 散度上达到 1.36（移除）和 1.29（添加），LSD 分别为 12.81 和 11.85。联合音视频评估中，添加任务的 VES/AES/AVC 分别达 40.10%/77.90%/71.50%，均优于 InstructAV2AV 等基线，模型仅 2.26B 参数。
AI.conclusion: AVIOBench 和 AVIO 提供了首个大规模非语音发声对象的音视频配对编辑基准与统一模型，在保留场景一致性和跨模态一致性方面优于现有单模态和跨模态基线，并通过参考帧课程支持灵活的编辑控制。

title: BRIDGE: Bilevel Retrieval-Credit-Aware Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (ARL) with verifiable rewards improves the ability of large language models (LLMs) to tackle knowledge-intensive tasks by learning to interleave search and reasoning. However, most existing ARL methods optimize only LLM-generated tokens and treat retrieved evidence as environment observations. This creates an information-credit gap: failures caused by missing or misleading evidence are attributed to the LLM policy rather than to the retriever, which motivates training the LLM and the retriever jointly. In this paper, we show that retrieval and LLM policy learning are order-sensitive: adapting the retriever before optimizing the policy yields a larger reward gain than the reverse order. To preserve this hierarchy while allowing both components to co-adapt, we formulate retrieval-augmented agentic RL as a bilevel optimization problem. To solve it efficiently, we introduce BRIDGE, a memory-efficient first-order bilevel method motivated by a loss-landscape analysis of the RL and retrieval objectives. Across seven open-domain QA benchmarks, BRIDGE achieves the highest average accuracy with both 3B and 7B backbones, improving the multi-hop average over the strongest baseline by 9.6 and 3.4 EM points, respectively. It also achieves the best averaged answer accuracy and reasoning quality across medical QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: BRIDGE提出了一种面向检索增强智能体强化学习（agentic RL）的双层优化方法（bilevel optimization），联合训练LLM策略与查询端检索器（通过LoRA adapter），通过分层结构——先优化检索器、再优化LLM——并在内存高效的一阶双层算法下实现，在开放域与医疗问答基准上显著优于现有基线，尤其在多跳问答（multi-hop QA）和小型骨干模型上。
AI.motivation: 现有agentic RL方法仅优化LLM生成的token，将检索证据视为环境观察，导致"信息-信用差距"（information-credit gap）：检索缺失或误导所导致的错误被错误归因于LLM，而非检索器。研究还发现检索与LLM策略学习存在顺序敏感性——先调检索器、再调策略的顺序带来更大收益。
AI.method: 1. 将检索增强agentic RL形式化为双层优化问题：上层为RL目标（最大化最终答案奖励），下层为RAG似然目标（让检索器为当前策略提供最有用证据）。2. 基于损失景观分析，提出BRIDGE：内存高效的一阶双层方法，丢弃传统两状态估计中的RAG校正项，仅跟踪惩罚检索器。3. 检索器用LoRA adapter参数化，结合检索回合的RL信用与RAG似然进行更新；LLM仅用GRPO在当前检索器生成的rollouts上更新。4. 在E5检索器上用查询端LoRA（rank=16），250步训练，GRPO组大小8/16。
AI.result: 开放域QA（7个基准）：3B骨干上多跳平均比最强基线VT-Search提升9.6 EM，整体平均提升7.1 EM；7B骨干上多跳提升3.4 EM，整体提升2.3 EM。医疗QA（5个MIRAGE基准，7B）：在所有5项上取得最佳推理质量（GPT-5.6 Luna评判）和答案准确率。计算效率：相比两状态估计器减少49.7%峰值内存、55.8%每次检索更新时间；运行时约为联合训练基线Agentic-R的一半。还提供收敛性理论保证（PL条件+上層平坦性假设下达到近似平稳点）。
AI.conclusion: BRIDGE通过双层优化框架有效解决了检索增强agentic RL中的信息-信用差距问题，验证了"先检索后策略"的层次顺序在联合训练中通过一阶双层算法可以高效保持，在多跳问答、小型骨干和医疗推理等场景带来一致增益，同时大幅降低内存开销。

title: MAADBench: The Refreshable Paradigm for Anomaly Detection in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Recent studies report that LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) fail at rates of 41%-87%, yet to our knowledge, no benchmark to date supports systematic anomaly detection (AD) for them. Building MAS AD benchmarks is hard because they must remain fresh as LLM systems evolve: tasks may leak into training data and thus be memorized by LLMs, traces and anomaly patterns expire as backbones evolve, and labels must be provided reliably for each refresh. To address these challenges, we present MAADBench (MA: multi-agent; AD: anomaly detection), the first refreshable MAS AD benchmark designed for diverse, evolving LLM backbones underlying the agents. MAADBench combines (1) sampled-and-coupled generative tasks over an approximately 10^37-task space to mitigate task leakage, (2) refreshable trace generation under configurable LLM backbones, and (3) automated provision of cost-free, deterministic step-level labels for fine-grained AD evaluation. Beyond offering the paradigm itself, we run MAADBench with five state-of-the-art LLM backbones and release the MAADBench-Full dataset with 5,200 step-labeled traces. Benchmarking 25 AD methods on the MAADBench dataset reveals substantial limitations in current approaches: they rely heavily on supervision, struggle with subtle MAS-specific anomalies, and lack robustness across LLM backbones. These gaps point to a rich research agenda for MAS-specific anomaly detection, with MAADBench providing a systematic and refreshable testbed for method development and evaluation. We open-source MAADBench-Full at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 MAADBench,首个面向 LLM 多智能体系统(MAS)的可刷新异常检测(AD)基准。通过组合式任务生成(约 10^37 任务空间)、可配置 LLM 骨干上的可刷新轨迹生成和确定性步骤级自动标注,解决了任务泄漏、轨迹过期和标签保真三大挑战。基于五种 SOTA LLM 生成的 5,200 条带标签轨迹,对 25 种 AD 方法的系统评测揭示了现有方法对监督信号的高度依赖、对细微 MAS 异常的低效检测以及跨骨干的脆弱性等显著局限。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统(MAS)失败率高达 41%-87%,但缺乏系统性异常检测基准。核心困难在于:LLM 持续进化导致静态基准面临任务泄漏(记忆而非推理)、轨迹过期(骨干变化使旧轨迹失效)和标签保真(细粒度、确定性、可刷新标签难以兼得)三大挑战。
AI.method: 1) 自底向上 Oracle 引导构造:从具备验证真值的原子任务出发,通过隐式依赖耦合生成组合式任务,以"密室逃脱"为隐喻,分 Action-Puzzle-Room 三层;2) 在五种 LLM 骨干(Claude Sonnet/Opus、DeepSeek-R1、GPT-4.1/5.4)上生成可刷新轨迹;3) 通过 Oracle 自动传播真值,提供零成本、确定性的步骤级标签;4) 系统评估 25 种 AD 方法,涵盖四种监督级别(无监督、单分类、半监督、全监督)与四类方法族(表格型、图型、MAS 专用、LLM-as-judge)。
AI.result: MAADBench-Full 含 5,200 条步骤级标注轨迹。关键发现:(1)MAS AD 监督差距(~0.28 AUROC)显著大于传统表格 AD(~0.20),无监督下难以检测;(2)最佳方法为 XGBoost(0.88)、Random Forest(0.86)、G-Safeguard(0.83);(3)长程推理异常最难(平均 0.51);(4)各骨干表现差异显著,GPT 系列最难检测;(5)在传播链中,中间步最易捕获(0.47),根源与下游步均更难(0.29);(6)LLM 检测器成本高出传统方法约 2 个数量级。
AI.conclusion: MAS 异常检测仍是远未解决的问题。MAADBench 提供的可刷新基准范式(组合任务生成、可刷新轨迹、确定性步骤级标签)为应对快速演化的 LLM 生态提供了可持续的测试基础。核心研究议程包括:降低监督依赖、提升骨干鲁棒性、增强语义理解、引入因果感知与根因定位机制,并探索成本可控的 LLM 检测路径(模型级联、蒸馏、选择性调用)。

title: Visual sensitivity is not claim retractability: persistence-aware credit assignment for multimodal reinforcement learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been extended to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), and perception-aware methods further encourage policies to rely on visual evidence. Yet relying on the image does not guarantee that visual claims are supported by it. Before RL training, 27.81% of the correctly answered responses of Qwen2.5-VL-7B on four multimodal reasoning benchmarks contain at least one direct visual claim that the image does not support. Since outcome-level RL rewards each response as a whole, these claims inherit the positive credit of the correct answer. We introduce a fixed-rollout counterfactual diagnostic that re-scores the same response under an intervened image to separate Evidence-Function Sensitivity (EFS), how strongly the model's predictions change, from claim persistence, whether the model keeps supporting the same claim rather than retracting it. The diagnostic reveals Sensitivity-Persistence Decoupling (SPD): under DAPO and VPPO, EFS increases and claims become more retractable overall, yet unsupported claims become significantly more persistent, whereas GRPO raises EFS without this deterioration. We therefore propose Persistence-Aware Credit Gating (PACG), which attenuates positive credit for unusually persistent visual claims and leaves all other credit unchanged. It requires no supported/unsupported labels and adds no inference cost. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, PACG raises the nine-benchmark average over three seeds from 58.1% to 59.9% with DAPO and from 59.8% to 60.9% with VPPO, while making unsupported claims more retractable. The gains extend to a larger model, a newer backbone, and the accuracy of HallusionBench also improves consistently. These results suggest that visual sensitivity and claim retractability are complementary dimensions of multimodal credit assignment.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出多模态强化学习（RLVR）中的一种信用分配失败：正确答案的轨迹中常包含图像不支持的直接视觉断言，这些断言仍继承了正向轨迹级奖励。作者引入基于固定采样的反事实诊断，将"证据敏感度"（EFS）与"断言持续性"解耦，发现"敏感度-持续性脱钩"（SPD）现象，并提出持久性感知信用门控（PACG）方法，通过对不撤回的视觉断言衰减其正向信用来缓解该问题，无需支持/不支持标签，推理阶段零开销。
AI.motivation: 在LVLMs的多模态RLVR训练中，结果级奖励（outcome-level reward）对整条响应赋予统一信用，即使响应包含图像不支持的视觉断言。先前的感知增强方法关注"模型是否依赖图像"，但忽略了一个关键问题：模型是否会撤回图像不支持的断言？作者发现Qwen2.5-VL-7B在四个多模态推理基准上，27.81%的正确答案轨迹至少包含一个不支持的直接视觉断言，且提高视觉敏感度并不等同于提高断言的可撤回性（retractability）。
AI.method:
方法分为三步：  
1. **直接视觉断言路由（Direct Visual Claim Routing）**：使用冻结的Qwen3-35B-A3B路由器识别响应中直接从图像读取信息的最小片段（直接视觉断言），并构建残差token集作为同轨迹参考。  
2. **固定采样反事实测量（Fixed-Rollout Counterfactual Measurement）**：在原始图像和干预图像（随机14×14补丁黑化，概率0.5）下教师强制同一响应，计算两个量：  
   - **证据敏感度（EFS）**：声明token处预测分布的KL散度（衡量模型对图像的反应强度）。  
   - **校正持续性（Corrected Persistence）**：声明token的对数似然变化减去残差token的平均漂移（衡量模型是否撤回该断言）。  
3. **持久性感知信用门控（PACG）**：基于校正持续性对路由声明的正向信用进行软门控：$g_s = \max(g_{\min}, e^{-\alpha v_s})$，其中 $v_s = [\widetilde{\Delta}(s)+m]_+$。仅修改路由声明的正向信用，保留所有其他信用不变。形式分析证明该门控（1）保持信用符号，（2）有界偏差，（3）在标签无关条件下相对缩减不被支持声明的正向信用比例。
AI.result:
核心实验结果：  
- **SPD现象**：在CrossBench4-2000上，DAPO和VPPO均增加EFS并改善整体可撤回性，但不支持断言的持续性分别上升0.0651和0.0831（95%CI不含零）；GRPO增加EFS而不恶化。  
- **主结果**：PACG在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上9个基准平均从58.1%提升至59.9%（DAPO）和59.8%→60.9%（VPPO），3个种子下Welch t检验p<0.05。在Qwen2.5-VL-32B（66.3%→67.2%）和Qwen3-VL-2B-Thinking（53.7%→54.5%）上同样有效。  
- **HallusionBench**：PACG一致提升aAcc、fAcc、qAcc三项指标。  
- **消融研究**：移除残差校准、仅正向门控或直接路由任一组件均会损失性能或导致训练崩溃。  
- **训练开销**：每步增加57.3%时间（主要来自注释等待），推理阶段零开销。
AI.conclusion: 本文识别了多模态RL中一个被忽视的信用分配失败模式——"敏感度-持续性脱钩"（SPD）：模型可对图像更敏感但对不支持的断言更坚持。提出的PACG通过反事实测量和持久性感知的信用门控，无需支持标签即可提升不支持断言的可撤回性，同时在9个多模态推理基准上提升任务准确率，并在更大模型、新骨干和HallusionBench上泛化。结果表明视觉敏感度与断言可撤回性是多模态信用分配的两个互补维度，使视觉断言对视觉证据负责而非仅依赖图像，是有前景的研究方向。

title: Divide and Inject: Can Agents Reconstruct an Indirect Prompt Injection from Fragments?
summary: Agentic systems are now being widely used to orchestrate tools and reason over long contexts. However, the improving capabilities of the large language models powering these agents also create new attack surfaces for indirect prompt injection. In particular, an attacker may not need to place a complete malicious instruction in retrieved content if the agent can reconstruct the objective from incomplete fragments distributed across a long context. In this work, we introduce adaptive long-context prompt injection (AdaLCPI), which combines long-context fragmentation with adaptive search. AdaLCPI splits an attack objective into incomplete fragments, embeds them in external content retrieved through the agent's tools, and uses a reconstruction cue to prompt the agent to combine them. It then iteratively refines the fragments and cue with OpenEvolve using graded scoring and natural-language execution feedback from the target agent. Empirically, AdaLCPI achieves higher attack success than strong adaptive baselines, reaching 61.4\% macro-average ASR compared with 32.8\% for Trojan Hippo-style and 30.0\% for AgentVigil. Safety evaluations should therefore test whether agents remain robust when harmful objectives must be reconstructed from incomplete fragments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdaLCPI，一种将长上下文分片与自适应搜索相结合的间接提示注入攻击，通过 OpenEvolve 框架迭代优化不完整片段和重建线索，在七个模型上达到 61.4% 的宏观平均攻击成功率，显著优于现有的自适应基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的间接提示注入攻击通常需要在外部内容中放置完整的恶意指令，但随着智能体在长上下文推理与跨工具信息整合方面的能力提升，攻击者可能只需分散嵌入不完整的片段，让智能体自行组合并执行恶意目标，这构成了一种尚未被充分研究的新攻击面。
AI.method: AdaLCPI 将恶意指令拆分为两个不完整的片段（f1, f2）和一个通用的重建线索（c），将这些片段嵌入长上下文填充内容中，由智能体通过工具检索；随后利用 OpenEvolve 进化搜索框架，结合一个 LLM Judge 提供的分级评分（1-10）与自然语言执行反馈，以及一个 LLM Mutator 生成新的候选片段与线索，以最大化攻击成功率；采用 8×8 的质量-多样性档案，按载荷长度和与种子的编辑距离进行分箱。
AI.result: 在 Email、GitHub、Slack 三种环境的七个模型、81 个任务-目标对上的评估显示，使用 8k 填充的 AdaLCPI 达到 61.4% 的宏观平均攻击成功率，显著优于 Trojan Hippo-style 基线（32.8%）、AgentVigil（30.0%）、TAP（26.3%）和 IterInject（32.6%）；消融实验表明，分片与长上下文嵌入相结合是攻击成功的关键（分片+8k 填充达 75.3%，而仅有分片无填充为 0%，仅有完整指令有/无填充约 25-29%）；该攻击在片段分布在不同工具输出时仍然有效（47.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 将长上下文分片与基于执行反馈的自适应优化相结合，可生成显著强于现有自适应攻击的间接提示注入；安全性评估应测试智能体在有害目标需从不完整片段中重建时是否仍然稳健，因为攻击者无需在受控内容中显式呈现完整恶意指令。

title: SafeCoEvo: Co-Evolving Safety Harnesses and Guards for LLM Agents at Test-Time
summary: LLM agents deployed in real-world environments continually encounter new tasks and safety risks, while execution feedback typically becomes available only after each task is completed. However, existing self-evolving approaches commonly rely on multiple rounds of optimization over fixed and repeatedly accessible task distributions, fundamentally differing from test-time adaptation in real-world deployment, where only experience accumulated from past tasks can be used to improve safety decisions on future unseen tasks. To address this limitation, we propose SafeCoEvo, a test-time Harness-Guard co-evolution framework for LLM agent safety that enables the external safety system to continually adapt from accumulated runtime experience. SafeCoEvo jointly improves two complementary safety capabilities at different timescales: S-Harness rapidly externalizes recent runtime experience into updatable explicit safety knowledge that can promptly influence subsequent tasks, while GuardVPO internalizes accumulated runtime safety experience over a longer timescale into parametric risk-judgment capabilities. By combining short-term rapid adaptation with long-term capability consolidation, SafeCoEvo continually improves the agent's safety capabilities, reducing the unsafe outcome rate by 10.05% while improving the task success rate by 12.15% over the strongest baseline, thereby achieving simultaneous gains in safety and task utility.

AI.tldr: SafeCoEvo提出了一种测试时的双时间尺度安全协演化框架,通过同时进化Safety Harness(S-Harness)和Guard两个外部安全组件,使LLM Agent能够在真实部署过程中仅利用过往积累的运行时经验持续提升安全性,同时在任务执行模型保持冻结的情况下将不安全结果率降低10.05%、任务成功率提升12.15%。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化安全方法通常依赖于在固定、可重复访问的任务分布上进行多轮优化,这与真实部署中的测试时自适应场景根本不同——真实场景中任务按顺序到达,只能利用过去任务积累的经验来改善未来未见任务的安全决策。因此,需要在保持任务执行模型冻结的前提下,实现外部安全系统从累积运行时经验中的持续测试时安全自适应。
AI.method: SafeCoEvo采用双时间尺度协演化策略:短时间尺度上,S-Harness在每个任务后将最新运行时反馈外部化为五种可更新的显式安全组件(Safety Prompt、Validated Memory、Safety Skills、Permission Policy、Guard Policy);长时间尺度上,GuardVPO(Guard Verdict Policy Optimization)通过带非对称奖励(safe→unsafe判错惩罚-0.5,unsafe→safe漏检惩罚-1.5,正确奖励+0.5/+1.0)的裁剪PPO风格目标,结合KL正则化约束策略漂移,将累积的事件级安全经验内部化为参数化风险判断能力。
AI.result: 在Agent-SafetyBench和Agent Security Bench (ASB)的1024集持续演化流上,SafeCoEvo相比最强基线SHE将UOR降低10.05%、TSR提升12.15%、SUCR提升15.67%;在未见过的测试场景上,UOR降低21.52%、TSR提升26.97%、SUCR提升36.38%。框架在不同任务执行模型(DeepSeek/Qwen)和Guard骨干(AgentDoG/SingGuard)以及外部基准(AgentDojo、AgentHarm、R-Judge、ATBench)上均表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SafeCoEvo验证了显式Safety Harness与参数化Guard的双时间尺度协演化是将外部智能体安全机制从静态保护转变为持续自适应系统的有效范式;S-Harness提供快速显式适应,GuardVPO实现长期能力固化,二者协同实现安全性与任务效用同步提升,为持续测试时安全自适应提供了有前景的解决方案,但仍需在参数化Guard内部化机制以及多模态、更复杂智能体环境方面进一步探索。

title: MemEvo: Automatic Discovery of Streaming Video Memory Mechanisms
summary: Query-agnostic streaming video understanding requires vision-language models to continuously compress an indefinitely growing visual stream into a bounded memory before future queries are known. The performance depends critically on the memory mechanism--what observations to preserve, how to represent and consolidate them, and what information to retrieve when a query eventually arrives. Rather than designing a single memory architecture by hand, we formulate memory design as a search problem over executable memory programs. We introduce a lightweight domain-specific language that expresses memory mechanisms through structured primitives for representation, admission, retention, consolidation, budgeting, and retrieval, while enforcing causal and bounded-memory constraints. Although structured, the derived program space remains large and contains heterogeneous, conditionally dependent design choices whose effects can only be assessed via downstream execution. We therefore propose MemEvo, an LLM-driven auto-research framework that uses pretrained LLM as a semantics-aware proposal model to iteratively generate and refine candidate memory programs based on accumulated experimental feedback. At runtime, a deterministic evaluation pipeline validates and evaluates each candidate, while the underlying vision-language model remains frozen throughout discovery. We finally produce a training-free, bounded-memory mechanism. Extensive experiments on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench demonstrate strong streaming video understanding performance together with substantial context and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: MemEvo是一个LLM驱动的自动研究框架，将流式视频记忆机制设计形式化为在领域特定语言（DSL）上的可执行记忆程序搜索问题，通过LLM作为语义感知提议模型迭代生成与优化候选记忆程序，最终产生无需训练、边界有界的记忆机制，在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上取得了优异的性能与显著的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 查询无关（query-agnostic）的流式视频理解要求视觉-语言模型在未知未来查询的情况下，持续将无限增长的视觉流压缩到有界记忆中。现有方法多为人工设计的单一记忆架构，而记忆设计涉及表示、准入、保留、合并、预算分配和检索等多个异构且强耦合的设计选择，其效果只能通过下游执行评估，且大多不可微，传统的梯度优化方法难以直接应用。
AI.method: 1. 将记忆设计形式化为可执行记忆程序上的搜索问题；2. 设计轻量级DSL，包含recent memory（R）、episodic evidence（E）和gist memory（G）三种功能角色，通过结构化原语表达表示、准入、保留、合并、预算和检索，并强制因果和有界内存约束；3. 提出MemEvo框架，使用预训练LLM作为语义感知提议模型，根据累积的实验反馈迭代生成和优化候选记忆程序；4. 采用三阶段搜索计划（E→Retrieval→G），配合确定性的评估管道验证和评估每个候选，MLLM在整个搜索过程中保持冻结；5. 优化目标包括任务质量（金标答案的平均概率）、存储成本、reader context长度和reader延迟，通过经验Pareto存档进行多目标优化。
AI.result: 在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上均取得最优性能：使用Qwen3-VL-8B时，在StreamingBench RTVU上达到81.4分（提升5.7点），OVO-Bench平均68.8分（提升11.5点）；使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B时，在RTVU提升4.2点，OVO-Bench平均提升10.6点。在StreamingBench 10个子类别中7项排名第一，其中Clips Summarization提升14.1点（78.6→92.7）。效率方面，reader context从约35K token降至约5K token（减少86%），端到端推理延迟减少71%。记忆大小有界（5500 token、96 MiB），writer可持续运行在1 FPS以上。整个搜索过程约54 A100 GPU小时，共评估89个不同候选程序。
AI.conclusion: MemEvo证明了自动发现记忆程序是手工设计流式记忆机制的实用替代方案。核心发现包括：（1）有效的记忆设计依赖于多种操作间的耦合交互，而非简单增加容量；（2）不同记忆角色（R/E/G）在不同任务类型上提供互补信息；（3）更复杂的算子（如自适应边界分割、最相似合并）仅在执行实验支持时才被保留，复杂度本身不被视为改进证据；（4）搜索不贪婪地绑定单一中间得分，智能体能够保留和重新审视多个语义分支，并使用失败执行作为可行性反馈。搜索结束后所有搜索机制被移除，部署时仅使用冻结程序和冻结MLLM，无额外搜索开销。

title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
summary: Pretrained transformers use little of their depth to follow references in context. Thirteen base models reliably follow only 1.4-3.6 lines, and extra pretrained loops add little. A task-trained rank-8 LoRA at one early layer extends this computation with all model weights frozen. Qwen3-8B improves from 15.5% to 99% exact accuracy on 24-line chains; a longer-trained LoRA reaches 50 lines. Ouro-1.4B reaches 60 lines after four loops and at least 160 after eight. The LoRA starts a relay: program lines pass on their chain identity through a short range of middle layers. Frozen heads read progressively further up the chain, and removing parent-line attention stops the relay. A frozen-model measurement locates the last useful intervention layer within tolerance in three of four held-out models. Task-specific LoRAs also improve MuSiQue. Default answers therefore understate the computation accessible through a tiny edit. Code and an interactive demo are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文发现预训练Transformer仅使用其深度的一小部分来跟踪上下文中的引用链（仅1.4-3.6行），但通过在某一早期层插入一个rank-8 LoRA（仅占模型参数0.01%以下），即可将Qwen3-8B在24行引用链上的精确准确率从15.5%提升至99%，并在循环模型Ouro-1.4B上将可达长度从约2行扩展到至少160行。研究揭示了一个"接力"机制：程序行通过中间层短距离传递链身份信息，冻结的注意力头逐层读取链上更远位置，而父行注意力是该机制的关键。
AI.motivation: 预训练Transformer理论上能够实现更长的引用链跟踪（Sanford et al., 2024; Saunshi et al., 2025），但实际中仅能可靠跟踪约1.4-3.6行引用。增加预训练循环或扩大模型规模都无法显著改善这一缺陷。这表明模型权重中可能存在可被访问的更长计算，但默认行为未能触发它。本文旨在：(1)系统量化该失败；(2)通过微小修改激活潜在的计算能力；(4)理解冻结层中实际发生的计算过程。
AI.method: 本文采用一种残差流上的rank-8 LoRA（DiReFT形式），作用于单一层的输入：h ← sh + BAh，其中A∈ℝ^(8×n)，B∈ℝ^(n×8)，s为标量。在Qwen3-8B中仅训练65,537个参数（<0.01%），其余权重全部冻结。训练目标为答案交叉熵加上KL(p₀‖p_M)的WikiText-103惩罚。研究方法包括：(1) 13个标准基础模型（Qwen3、Llama、OLMo-3、Gemma-3系列）和3个循环模型（Ouro-1.4B/2.6B、Huginn-0125）的系统评估；(2) 通过恢复性干预、线性探针和注意力切割进行因果分析；(3) 使用层级扫描识别最优干预位置，并基于冻结模型的"截止层"预测预注册测试中的位置限制。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B在24行链上的精确准确率从15.5%提升至99%（200个程序中198个正确），更长训练的LoRA可达50行。Ouro-1.4B在4次循环后达到60行，8次循环后达到至少160行（160行准确率87%）。Huginn在16次循环后达到58行。机制分析揭示：(1) LoRA在中间层启动一个"接力"，程序行通过短距离中段层传递链身份信息；(2) 注意力逐步从父行读取扩展到更早行（Qwen3-8B的注意力距离从1行逐步增长到7行）；(3) 移除父行注意力会阻止接力，而移除更远距离的注意力会降低可达长度；(4) 干预位置至关重要——必须在中段层窗口之前（Qwen3-8B的层14-20，OLMo的层12-15），过晚则失效；(5) 冻结模型的截止层测量在4个保留模型中的3个正确定位了位置限制。在MuSiQue上，最早层的LoRA带来11.4-17.9点的精确匹配提升，仅占全层projection LoRA增益的大部分。
AI.conclusion: 默认的直接回答弱化了Transformer通过上下文引用所能达到的计算深度。本文通过单一层的rank-8 LoRA（约0.01%参数）将引用链可达长度扩展25倍以上，揭示了预训练权重中本就存在的中间层接力机制。核心发现包括：(1) 一个微小的表征编辑即可激活显著更长的上下文计算；(2) 该计算发生在冻结的中间层中，通过父行注意力头传递链身份；(3) 干预位置必须早于模型特定的层截止点；(4) 该机制可迁移到MuSiQue等多跳问答任务。该工作意味着评估应区分默认行为与通过特定干预可访问的计算；对适应而言，位置决定了有用计算能否跟随变化；对推理而言，循环和重入通过重复承载接力的层来帮助。这为设计师可能为下游部署定位一个极小但有效的编辑以释放冻结权重中的计算提供了系统方法。

title: SAKI: Maximal-Coupling-Routed Teacher Supervision for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-test state mismatch by training a student on its own generated trajectories, but weak students may visit teacher-misaligned prefixes where supervision is less representative. We introduce SAKI (Supervision Allocation with KL-constrained Interpolation), which combines a KL-constrained teacher-guided rollout with maximal coupling and reuses realized accept/correction events to route token-level supervision. Accepted positions retain sampled-token reverse-KL supervision, while correction positions receive direct supervision on the teacher's highest-probability token. Under maximal coupling, the correction probability is exactly TV(p_t, q_t), so the same trust-region radius controls rollout deviation and upper-bounds intervention and specialized-supervision frequency. We further implement an engine-resident speculative verifier that preserves the exact-q trajectory distribution and coupling semantics while improving matched-workload rollout throughput by 4.22x. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SAKI improves the matched teacher-guided baseline in Mean@8 and Pass@8 for both 1.7B and 0.6B students. Placement controls and fixed-prefix analysis further support correction-triggered routing as a conflict-adaptive supervision signal.

AI.tldr: SAKI提出了一种基于最大耦合的内生监督路由机制，用于在线策略蒸馏（OPD）。通过将TRB的几何插值策略通过最大耦合实现，并利用耦合的接受/修正事件自动路由token级监督：在接受位置保留采样的反向KL监督，在修正位置切换为对教师argmax token的直接监督。该方法在七个数学推理基准测试上对0.6B和1.7B学生模型均优于TRB基线，并提出了4.22倍加速的引擎内推测验证器。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏虽然缓解了状态分布不匹配问题，但弱学生可能访问与教师不对齐的前缀，导致教师在这些本不常生成的状态上提供监督信号，代表性不足。现有方法如TRB仅改进了rollout分布（行为侧），但未解决目标侧问题——是否在不同位置应使用相同的监督目标。
AI.method: SAKI包含三个核心组件：（1）通过最大耦合实现TRB几何插值策略q_t，耦合概率精确等于TV(p_t,q_t)，受KL信任域约束控制；（2）将接受/修正事件作为内生监督路由器——接受位置使用采样token的RKL监督，修正位置使用教师Top-1 token的直接监督（硬标签负对数似然）；（3）引擎内推测块验证器，保持精确q分布的同时实现4.22倍吞吐量加速。
AI.result: 在七个数学推理基准（MATH-500、HMMT-Feb26、AIME 2026/2025、AMC 2023、Minerva Math、OlympiadBench）上，1.7B学生Mean@8/Pass@8从TRB的27.9/44.6提升至29.0/47.5（+1.1/+2.9），0.6B学生从17.2/33.6提升至18.4/35.6（+1.2/+2.0）。SAKI在14个学生-基准对中的13个上Mean@8超越TRB。放置控制实验表明，基于耦合修正的路由优于随机放置（+0.7 Mean@8）和TV加权放置。固定前缀分析显示，修正触发的教师模式监督建立了持久的教师对齐，在最高冲突四分位上获得最大增益（+1.07pp for C_16）。
AI.conclusion: SAKI通过最大耦合的内生路由机制，有效地将token级监督与rollout构造解耦，同时在两个学生规模上实现了最佳的在线策略蒸馏性能。理论上，耦合的修正概率精确等于TV距离且被信任域约束；实践上，耦合修正作为冲突自适应的路由信号，且教师模式监督建立了超越训练阶段的持久学生-教师对齐。引擎内推测验证器为在线教师引导的rollout提供了4.22倍的实际加速，使该方法的计算开销可控。

title: Multi-Channel Mitigation of Source-Trust Shortcuts in Fact-Checking RL Agents
summary: Retrieval-augmented fact-checkers often receive a reliability label, such as HIGH or LOW trust, for each evidence source. These labels should adjust the model's confidence and its decision to search for more evidence, while the verdict should follow the evidence content. We introduce TrustSwap, a counterfactual test that swaps, lowers, or removes source labels while keeping every evidence text fixed, and measures its three output channels (the verdict, the confidence, and the search decision) separately. Across untrained and RL-trained models at two scales, three datasets, and two prompts, confidence and search respond to the labels as intended in 49 of 50 comparisons, yet a label change alone alters 4-23% of confident verdicts for Qwen3 models and up to 50% for an existing RL-trained fact-checker. Standard GRPO fine-tuning amplifies this shortcut at 8B in all six settings. To reduce it, we propose trust-swap augmentation (TSA), which trains GRPO on each claim with both its original and its label-swapped evidence under the same gold verdict. At 4B, TSA lowers the verdict flip rate by 7-35% (relative) in four of six settings, keeps accuracy and the intended confidence and search responses, outperforms reward-based alternatives in the main setting, and carries over to an unseen label-removal perturbation. An added consistency reward helps on the trained-on swap but not on unseen perturbations. At 8B, TSA's effect is not detectable, which makes scale the main open question.

AI.tldr: 本文针对事实核查模型中源信任标签(HIGH/LOW)被错误用于决定判定结果的问题，提出TrustSwap诊断测试和trust-swap augmentation (TSA)训练方法，发现RL微调会放大该捷径，TSA在4B模型上有效但8B上不显著。
AI.motivation: 检索增强的事实核查系统会给证据源打上HIGH/LOW等可靠性标签，但这些标签可能被操纵（间接提示注入）或过时。理想契约应为：证据内容决定判定结果，标签仅调节置信度和搜索决策。然而模型可能将信任标签当作判定捷径，导致仅标签变化就改变判定结果，且GRPO微调可能放大此捷径。
AI.method: 1) TrustSwap诊断测试：对证据包交换HIGH/LOW标签（保持文本不变），测量三个输出通道（判定翻转率、置信度变化、搜索决策变化）独立响应；2) TSA训练方法：对每个训练claim用原始证据和标签交换证据形成两个独立的GRPO rollout组，共享相同的 gold label；3) 对比trust-aware reward shaping和consistency reward等替代方案；在Qwen3-4B/8B两个规模、AVeriTeC/SciFact/CONFACT三个数据集、neutral/principled两种提示下评估。
AI.result: 诊断发现：在50次比较中49次置信度和搜索响应符合契约，但Qwen3模型的判定翻转率4-23%，Veri-R1最高达50%；GRPO微调在8B所有六个设置上都放大了捷径。TSA在4B上将翻转率降低7-35%（四个设置显著），保持准确率和有用的置信度/搜索响应，优于基于奖励的替代方案，并能泛化到未见过的标签移除扰动；TSA+consistency在训练过的交换上更强但在未见扰动上变差。在8B上TSA效果不显著，规模是主要未解问题。
AI.conclusion: 事实核查模型正确使用源信任标签来调节置信度和搜索，但错误地将其用于判定结果；GRPO微调可放大此捷径。TSA在4B规模上有效减少该捷径而不损害准确率或有用的信任响应，并泛化到未见扰动。扩展到更大模型和减少判定反转是TrustSwap使可测量的主要开放问题。

title: Neural Structural Reasoner: A Brain-inspired Architecture for Reasoning over Structured Knowledge
summary: Structural reasoning, the ability to recognize and make inferences over the relational structure between objects and concepts, is a hallmark of human cognition, yet prevailing methods often collapse relational topology into flat embeddings, cannot discover hidden structure and lack interpretability. We introduce Neural Structural Reasoner (NSR), a brain-inspired network that preserves relational structure directly in the connectivity and dynamics of coupled neuronal populations. NSR draws inspiration from three biological mechanisms: multi-layered architecture for encoding hierarchical knowledge, stable representations of entity and concepts, and path integration for input-driven state inference. At query time, NSR parallelizes computation over candidate relational structures and leverages confidence-weighted scores to perform link prediction. Across standard knowledge-graph benchmarks, NSR achieves competitive accuracy without leading on every dataset, and has lower reported training times than several neural baselines. Because reasoning is implemented through sequences of human-readable neuron activations, NSR affords native interpretability by tracking intermediate inference steps. The model further extracts latent relational hierarchies and compositional rules, demonstrating the brain-inspired architecture as an effective, efficient, and highly interpretable substrate for structural reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Neural Structural Reasoner (NSR)，一种受大脑启发的神经网络架构，用于知识图谱上的结构推理。其核心思想是将关系结构直接编码到神经元群体的连接与动力学中，而非将其压缩为平面嵌入向量，从而同时实现知识图谱链接预测、推理过程可追溯性和潜在关系结构的发现。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱推理方法（包括知识图谱嵌入、图神经网络和大型语言模型）存在两个共性缺陷：(1) 将丰富的结构信息压缩为平面向量表示，丢失了关系拓扑；(2) 推理过程不透明，难以验证且在深度多步推理中容易失效。作者受大脑中海马-内嗅皮层系统（认知地图）、前额叶皮层（层级抽象）和稳定概念表征等神经机制的启发，试图构建一个既可扩展又能原生提供可解释推理轨迹的结构推理架构。
AI.method: NSR 采用四层双向耦合的神经元群体：实体层 L_E、关系层 L_R（含逆关系编码）、关系推理层 L_Z（编码头实体与关系的关联）和关系组合层 L_C（编码多跳链式组合）。核心机制包括：(1) 通过固定连接和 Sigmoidal 门控动力学实现路径积分启发的状态转移；(2) 通过 Hebbian 式（Oja 规则）学习抽取关系等价性、对称性、逆关系和多跳组合规则；(4) 推理时分五个步骤完成：检索等价关系、单跳推理、检索等价组合、多跳推理、路径支持分数聚合（max 或 sum）。作者还提供了静态知识图谱的离线闭式加速实现。
AI.result: 在 Nations、Kinship、YAGO3-10、FB15k-237 四个标准基准测试中，NSR 取得有竞争力的准确率（并非每项最优），训练时间显著低于多个神经基线；在需要多跳推理的 Countries S3 和组合推理压力测试 Kinship1990_EXTENDED 上达到最优 MRR（分别为 1.0000 和 0.9533）；在 Nations 上通过 L_Z 层投影的 PCA 可视化自动涌现出符合冷战政治阵营划分的实体聚类结构。消融实验表明逆关系编码、关系等价检索、组合推理和 Hebbian 学习四个机制各有不可替代的功能。
AI.conclusion: NSR 通过将关系结构保留在分层网络的连接中而非压缩为平面嵌入，在标准基准上实现了具有竞争力的、数据集相关的准确率，同时其推理动力学原生暴露人类可读的推理轨迹，并能自发发现可解释的潜在结构（关系间的组合规则和实体间的关系相似性）。这些特性使其成为迈向高效且可解释结构推理模型的一步；未来工作需扩展到时序、超关系、事件型或含噪的真实知识，并结合神经模块从文本或感知中提取关系结构。

title: DualTrack: Synchronized speech-gesture generation via symmetric coupling of pretrained priors
summary: Joint speech-gesture synthesis must coordinate two modalities despite limited paired data. Existing approaches often lack bidirectional interaction, have limited language coverage, or simplify body and finger representations. We present DualTrack, which couples pretrained speech and motion priors on a shared 12.5 Hz timeline. Causal adapters exchange previous-packet information, while current-state fusion coordinates the streams before they separately complete sixteen-codebook packets. We evaluate 43 BEAT2 recordings in four languages, with speakers held out from joint training and validation. On the shared English/Spanish inputs, without speech or motion prefixes, DualTrack achieves lower word error rate and full-motion Fréchet Gesture Distance, higher beat consistency and speech naturalness than the evaluated GELINA baseline.

AI.tldr: DualTrack提出了一种联合语音-手势合成框架，通过对称耦合预训练语音模型(Qwen3-TTS)和自建的运动先验(MotionPrior)，在共享的12.5Hz时间线上实现双向因果历史交换和当前状态融合(Tick Fusion)，在BEAT2多语言测试集上优于GELINA基线。
AI.motivation: 联合语音-手势合成面临三大挑战：(1)现有方法多为级联式单向(仅语音引导动作),缺乏双向跨模态交互;(2)多语言能力有限;(3)身体表征常简化手指等细节。已有对齐语音-动作语料数据少且多样性不足,难以独立训练各模态。
AI.method: 1)将SeMoCo分词器适配到UMR499体手指运动,生成1个语义码+15个运动学码的16码包,12.5Hz;2)MotionPrior:两层级自回归模型(语义Transformer+全历史Transformer+Depth GPT),在大规模运动数据上预训练后适配BEAT2;3)DualTrack耦合:残差适配器交换上一包历史(运动→语音、语音→运动),Tick Fusion融合当前语音状态与运动语义状态,两流并行自回归完成各自的16码包。训练分阶段冻结/解冻不同模块。
AI.result: 在BEAT2四个语言43条记录(22英、9中、6日、6西)上:英语DualTrack†相比GELINA将WER从18.09%降至3.45%,NMOS从2.709升至3.830,Full FGD从7.513降至6.889,包含手指的完整运动多样性从2.651升至11.499(GT为16.085);西班牙语WER从215.09%降至0.00%;消融实验证实残差适配器和Tick Fusion对FGD、节拍一致性、NMOS均有贡献;15人用户研究在三项主观评分上均优于GELINA。
AI.conclusion: DualTrack通过双向历史交换和当前状态融合将独立的语音和运动预训练生成器对称耦合,在多语言、含手指细节的语音-手势联合生成上实现了优于GELINA的节奏对齐、语音自然度和运动质量;其因果包接口天然支持流式生成,未来工作将聚焦于增量解码与低延迟实时合成。

title: Semantic Projection for Continual Self-Evolution of Language Agents
summary: Language-model agents increasingly rely on persistent natural-language skills to adapt beyond their frozen model parameters. When a shared skill is repeatedly revised from a non-stationary, heterogeneous task stream, however, improvements for new tasks can overwrite procedures needed for earlier ones. In continual learning, Orthogonal Gradient Descent (OGD) addresses analogous interference by projecting a new-task gradient onto a subspace that locally preserves prior predictions. Natural-language skill revisions, however, have neither gradients nor a canonical vector space in which such a projection can be performed. We introduce \emph{Semantic-Scope Projected Evolution} (SSPE), which transfers the functional principle of gradient projection from parameter space to behavior space. SSPE treats an unconstrained skill revision as a proposed update, identifies acquired capabilities with which it may interfere, and uses the observed gains and regressions to construct a compatible revision rather than merely rejecting the update. This enables one shared skill to evolve across latent and recurring task contexts without exposing semantic domain identities to the evolution model. Across controlled synthetic streams and heterogeneous real-agent benchmarks, SSPE improves final cross-domain competence and mitigates forgetting relative to strong skill-evolution baselines. The evolved skill also retains the strongest average performance after transfer to a different executor model. These results establish semantic projection as a promising principle for stable and adaptive self evolution of language agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SSPE，将持续学习中正交梯度下降（OGD）的"投影保稳定"思想从参数空间迁移到语言智能体共享自然语言技能的"行为空间"，通过能力记忆、风险导向审计和语义修复迭代构造兼容的历史无干扰更新，从而缓解异构任务流中的"程序性灾难性遗忘"。
AI.motivation: 大模型智能体常通过持久化自然语言技能实现自进化，但共享技能在非平稳异构任务流中被反复修订时，新任务的改进可能覆写早期任务所需的过程，引发"程序性灾难性遗忘"。现有的纯当前域验证只能拒绝局部较差编辑，无法暴露缺失能力上的回归，也无法在保留新收益的同时修复旧能力。现有文本优化器（TextGrad、SkillGrad、SkillOpt等）大多在单任务分布下发展，缺乏针对异构流的稳定性机制。
AI.method: 1）形式化持续技能进化：将流视为对潜在能力上下文𝒞的混合变化，定义能力影响Δc(S';St)与"程序性干扰/遗忘"；2）能力记忆Γ：维护不可变微胶囊并整合为能力胶囊h，指向不透明审计任务库Vh；3）非受限修订𝒫 + 风险路由ℛ+𝒮：先生成无约束修订Ŝt与范围预测σ̂t，按风险评分挑选历史能力并额外随机选一个"预测安全"的能力；4）语义投影Πsem（LLM推理算子）：在固定套件𝕍t上配对评估，迭代重写修订以同时保留当前增益与历史能力，最多K_proj轮（默认1），通过则提交，否则保留父技能；5）适配性：接受匿名整合边界，不暴露领域标识。整体流程见Algorithm 1。
AI.result: 受控合成实验（11,300 paired worlds，覆盖能力数K、批次数m、干扰λ、作用域误差ε、投影成功率p_proj、连续/循环流等）：SSPE在最终宏观能力上较SkillGrad提升+0.3211，累积前预增奖励+0.09345，遗忘降低55.84%，有害更新率降低0.3899（仅付出即时增益-0.02864的稳定性-塑性权衡）。实际异构流（SpreadsheetBench→SearchQA→BFCL→DocVQA，各40任务、batch=8，GPT-5.4执行与进化，80 held-out任务评估）：SSPE平均77.50%，优于Static(72.50%)、SkillGrad(74.06%)、SkillOpt(73.13%)，并在BFCL(+20)、DocVQA(+5)上优势最大。跨模型迁移至GPT-4.1：SSPE仍为最强(63.75%)，显示学习到可迁移的程序性指引。消融：移除历史能力证据（SSPE-NoHistory）平均降至73.44%，增大K_proj∈{2,5}在GPT-5.4与GPT-4.1上均不优于K_proj=1（甚至下降），因后续候选均未被采纳。定性案例（BFCL多轮车控任务）：SSPE因含"满足前提后重试+执行挂起动作而非描述"的指令而获6/6回合前缀正确，SkillGrad 5/6，SkillOpt 1/6。
AI.conclusion: SSPE将OGD"保留兼容进度、剔除改变受保护行为的分量"的不变量从参数几何迁移到行为空间：先以塑料性生成当前域提案，再用范围推理与选择性历史审计暴露真实行为冲突，最后构造一个同时保留当前收益与历史能力的相容技能，而非仅作接受-拒绝门控。在受控仿真、四个异构真实基准以及跨执行模型迁移上，SSPE均产出最强最终共享技能；消融证实历史行为证据是必要约束，而语义投影使该约束成为建设性反馈。局限在于固定任务序、有限域集合与LLM采样的不可种性，需在开放域、循环/交错流及顺序鲁棒性上进一步研究。

title: Distilling Agentic Systems: A Roadmap across Models, Artifacts, and Harnesses
summary: Modern agents increasingly rely on memories, tools, and execution logic, so their competence extends beyond model parameters. This shift exposes a limitation of conventional knowledge distillation, which asks how a student model imitates a teacher model. We define Agent Distillation as the persistent transfer of task-solving knowledge from a teacher agent to a student agent. Our study organizes the field by where transferred knowledge is retained: within the model, as artifacts, through the execution harness, or across substrates. This perspective separates transfer evidence from its outcome and clarifies how knowledge moves between agent components. We develop an evaluation framework that relates retention to causal contribution and deployed utility. Together, these contributions establish a foundation for the reliable, maintainable, and safe development of increasingly complex agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次将蒸馏概念从模型层面拓展到完整的智能体层面，提出了"智能体蒸馏"（Agent Distillation）的统一定义：以教师智能体到学生智能体之间任务解决知识的持久性转移为核心，围绕知识保留的三大基底（参数化模型、可复用工件、执行调度框架）建立分类体系，并涵盖跨基底迁移与混合实现，同时配套提出了一套基于获取证据、效用、忠实度与泛化、安全与可维护性的评估框架，为复杂智能体系统的可靠开发奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 传统知识蒸馏主要处理"模型模仿模型"，但现代LLM智能体的能力已延伸至模型参数之外（记忆、工具、执行逻辑），需要将蒸馏单元从模型扩展到完整智能体实现，以支持高效部署、能力开放获取与智能体自我演化。
AI.method: 论文将智能体形式化为 A=(M,R,H) 三元组（参数化模型 M、可复用工件 R、执行调度框架 H），提出以"知识基底"（knowledge substrate）为中心的分类法。核心方法：（1）基于教师执行轨迹 τ_T 提取可迁移知识 K_T；（2）通过信息瓶颈原理定义充分性与最小性目标函数；（3）按知识最终持久化所在基底分为参数化蒸馏（细分为语言蒸馏、轨迹蒸馏、在策略蒸馏、智能体在策略蒸馏）、工件蒸馏（从情景记忆到抽象程序再到可执行工具的递进）及工件库演化）、调度框架蒸馏（从可执行工作流到条件路由再到验证恢复再到多智能体编排）；（4）跨基底迁移以3×3源-目的矩阵建模，分内部化（R/H→M）与外部化（M→R/H）及编译（R→H）与结晶（H→R）；（5）评估采用声明元组 C=(s,d,E_T,Φ,Z_S) 并结合随机干预、交叉模型-调度框架设计与混合协同度量。
AI.result: 论文系统梳理了智能体蒸馏的完整理论框架与文献版图，明确区分了教师证据与保留知识、转移机制与目标基底，并提供了面向参数的ProcessBench/SkillsBench/HarnessBench/MultiAgentBench等基准的声明对齐解读。提出了从内在目的地质量、因果贡献到在策略系统效用的评估方法学，包括保真度干预、子过程去除、跨组件交换等控制协议；阐明了无单一基底普适最优的结论，强调各基底在自包含执行、可编辑性、显式控制之间各有取舍。
AI.conclusion: 智能体蒸馏应被视为一个新兴的系统学科，连接知识迁移、经验复用与智能体架构设计。其长期目标不是生产模仿教师的小模型，而是构建在部署约束下、以恰当基底保留恰当知识的学生智能体。该领域未来需在因果性基底归属、环境变化下的可重复性、跨基底联合设计、知识生命周期管理与安全治理、以及支持累积进步的共享基础架构等方面取得突破，方能实现更强大、可控且可维护的智能体系统。

title: RankBuffer: Efficient Ranking-Based Rewards for Open-Ended Generation
summary: Open-ended generation lacks canonical answers, making pointwise rewards difficult to calibrate for group-based reinforcement learning. Directly ranking same-query rollouts provides a more suitable relative reward signal, but existing ranking-based reward methods can incur substantial judging cost. We introduce RankBuffer, which maintains an ordered, query-specific buffer of previously judged responses as a reusable quality scale. Each rollout is first inserted into an anchor interval through an independent coarse judgment, after which only rollouts assigned to the same interval undergo local fine ranking. The resulting complete order is converted into bounded rank rewards, while boundary expansion, local refinement, and inactive-anchor pruning adapt the buffer as the policy evolves. Across four open-ended benchmarks, RankBuffer consistently outperforms all pointwise baselines. It also achieves nearly on-par performance with the strongest ranking-based reward baseline while substantially reducing judging cost. Ablations demonstrate the importance of both local fine ranking and anchor response content, while buffer analyses show that rollout-derived anchors progressively extend and refine the covered quality scale. These results establish response reuse as an effective approach to efficient relative reward construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RankBuffer，一种基于缓冲区的粗到细排序框架，通过维护针对每个查询的有序已评估响应缓冲池作为质量参照系，结合并行粗排序与选择性局部细排序，为开放生成任务中的GRPO组强化学习构建相对奖励，显著降低评判成本。
AI.motivation: 开放生成任务缺乏标准答案，使点式奖励难以校准，导致GRPO中组内优势信号区分度不足；现有基于排序的奖励方法（如锦标赛、循环赛、成对比较）虽提供更合适的相对信号，但评判成本高昂，亟需在接近点式方法成本下获得排序型奖励。
AI.method: RankBuffer维护针对每个查询的有序锚点缓冲区作为可复用的质量标尺；新推理结果通过与锚点的单次独立粗排序插入相应区间，仅对同一区间内的多推理结果执行局部细排序；拼接得到完整排序后映射为有界秩奖励；通过边界扩张、局部细化与不活跃锚点剪枝三类规则化机制随训练进程演化缓冲区。
AI.result: 在四个开放生成基准（AlpacaEval 2、Arena-Hard v2、WildBench v2、WritingBench）上，RankBuffer一致优于所有点式基线（平均提升3.83分），与最强排序型奖励基线RRC-SCR性能相当但评判令牌减半以上；消融实验验证了局部细排序与锚点内容的重要性，缓冲区分析显示策略生成的锚点随训练逐步扩展并精细化所覆盖的质量标尺。
AI.conclusion: RankBuffer确立了响应复用作为构建高效相对奖励的有效途径，无需训练独立奖励模型即可在GRPO框架下以接近点式方法的评判成本获得高质量排序型奖励信号。

title: FineSID: Scalable and Efficient Semantic Identifier Learning for Generative Recommendation
summary: A critical prerequisite of generative recommendation is designing semantic identifiers (SIDs) that are both scalable to large item sets and efficiently learnable. Existing SID learning methods fundamentally rely on Top-1 hard assignment during vector quantization. While heuristic strategies -- such as clustering-based initialization or forced post-hoc collision resolution -- can artificially inflate codebook coverage, they often disrupt end-to-end semantic alignment and fail to address the underlying optimization bottleneck: sparse gradient propagation. In standard Top-1 assignment, gradients concentrate on a narrow subset of frequently selected codewords, leaving the majority inherently under-trained and causing severe SID collisions. To overcome this limitation natively without relying on complex initialization priors, we propose FineSID, a unified quantization framework that moves beyond Top-1 assignment by enabling fine-grained gradient propagation across the entire codebook. Instead of updating only a single selected codeword, FineSID distributes learning signals to all codewords in a soft, differentiable manner. This design promotes globally balanced codebook optimization while strictly preserving semantic consistency, effectively alleviating SID collisions and stabilizing training in large, high-dimensional codebooks. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that FineSID is robust to initialization configurations and consistently improves both codebook utilization and recommendation accuracy. Our work provides a principled, initialization-agnostic solution for semantic identifier learning, advancing the practicality of generative recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FineSID，一个用于生成式推荐的语义标识符（SID）学习框架，通过超越Top-1硬分配的细粒度梯度传播，解决现有向量量化方法中梯度稀疏导致的码本崩溃和SID冲突问题。
AI.motivation: 现有SID学习方法依赖Top-1硬分配进行向量量化，导致梯度仅集中在少数频繁被选中的码字上，大部分码字训练不足，产生严重的SID冲突。传统的启发式策略（如K-means初始化或事后碰撞解决）虽能暂时缓解症状，但破坏了端到端的语义对齐，无法从根本上解决优化瓶颈。生成式推荐需要SID同时满足可扩展性（低冲突率适应大规模物品）和效率（轻量级自回归解码）两大需求。
AI.method: FineSID包含两个核心组件：（1）全局-局部量化（GLQ），由局部精化量化（LRQ）通过softmax软分配实现全码本的密集梯度流，以及全局锚点量化（GAQ）通过EMA频率跟踪动态平衡码字更新率；（2）量化语义一致性模块（QSCM），通过双向对齐损失（硬量化表示与连续嵌入之间）防止语义漂移。前向传播使用硬分配（来自GAQ），反向传播通过直通估计器（STE）路由软概率梯度（来自LRQ），既保持离散标识符的严格性，又实现全局优化。整体损失包含排序损失、GLQ损失和QSCM损失三部分。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准数据集（Musical Instruments、Industrial Scientific、Video Games）上的实验表明，FineSID在Recall@5/10和NDCG@5/10上均显著优于现有SID学习方法（如TIGER、LETTER、SaviorRec、CAR等），统计显著性达p<10^{-4}。关键发现包括：（1）训练时间比最强基线CAR减少超过50%；（3）码本利用率在不同码本大小下均保持最优；（4）对初始化策略具有鲁棒性（随机初始化甚至优于聚类初始化）；（5）在长尾物品上的性能提升尤为显著，缓解了流行度偏差。
AI.conclusion: FineSID通过全局细粒度梯度传播和语义一致性约束，在保持离散标识符兼容性的同时，实现了码本均衡利用和高语义保真度，为大规模生成式推荐提供了一个原则性的、与初始化无关的SID学习解决方案。未来工作可扩展至跨域设置并整合自然语言指令以实现更可控的推荐。

title: FairDiff: Mitigating the Self-Reinforcing Matthew Effect in Diffusion Recommender Models
summary: While the "Matthew Effect" and filter bubbles are widely recognized outcome-level biases in recommender systems, we reveal that Diffusion Recommender Models (DRMs) uniquely compound this issue through their generative dynamics. Rather than merely inheriting data imbalances, DRMs trigger a self-reinforcing amplification of popularity bias. We identify that this phenomenon is driven by two compounding mechanisms. First, while optimization loss is universally dominated by high-frequency items across recommenders, DRMs suffer from a unique structural prior mismatch during generation. Because the forward terminal distribution of long-tailed data deviates significantly from the standard Gaussian prior, reverse sampling trajectories inherently collapse toward high-density popular items, fundamentally suppressing niche item generation. To dismantle this self-reinforcing loop, we propose FairDiff, a plug-and-play fairness-aware diffusion framework. To overcome the popularity-dominated loss, we introduce Popularity Condition Guidance (PCG). Rather than altering the training objective, PCG acts as an inference-time distributional reweighting mechanism, mathematically reshaping the score-based gradient field to penalize high-popularity regions and guide trajectories toward niche semantics. Furthermore, we design a Semantic Calibration (SC) Module to bridge the prior mismatch, aligning the forward and reverse distributions via one-step optimal transport. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that FairDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance while effectively mitigating the self-reinforcing Matthew Effect, highlighting its value as a general framework for DRMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FairDiff框架，针对扩散推荐模型(DRMs)中独特的"自我强化马太效应"进行公平性干预。通过Popularity Condition Guidance (PCG) 和 Semantic Calibration (SC) 两个模块，在推理时干预反向扩散过程，无需修改训练目标即可同时提升推荐准确性和长尾公平性。
AI.motivation: 现有的"马太效应"研究主要将其视为结果级偏差，但作者发现扩散推荐模型(DRMs)通过其生成动力学独特地加剧了流行度偏差——不仅继承数据不平衡，还通过两个正交机制自我放大：(1)训练阶段优化损失被高频物品主导；(2)生成阶段结构先验不匹配导致反向采样轨迹偏向高密度流行物品。
AI.method: FairDiff包含两个即插即用模块：(1) Popularity Condition Guidance (PCG)——将流行度作为独立引导信号，通过线性插值流行度无关与流行度感知的噪声预测，重塑得分梯度场，在推理时对流行度进行重加权；(2) Semantic Calibration (SC)——通过一步静态最优传输(OT)将标准高斯噪声映射到经验前向终端分布，对齐前向-反向分布的初始偏差，同时支持截断采样以加速推理。理论证明PCG等价于从重加权分布采样，SC提供正确的前向-反向分布初始化对齐。
AI.result: 在7个数据集(Beauty, Toys, Steam, ML-1M, TikTok, Baby, Sports)上对多种骨干模型(DiffuRec, DreamRec, CDiff4Rec)进行评估，FairDiff在所有指标上一致达到最优且统计显著(p<10^{-4})。具体而言，FairDiff将效用指标Recall@10和NDCG@10提高，同时降低消费者差异(ΔRecall, ΔNDCG)、改善供应商公平性(ΔExp)和长尾覆盖率(APLT)。在冷启动物品上增益最显著(CDiff4Rec+FairDiff冷物品H@20从2.87→6.45)，且训练和推理时间均减少约50%(得益于截断采样)。理论分析严格证明两种偏差的正交性和组合性，并通过KL散度量化验证SC将前向-反向分布差异从10.6447降至0.2475。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了DRMs中马太效应的独特生成根源，提出FairDiff作为通用公平感知扩散框架，证明公平性与效用可以通过原则性的生成扩散轨迹控制共同实现，而非通过后处理重新加权或准确性-公平性权衡。FairDiff可无缝集成于顺序、多模态、跨域推荐等多种任务，具有广泛的适用性和即插即用特性。

title: MLToolBench: Learning Tool-Augmented Agents for Machine Learning Development
summary: Machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made substantial progress, but learning through ML experimentation remains costly in time and computation. Synthetic environments reduce these costs while introducing variations in data and experimental settings that require task-specific diagnosis. Access to diagnostic tools alone does not ensure that agents learn when to use them or how to act on their findings. We introduce ToolMLBench, a suite of executable tools for data inspection, code verification, and experiment diagnosis, together with an SFT and RL pipeline for learning their use. Diagnostic calls acquire evidence whose value depends on subsequent decisions, so final outcomes provide limited guidance on which calls to reinforce. We address this challenge with SPICE, which measures how privileged context changes the likelihood of a sampled tool action and uses this difference as a turn-level reward alongside the final outcome. We train on 80 synthetic tasks and evaluate on 25 in-domain and 10 out-of-domain tasks. Providing tool interfaces and descriptions alone yields inconsistent gains across unadapted models. With the same diagnostic interface, our training pipeline raises in-domain success from 24.8% to 52.4% for Qwen3-8B and from 35.6% to 69.2% for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. The latter also improves from 31% to 48% out-of-domain, supporting learned diagnostic tool use on held-out sources and targets.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍MLToolBench，一个可执行诊断工具套件，结合SFT与RL训练流程，使机器学习工程(MLE)智能体学习何时及如何调用诊断工具以获取决策证据；提出SPICE方法通过特权解上下文下的对数似然差为工具调用提供轮级信用分配信号；在80个合成任务训练，在25个域内与10个域外任务上评估，使Qwen3-8B和Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的ID成功率分别从24.8%升至52.4%、从35.6%升至69.2%，且域外也有提升。
AI.motivation: MLE智能体在多步骤ML开发任务中常因忽视任务级诊断证据（如数据分布变化、预处理不当、评估条件差异）而失败；仅暴露诊断工具接口并不足以让智能体学会何时调用及如何利用结果，存在诊断证据获取与后续决策之间的信用分配难题。
AI.method: （1）MLToolBench：在MLAgentBench基础上构建67个诊断工具（数据检查、代码验证、实验诊断），覆盖表格、时序、NLP、视觉、图等模块，从失败轨迹中提炼并通过任务重跑验证；（2）指导式SFT：以LLM生成任务特定调查指导，由Gemini 3.6 Flash产生约6700条过滤后的演示轨迹，仅对助手令牌做下一词监督以冷启动工具使用；（3）RL+SPICE：采用GRPO式目标变式，将二元任务结果奖励与SPICE轮级奖励结合；SPICE利用冻结的同策略模型，对采样工具调用在加入与不加入已验证解摘要的条件下计算对数似然差，作为有符号轮级奖励。
AI.result: 在80训练/25 ID/10 OOD任务上，Qwen3-8B与Qwen3.5-35B-A3B经完整SFT+RL（Spice）后ID成功率分别从24.8%升至52.4%、35.6%升至69.2%；OOD从20%升至36%、31%升至48%；35B模型在匹配条件下优于纯结果RL与TIPS；SPICE比纯结果RL在8B/35B上ID提升13.2/21.2点；诊断观察遮蔽使35B成功率下降11.6–14.8点，表明诊断证据被有效利用；引导式Gemini ID/OOD分别达74.4%/65%。
AI.conclusion: MLToolBench与训练框架将诊断证据的可访问性与学习如何行动利用相连通；指导式SFT建立工具使用行为，SPICE在RL中提供动作级上下文支持信号；在受测合成套件上完整管线对两Qwen骨干在ID和OOD任务均有提升，匹配RL对比下SPICE优于纯结果训练；结果支持诊断工具学习，但对更广泛迁移与因果信度验证仍保持开放。

title: JudgeProfile: Understanding and Steering Subjectivity in LLM Judges
summary: LLM judges are inherently subjective, often favoring different responses in pairwise comparison when neither option is objectively wrong. To study this subjectivity, we introduce JudgeProfile, a framework that dissects LLM evaluation into perception (how a judge compares two responses across specific attributes like clarity, correctness, and detail) and prioritization (how much each attribute influences the final choice). We curate SubjectiveSet, a dataset of 50,013 response pairs from 17 public data sources, evaluated by 21 LLM judges across 87 attributes. We find a hidden consensus in perception: judges frequently agree on attribute judgments even when their overall choices diverge. Building on this separation, we first characterize each judge's prioritization using attribute weights estimated from its own overall choices. These weights differ across judges even when estimated from the same attribute judgments. We then learn new weights from reference labels to adapt their decisions to a target evaluation standard. Reweighting perceived attributes improves average held-out agreement with reference labels from 66.48% to 71.97%, outperforming fine-tuning and rubric prompting. Our findings show that understanding and steering the subjectivity of LLM judges requires attention not only to what they perceive, but also to how they prioritize it.

AI.tldr: 提出JudgeProfile框架，将LLM判断分解为感知（perception）与优先级排序（prioritization），通过SubjectiveSet数据集发现隐藏共识现象，并提出重加权（reweighting）方法以轻量化方式引导LLM评判的主观性。
AI.motivation: LLM评判者存在主观性差异，但驱动这些偏好的因素尚不清楚；现有研究通常将评判视为整体判断，无法区分感知差异与优先级差异。理解并引导LLM评判的主观性，对于构建可审计、可适配的评估系统至关重要。
AI.method: 构建SubjectiveSet数据集（50,013对响应，17个来源），由21个LLM评判者在87个属性上独立评估（双向呈现顺序，共1.827亿次推理调用）。使用有序一致属性方向估计每位评判者的逻辑斯谛权重，表征其优先级排序；提出重加权方法，即固定属性判断不变，仅学习新的属性权重以对齐目标参考标签。
AI.result: 1. 发现隐藏共识：评判者在选择不同获胜者时，属性层面的一致率仍达85.9%（人类研究为92.8%）。2. 优先级是另一主观性来源：即使属性判断一致，权重仍不同（平均Pearson相关0.609）。3. 重加权将平均参考标签一致性从66.48%提升至71.97%（21位评判者均提升），在低监督下优于LoRA微调和评分标准提示。
AI.conclusion: 理解并引导LLM评判的主观性需要同时关注其感知内容与优先级排序。JudgeProfile框架提供了可测量的分离方式，重加权作为一种轻量化方法，能在不更新模型的情况下有效适应不同评估标准。未来需探索上下文相关或非线性优先级模型。

title: Can AI Scientists Change Their Minds? Prior-Evidence Conflict in Synthetic Universes
summary: Can a scientific agent distinguish a law it inferred from evidence from one it merely recognizes? We introduce Synthetic Universes, a controlled benchmark that pairs canonical famous worlds with matched twisted twins governed by nearby noncanonical mechanisms. We evaluate each reported law twice: by executing it on held-out continuations and transfer settings, and by independently checking whether it recovers the generating mechanism. In the current checkpoint of a pre-specified 60-cell study, 22 trials were graded and one additional run ended in infrastructure failure. Among 20 twin trials, 8 pass predictive verification while 5 recover the generator. The dissociation is bidirectional: six parsable outputs predict successfully while missing the mechanism, whereas three recover the mechanism but fail predictive rollout. Drag exhibits the first pattern (5/5 predictive pass, 1/5 mechanism recovery); Gravity exhibits the second (1/5 predictive pass, 4/5 mechanism recovery). Because matched famous controls, the corrected identifiability sweep, and the Evidence Ladder remain incomplete, we do not claim a confirmatory causal prior-conflict effect. Instead, the completed runs establish a narrower verification result: predictive adequacy and mechanism recovery are distinct scientific claims and require distinct tests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Synthetic Universes"基准,将AI科学发现中的"预测验证"与"机制恢复"分离为两个独立检验维度。通过配对的"经典世界"与"扭曲孪生世界",在保持观察界面不变的同时改变生成机制,用以检验AI科学代理能否在先验知识与证据冲突时识别非经典机制。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统从假设生成走向实验执行与科学发现,验证成为瓶颈。一个核心问题在于:AI可能给出正确答案但出于错误原因——它可能真正从证据中推断了定律,也可能只是从预训练中识别并检索了熟悉答案。传统基准无法区分这两种情况,因此需要新的实验设计来操控"先验-证据一致性"作为变量。
AI.method: 核心方法为构建Synthetic Universes基准,包含六个物理家族(Spring、Gravity、Drag、Pendulum、Conservation、Coupling),每个家族配对一个经典机制(如F∝r⁻²)与扭曲孪生机制(如F∝r⁻²·³)。采用两轴评估:(1)预测通过——在留出延续与迁移轨迹上执行报告定律,以NRMSE<0.10为门槛;(2)机制恢复——独立检查报告定律是否匹配生成机制的功能形式。预指定60格矩阵(6家族×5种子×2条件),使用FreshAgent延迟交付子代理执行,配合BIC复杂度惩罚的偏差控制与Evidence Ladder证据干预设计。
AI.result: 在22个已评定试次(20个孪生+2个经典)中,两轴解离是双向的:(1)Drag家族表现"预测成功但机制错误"模式(5/5预测通过,仅1/5机制恢复),代理即使自身自由指数分析倾向超线性定律,仍因简洁性选择熟悉线性阻力;(2)Gravity家族表现"机制正确但预测失败"模式(4/5机制恢复,仅1/5预测通过),代理利用拱线进动正确拒绝p=2并估计p≈2.30,但长程积分失败。此外,Conservation与Coupling家族被发现存在基准设计缺陷(存在意外能量不变量、样本不足),被排除于主要分析。
AI.conclusion: 本文核心验证结论为:预测充分性≠机制恢复,二者是独立的科学声明,需要不同的检验。仅完成23/60格且经典对照不足,作者明确不主张确认性的"先验-证据冲突因果效应"。主要贡献为基准设计、执行基础的两轴验证器、基准/评估器失败的透明审计,以及观察到的预测-机制解离现象。未来工作包括完成匹配网格、偏差控制扫描与Evidence Ladder,以建立先验放弃的因果剂量-反应证据。

title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Agents increasingly build on code written by other agents, and they reimplement rather than reuse, growing the codebases later agents must work in. To measure how well agents design libraries for other agents, we introduce LibraryDesignBench, a two-phase benchmark in which an agent implements a full-featured library from a specification that defines required capabilities and potential use cases without prescribing the design. We evaluate the library through the correctness and simplicity of programs written by three user agents from different model families. The benchmark spans 242 expert-validated programming problems across 15 library-design tasks in four languages. On eleven of the fifteen tasks, agent designers reproduce the abstractions of the human-written production library. Downstream agents adopt agent- and human-written libraries alike but underuse them, reimplementing capabilities the library already provides. Our failure analysis finds that downstream agents write extra code mainly because agent-written libraries are rigid or hard to use, not because capabilities are missing. We also experiment with giving designers more prescriptive, agent-first guidance and having them test their library with subagents; this improves downstream scores and yields simpler programs. LibraryDesignBench provides both a testbed for evaluating library-design practices for agent users and an initial design baseline that improves downstream reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LibraryDesignBench——一个两阶段基准测试，通过观察下游智能体如何使用智能体设计的库来评估库的设计质量。该基准涵盖15个库设计任务和242个专家验证的编程问题，涉及4种编程语言。实验表明，最强的智能体设计师（Opus 5.5）得分比人工编写的生产库高2.3分，但在15个任务中有11个直接复用了生产库的抽象设计。下游智能体倾向于"重写而非复用"，64%的冗余代码源于库的接口僵化或难以使用，而非能力缺失。提供更具针对性的"agent优先"指导（让设计师先勾勒消费者程序、用子代理测试）能进一步提升分数，但仍略逊于生产库。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体越来越多地基于其他智能体编写的代码进行构建，它们往往选择"重新实现而非复用"，导致代码库不断膨胀。本研究旨在回答一个基础问题：智能体能否设计出对其他智能体真正有用的库？现有的库评估方法（测试套件、签名匹配、静态度量、人类评审）均无法衡量库在下游智能体实际使用中的价值。
AI.method: 1. 提出LibraryDesignBench两阶段评估框架：设计阶段由待评估的智能体根据非规范性规范（仅描述能力，不规定接口）实现完整库；评估阶段由三个不同模型家族的下游"使用者"智能体用该库完成编程任务。2. 评分公式为正确性（测试通过率的平方）与简洁性（相对参考方案的静态度量比率，包括圈复杂度、认知复杂度、Halstead体积、源代码行数）的乘积。3. 基准涵盖15个库任务、242个专家验证问题，覆盖Python、TypeScript、Rust、Haskell四种语言。4. 对810个部分通过方案进行失败分类审计，划分覆盖率、正确性、刚性、冗长性、可交付性等类别。5. 在LibraryUseBench中固定使用生产库评估8个模型的库利用能力，并测试不同的提示指令性与推理深度。7. 引入"neuralese"显式指导提示（让设计师先草拟消费者程序、用子代理测试），与无指导条件对比。
AI.result: 1. Opus 5.5以48.9分位列第一，超过生产库基线（46.6）2.3分（相对提升4.9%），Fable 5.1以47.5分紧随其后；DeepSeek V4 Pro表现最差（31.2），甚至低于无库条件（34.4）。2. 15个任务中有11个，智能体设计师复现了人类编写生产库的抽象设计。3. 失败分析显示：64%的冗余代码源于库的接口僵化或难以使用，仅14%源于能力缺失（覆盖率不足）。4. 即便使用生产库，下游智能体的简洁性也只有61.5分；Opus 5.5作为使用者得分66.9为最佳。5. 提高推理深度主要改善正确性，提高提示指令性主要改善库利用；高指令性使生产库导出名称重叠率从19.4%降至13.4%，分数提升2.3点，主要来自简洁性改善。6. 哈斯克尔语言是智能体设计库表现最差的领域。7. 下游智能体倾向用grep搜索已知API名称，未见过的符号往往被忽略；24%的最小提示试验甚至从未接触库。
AI.conclusion: 智能体能够设计出帮助其他智能体的库，且最强智能体的表现略优于人类编写的生产库，但这是因为它们直接复用了生产库的抽象设计，而非创造了更优的新设计。下游智能体普遍存在"重新实现而非复用"的问题，64%的失败源于接口刚性而非功能缺失，说明现有库的接口设计并不符合代码为人类理解而优化的传统设计哲学。为智能体设计库与为人类设计库是不同的、尚未解决的问题。LibraryDesignBench为研究哪些接口、抽象和文档有助于智能体间代码复用提供了测试平台，并提供了一个优于基线的初始设计参考。

title: BiFE: Search-Efficient Discovery of CPU-Only Branching Policies via LLM-based Bi-Fidelity Evolution
summary: In branch-and-bound (B&B) for mixed-integer linear programming (MILP), branching variable selection critically impacts efficiency. Existing neural branching policies often require GPU inference, while CPU-efficient symbolic expressions lack the representational capacity for complex logic. Large Language Model (LLM)-generated code provides a flexible search space for designing lightweight branching rules with diverse algorithmic logic. To discover effective rules within LLM-based evolutionary frameworks, a core challenge arises: full B&B evaluation on real instances is prohibitively expensive, whereas offline imitation learning suffers from distribution shift. To address this, we introduce a Bi-Fidelity Evolutionary framework (BiFE). It employs low-fidelity imitation scores as a rapid pre-screener and selectively applies high-fidelity on-instance evaluation only to elite candidates, effectively balancing search efficiency with performance reliability. Experiments validate both the search efficiency of BiFE and the competitiveness of its discovered rules, which outperform the SCIP solver and other baselines on CPUs, and even surpass certain GPU-based neural policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BiFE（双保真度进化框架），用于在LLM生成的代码空间中高效搜索仅需CPU的MILP分支策略。核心思路是以强分支模仿得分（低保真）作为快速预筛选，仅对精英候选执行昂贵的实例求解评估（高保真），从而平衡搜索效率与性能可靠性。实验表明BiFE发现的策略在多个标准与真实MILP基准上优于SCIP默认策略及其他CPU基线，甚至在部分基准上超越GPU神经分支策略，同时规则设计时间仅为LLM4Branch的1/4至1/20。
AI.motivation: 在MILP分支定界（B&B）中，分支变量选择对求解效率至关重要。现有神经分支策略依赖GPU推理，而CPU高效的符号表达式表达力有限；LLM生成代码虽提供丰富搜索空间，但在庞大代码空间中直接进行实例级B&B评估代价昂贵，而单纯离线模仿学习又因分布漂移无法保证最终性能。因此需要一种兼顾搜索效率与评估可靠性的进化搜索机制。
AI.method: 1) 将分支规则发现形式化为黑盒优化问题，最大化启发式在MILP实例集上的求解性能F_HF；2) 构造低保真代理F_LF：利用强分支演示数据计算候选规则对强分支决策的一致性（模仿正确率），成本极低但因强分支短视与分布漂移而不可靠；3) LLM基于初始化、交叉、变异三种操作生成规则代码；4) 精英优先进化机制：初始化后按F_LF取前α比例组成精英集并评估F_HF；迭代中将F_LF超过阈值τ（取自精英集中F_HF最差个体的F_LF）的新候选晋升为精英进行F_HF评估；父本选择与生存选择均优先考虑精英集（按F_HF排序），其余按F_LF排序。
AI.result: 在CA、SC、MIS、CFL四个标准基准及BIP、OTS、NNV三个真实世界基准上，BiFE在所有标准基准的测试实例上均取得CPU方法中的最佳求解时间，并在CA、CFL上超过GPU方法；迁移实例与真实基准（NNV、OTS）上同样领先CPU基线，并在NNV上超越GNN-GPU。规则设计时间相比LLM4Branch减少3.9×至20.6×，消融实验显示去除F_LF后设计时间增加1.7×至9.2×，而解规则性能无显著差异。统计检验证实BiFE在CFL与CA迁移实例上显著优于LLM4Branch。复杂度分析显示BiFE生成的规则在AST节点数、算子种类、非线性调用、分支结构等指标上均显著超过Symb4CO的符号规则。
AI.conclusion: BiFE通过双保真度评估分配机制，成功在LLM代码空间中高效发现兼具表达力、轻量性与可解释性的CPU分支策略，证实了LLM生成代码作为分支规则表示的潜力；当前局限在于发现的策略仍为基准特化，未来工作将致力于发现跨实例可泛化的LLM分支规则。

title: Distinguish or Homogenize: Last-Chance Policy Identification and Risk-Budgeted Recovery under Irreversible Resource Depletion
summary: Under irreversible resource depletion, an agent can spend resources to distinguish among latent fault models, or to change the system state so that the remaining models admit a common acceptable continuation--at which point further diagnosis becomes unnecessary. This distinguish-or-homogenize principle identifies a path that existing frameworks for identification, planning, and diagnosis do not make explicit: prior formulations treat the mapping from fault models to acceptable policies as a given, whereas LCPI makes it a function of the agent's own actions. We formalize this principle through Last-Chance Policy Identification (LCPI), where correctness is evaluated at the state the agent reaches rather than at the initial state. The Last Identifiable Margin (LIM) marks the feasibility boundary between distinguishing and homogenizing. For deterministic diagnostic graphs we provide the Exact-LIM recursion; for noisy finite-horizon recovery we propose Risk-Budgeted Compatibility Planning (RBCP), which searches a compatibility-aware frontier under a hard worst-case failure constraint. Across incident recovery on abstract microservice topologies and latent-damage navigation in MiniGrid, RBCP improves risk-feasible recovery while satisfying the failure budget. A sham control--cost-matched actions that preserve model incompatibility--eliminates the gain entirely, confirming that the benefit comes from changing which policies are acceptable for which models, not from extra search or additional budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"辨别或同质化"原则（distinguish-or-homogenize principle），形式化为最后机会策略识别（LCPI）框架：当诊断与干预竞争同一不可逆资源池时，智能体可以花费资源来区分潜在故障模型，或者改变系统状态使剩余模型共享同一可接受恢复策略；后者使进一步诊断变得不必要。引入最后可识别边界（LIM）作为可行性边界，并提出Exact-LIM（确定性诊断图）和风险预算兼容性规划（RBCP，含噪环境）两种算法。实验在微服务事故恢复和MiniGrid潜在损伤导航上证明RBCP的增益来自兼容性改变干预本身，而非额外搜索或预算。
AI.motivation: 现有框架（固定置信度识别、鲁棒规划、决策聚焦诊断）将"从故障模型到可接受策略"的映射视为给定，忽略了智能体自身行动可以改变这一映射的结构可能性。当诊断与恢复竞争同一不可逆资源时，这一缺口导致智能体无法显式权衡"花资源辨明故障"与"花资源使剩余故障共享同一恢复路径"。救援机器人、云计算事故代理、飞行员发动机告警等场景均面临此结构。
AI.method: 1) 形式化LCPI：正确性在"到达状态"评估而非初始状态；定义损失自主性（loss-of-agency）时刻与最后机会正确性；2) 引入LIM B*_δ = inf{b≥0: E*(b)≤δ} 作为可行性边界；3) 定理1（KL下界）：累积KL散度必须超过 kl(1-δ-g, δ)，其中g为抵达共识状态的概率质量——同质化降低的是"必须被识别的概率质量"而非"单位证据成本"；4) Exact-LIM：确定性诊断DAG上的AND/OR递归计算零误差恢复的最小资源；5) RBCP（算法1）：在深度L前沿搜索可达状态，配以置信集C_t、风险门max_θ F_θ ≤ δ、协调支配剪枝、认证回退（所有模型共享可接受续推时部署，否则选最小失败续推）。
AI.result: 在MIR（微服务事故恢复）和MLD（MiniGrid潜在损伤）两环境、确定性锁定与随机储备冲击两设置、资源裕度{2,...,8}下，以δ=0.10最差模式风险为门控：1) Q1：RBCP在四轴上均改善风险可行恢复，WM-S-AUC配对提升+0.0067至+0.3512，全部通过非劣性检验；2) Q2：基线失效模式各异——回退/minimax保持可行但成功低，DTT/ECD冲击轴WM-F达0.25–0.40，RC-POMDP约束在初始态不沿轨迹适配，Lagrangian标量化违反WM-F=0.32；3) Q3：no_hom消融使WM-S-AUC下降0.121–0.343，成本匹配的sham_hom重现完全相同下降——增益来自兼容性改变而非搜索/预算；4) Q4：MLD上向量资源表征比标量改善0.032–0.122（Holm调整p=0.0012），MIR上差异可忽略，因资源异质性程度不同。
AI.conclusion: 辨别或同质化原则填补了固定置信度识别、决策聚焦诊断、鲁棒规划之间的结构性缺口：策略映射本身可被干预重塑，LIM刻画该选择何时可行，且Exact-LIM/RBCP证明该选择在实践中可达。增益来源于机制本身而非额外搜索或预算（经sham控制证实）。当前局限：KL下界是必要非充分；Exact-LIM仅适用于确定性无环图；RBCP依赖估计接口、有限搜索深度与硬风险门。后续工作包括扩展理论至更丰富图结构与在线学习接口。

title: SIPO: Unifying Reinforcement Learning with On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for improving large language models (LLMs) on various tasks, yet its sparse outcome rewards lack token-level credit assignment for intermediate steps. To address this, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a self-teacher with privileged context to provide additional dense learning signals. However, because the self-teacher is often overconfident and imposes excessive penalties on long reasoning trajectories, OPSD frequently struggles in practice. To mitigate this, we propose self-instructing policy optimization (SIPO) with a contrastive self-teacher to provide dense credit. At each iteration, SIPO samples multiple rollouts per prompt from the current policy, scores them with environment rewards, and constructs two teacher contexts for each rollout by pairing the reference answer with mistakes made within the group. The model then re-evaluates its own responses under both contexts, using the difference between the two teacher log-probabilities as token-level feedback, so that biases shared by both contexts are expected to largely cancel. The resulting objective yields a token-level advantage for every rollout: the reward still sets the main direction of each update while the self-teacher redistributes credit across tokens. Even in groups where every rollout fails and group-relative advantages vanish, SIPO still provides a learning signal. By preserving direct optimization of the task reward while providing dense, token-level feedback, this approach bridges reinforcement learning and on-policy self-distillation. Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning and code-generation benchmarks demonstrate that SIPO outperforms both RLVR and OPSD baselines without an external teacher or additional generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SIPO（Self-Instructing Policy Optimization），通过对比式自教师（对比正确与错误特权上下文下的对数概率差）将基于奖励的策略梯度与在线自蒸馏统一为单一token级优势函数，在无需外部教师且不增加生成的前提下，为每条rollout（包括全失败组）提供密集token级监督信号。
AI.motivation: RLVR仅提供粗粒度的结果级奖励，缺乏token级信用分配；尤其在困难问题上全失败组占早期训练的20–30%，此时GRPO组相对优势消失，造成采样算力浪费。现有OPSD使用特权自教师提供密集信号，但自教师过度自信，会对长推理轨迹施加过大惩罚，导致在数学等长链推理任务中失效。
AI.method: 在GRPO采样G条rollout基础上，为每条构建正负两个增强教师提示：正提示拼接参考答案（无参考答案时拼接同组成功兄弟rollout），负提示拼接组内错误答案（失败rollout自身的错误答案或同组失败兄弟）。冻结的教师θ̄对同一响应在两个上下文下分别前向传播，取两次teacher log-prob之差并clip作为token级证据e_{i,t}，叠加到GRPO组相对优势上：A_{i,t} = Â_i + κ·clip(e_{i,t}, -δ, δ)，并施加保号投影以防翻转奖励方向。超参δ=0.2, κ∈{0.1,0.2,0.5}，教师每10步同步一次。
AI.result: 在数学（Qwen3-8B, DAPO-Math-17k）：平均59.4，超过GRPO（57.3）2.1%、RLSD（56.7）2.7%、SDPO（44.9）14.5%，在全部6个基准均最优。在科学QA+工具调用（Qwen3-8B, Olmo3-7B）：平均70.4/66.5，6/10和7/10设置下最佳，1小时训练常匹配基线5小时。代码生成（LCBv6）：56.3 vs GRPO 41.2、RLSD 55.4，且在保持性能力（IFEval/ArenaHard/MMLU-Pro）上仅损失0.8%。消融验证对比式证据是核心，全失败组贡献额外增益（57.3→58.3→59.4），单教师证据（RLSD）反而略低于GRPO，分析KL变体在长链推理中崩溃。
AI.conclusion: SIPO成功统一RL与在线自蒸馏，在无需外部教师和不增加rollout生成的前提下提供密集token级信用分配；对比机制有效抵消自教师的过度自信偏差，使全失败组也能贡献学习信号；该方法在长短推理任务上均表现稳健，是GRPO的环境反馈场景下的即插即用替代方案。

title: EASE: Behavior-Adaptive Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Agent skills provide a lightweight mechanism for self-evolving agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. However, existing learned skill curators typically optimize curation without explicitly modeling downstream executor behavior. We show that this can cause systematic cross-executor degradation: curators trained with different executors perform best when paired with their own training executor, indicating that effective skill curation is executor-dependent. We formulate behavior-adaptive skill curation and introduce EASE, a framework that learns a single curator that adapts its decisions to different executor behaviors. EASE maintains an online behavioral profile of recent execution patterns and conditions the curator on this profile, the current trajectory, and retrieved skills to add, modify, or remove skills from an evolving repository. We train the shared curator jointly across multiple frozen executors with reinforcement learning, using retrieval-aware and behavior-aware temporal attribution to focus optimization on curation actions with observable downstream influence. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, with executors ranging from Qwen3-8B/32B and GPT-OSS-120B to unseen Kimi K2.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Gemini 3.5 Flash, EASE outperforms strong skill- and memory-based baselines without per-executor finetuning. EASE also maintains 34.5--41.0% fewer skills, improves skill retrieval by 36.3--38.7% and measured edit utility by 51.8--60.0%, and reduces deployment-time inference tokens by 9.1--14.5%. These results establish behavior-adaptive skill curation as an effective principle for building self-evolving agents.

AI.tldr: EASE 提出了一种面向自进化智能体的行为自适应技能策展框架，通过在线行为画像将共享策展器适配到不同执行器（已知与未知），解决了已有策展器跨执行器退化的问题，在多个基准上取得了更优性能与更紧凑的技能库。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式技能策展器在策展时未显式建模下游执行器行为，导致不同执行器之间出现系统性性能退化（curator 与训练执行器配对最佳，跨配对时显著下降），技能策展的有效性本质上是执行器依赖的。
AI.method: 方法包括三部分：(1) 在线行为画像 P_t(E)，在长度为 W 的滑动窗口内聚合动作有效性、失败恢复、状态跟踪、效率、错误类型与技能利用等可观测特征；(2) 行为条件化的共享策展器 π_θ，接收轨迹 ξ、当前任务、检索技能和描述子 e_t=[P_t(E); m(E)]，执行 add/modify/delete 操作；(3) 采用 GRPO 在多个冻结执行器（Qwen3-8B/32B、GPT-OSS-120B）上联合训练，并使用两个时序归因门控——检索发生门 Z_t>0 与行为偏差门（相对于无技能参考轨迹的归一化 Levenshtein 偏差 D_j>τ）——仅对有可观测影响的策展步骤施加 PPO 监督。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上，使用单一个策展器，EASE 在三个训练执行器上平均超过专用 SkillOS 专家 1.9–2.7 pp，在 Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Gemini 3.5 Flash 三个未见执行器上超过 SkillOS-best 2.1–3.8 pp（9 个组合中 8 个最优）。技能数量减少 35–41%，编辑技能检索率提升 36–39%（相对），编辑回滚效用提升 52–60%（相对），部署推理 token 减少 9–15%。消融显示行为画像贡献 7.5–9.5 pp（静态模型卡仅恢复其中 1.8–4.6 pp），检索门贡献 3.5–4.4 pp，行为偏差门贡献 1.3–2.1 pp。
AI.conclusion: 行为自适应技能策展应作为构建自进化智能体的有效原则：通过将策展决策条件化于执行器在线行为而非模型身份，单一策展器即可在多个冻结执行器（已知与未见）上同时取得最优或竞争性表现，并产出更紧凑、更易被检索与利用、推理成本更低的技能库。

title: Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing via Preference Optimization
summary: Knowledge editing enables rapid updates of specific factual knowledge in large language models (LLMs) without full retraining. However, more realistic scenarios call for a lifelong framework that handles continual updates rather than one-off modifications. In such settings, existing editing methods often overfit to target prompts, significantly degrading both the generalization of the edited knowledge and the model's general capabilities. To address this issue, we propose GLIME (Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing), which combines knowledge editing with preference optimization over generation behavior. GLIME further incorporates replay-based editing and a gradient constraint to preserve previously edited knowledge. Experimental results show that GLIME significantly improves knowledge generalization in lifelong editing settings while maintaining both editing performance and general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GLIME框架，通过结合知识编辑与偏好优化、回放机制和梯度正交约束，解决大语言模型终身知识编辑中的过拟合、泛化能力差和灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑方法在终身编辑场景下存在两大局限：1）仅在表层词汇相似的提示上过拟合，难以泛化到新语境；2）参数更新累积导致模型偏离预训练分布，造成整体能力退化。根本原因是现有方法仅关注编辑成功率和局部性等表层目标，未能保证编辑知识的泛化性和模型通用能力的保持。
AI.method: GLIME包含三个核心组件：1）持续偏好优化（CPO）——使用OpenHermesPreferences数据集的偏好对作为行为级正则化，防止模型过度适应特定编辑提示；2）基于回放的编辑——维护回放缓冲区存储历史编辑请求，联合训练以减轻灾难性遗忘；3）梯度空间约束（GC）——维护正交基矩阵，将当前梯度投影到历史子空间的正交互补上，保护过去编辑的参数方向。编辑仅作用于MLP第4-8层。
AI.result: 在MQuAKE-Remastered和ZSRE数据集上，GLIME在LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct两种模型上均取得最佳平均性能。尤其在自回归解码（AD）评估下，GLIME显著优于基线（如在MQuAKE上LLaMA模型的可靠性从AlphaEdit的0.604提升至0.830）。在5000次编辑的长序列测试中，GLIME保持稳定，而AlphaEdit在约3000次编辑后急剧退化。消融实验表明CPO主要贡献于泛化性和可移植性，而回放和GC主要贡献于保留历史编辑。
AI.conclusion: GLIME将终身知识编辑重新定义为联合注入新知识、泛化编辑知识和保持模型通用能力的多目标优化问题。通过偏好优化实现行为级正则化，通过回放和正交梯度约束缓解灾难性遗忘，在长编辑流中显著提升了编辑知识的泛化能力和模型的稳定性。

title: Emergent Specialization in Populations of Self-Supervised Collaborative Vision Experts Without a Shared Gate or Cross-Agent Gradients
summary: Can a population of neural networks develop a useful division of labor without a shared gate or gradients between agents? We study a setting where each network has its own weights, trains independently on the same heterogeneous data, and can ask another agent for help through a forward pass. Unlike mixtures of experts, where a jointly trained gate assigns inputs to experts, specialization here must emerge without central control. We test this in a small scale proxy for predictive visual pretraining. Initially identical agents are finetuned on an unlabeled mixture of six visual domains using masked prediction of frozen DINOv3 features. We measure specialization by asking whether the best agent for an input aligns with its latent domain, and utilization by asking whether responsibility is distributed across agents. We progressively remove central control, ending with DISCO (DIStributed COllaboration) where each agent locally selects a helper, reads its internal state through a gradient free channel, and rewards its router only for the improvement that help provides. Specialization emerges and is useful. Randomly routed populations underperform a single generalist, while semantically routed populations outperform it, showing that specialization rather than population size drives the gain. Specialization persists without a central router, and gradient free communication lets nonexperts exploit emergent expertise. In DISCO, a random agent helped by the expert matches the solo generalist, while experts surpass it, including on data outside the specialization mixture. Local routers select the emergent expert for 98% of inputs. These effects persist across population size, model capacity, data imbalance, and finetuning seeds, providing measurable evidence for the dynamics needed by decentralized predictive pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在没有共享门控和跨智能体梯度的条件下，一组独立训练的神经网络能否自发形成有意义的劳动分工。作者以DINOv3特征的掩码预测为代理任务，提出了DISCO（分布式协作）框架：每个智能体通过本地路由器选择辅助智能体，并通过停止梯度的键值通道读取其内部状态，路由器仅基于帮助带来的本地提升获得奖励。实验表明，特化确实涌现并具有实际价值：语义路由的种群优于单一通用模型，而随机路由的种群则更差，说明增益来自特化而非模型数量。去掉中央路由器后特化仍然存在，且梯度自由的通信使非专家能够利用涌现的专业能力。本地路由器在98%的输入上选择了真正的专家智能体。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉基础模型几乎都是单一整体网络处理所有类型的数据。混合专家模型（MoE）虽然引入了分工，但需要一个联合训练的门控来分配输入，且专家特化通常围绕token位置、噪声水平等非语义因素。是否存在一种无需中央控制、仅凭独立训练的智能体就能围绕数据语义结构自发形成劳动分工的机制，是一个尚未在受控条件下验证的基本问题。这对于去中心化的大规模模型训练具有重要意义。
AI.method:
1. **任务设定**：智能体在DINOv3特征空间中进行70%掩码patch的重建预测，使用6个视觉领域（航拍、自动驾驶、机器人操作、人脸、花卉等）的无标签混合数据进行LoRA微调。
2. **特化度量**：用归一化互信息（NMI）衡量最佳智能体身份与潜在领域标签的对齐程度（Sp），用归一化熵衡量负载均衡程度（U）。
3. **训练阶梯**：从完全中心控制逐步过渡到去中心化——Solo、Random、K-means、Learned Central、Distributed Delegation，最终到DISCO。
4. **DISCO核心设计**：(a) 通信通道——请求者在通信层将其查询（Q）同时关注自身和辅助者的停止梯度键值（K, V）；(b) 奖励信号——路由器基于请求者自身损失的改善量获得REINFORCE奖励，而非辅助者的绝对性能。
5. **正则化**：使用KL散度惩罚路由器边际分布偏离均匀分布，防止路由坍缩。
AI.result:
1. **特化确实涌现且有用**：语义路由（K-means Sp=0.96，Learned Central Sp=0.79）将R-Top5-Best从0.653提升至0.678；随机路由（Sp=0.01）反而劣于单一模型，说明分工而非模型数量驱动增益。
2. **无中央路由器时特化仍存在**：分布式委托（Sp=0.93）和DISCO（Sp=0.93）的特化程度接近K-means正控制。
3. **梯度自由通信有效**：DISCO是唯一使非专家通过消息匹配通用模型水平的机制（协作得分0.653 vs solo 0.653），且在ImageNet100保留测试中损失最小。
4. **本地路由器准确识别专家**：98.3%的输入上所有非专家请求者都选择了真正的最低损失智能体。
5. **消融实验**：消息内容（而非形状）至关重要——用错误图像的K/V导致性能下降0.239；负载均衡的KL正则项是分工涌现的前提条件但单独不足。
6. **可扩展性**：在4/6/8智能体、S/B/L容量、平衡/不平衡数据混合、多个种子下结论一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了一组初始相同的独立神经网络，在共享的自监督目标下，无需任务标签、预定义角色或中央协调器，能够围绕异构视觉数据的潜在语义结构自发形成劳动分工。关键发现是：只要路由与逐样本性能挂钩，智能体就会组织成与领域对齐的专家组合；更重要的是，梯度自由的键值通信使这种涌现的专业能力可在智能体间共享，使非专家也能达到通用模型的水平。DISCO框架在多种规模、容量、数据平衡度和训练种子下均表现出稳定的特化和协作效应，为去中心化预测式预训练提供了可量化的动力学证据。

title: Code4Scene: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Constructing and Editing 3D Scenes
summary: Frontier coding agents can now write and execute code that authors 3D environments, but whether they reliably understand 3D structure and precisely control scene state remains unclear. The generated 3D scene is a persistent, executable artifact: a convincing render can hide incorrect spatial relations, intersecting objects, or unintended modifications. We introduce Code4Scene, a benchmark of 190 Unreal Engine cases built from human-assembled scenes that evaluates coding agents on two complementary settings under a shared execution interface. Construction tests scene-level spatial reasoning from open-ended language specifications, where many realizations are valid; editing tests precise control of scene state, where the agent must recover the target scene from reference images while preserving everything else. Rather than scoring code or rendered views, Code4Scene evaluates the generated engine-native scene for task fulfillment, artifact integrity, and static physical validity, with edits additionally compared against withheld ground truth. Across 14 coding-agent configurations on the 95-case public set, construction and editing performance are strongly correlated but not interchangeable (Spearman $\rho = 0.78$): Claude Fable 5.1 leads construction, Gemini 3.8 Flash leads editing, and GPT-6 Astra narrowly leads overall. Spatial Composition is the weakest construction category for every agent, while editing remains imprecise: the best Repair F1 is only 0.527, and 35.8% of edits that fully recover the target still introduce unintended changes elsewhere in the scene. These results expose a gap between plausible 3D generation and reliable spatial reasoning and state control.

AI.tldr: Code4Scene是一个针对Unreal Engine的3D场景构建与编辑基准测试，包含190个案例，评估14种编程智能体配置在构造（文本生成场景）和编辑（图像参考修复）两种任务下的空间推理和场景状态控制能力，揭示了当前前沿模型在空间组成和精确编辑方面的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 前沿编程智能体已能通过代码生成3D环境，但其能否可靠理解3D结构并精确控制可执行场景状态尚不明确。现有3D场景生成评估在引擎、场景表示、智能体接口和评估目标上差异较大，难以系统比较通用编程智能体，且难以区分视觉合理性、空间正确性、物理有效性和精确状态控制。
AI.method: 基于人类组装的Unreal Engine场景构建190个案例（30个文本生成场景构造任务、160个图像到场景编辑任务，含室内和室外），通过共享的25个工具接口让智能体使用Python和工具调用构建或编辑持久化的.umap场景。评估生成场景的工件完整性（Candidate Integrity）、任务完成度（Semantic Verifier含Detailed与Overview Alignment、Actor Repair F1）和静态物理有效性（Physical Safety含支撑与碰撞检查），并以Embodied Utility Score（EUS）作为辅助下游可用性指标。
AI.result: 在95个公开案例的评估中，构造与编辑性能强相关但不可互换（Spearman ρ=0.78）：Claude Fable 5.1领先构造（0.788），Gemini 3.8 Flash领先编辑（0.581），GPT-6 Astra以微弱优势领先综合（0.619）。空间组合（Spatial Composition）是所有14个智能体配置最弱的构造类别（即使对象存在，20.6%的空间要求仍被判不匹配）；编辑仍不精确，最佳Repair F1仅0.527，35.8%的完全恢复目标的编辑仍包含非预期的场景改动。
AI.conclusion: Code4Scene揭示了看似合理的3D生成与可靠空间推理及状态控制之间的显著差距。前沿智能体在内容生成上表现良好，但在空间组织、精确场景状态控制和保持非目标内容不变方面存在系统性不足，表明当前编程智能体尚不能可靠胜任生产级3D场景创作。

title: Aperture: Merge-Consistent Rotary States for Compressed Tokens
summary: Token compression combines content from several positions, yet rotary position embeddings usually assign the merged token one coordinate. We ask what positional information must survive later merges. Aperture stores Fourier moments of the token's weighted support at the model's rotary frequencies. We prove that these moments have minimal real dimension among continuous states sufficient for the selected expected rotary interactions. Represented mass makes updates additive; attention normalisation remains a separate readout choice. Uniform intervals give a centre rotation times a sinc gain. We characterise when centres determine interval widths and construct matched examples where they do not. Numerical checks verify the weighted-support implementation. In trained temporal readers, compression transfer varies with gain calibration and feature placement. In a prespecified native video question-answering comparison, stored support reaches $65.63\%$ accuracy versus $67.12\%$ for the deployed merging rule. These results separate exact positional preservation under compression from downstream benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Aperture，一种用于压缩令牌的旋转位置编码（RoPE）状态表示方法，通过存储令牌加权支撑集的傅里叶矩而非单一中心坐标，实现合并一致的仿射聚合，并在保持最小实数维度的同时支持后续加权合并操作。
AI.motivation: 令牌压缩将多个位置的内容合并，但现有 RoPE 方法仅为合并后的令牌分配一个中心坐标，丢弃了内容围绕该中心的分布信息（即支撑集的宽度信息）。本文旨在回答"在后续合并操作中，哪些位置信息必须被保留"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 1. 将每个令牌的位置状态定义为加权支撑集的概率测度 μ，在模型的旋转频率 Mi(θ₁,...,θ_M) 上取复数矩 z(μ) = (∫e^{iθₘt}dμ(t))_{m=1}^M；2. 证明该仿射状态在弱连续充分状态中具有最小实数维度 2M（定理 1）；3. 通过存储 (ρ, Z) = (质量, 未归一化复数矩) 实现可加性合并更新；4. 均匀区间情形下，状态分解为中心旋转 × sinc 增益；5. 表征中心何时能确定宽度，并构造匹配反例；6. 在 EPIC-Kitchens 时间定位任务及 Qwen2.5-VL/Omni 视频问答中验证。
AI.result: 1. 数值验证：float64 精度下，4 区间合并的树不一致性 <10⁻¹²，加权支撑矩的仿射残差 <10⁻¹²；2. EPIC 时间定位中，精确 Aperture 减去纯中心时钟为 -0.0020（包含零），减宽度特征为 +0.0325（5 种子 t 区间 [0.0155, 0.0494]，描述性结果）；3. 在内容删除策略下宽度敏感性排序：Aperture RMS D-M=+0.0867，exact Aperture D-M=+0.0600；4. 大模型 3B/7B 中，在主保留预算 b=4 下，exact Aperture 减 MN-sinc 为 +0.0597 (3B) 和 +0.0549 (7B)；5. 原始视频问答对比中，存储支撑达 65.63% vs PPE 的 67.12%（差 -1.49 个百分点，Holm 调整后 p=4.7×10⁻⁴）；6. 计算开销：旋转操作增 25%，折叠后仅 2.8%。
AI.conclusion: Aperture 通过傅里叶矩保留了合并所需的仿射位置状态，且具有最小实数维度。然而，代数保证（即位置信息可被保留）与训练后的实际收益是分离的。时间迁移效果取决于增益校准与特征放置方式；压缩感知的 3B/7B 自适应结果未达显著性。存储、读取与部署成本需分别评估。原生界面下，存储支撑在视频问答中落后于已部署的 PPE 合并规则。

title: AI as a Compiler: Compiling Triton kernels without the Triton compiler
summary: Compiler backends are expensive to build and maintain as programming models, workloads, and accelerators evolve.
