We investigate whether large language models can replace the conventional optimizing and lowering pipeline, a process that we call AI lowering. We study AI lowering from Triton to NVIDIA PTX: an LLM agent translates Triton kernels directly into PTX. We build an environment that evaluates candidate PTX, and an agentic harness in which an LLM translates Triton kernels into PTX. Across twelve common kernels on Ada, Hopper, and Blackwell GPUs and ten kernels from recent ML papers, AI lowering achieves 0.83x-3.34x the performance of autotuned Triton. The largest gains come from transformations that Triton's lowering pipeline does not perform, such as decoding packed binary weights directly into Tensor Core operands (3.34x on BitDelta), assigning each thread a complete softmax row in tensor memory (1.37x on FlashAttention), and reusing overlapping convolution windows (up to 2.23x). These results rely on a robust evaluation harness with comprehensive verification support. We build on Volta, an existing PTX verifier, and substantially extend it to support modern GPU architectures by introducing support for Blackwell's tcgen05 Tensor Core interface. This requires modeling three architectural features: managed tensor memory, descriptor-based operand layouts, and asynchronous execution coordinated through commits, waits, memory barriers, and proxy fences. We discuss the challenges involved in formalizing them, as well as the current limitations. Our results suggest an emerging future in which AI compilers replace custom-written intermediate representations and checkers, reducing the time and engineering effort required to bring up software for new general-purpose and custom chips.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"AI lowering"概念，利用大语言模型直接将Triton内核翻译为NVIDIA PTX，绕过传统编译器优化和降级流程。在Ada、Hopper、Blackwell三代GPU上，相对自动调优的Triton实现0.83x至3.34x的性能，最高3.34x加速来自Tensor Core级别的创新优化（如BitDelta直接解码打包二进制权重）。
AI.motivation: 传统编译器后端构建和维护成本高昂：随着编程模型、工作负载和加速器不断演进，需要持续扩展中间表示、优化通道和降级路径。新硬件特性往往超出现有IR的表达能力，迫使开发者使用特定架构的内联汇编绕过编译器。核心问题是：LLM能否取代手写的优化和降级管道？
AI.method: 构建Triton Compiler Environment (TCEnv)——提供PTX验证、基准测试、profiling的受控环境；构建Triton AI Compiler (TAIC)——一个LLM驱动的agentic harness，通过"诊断-规划-分支-评估"循环迭代优化PTX；扩展Volta PTX验证器以支持Hopper和Blackwell特性（tcgen05 Tensor Core接口、托管张量内存、描述符布局、异步执行）；使用GPT-6 Astra作为编译LLM。
AI.result: 在12个常用内核（覆盖Ada/Hopper/Blackwell）和10个近期ML论文内核上的评估：AI lowering达到0.83x-3.34x Triton性能。显著加速包括BitDelta 3.34x（二进制权重直接解码为Tensor Core操作数）、FlashAttention 1.37x（将完整softmax行映射到tensor memory布局）、FlashSinkhorn 1.55x、卷积2.23x（复用重叠窗口）。架构覆盖完整：Ada使用mma.sync+ldmatrix+cp.async，Hopper使用wgmma+TMA，Blackwell使用tcgen05+TMEM累积器。LLM能正确从Triton源码恢复语义，不受名称/注释/熟悉模式干扰；IEEE-754语义请求下会避免使用Tensor Core。验证扩展后Volta TCB从42kLoC增至60kLoC，仍不支持原子操作、数据相关控制流和位级操作。
AI.conclusion: LLM可以直接将专业Triton内核降级为有竞争力的PTX，通过随机差分测试验证正确性。生成成本虽远高于毫秒级Triton编译，但该成本仅发生一次，可通过重复执行分摊。对于新硬件或支持不足的硬件，AI lowering可能比开发和维护专用优化编译器后端更经济，指向了加速器上生成性能关键代码的新范式，但仍需更强大的形式化验证。

title: UpliftMem: Learning Set-Level Uplift for Agent Memory Retrieval
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents reuse external memory to guide new tasks, but effective retrieval requires learning which memory sets improve execution. Such learning relies on costly outcome feedback: ordinary retrieval observes only executed sets, while evaluating alternatives requires additional rollouts. We introduce \textsc{UpliftMem}, which learns memory retrieval from set-level execution uplift relative to the same executor without memory. A theoretical analysis of how retrieval preferences restrict feedback coverage motivates targeted probing of alternative memory sets. Probe selection follows an expected value of sample information (EVSI) criterion, derived in closed form under a correlated Gaussian model, to allocate limited training rollouts according to their expected improvement in local retrieval decisions. The shared scorer is trained with a frozen executor and selects memory sets without test-time probes. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and BigCodeBench, \textsc{UpliftMem} achieves the best success rates among evaluated baselines on the main evaluation sets. Controlled fixed-store and matched probe budget evaluations further demonstrate improved memory-use decisions and more effective use of execution feedback.

AI.tldr: UpliftMem提出了一种集合级执行uplift学习方法，通过EVSI准则选择探测样本，为LLM智能体学习更有效的记忆检索。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的记忆检索方法面临反馈覆盖有限的问题：普通检索只对执行过的记忆集合提供直接监督，而评估替代集合需要额外的执行滚动，这使得被低估的集合难以获得纠错反馈，导致检索效果受限。
AI.method: 1. 将记忆检索建模为集合级执行uplift学习问题，以无记忆执行作为参考基线；2. 通过理论分析刻画选择性检索对反馈覆盖的限制（命题1）；3. 在相关高斯代理模型下推导EVSI的闭式表达，定向探测能改善检索决策的替代记忆集合；4. 训练一个共享的uplift评分器Gθ，采用值损失（回归+符号+排序）和结果加权的策略损失联合监督。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和BigCodeBench三个基准上，UpliftMem均取得最佳成功率（4B/8B执行器）：ALFWorld seen 76.86%/81.43%，unseen 70.91%/79.10%，WebShop 45.60%/44.00%，BCB 39.77%/42.69%。在MemSyco-Bench固定记忆存储评估中，决策准确率从41.7%/44.4%提升至66.5%/68.8%；匹配探测预算下，EVSI引导获取比随机探测决策准确率提高10.6/13.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将智能体记忆检索重新定位为"学习使用何种经验"与"决定哪些缺失结果值得观察"耦合的学习问题，通过set级uplift建模和EVSI引导的主动反馈采集，在有限rollout预算下显著提升了检索决策质量和执行成功率。

title: CAD-Native Transformer Operators for AI-Aided Engineering
summary: Modern engineering systems, from automobiles to aircraft, are designed by using precise, continuous parametric computer-aided design (CAD) models. Evaluating design changes through numerical simulation requires meshing the continuous geometry, a computationally expensive and often brittle process that can require manual intervention and replaces the continuous representation with a discrete approximation. Most neural surrogates accelerate the simulation, but inherit this representation gap by relying on meshes, point clouds, voxels, or other sampled approximations of geometry. We introduce CANTO, a transformer neural operator that maps directly from continuous CAD geometry to physical fields, without meshing the input geometry. We develop a theoretical framework for learning operators from geometric manifolds to function spaces of physical fields, representing geometry through sequences of parametric patches. CANTO instantiates this framework by directly tokenizing non-uniform rational B-spline (NURBS) patches from their control points, knot vectors, and weights, and predicts continuous surface and volume fields at arbitrary query locations. We evaluate CANTO on four automotive and aircraft aerodynamics industry benchmarks: AhmedML, WindsorML, DrivAerML, and HiLiftAeroML. CANTO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on most evaluated surface and volume prediction tasks, including a 19.8% reduction in surface-pressure relative $L_2$ error compared with AB-UPT on HiLiftAeroML. Differentiability with respect to CAD parameters further enables gradient-based inverse design of designs. On AhmedML, CANTO identifies designs with 4.4 to 20.4% lower drag than the best dataset designs satisfying the same volume and lift constraints, with the improvements verified using the same CFD setup used to generate the original dataset.

AI.tldr: CANTO是一种直接在CAD参数化几何上运行的自注意力Transformer算子，将连续NURBS参数映射到CFD物理场，无需网格划分。在4个汽车和航空空气动力学基准测试中达到最先进精度，并通过相对于CAD参数的可微性实现基于梯度的逆向设计。
AI.motivation: 现代工程设计依赖精确的连续参数化CAD模型，但CFD仿真和现有神经代理都需要将连续几何离散化为网格/点云/体素等采样近似（"表示鸿沟"），不仅计算昂贵、脆弱，还使得设计表示与分析表示之间存在脱节，限制了设计优化迭代效率。
AI.method: 1）理论框架：将CAD到物理场的代理建模形式化为从紧致C¹流形到Banach函数空间的算子，流形通过有向边界参数化片序列表示；2）NURBS原生分词：使用三个Perceiver Pooling模块分别编码加权控制点和两个节点向量，得到每个非裁剪NURBS片的固定维patch token，再通过DiT自注意力块构建全局几何上下文；3）架构：基于AB-UPT多分支Transformer骨干，用NURBS几何token作为cross-attention键值缓存条件化预测流，表面token直接从参数化NURBS分解提取，任意空间位置查询场预测。
AI.result: 在AhmedML、WindsorML、DrivAerML和HiLiftAeroML四个工业基准上：AhmedML表面压力相对L₂误差降低11.6%；HiLiftAeroML表面压力相对L₂误差降低19.8%（相比AB-UPT），壁面剪切应力降低2.23%，速度降低16.9%，R²达0.99；WindsorML表面压力降低5.5%。模型对采样和锚点稀疏性极其稳健（性能与网格分辨率完全解耦），推理加速达2300×（vs CFD）。逆向设计在AhmedML上找到比数据集最优设计低4.4%-20.4%阻力的方案，CFD验证预测误差在2.2%以内。
AI.conclusion: CANTO通过直接在参数化NURBS表示上运行，弥合了CAD设计与学习物理之间的表示鸿沟，无需推理时网格划分并对离散化保持稳健，其对NURBS输入的可微性使基于梯度的形状优化和逆向设计能直接在CAD参数空间中进行。

title: Geometry-Conditioned Fixed-Scaffold Encoders for Time-Warp Robust Sequence Retrieval
summary: Embedding-based retrieval is attractive for long sequence collections because each item can be encoded once and searched by nearest-neighbor ranking. The difficulty is that the objects being indexed are often observed under a noncanonical clock: cardiac cycles stretch with rate, speech changes with tempo, and sensor traces reach comparable states at different speeds. This paper studies a specific source of instability in patch-based encoders for this regime. If patch boundaries are chosen from signal geometry, then the tokenization can change under the same temporal deformation that the representation is expected to tolerate. We propose GeoPatch, a fixed-scaffold patch encoder that keeps token support independent of geometry and uses slope, curvature, acceleration, affine-residual, and confidence descriptors only as continuous conditioning variables. The design turns boundary variation into feature modulation: geometry can change the embedding through a controlled pathway, but it cannot change the number, order, or support of local tokens. We formalize this distinction through a mechanism-level stability analysis that separates boundary drift, affine timing variation, confidence-weighted geometry perturbation, and retrieval-margin effects. The same local tokens support global embedding retrieval and late-interaction scoring, so the scoring rule can be matched to the evaluation protocol. Across ECG, speech, and multivariate time-series retrieval tasks, GeoPatch improves early-rank retrieval under timing variation while exposing a clear trade-off between local surface matching and strict non-overlap retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoPatch，一种用于时间序列检索的"固定骨架+几何条件"patch编码器。其核心思想是：patch边界由固定网格决定（不随信号几何变化），而斜率、曲率、加速度、仿射残差和置信度等几何描述符仅作为连续条件变量调制嵌入。该设计将"边界漂移"这一离散不稳定性转化为有界特征扰动，并通过形式化稳定性和边界度量证明其性质。模型同时支持全局嵌入检索与ColBERT风格的late-interaction重排序，在ECG、语音和UEA多变量时序检索任务上验证了早期排序精度的提升，并揭示了局部表面匹配与严格非重叠检索之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 在嵌入式长序列检索中（如心电、语音、传感器数据），同一事件常以不同"时钟"被观测（心率变化、语速变化、时间拉伸）。现有patch-based编码器若用信号几何（峰、拐点、曲率极值）选择patch边界，则时间扭曲会同时扰动patch的内容与边界，产生作者所谓的"分割-不变性悖论"（segmentation-invariance paradox）——边界成为额外的随机变量，破坏了warp-tolerant检索所需的不变性。
AI.method: GeoPatch采用固定滑动骨架S={I_k}（默认patch长度ℓ=16，最多K=16）抽取patch，内容流通过时间stem编码，描述符流（含Slope、Curvature、Acceleration、Affine residual、Confidence）通过独立几何编码器后以Fusion模块调制token；含门控a_k与有效性mask、patch解相关正则化、可选重建损失，支持supervised contrastive训练与MaxSim late-interaction重排序。形式化上给出三件关键分析：(1) 边界漂移vs特征漂移的分解不等式；(2) 仿射残差规范化在局部仿射重参数化下的不变性；(4) 置信加权Lipschitz调制稳定性的Theorem 1，给出‖T(g_k+δg_k)−T(g_k)‖₂ ≤ L_N·L_A·L_f·L_γ·(1/|M|)Σ_{k∈M} a_k‖δg_k‖₂ 的上界；(5) 排序稳定性的Theorem 2与max聚合表面相似偏好的Proposition 3。
AI.result: 单向量检索：GeoPatch在NSRDB上Recall@1达到0.8800（比最佳基线高近20个百分点），在NSTDB取得1.0000的上限值，在MITDB取得0.8018，在UEA均值上为0.7639。压力测试（7个UEA数据集）：平滑时间扭曲平均R@1仅下降4.2%，几何/曲率噪声平均变化-0.9%，patch顺序扰动下降1.9%，但局部span masking下降21.3%（符合局部形态依赖）。Late-interaction重排序（MaxSim）：在NSRDB/MITDB上R@1分别+9.27/+17.67点；但在严格非重叠ECG评估下，MaxSim的R@1从0.3229暴跌至0.0563（NSRDB），证明Standard vs Strict存在显著权衡。总体计算：约132 GPU-hours（报告结果）/400 GPU-hours（完整项目）。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将token支持与几何调制分离，将离散边界漂移问题转化为连续有界扰动问题，在多域高变异时序数据上显著提升早期排序精度。然而warp鲁棒性不能仅靠编码器解决：需要一个稳定的token接口与一个明确为局部形态匹配设计的评分规则（而非与全局身份一致性目标对齐）。MaxSim并非通用最优聚合器，其对局部最强匹配的奖励与严格跨记录身份检索目标在数学上不可同时满足（Corollary 1）。GeoPatch作为检索优先架构定位为gallery初筛，与高精度两两对齐方法（如DTW）互补。

title: Calibrate the Decisions That Change the Future: On-Policy Post-Training Quantization for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) lowers deployment cost for multimodal large language models, but calibration typically reconstructs fixed sequences with local objectives. This overlooks autoregressive feedback: a quantization-induced token change redirects the prefix and changes future states. Yet on-policy coverage alone is insufficient because many decision mismatches barely affect future generation. We propose OnPTQ, an on-policy framework that calibrates on trajectories visited by the current quantized policy. On shared prefixes, OnPTQ identifies quantization-eroded boundaries, evaluates competing tokens through short counterfactual rollouts, and combines current discrepancy with branch consequence into a Decision--Consequence risk. The risk prioritizes critical states, while context anchoring and trajectory refresh preserve multimodal behavior and keep calibration aligned with the updated policy. We further derive a Decision--Consequence bound linking behavioral deviation to current policy discrepancy and action-conditioned future-value span. Across vision--language and omni-modal Qwen models under multiple low-bit settings, OnPTQ improves downstream performance and yields fewer correctness flips against the corresponding Dense/FP16 references, without changing the deployed inference graph.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OnPTQ，一种针对多模态大语言模型(MLLM)的训练后量化(PTQ)框架。其核心思想是将自回归PTQ重构为一个在策略(on-policy)校准问题：在当前量化策略实际访问的轨迹上进行校准，并通过"决策-后果(Decision-Consequence)风险"优先聚焦于真正影响未来生成的关键决策状态。OnPTQ不修改部署推理图，在多种低比特设置下提升了视觉-语言和全模态Qwen模型的下游性能，并减少了相对于FP16参考模型的正确性翻转。
AI.motivation: 传统PTQ校准通常在固定的图像-文本上下文上以局部重构目标进行优化，忽略了自回归反馈：量化引起的token变化会重定向前缀并改变未来状态。然而，仅采用在策略覆盖也不够，因为许多决策不匹配对未来生成几乎无影响。因此，需要一种方法既能跟随量化策略的轨迹，又能将校准精力集中在真正改变未来生成的关键决策上。
AI.method: OnPTQ采用"Follow–Compare–Branch–Calibrate"循环：(1) Follow：当前量化模型自回归生成轨迹，构建在策略轨迹库B^(k)；(2) Compare：在共享量化前缀上比较密集与量化模型的next-token决策，识别mismatch与near-miss候选状态，计算边界侵蚀e_t和同状态JS散度j_t；(3) Branch：对每个候选状态从竞争token进行短视距反事实rollout，用密集模型衡量分支未来发散程度A_t；(4) Calibrate：组合成决策-后果风险r_t^DC = e_t(1+λ_b·A_t) + η·j_t，选取TopK_c关键状态进行风险加权校准，并配合上下文锚点损失保持多模态行为。每轮更新θ后刷新轨迹库，使其对齐新量化策略。理论上给出Decision-Consequence界，将行为偏差分解为当前决策分歧(TV)与动作条件未来值跨度的乘积。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct以及Qwen2.5-Omni-3B/7B上，于W4A16/W8A8/W4A8/W4A6等低比特设置下，OnPTQ在多数情况下取得最高的平均准确率（6/8设置），并在W4A6下两个骨干均领先；在Omni模型上ASR任务的WER最低。Flip Rate显著低于其他PTQ方法，更好地保留了FP16参考模型的样本级正确性。消融实验证实：边界侵蚀、后果项A_t、上下文锚点L_anchor、配对边界损失L_pair以及策略刷新均贡献关键收益；迭代刷新的两轮最优，五轮反而下降。推理图未改变，W4A8相比FP16在B200上获得1.79×/1.41×的prefill加速和37.4%/28.7%的峰值显存降低。
AI.conclusion: OnPTQ将自回归PTQ重新诠释为在策略校准问题，通过共享前缀决策比较和短反事实分支量化未来后果，优先处理真正改变未来生成的决策而非纯数值误差。Decision-Consequence界提供了理论动机。在多种Qwen多模态模型和低比特设置下，OnPTQ提升了性能并降低了正确性翻转，且不改变部署推理图。局限：额外的离线校准开销（密集-量化对比与贪心rollout），局部后果代理可能遗漏长视距或随机效应，且评估目前限于Qwen系列多模态模型。

title: The Default Trap: Rethinking Plan Evaluation in Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: An executor can respond strongly to a change in a supplied plan's priority while showing a small change in the same information-selection probability when a default-aligned whole plan is removed. We call the risk of interpreting the latter as weak responsiveness to alternative priorities the default trap. We compare paired plans that prioritize different information targets with a shared no-plan reference. An accounting identity relates these distinct behavioral contrasts. Across 3,200 decision windows on 160 selected Retail, Airline, and AgentDojo tasks, switching priorities strongly redirects two models' choices, while the two plan-versus-default contrasts differ. In 2,160 additional windows, reversing account-list order shifts default target selection by 63.3-98.3 percentage points; priority-switching effects remain 96.7-100.0 points in either order. A separate 3,240-window component study finds strong control under single priority sentences, with effects of additional text varying by group and direction. Finally, 1,080 full-task episodes yield observed success differences of -19.4 to +8.3 points relative to no plan. All Retail and Airline success intervals include zero; AgentDojo results describe four fixed application worlds. These findings support joint reporting of priority responsiveness, presentation-dependent defaults, and task success and cost.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工具调用型LLM Agent在"计划（plan）"作用评估中存在的系统性偏差，提出"默认陷阱（default trap）"概念：通过配对优先级实验（paired-priority framework）区分"切换优先级响应"与"删除计划响应"两种行为对比，并借助恒等式将两者形式化关联，发现仅依据删除效应评估会严重低估Agent对优先级的实际服从度；同时揭示默认行为高度依赖信息呈现顺序，而强局部控制未必带来任务成功率的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法在衡量计划（plan）对LLM Agent行为的影响时存在混淆：研究者常用"删除计划"这一单一对比来推断Agent对计划内容的服从程度，但若Agent的无计划默认行为已与某一计划对齐，删除效应会很小，从而产生误判——即"默认陷阱"。此外，默认行为本身可能受信息呈现方式（如列表顺序）影响，使删除基线难以稳定。本文旨在建立一个能区分"优先级响应"、"默认行为"和"任务效用"三种独立测量的统一评估框架。
AI.method: 核心方法为"配对优先级框架"：针对每个任务构造一对仅在连续优先级片段上不同的计划P_A和P_B，并共享无计划条件∅。定义方向效用D_A = p_A(P_A)−p_A(P_B)（切换优先级效应）和删除对比R_A = p_A(P_A)−p_A(∅)（删除计划效应），并建立恒等式 D_A = R_A + G_A，其中G_A为"默认到B对比"。通过3,200个决策窗口（Retail/Airline/AgentDojo，160任务，两个执行器Luna和Mini）、2,160个列表顺序干预窗口、1,080个完整任务回合和3,240个组件研究窗口进行验证；采用客户聚类自助法估计95%区间，所有八类端点结果均保留在分母中。
AI.result: 1）配对优先级研究中，两个模型均展现强方向控制（D_A范围67.36–99.11个百分点），但删除效应R_A仅5.73–24.11个百分点，二者差异G_A高达47.92–89.29个百分点，证实小删除效应≠弱优先级响应。2）列表顺序干预中，反转账户列表顺序使默认A选择偏移63.3–98.3个百分点，而方向控制D_A在两种顺序下均保持96.7–100.0，说明默认基线高度依赖呈现方式。3）完整任务评估中，强局部控制伴随不确定的收益：相对于无计划，成功率差异范围−19.4至+8.3个百分点，所有Retail和Airline客户区间包含零。4）组件研究表明，单个优先级句子即可产生强控制（86.7–100.0个百分点），额外指导文本的贡献因组别和方向而异。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了一条报告原则：评估计划对Agent的影响时，应联合报告优先级响应、呈现依赖的默认行为以及任务成功率与成本三个维度，不能将删除计划的效应等同于对替代优先级的服从度。研究支持"默认陷阱"作为可量化偏差的存在，并强调应将信息呈现方式纳入评估设计，使对比基线本身成为可控实验变量。

title: Where Does Staleness Accumulate? Pool Aware Effective Staleness Control for Asynchronous RL in LLM Post-Training
summary: Fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves resource utilization in large language model post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but it also introduces policy lag as trajectories are generated and queued while the trainer continues to update. We study how this lag accumulates over a trajectory's lifetime and how it can be controlled without sacrificing the wall-clock benefits of asynchronous execution. We decompose trajectory staleness into Generation Staleness, accumulated before rollout completion, and Waiting Staleness, accumulated after a completed trajectory enters the pool. Motivated by this decomposition, we introduce PACE (Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness). PACE converts excess pool occupancy into an adaptive rejection budget and ranks completed trajectories using an effective-staleness score that combines Waiting Staleness with prefix-aware Generation Staleness. This avoids penalizing long or interrupted rollouts solely because they span multiple policy versions. In single-turn mathematical reasoning, PACE improves the six-benchmark average validation accuracy by 18.7\% over unfiltered asynchronous RL at the same wall-clock budget and matches synchronous RL performance with 47.1\% less GPU time. PACE also improves validation performance in multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning, outperforming both synchronous and unfiltered asynchronous RL. Further experiments with the mixture-of-experts model and an alternative RL algorithm support its applicability across model architectures and training algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACE（Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness）方法，通过将轨迹陈旧性分解为生成陈旧性（Generation Staleness）和等待陈旧性（Waiting Staleness），并采用自适应拒绝预算与有效陈旧性评分机制，解决全异步强化学习中策略滞后（policy lag）导致的性能下降问题，在保持异步执行效率优势的同时提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 全异步强化学习虽然能通过将rollout生成与策略优化重叠来提高大语言模型后训练的资源利用率，但会引入策略滞后问题——即在训练器持续更新的同时，生成的轨迹被排队等待，造成轨迹陈旧性（staleness）累积。现有方法或牺牲异步执行的时钟效率优势，或因策略滞后而损失性能，缺少一种能在不牺牲时钟优势的前提下控制陈旧性的方法。
AI.method: 1. **陈旧性分解**：将轨迹陈旧性分解为生成陈旧性（rollout完成前累积）和等待陈旧性（轨迹进入池后累积）。2. **自适应拒绝预算**：将过量的池占用（pool occupancy）转化为自适应拒绝预算。3. **有效陈旧性评分**：综合等待陈旧性与前缀感知的生成陈旧性（prefix-aware Generation Staleness），对已完成的轨迹进行排序，避免仅因轨迹跨越多个策略版本而对其进行惩罚。4. **单轮与多轮实验验证**：在单轮数学推理与多轮工具集成推理任务上验证方法有效性，并在混合专家（MoE）模型与替代RL算法上进行泛化性测试。
AI.result: 1. **单轮数学推理**：在六个基准测试的平均验证准确率上，PACE相比未过滤的异步RL提升了18.7%（相同时钟预算下），并以47.1%更少的GPU时间达到了同步RL的性能水平。2. **多轮工具集成推理**：PACE改善了验证性能，超越了同步RL和未过滤的异步RL。3. **泛化性**：在MoE模型架构和替代RL算法上的进一步实验支持了该方法的广泛适用性。
AI.conclusion: PACE通过精细的轨迹陈旧性控制机制，有效解决了全异步强化学习中的策略滞后问题，既保留了异步执行的时钟效率优势，又显著提升了模型性能。该方法在多种推理任务、模型架构和RL算法上均表现出色，具有良好的通用性和实用价值。

title: ARC-KV: Amortizing Anchor Search for Reconstruction-Based KV Cache Compaction
summary: Long-context large language model inference is bottlenecked by KV caches that grow linearly with sequence length. This burden is especially severe for long, reusable context prefixes, whose cache must serve many downstream queries. Reconstruction-based methods such as Attention Matching achieve strong downstream task performance with compact KV caches. However, iterative anchor search dominates the compaction cost of OMP-based Attention Matching. This motivates our selective amortization principle of learning a reusable anchor-selection policy across contexts while retaining context-specific reconstruction. In this work, we propose ARC-KV, a novel reconstruction-based KV cache compaction method that follows this principle. To this end, we first train a value-aware indexer to select real-key anchors in a single scoring pass. ARC-KV then applies convex-hull-constrained key merging and fits an attention-mass bias and compact values against the full cache. At inference time, ARC-KV builds the compact cache once per context using the frozen indexer and reuses it for all subsequent queries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ARC-KV outperforms reported compaction methods in most settings across QuALITY, RULER, and LongBench on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. In particular, at 10% KV retention on QuALITY, ARC-KV improves accuracy from 0.6409 to 0.6474 over Attention Matching while reducing compaction time by a factor of 25.73, from 959.8 s to 37.3 s.

AI.tldr: ARC-KV提出了一种选择性摊销的KV缓存压缩方法，通过训练一个值感知索引器来替代基于OMP的Attention Matching中昂贵的迭代锚点搜索，从而在保持重建质量的同时大幅降低压缩时间。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM推理受限于随序列长度线性增长的KV缓存。现有的重建式压缩方法（如OMP-based Attention Matching）虽然能保持高质量的紧凑缓存，但其迭代锚点搜索占据了绝大部分压缩时间（64K tokens下需15.36小时）。核心问题在于：锚点选择策略可以跨上下文泛化学习，而重建操作必须针对特定上下文进行拟合。
AI.method: ARC-KV采用选择性摊销原则，将压缩流程分为三个上下文特定阶段：(1) 锚点选择：训练一个值感知索引器（扩展自DeepSeek稀疏注意力索引器，增加值注意力头），通过单次评分从完整缓存中选择真实键锚点；(2) 凸包约束的键合并：根据参考查询的归一化注意力响应剖面将非锚点键分配给最近的锚点组，然后通过质量加权质心合并，并约束在凸包内；(3) 闭式拟合：通过投影最小二乘法解析求解注意力质量偏置β和紧凑值Cv。训练时使用KL散度预热加联合目标（硬选择前向+软替代梯度），以保持查询输出保真度。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，ARC-KV在QuALITY、RULER和LongBench v1的15个基准-保留率设置中有13个排名第一。在QuALITY的10%保留率下，准确率从0.6409提升到0.6474，压缩时间从959.8秒降至37.3秒（加速25.73倍）。跨模型评估（Qwen3-8B和Gemma-3-12B-IT）也验证了泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ARC-KV通过将可泛化的锚点选择策略与上下文特定的重建操作解耦，成功解决了重建式KV缓存压缩中迭代搜索的成本瓶颈，同时在多个长上下文基准上达到了领先性能，为可重用上下文前缀的高效压缩提供了实用方案。

title: Automated Screw Planning for Reduced Pelvic Fractures Based on Statistical Shape Models and Deep Learning
summary: Percutaneous iliosacral screw fixation is an important minimally invasive treatment for unstable pelvic fractures. Because the sacroiliac region has complex anatomy and narrow screw corridors, the accuracy and safety of screw placement directly affect surgical outcomes. Accurate and reliable preoperative screw planning is therefore essential to improve surgical success and reduce intraoperative risks. Conventional preoperative planning typically requires surgeons to determine screw trajectories through manual measurements, a labor-intensive process that depends on subjective clinical experience. To address these challenges, we propose a fully automated pipeline for preoperative iliosacral screw planning in patients with pelvic fractures. Using patient-specific three-dimensional anatomy, the pipeline automatically identifies safe screw corridors and generates individualized insertion trajectories to support clinical preoperative planning. We evaluated the proposed pipeline on 200 clinical cases of pelvic fractures. Compared with conventional manual measurements, the safety margin of the safe insertion corridors increased by 2% across the four screw types, the mean planning time decreased by more than 90%, and the clinical acceptance rate reached 95%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于骨盆骨折患者术前髂骶螺钉规划的完全自动化流程，可在患者特定的三维解剖结构上自动识别安全螺钉通道并生成个性化置钉路径，在200例临床病例中显著提高了规划效率和安全性。
AI.motivation: 髂骶螺钉经皮固定是治疗不稳定骨盆骨折的重要微创方式，但骶髂区域解剖结构复杂、螺钉通道狭窄，传统术前规划依赖医生手工测量和主观临床经验，耗时且依赖个人判断，无法保证准确性和安全性。
AI.method: 提出一种完全自动化的术前髂骶螺钉规划流程：基于患者特定的三维解剖模型，自动识别安全的螺钉通道（safe screw corridors），并生成个性化的置钉轨迹（individualized insertion trajectories），以支持临床术前规划。该方法在200例临床骨盆骨折病例上进行了评估，并与传统手工测量方法对比。
AI.result: 在200例临床骨盆骨折病例的评估中，相比传统手工测量：(1) 四类螺钉的安全置钉通道安全裕度平均提升2%；(2) 平均规划时间缩短超过90%；(3) 临床接受率达到95%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的全自动术前髂骶螺钉规划流程能够显著提升规划效率（时间缩短>90%）、改善螺钉通道安全性（安全裕度+2%），并获得高临床接受率（95%），证明其在骨盆骨折微创手术术前规划中具有重要的临床应用价值。

title: When Upstream Messages Override Correct Answers: A Controlled Study of Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems rely on message passing among specialized agents to accomplish complex tasks. However, an upstream agent may provide useful information or an incorrect answer that causes a downstream agent to override a correct answer supported by its own evidence. Prior work has not clearly separated the benefits of communication from the damage caused by incorrect messages. We study this problem with controlled experiments across five benchmarks and five receivers, keeping the downstream task and evidence fixed while comparing answers under three conditions: no message, the upstream agent's original message, or a message with the opposite conclusion. Our experiments reveal three key findings. First, messages often help when the downstream agent would otherwise answer incorrectly. Second, messages can also hurt: when the downstream agent would answer correctly without a message, an incorrect upstream message changes the answer in up to 32% of cases. Third, in 94% of audited harmful cases, the downstream agent copies the upstream's specific wrong answer--a pattern we term answer substitution. Removing unreliable messages recovers part of the lost accuracy, suggesting that communication should be selective based on upstream reliability and the evidence already available to the downstream agent.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过受控实验，系统研究了多智能体LLM系统中上游智能体消息对下游智能体判断的影响。研究发现：当下游智能体拥有独立证据并能独立正确作答时，上游错误消息会导致高达32%的正确答案被覆盖，其中94%的覆盖是下游智能体直接采纳了上游的具体错误答案（即"答案替换"现象）。这一现象在5个基准测试和5个接收模型上稳定存在。论文将这种模式命名为"答案替换"，并提出了基于错误检测的选择性消息门控作为缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统通过智能体间的消息传递完成复杂任务，但上游智能体的错误会传播到下游。现有研究未能清晰区分通信带来的收益与错误消息造成的损害。该论文旨在研究：当下游智能体已拥有足够证据能够独立得出正确答案时，上游错误消息是否仍会覆盖其正确判断，以及这一现象的程度与机制。
AI.method: 采用2×2析因设计：(1) 是否有独立证据；(2) 是否显示上游消息。在5个基准（BIRD、HotpotQA、LBMusique、2WikiMultihopQA、DROP）和5个接收模型上进行实验，比较"无消息"、"原始消息"和"结论反转消息"三种条件下下游答案的变化。引入替代解释排除控制：源标签控制、延迟接收控制、最小编辑控制、匹配审查控制、思维链诊断等。同时进行错误门控恢复实验，使用oracle错误知识检测并移除不可靠消息。
AI.result: 1) 25个单元格中Γ均为正（p<0.0001），证据的存在大幅降低消息边际价值；2) 条件分解显示：当上游正确时消息有帮助（τ>0），当上游错误时消息有害（τ<0）；3) 在可独立解答的2667个项目中，297个正确答案被覆盖（11.1%），最高单格率达32%；4) 对82个c→w转换的审计显示，94%的覆盖是下游采纳了上游的具体错误答案（"答案替换"）；5) 结论反转实验在11/11单元格中均显著：纠正错误结论恢复准确率，破坏正确结论降低准确率；6) 源标签、延迟接收、格式变化等替代解释均不成立；7) 错误门控恢复（检测错误后移除消息+更换接收模型）可恢复+21.7至+30.8pp的准确率，但检测精度需达66%-94%以上才可盈亏平衡；8) 思维链推理无法可靠消除该现象。
AI.conclusion: 该研究识别了多智能体LLM系统中一个被忽视的可靠性问题：当上游消息出错时，即便下游智能体持有充分独立证据，错误消息仍会定向覆盖其正确答案，最高覆盖率达32%，且94%的覆盖针对上游的具体错误答案。聚合层面消息价值接近于零（帮助与伤害几乎抵消），说明下游智能体无法有效"自由处置"上游消息（违反价值信息理论的非负性预期）。基于错误检测的选择性消息门控是可恢复部分损失的可行策略。系统设计应基于上游可靠性和下游证据状态评估消息价值，而非默认转发。

title: IronLLM: Forging Compact Edge-Native Language Models for Real-Time Embodied Intelligence
summary: We present IronLLM-0.6B, a 654M-parameter language model designed for efficient on-device inference. IronLLM-0.6B combines a hybrid attention architecture with X-MTP, a lightweight shared-KV multi-token prediction design that eliminates per-depth KV-cache replay and employs a lightweight verification head for rollback-free drafting, achieving a 1.48x decoding speedup. The model is pretrained on approximately 6.2 trillion tokens using a quality-oriented data pipeline and is further post-trained with Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation to integrate capabilities from domain-specialized teachers. To better meet the low-latency requirements of on-device scenarios, IronLLM-0.6B adopts an Instruct-Only design. Evaluations show that IronLLM-0.6B achieves competitive performance relative to larger models such as Qwen3.5-0.8B and MiniCPM5-1B, while producing more concise responses on many tasks. We further present IronLLM-0.6B-Light, which replaces RMSNorm with Dynamic Tanh and simplifies several computationally expensive components to improve inference and quantization efficiency. Together, the IronLLM models provide an effective performance-efficiency trade-off for resource-constrained deployment.

AI.tldr: IronLLM-0.6B is a 654M-parameter compact language model designed for efficient on-device inference targeting embodied intelligence applications. It features a hybrid attention architecture (Gated DeltaNet + GQA), X-MTP speculative decoding with shared KV-cache achieving 1.48x speedup, and a quality-driven training pipeline on 6.2T tokens. The Instruct-Only design produces concise responses suitable for low-latency edge deployment.
AI.motivation: The paper addresses the critical need for compact, high-performance language models for embodied intelligence scenarios (robots, in-vehicle systems, smart cockpits) where inference latency, memory footprint, and energy consumption outweigh raw model capacity. Small models face unique challenges in data sensitivity, architectural efficiency, and post-training capability preservation that require specialized design.
AI.method: The approach combines four key innovations: (1) Hybrid attention architecture with Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and GQA layers at 3:1 ratio with Zero-RMSNorm; (2) X-MTP shared-KV multi-token prediction eliminating per-depth KV replay, plus lightweight verification head for rollback-free drafting; (3) Quality-oriented data pipeline on 6.2T tokens with WSD learning rate schedule and three-stage curriculum; (4) Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) that decouples capability production (specialist models) from capability integration via token-level reverse KL distillation plus verifiable rewards. The Light variant replaces RMSNorm with Dynamic Tanh, uses ReLUx activations, and employs data-independent gating for extreme efficiency.
AI.result: IronLLM-0.6B achieves performance competitive with Qwen3.5-0.8B and MiniCPM5-1B despite being smaller, winning 8/19 base benchmarks and leading in instruction following, math reasoning, and subjective quality. Decoding speed reaches 460 tokens/s at 1K context, maintaining 377 tokens/s at 32K (vs Qwen3-0.6B at 166 tokens/s). X-MTP achieves 1.37-1.48x speedup on math/code tasks with 3.3-3.6 tokens committed per step. The Light variant retains most capabilities (5.5 point average deficit) with improved inference/quantization efficiency. MOPD outperforms TIES merging on all 13 tested benchmarks for capability integration.
AI.conclusion: The IronLLM models establish an effective capability-efficiency frontier for resource-constrained edge deployment. The work demonstrates that compact models can achieve competitive performance through careful co-design of architecture (hybrid attention), data efficiency (6.2T vs 36T tokens for Qwen3), training methodology (MOPD), and inference optimization (X-MTP, Instruct-Only design). Future directions include more capable edge architectures, robot-side deployment, multimodality, and broader hardware evaluation for embodied tasks.

title: State Trace Rationale As Auxiliary Task in Reinforcement Learning
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: We propose STRAT, an auxiliary task that trains deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents to predict a short textual trace of their own state. Inspired by human spatial navigation, the description combines landmark, route, and survey knowledge, tracking the agent's position, inventory, goals, and immediate progress. Environment rules generate this text online without human labelling. Our method adds a single auxiliary head to a standard policy. Across 60 sparse-reward XLand-MiniGrid tasks, STRAT solves complex environments where standard RL fails outright, while compacting state representations and preventing rank collapse. Beyond performance gains, the predicted trace provides a readable account of agent beliefs at every step for no extra cost.

AI.tldr: STRAT (State-Trace Rationale as Auxiliary Task) 在深度强化学习中增加一个辅助预测头，要求智能体基于人类空间导航框架（landmark/route/survey）预测自身状态的简短文本trace。文本标签由环境规则在线自动生成，无需人工标注。在60个稀疏奖励的XLand-MiniGrid任务上，STRAT在标准PPO完全失败的中等难度任务上取得了显著性能提升，同时压缩了状态表征、防止了表征秩坍塌，并提供每步可读的智能体信念。
AI.motivation: 在稀疏奖励的深度强化学习中，学习到的表征往往只捕捉与回报相关的信息，可能不足以支撑复杂任务。已有辅助任务多关注像素、下一帧或潜状态等任务无关目标，而基于语言的辅助任务虽已出现，但未明确描述内容应包含什么、各部分重要性如何。人类空间导航通过 landmark（地标）、route（路径）和 survey（全局布局）三类知识协同完成导航，本文以此为动机设计语言辅助任务的监督内容。
AI.method: STRAT 在基于PPO 的actor-critic 策略上添加一个辅助状态trace 预测头。trace 由5 行模板化自然语言组成（共90 个token，其中24 个内容槽可变）：agent position（pos_y, pos_x, direction）→ route knowledge；goal 和 subgoal（由规则集的goal predicate 和反向链式planning 生成）→ landmark knowledge；上一动作及基于值函数差 ΔV 的"closer/farther/same"进度信号 → route knowledge；inventory 持有物 → survey knowledge。标签在rollout 阶段从模拟器状态和任务规则在线生成，不作为策略输入。损失为内容槽上的token 级交叉熵 L_ST，加权 λ_st 加入到 L_PPO + c_v L_V − c_e H 中。基础策略使用Transformer-XL 记忆骨干，主实验在XLand-MiniGrid-R1-9x9 符号观测、243 步稀疏奖励下进行，60 个任务分属small/medium/high 三个benchmark，按 Placed/Go-hold/Beside/Align 四类难度分层，10 个随机种子。消融包括：(1) trace 各组成部分组合（landmark-only、route-only、无action、无position、无goal-subgoal）；(2) 进度标签替换为BFS/欧氏距离；(3) 用GRU 替换Transformer-XL；(4) λ_st 与τ 扫描。表征分析采用40 个时间点上冻结检查点的Minimum Description Length（prequential code length）评估目标可见性、子目标相位、动作、方向、坐标、库存等可解释变量的可压缩性，并使用effective rank、srank、participation ratio、dormant units 四个统计量跟踪表征容量以检测秩坍缩。
AI.result: 在60 个任务中：Placed（easy）类任务PPO 与STRAT 均能解决；Go-hold（medium）类任务上STRAT 在100% 任务上严格优于PPO 且差距显著；Beside（hard）类任务上两者均整体表现不佳，但STRAT 在约40% 环境中明显优于PPO；Align（hardest）类任务两者均无法解决。消融表明：单独landmark（goal/subgoal）或单独route（position/action）信号不足，PPO 在多个Go-hold 任务上完全失败；同时去除action 或position 描述也会显著降低性能。BFS/欧氏距离进度信号与值引导进度信号在样本效率上接近，少数任务上前者更优。λ_st 与τ 对最终回报有影响，应作为超参调节；GRU 骨干在easy 与Beside 任务上同样能获得增益，证明STRAT 不依赖具体记忆架构。表征分析显示：STRAT、STRAT-wa、STRAT-wp 在目标可见性上稳定压缩信息，而STRAT-gs 与PPO 未能压缩；STRAT 在子目标相位、动作、方向、坐标、库存等变量上也表现出比PPO 更优的可压缩性，呈现更透明的表示。容量分析表明STRAT 的effective rank、srank、participation ratio 不发生坍缩，dormant units 几乎为0，与PPO 差异明显。
AI.conclusion: STRAT 通过引入基于人类空间导航框架的状态trace 辅助任务，在不改变推理流程、不增加人工标注的前提下，显著提升PPO 在稀疏奖励长视野任务中的表现，并产出更紧凑、可解释的表征以及每步可读的智能体信念报告；其收益主要来自landmark、route、survey 三类知识的联合监督，未来工作可向更难任务（如Align）的课程式或开放式学习方向发展。

title: WEFT: Scaling Tool-Use Post-Training for General-Purpose Agents
summary: Recent efforts to scale tool-use post-training have largely centered on the synthesis of executable environments, which constitute only one component of a broader agentic interaction system comprising the environment, task, agent harness, and evaluator. Scaling environments in isolation, however, does not guarantee commensurate gains in model performance, because reliable learning signals depend on coherent interactions among all components of the agentic interaction system. To address this problem, we introduce WEFT (Whole-system Evolution For Tool-use Post-training), which couples scalable agentic interaction system construction, execution-driven self-evolution, and stable post-training. WEFT scales agentic interaction system construction across environment breadth, task complexity, and interaction diversity. Execution-driven self-evolution iteratively uses execution traces and state evidence to attribute failures and revise the responsible components, with fresh rollouts evaluating the changes and providing evidence for subsequent evolution rounds. For stable post-training at scale, WEFT addresses both optimization and execution reliability: prefix-preserving sampling retains verified progress and atomic-turn credit assignment localizes learning signals, while MegaMCP maintains isolated, recoverable state across concurrent rollouts over shared tool services. Extensive experiments across various models and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of WEFT for tool-use post-training. WEFT-8B and WEFT-14B outperform all evaluated matched-size environment-scaling baselines on BFCL V4, $\tau^2$-Bench, and Claw-Eval. In particular, WEFT-14B improves over Agent-World-14B by 6.41, 2.23, and 12.27 percentage points. WEFT-35B-A3B further extends these gains to more challenging long-horizon workflow benchmarks, including Toolathlon-Verified and AutomationBench.

AI.tldr: WEFT提出了一种面向工具使用后训练的全系统进化框架，通过协同构建智能体交互系统、执行驱动的自进化以及稳定的大规模后训练，解决了仅扩展可执行环境带来的性能瓶颈问题，并在多个基准测试上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 当前工具使用后训练的规模化主要集中于合成可执行环境，但环境只是智能体交互系统（环境、任务、智能体框架、评估器）的一部分。孤立扩展环境并不能保证模型性能的同步提升，因为可靠的学习信号需要所有组件的协同交互。
AI.method: WEFT框架包含三个核心机制：(1) 可扩展的智能体交互系统构建，跨环境广度、任务复杂度和交互多样性进行扩展；(2) 执行驱动的自进化，利用执行轨迹和状态证据迭代归因失败并修订负责的组件，新一轮rollout评估变更并为后续进化提供证据；(3) 稳定的大规模后训练，包括前缀保留采样以保留已验证的进度、原子回合信用分配以定位学习信号，以及MegaMCP以在共享工具服务的并发rollout中保持隔离和可恢复状态。
AI.result: 在多个模型和基准上的大量实验证明了WEFT在工具使用后训练中的有效性。WEFT-8B和WEFT-14B在BFCL V4、τ²-Bench和Claw-Eval上均优于所有评估的同规模环境扩展基线。具体而言，WEFT-14B相比Agent-World-14B分别提升了6.41、2.23和12.27个百分点。WEFT-35B-A3B进一步将这些增益扩展到更具挑战性的长程工作流基准，包括Toolathlon-Verified和AutomationBench。
AI.conclusion: WEFT通过将训练重点从孤立扩展可执行环境转向整个智能体交互系统的协同进化，有效提升了工具使用后训练的效果和稳定性，为大规模智能体训练提供了更可靠的方法论。

title: Beyond Sub-Gaussian Detector Scores: Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection for Human-LLM Text Segmentation
summary: Mixed human-LLM documents require locating authorship transitions from detector scores whose reliability varies across text units. Existing weighted mean contrasts are vulnerable to extreme scores, while directly replacing means with robust centers obscures how a misplaced boundary changes the population objective. We propose Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection (RWCP), which combines capped reliability weights, Huber profile gains, and narrowest-over-threshold search in reliability coordinates. Our key analysis expresses the population gap between a true and a displaced split as a merge cost, avoiding a closed-form solution for the nonlinear center of a mixed segment. Under explicit curvature, spacing, and dependence conditions, core RWCP recovers the number of changes and localizes their boundaries; its quadratic-loss limit recovers squared weighted CUSUM. We also study RWCP-R, a separately evaluated decoder that shares source centers across nonadjacent passages. Across five retrospective cached-score benchmark families, core RWCP reduces family-macro WindowDiff by 17.6\% relative to weighted change-point detection, and RWCP-R lowers it further. Boundary recovery improves most clearly for isolated changes, while both fixed configurations miss changes in collaborative and densely alternating text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RWCP（Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection）方法，用于在人类与 LLM 混合文本中定位作者切换点。针对现有加权均值对比方法对极端分数脆弱以及直接将均值替换为稳健中心会模糊目标函数的问题，RWCP 结合封顶可靠性权重、Huber 轮廓增益和可靠性坐标下的窄区间阈值搜索。理论核心是将真实分割与偏移分割之间的总体差距表示为合并成本，绕过了混合段非线性中心的封闭解；在显式曲率、间距和依赖条件下实现了变化数量的精确恢复和边界定位；其二次损失极限恢复了加权 CUSUM。还提出 RWCP-R 变体用于在非相邻段落间共享源中心。在五个回顾性基准上，核心 RWCP 将族宏平均 WindowDiff 相对 WCP 降低 17.6%，RWCP-R 进一步降低；但在协作与密集变化文本中两者均漏检变化。
AI.motivation: 混合人机文档需要定位作者切换点而非整体分类。现有加权变化点检测（WCP）使用检测器分数的可靠性加权，但存在三个问题：(1) 极端分数（如罕见 token、代码、短单元）会扭曲加权均值对比；(2) 将均值替换为稳健中心会破坏 CUSUM 的人群分解（错误分割混合两个源位置，其最优中心并非加权算术平均）；(3) 需要依赖感知而非仅亚高斯假设。需要一种既能控制极端值影响、又能给出可分析的人群差距的稳健加权变化点检测方法。
AI.method: 1. 稳健加权轮廓增益：用 Huber 损失代替二次损失，权重由封顶逆方差定义  $w_i^\circ = \Pi_{[w_{\min},w_{\max}]}(\sigma_i^{-2})$；增益 $\hat{\Gamma}_{s,e}(b)$ 为单位置模型与分割模型的优化 Huber 损失之差。2. 可靠性坐标搜索：在累积权重 $W(t)=\sum_{i\le t}w_i$ 上均匀采样区间，应用窄区间阈值原则（NOT），选择总可靠性质量最小的过阈值区间，递归执行；使用置信质量 $g_N$ 保护防止重复发现。3. 合并成本分析：定理 3.8 证明真实边界与偏移边界的人群增益差等于两段合并的过剩风险 $2D^*$，迁移至消除对非线性混合中心的需求。5. RWCP-R 变体：用 Viterbi 解码共享 $S$ 个源状态中心，拟合尺度 $\sigma$，目标函数含 Huber 发射损失与转换惩罚 $\lambda$。6. 理论框架：基于曲率假设、可靠性假设、依赖假设（Bernstein 条件 + $\beta$-混合）、中心质量与间距/信号假设，证明有限样本下变化数精确恢复与加权定位。
AI.result: 在 25 个设置、2,690 个实例的五个基准族（单变化 WikiQA/News/Story、CoAuthor 真实协作、多变化 Story、文本攻击、LLM 比例）上：(1) 核心 RWCP 将族宏平均 WindowDiff 从 WCP 的 0.4070 降至 0.3355（相对 17.6%），在四个族上改善 WD；(2) RWCP-R 进一步降至 0.3110（相对 WCP 23.6%），在 23/25 设置上优于 WCP；19 个逐设置配对 95% 区间低于零；(3) 边界恢复改善最明显的是单变化文本（单变化族 F1 从 0.435 升至 0.544，count MAE 从 1.637 降至 0.340）；(4) 但两者在协作与密集变化文本上均漏检变化：核心 RWCP 在 CoAuthor、多变化、攻击、比例族上分别有 82.4%、93.1%、94.7%、92.8% 的文档未报告边界；(5) RWCP-R 在 84.1% 的 CoAuthor 文档上输出零边界。组件消融显示尺度自适应和有限 Huber 截止改善窗口误差，而统一权重改善 count MAE 和边界 F1。
AI.conclusion: RWCP 通过合并成本识别将稳健变化点检测转化为优化段风险比较，无需求解混合段 Huber 中心的封闭解；二次极限恢复加权 CUSUM。在有界分数集中、可靠性坐标隔离和保护递归下，核心 RWCP 在陈述条件下获得精确计数恢复和加权定位。回顾性评估显示核心 RWCP 平均 WindowDiff 降低且仅在单变化族同时改善计数与 F1；其高零边界率暴露了固定分析阈值在 CoAuthor 与密集/扰动文本上的局限。RWCP-R 通过在非相邻段落间共享信息进一步降低族宏平均 WindowDiff，在单变化上获得最明显的边界恢复增益，但其他族仍存在计数/F1 权衡。窗口级一致性与个体变化恢复回答不同问题；结果支持窗口误差降低而非该基准套上的通用精确计数恢复。遗留问题包括渐进编辑、句内混合、分数语义反转、长记忆依赖与目标相关权重估计。

title: Harness Evolution as Learning: Approximation, Generalization, and Optimization Limits of Self-Improving Personal Agents
summary: As the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) continue to advance, increasing attention is turning to how to translate their abilities into useful behavior. Personal agents bring this question into everyday settings, where models are expected to serve individual users and continually adapt to their preferences. With the underlying model held fixed, such adaptation relies on harness engineering: designing and evolving the surrounding layer that manages context, memory, tools, and execution. Despite rapid progress, the factors governing effective harness evolution remain insufficiently understood. To narrow this gap, we investigate three central questions concerning harness architecture, harness scale, and self-evolution algorithms through complementary empirical and theoretical analyses. Empirically, we introduce a preference-oriented benchmark and systematically characterize the capabilities and limitations of personal agents associated with these three dimensions. Theoretically, we formulate harness evolution as a learning problem and explain these phenomena through approximation, generalization, and optimization errors. Analyses of reachable policies, capacity under finite interaction evidence, and biased update dynamics provide theoretical accounts of the observed phenomena. Together, these results offer a unified perspective on the limits of personalization through harness evolution and inform future harness design.

AI.tldr: 本文将"个人代理的harness演化"建模为机器学习问题，从经验与理论两方面系统分析了围绕固定基础模型的自适应个性化所面临的三大局限性：harness架构的近似误差、harness规模的泛化误差、自演化算法的优化误差，并给出了相应的实验观测与定理解释。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能力提升后，如何将其转化为个人代理在日常场景中持续适配用户偏好的实用行为成为关键问题。现有工作多集中于修改模型参数，但实际部署中基础模型通常被冻结，适应性必须通过外部harness工程实现。harness设计的多样性与演化算法的差异留下了三个未解张力：harness架构、harness规模与自演化算法对个性化效果的影响缺乏统一量化基准与理论解释。
AI.method: 1) 提出AppWorld-P偏好基准，在AppWorld上增加可执行的用户偏好规则层，使偏好合规性可程序化度量。2) 采用固定基础模型claude-haiku-4-5-20251001，控制harness机制、内存长度或更新策略进行对照实验。3) 将harness演化形式化为学习问题，将风险差距分解为近似误差、泛化误差、优化误差三个分量。4) 通过潜概念模型、可达策略集合、信息论上界与Hoeffding不等式、Wasserstein不动点分析等手段给出条件性定理解释（Theorem 4.1–4.4及Corollary 4.3）。
AI.result: 经验结果：在所评估构造下，harness机制选择上，context类harness足以处理本地指令型偏好（如短信署名、付款备注格式），但对需要历史推断或精确计算的偏好（如字符校验和、习惯性支付卡、累计消费）效果有限，加入验证重试或外部计算后合规率显著提升（运行总额违规率从0.44降至0.00）；内存规模上，违规率从L=0时约0.77下降至L=10时约0.20，但继续扩大至L=20–150反而回升至0.25–0.27，呈非单调U型；自演化算法上，ACE、TEPA与TRACE在24次交互后违规率约0.48–0.57，与oracle上下文0.071之间存在持续约0.40的差距，Reflexion几乎无提升。理论上证明了context可达集被预训练策略凸包限制困住而control可达集可超出该凸包；当用户最优策略只能由control达到时，control类近似误差为零而context类严格为正；Theorem 4.2与Corollary 4.3表明泛化界随L严格增大，与覆盖界结合后给出上确界风险的U型覆盖-估计权衡；Theorem 4.4证明在持续更新偏差下，优化误差存在正下界μβ₀²/(2(1+ρ)²)，解释了观察到的持续oracle差距。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出三个核心结论：(1) 个性化合规性依赖harness机制是否与偏好需求匹配，context适合激活既有行为，复杂偏好需要control类干预；(2) 内存扩张并非单调有益，存在覆盖增益与估计误差的权衡，应根据反馈证据量与可靠性决定保留、合并或扩展；(3) 重复自演化未必能闭合oracle差距，算法层面的偏差可能形成正优化下界，需要更丰富反馈、接地修正信号与独立验证记忆编辑。这些发现通过将harness演化形式化为学习问题，统一解释了多样化harness工程实践所对应的误差成分，为未来harness设计与失败诊断提供了统一框架。

title: HorizonFlow: Variable-Length Planning for Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
summary: Recent advances in generative planning have made trajectory inpainting a promising approach to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning. However, these methods typically specify the planning horizon before generating plan content, even though the appropriate horizon depends on the route itself. A horizon that is too short can force infeasible transitions, whereas one that is too long can introduce redundant motion. We introduce HorizonFlow, a hierarchical planner that treats plan length as an output of generation rather than a prescribed input. Its subgoal route planner guides its action-prefix controller through a sequence of latent subgoals. Both components combine insertion-based generation with flow matching to jointly generate continuous plan content and length, using the partially generated plan to guide token insertion. HorizonFlow reuses the resulting length information to select candidates and steer generation toward shorter plans without a separate learned value model. Across Maze2D, Multi2D, and OGBench navigation and visual manipulation benchmarks, HorizonFlow achieves the highest average performance among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HorizonFlow，一种用于离线目标条件强化学习的分层规划器，将规划长度视为生成的输出而非预设输入，通过结合插入式生成与流匹配，联合生成连续计划内容与长度，在 Maze2D、Multi2D 及 OGBench 导航与视觉操控基准上取得了最高的平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式轨迹规划方法（轨迹修复）通常在生成内容之前预设规划时长（horizon），但该时长因路径而异。过短的时长会导致不可行的转移，过长的时长则引入冗余运动，且 VH-Diffuser 等方法使用学习得到的长度预测器仍需在生成前选定时长，时机不匹配会限制计划质量。
AI.method: HorizonFlow 采用分层架构，包含子目标路线规划器（RP，生成变长潜在子目标序列）和动作前缀控制器（PC，生成变长动作前缀）。两者均结合基于插入的生成（insertion-based generation）与流匹配（flow matching），使用部分生成计划指导 token 插入，由共享 Transformer 同时预测速度、缺失 token 数（零截断泊松参数）与间隙完成概率。训练使用对数均匀采样长度、InfoNCE 损失稳定编码器、局部前缀目标及两阶段生成时钟 σ∈[0,2]。推理阶段采用最小计数选择（不依赖学习值函数）与 Feynman–Kac 重采样（基于计数引导分数偏向更短计划），并以滚动时域方式执行。
AI.result: 在 Maze2D/Multi2D（D4RL 归一化得分）、OGBench 导航与视觉操控（成功率）的基准对比中，HorizonFlow 在三组基准上均达到所有对比方法中最高的平均性能，且在长视野环境中优势最大。在 Maze2D-Large 的 XY 路线生成诊断中，联合内容–长度生成在所有标称步数分箱上保持高到达率，而预设时长在近/远目标间存在权衡；生成计数与标称步数的 Spearman 相关性（ρ=0.954）优于 HIQL 值派生长度（0.924）与 VHD 长度预测（0.653）。架构消融显示，用 BC 策略替换前缀控制器将平均成功率从 94.2% 降至 67.8%，去除分层则降至 42.9%。
AI.conclusion: HorizonFlow 证明了将规划长度作为生成输出而非预设输入的可行性，联合插入与流匹配能同时生成连续计划内容与长度，分层架构（RP+PC）对导航任务至关重要。生成计数可在无需单独值模型的情况下用于候选选择与生成引导。基于计数的方法在确定性环境中有效，但其在随机动力学下的适用性有待验证。

title: STAR-GRPO: Canonical Anchoring and Reliability-First Advantages against Representation-Dependent Reward Hacking
summary: Reward hacking occurs when policy optimization exploits a brittle reward interface or an overly permissive proxy objective, improving the training score without improving the underlying response quality. This phenomenon is amplified in group-relative policy optimization: an unsupported reward can shift the group baseline and alter the updates of other rollouts, while post-hoc or purely relative weighting cannot represent group-wide uncertainty. We propose \emph{Self-Tuned Anchored Reliability Group-Relative Policy Optimization} (STAR-GRPO), a reliability-first advantage estimator based on paired assessments of the same rollout. STAR separates the quality signal from its learning influence: score disagreement determines rollout reliability, relative reliability enters a self-tuned robust location--scale fit before group normalization, and absolute group reliability attenuates the resulting bounded advantage. The analysis establishes coordinate and second-moment bounds, characterizes exact centering through the weighted location equation, and gives reliability-dependent attenuation guarantees for outlying rewards. We evaluate STAR-GRPO in two complementary reward-hacking regimes. In token-interface exploitation, STAR prevents runaway optimization of the deployed-interface score while improving the canonical quality signal. In rubric-proxy overoptimization for medical reasoning, STAR improves independent semantic evaluation, narrows the proxy--judge discrepancy, and reduces overclaim while optimizing the same task proxy. Together, these results show that reliability-first normalization offers a principled way to limit unsupported reward influence on both group baselines and policy updates, while retaining the task reward as the optimization target.

AI.tldr: STAR-GRPO（Self-Tuned Anchored Reliability Group-Relative Policy Optimization）是一种针对群组相对策略优化（GRPO）中奖励黑客问题的可靠性优先优势估计器。它通过同一rollout的成对评分差异来评估rollout可靠性，将相对可靠性纳入鲁棒位置-尺度拟合中，并在最终优势中加入绝对组可靠性衰减因子，从而在保持任务奖励作为优化对象的同时，限制不可靠奖励对组基线和策略更新的影响。
AI.motivation: 在群组相对策略优化（GRPO）中，奖励黑客问题尤为突出：单个不可靠的高奖励会偏移组基线，改变其他rollout的优势分配；而后置加权或纯相对权重无法表达整组的不确定性。论文需要：设计一种优势构造方法，使可靠性在归一化前进入组统计，并在更新中保留绝对可靠性量级。
AI.method: 方法核心包括：(1) 成对评分视图——同一rollout使用部署视图和规范化视图（或代理评分与语义锚点）进行双重评估，计算差异 D=R_obs-R_canon；(2) 基于上下文自适应伪Huber鲁棒位置-尺度拟合，生成rollout级可靠性权重；(4) 自调式稳健拟合在归一化前进入组统计，共享跨批次尺度参数；(3) 最终优势为 A_STAR = w̄_b · w_{b,i}/(ν_b+ε_w) · φ_{b,i}，其中 w̄_b 为绝对组可靠性因子。理论分析包括识别边界（定理3.1/B.2/B.4）、量级控制与居中（定理5.1/D.3）、单离群点衰减（命题5.2）以及共形可靠性控制（定理5.3/C.9）。
AI.result: 在两个奖励黑客场景中验证：RQ1（令牌接口利用）：以Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct为策略、Skywork-Reward-V2-Qwen3-8B为奖励模型，STAR将规范化验证奖励从3.121提升至4.902（绝对增益1.781），同时抑制观察接口奖励至-0.570（对比TOMPA-GRPO的9.641）。RQ2（医学推理的rubric-proxy过度优化）：以Qwen3-4B在RubricHub-Medical训练，独立评委得分从0.2706提升至0.3174（+17.3%），代理-评委差距从0.2935降至0.2318（-21.0%），过度声明率从0.2464降至0.2204（-10.6%）。
AI.conclusion: STAR-GRPO提供了一种原则性方法，通过成对评估在归一化前将可靠性纳入组统计，并以绝对组可靠性因子限制有界优势。理论分析建立了坐标界和二阶矩界、精确居中条件以及可靠性依赖的衰减保证；实验证明该方法在两种不同奖励黑客场景下有效，在保持任务奖励作为优化目标的同时，将更多优化信号转化为独立评估可复现的质量。

title: PrecogUI: Proactive GUI Agents via Pre-cognitive Simulation and Experience Retrieval
summary: Existing reactive Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents often fail in long-horizon, dynamic scenarios, where unexpected disturbances trigger attention-diverting and cascading failures. To address this, we propose PrecogUI, a pre-cognitive architecture that shifts the paradigm from reactive execution to proactive decision-making. Specifically, we design a Proactive Experience Pool (PEP), which caches recurring anomaly and success patterns as "state-action-result" tuples in a dual-memory repository. Furthermore, we introduce a Proactive Simulation Executor (PSE) that learns to forecast the next symbolic UI layout given a candidate action, enabling early anomaly avoidance and ranking candidate actions by predicted reliability. Finally, a Pre-cognitive Execution Controller (PEC) fuses these priors and predictions, prioritizes handling of foreseen anomalies, and ensures execution robustness through a closed-loop error correction mechanism. For robust evaluation, we develop AutoTraj, an automatic data-generation engine, to construct InterfereBench, a benchmark for long-horizon tasks with strong disturbances. Experiments demonstrate that PrecogUI surpasses state-of-the-art methods on InterfereBench while maintaining competitive performance on public benchmarks. The code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: PrecogUI提出一种前认知(pre-cognitive)GUI智能体架构，将范式从被动反应式执行转变为主动预测式决策。其核心由三个组件构成：PEP(Proactive Experience Pool)以"状态-动作-结果"元组缓存异常与成功模式；PSE(Proactive Simulation Executor)基于条件扩散模型预测候选动作的下一符号化UI布局以提前规避异常；PEC(Pre-cognitive Execution Controller)融合先验与预测，通过闭环纠错机制实现异常优先处理与执行鲁棒性。同时提出AutoTraj数据生成引擎与InterfereBench基准（34个应用、1160个任务组、约27k标注截图），用于评估长时域、强扰动场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有反应式GUI智能体在长时域、动态场景中容易受弹窗、黑屏等突发扰动影响，导致注意力分散并产生级联失败。实验表明反应式策略在扰动增加或扰动出现较晚时成功率急剧下降，揭示了纯反应式策略的脆弱性，亟需赋予智能体前认知规划与显式异常处理能力。
AI.method: 方法由四个模块组成：(1) AutoTraj数据构建流水线，包含Autonomous Explorer(基于探索价值V平衡布局发现与罕见状态访问)、Trajectory Parser(两阶段过滤与MLLM排序标注)、Perturbation Injector(注入叠加层与环境级扰动生成clean-perturbed配对)以及PolyTouch多手势宏执行层；(2) PEP采用双记忆(Anomaly Memory与Success Memory)，以布局签名(type,bbox)与IoU贪婪匹配实现最近邻检索，并采用版本感知更新策略与指数陈旧衰减；(3) PSE采用条件潜扩散模型预测下一步符号化UI布局，结合规则化的异常识别(遮挡/黑屏/冻结)与布局差异度D_layout生成候选动作可靠性评分；(4) PEC先进行预认知异常检查(检索PEP或规则)，再生成候选动作-格式对(index/relative/absolute)、用PSE过滤高风险候选并执行最高分候选，最后通过布局变化与语义验证进行状态监控与停滞/意外转移恢复(回滚、重试、临时禁忌列表)。
AI.result: 在InterfereBench强扰动子集上，PrecogUI相对最强基线在扰动设置下SR高出22.4和22.1个百分点，扰动导致的SR下降控制在10.8和11.1点(基线下降27-30点)；在AndroidControl-High与GUI-Odyssey上SR分别达76.4%和89.1%；在ScreenSpot跨设备grounding上达91.2%加权平均准确率；在OSWorld 15步/50步协议下分别达20.7%与27.5% SR。消融实验显示PEP/PSE/PEC在强扰动子集上累计带来+10.6/+9.7/+6.6的SR增益。PSE预测质量达89.4%类型准确率、80.2% bbox IoU、83.2%元素级F1；恢复机制在12.4-18.6%的episode中触发，其中69.7-73.1%恢复成功。
AI.conclusion: PrecogUI通过"经验-预见-反馈"闭环显著提升了GUI智能体在长时域、强扰动动态环境中的鲁棒性与可靠性，且在标准grounding与导航基准上保持竞争力。局限性在于：look-ahead仿真与验证引入额外延迟与计算开销；经验先验可能因应用更新而过时。未来工作应采用轻量化、可任意时刻终止的预测与漂移感知的记忆维护策略。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Computer Use: Learning Reusable Policies for Reliable and Efficient Execution
summary: Many computer tasks recur: the same workflow runs many times, with new inputs and from different starting states. Current computer-use agents re-plan every step of every run, which makes them costly and unreliable on such tasks. We introduce neuro-symbolic computer use, in which a recurring workflow is executed by a learned policy rather than re-derived by an agent on each run. The policy fixes the decisions that are stable across runs (ordering, variables, loops, and branches) in executable code, and delegates observation-dependent decisions, such as grounding and state checks, to neural models. We learn these policies with neuro-symbolic policy iteration: starting from one agent trajectory, it executes the policy, diagnoses failures with task-completion and step-level judges, and revises the code with a coding model informed by an agent's continuation from the point of failure, without access to the benchmark evaluator. Iterating on generated parameter and initial-state variants makes the policy reusable, and a pre-action verifier guards each state-mutating step at deployment. On OSWorld-Verified and ScienceBoard, the learned policies achieve the highest Pass^3 of all methods in all four settings, 3.6-15.8 points above the base agent, while cutting per-run cost by 15-217$\times$ and latency by 3.4-5.1$\times$. On OSWorld-Verified, policies built only on variants transfer to the held-out original tasks, exceeding AutoRPA by 8.6-17.5 points in Pass^3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"神经符号化计算使用"范式，通过将重复性工作流编码为可复用的神经符号策略（代码处理稳定决策，神经网络处理依赖观测的决策），并采用神经符号策略迭代（NSPI）从智能体轨迹中学习这些策略。在OSWorld和ScienceBoard基准测试中，该方法显著提升了重复运行可靠性（Pass^3提升3.6-15.8分），同时将单次运行成本降低15-217倍、延迟降低3.4-5.1倍，并在工作流变体迁移任务上超越AutoRPA 8.6-17.5分。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体在每次执行时都从头规划每一步，对于重复性工作流既昂贵又不可靠；现有RPA方法则在环境变化时容易失效。本文旨在解决这一矛盾，使智能体能够将执行经验转化为可复用的程序，同时保持对状态变化的适应性。
AI.method: 1. 神经符号策略：代码处理稳定的工作流结构（顺序、变量、循环、分支），神经原语处理依赖观测的决策（如GUI定位、状态检查）；2. 神经符号策略迭代（NSPI）：从单条智能体轨迹初始化策略，通过执行-诊断-探索-修订循环迭代优化，使用任务完成判断器和模块级判断器定位失败，由编码模型根据智能体从失败点的延续进行代码修复；3. 通过在生成的参数/初始状态变体上训练实现策略泛化；4. 部署时使用前置动作验证器守护每个状态变更步骤。
AI.result: 在OSWorld（361任务）和ScienceBoard（169任务）上使用GPT-5.6 Terra和Claude Opus 5作为骨干模型：NSPI在全部四种设置中Pass^3均为最高，比基础智能体高3.6-15.8分；单次运行成本降低15-217倍，延迟降低3.4-5.1倍；在仅基于变体训练的策略迁移到保留原任务上，Pass^3超越AutoRPA 8.6-17.5分；构造成本可在3-27次执行后回收。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号计算使用范式成功将执行经验转化为可复用策略，在重复执行可靠性和效率方面显著优于纯神经智能体和传统RPA；策略泛化能力和前置验证器进一步增强了实用性；长工作流和判断器分析揭示了轨迹到策略转换及策略评估的剩余瓶颈，更好的获取与验证方法可进一步扩展该方法的适用范围。

title: Learn from the Gap: Differential-Aware Advantage Pruning with Adaptive Rollout Sampling for GRPO
summary: Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and its variants have been developed for policy optimization and demonstrated notable performance gains. However, these methods usually incur substantial computational overhead due to per-question multi-rollout sampling and repeated per-token probability evaluation across rollouts. Furthermore, low-information or highly homogeneous trajectories can degrade downstream learning signal efficiency, hindering model optimization and limiting final performance. To address these issues, we propose FastRL, a novel plug-and-play reinforcement learning framework that simultaneously improves training efficiency and the effectiveness of policy learning. Specifically, 1) We introduce an advantage-aware pruning strategy to selectively preserve high-advantage trajectories while maximizing inter-trajectory gradient diversity. 2) Then, we design an adaptive rollout sampling mechanism to dynamically adjust the sampling scale across different training stages based on historical pruning distributions, balancing exploration adequacy and computational efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that FastRL can be seamlessly integrated into GRPO, DAPO, and GSPO variants, achieving an average 2.07$\times$ training speedup on Geometry3K and GeoQA8K-R1V, along with an approximately 1.64\% improvement in average accuracy on visual reasoning benchmarks. Source codes will be available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出FastRL，一个即插即用的强化学习框架，通过"最大化差异性优势剪枝"（MDAP）和"自适应Rollout采样"（ARS）两个核心模块，在GRPO系列算法（GRPO/DAPO/GSPO）上同时实现训练加速与性能提升，实验获得平均2.07倍训练加速和约1.64%准确率提升。
AI.motivation: GRPO及其变体（如DAPO、GSPO）在策略优化中表现优异，但存在两大瓶颈：(1) 每个问题需多轮rollout采样并对每个token重复进行概率评估，计算开销巨大；(2) 低信息量或高度同质的轨迹会降低下游学习信号的效率，引入模式崩溃风险。现有加速方法（如CPPO、GRESO）存在效率-性能的权衡困境：加速明显时性能下降，性能保持时加速有限。
AI.method:
FastRL包含两个互补模块：
- **最大化差异性优势剪枝（MDAP）**：将同一问题内G条轨迹按优势值分组（Eq.6），在每个优势组内用n-gram Jaccard相似度（Eq.7）作为梯度相似度的代理，通过贪心最大独立集选择（阈值τ=0.8，Eq.8）去除低信息和高同质轨迹，保留结构多样的代表性轨迹。
- **自适应Rollout采样（ARS）**：基于历史剪枝统计量（均值G^mean和最大值G^max，Eq.10-11）动态调整下一轮的rollout数量（G_{t+1}=max(round(G_1-Δ_t), 2)，Eq.14），通过复合权重α（Eq.11）随训练进度从偏向探索转向偏向效率。

两个模块协同工作：MDAP消除梯度计算阶段的冗余，ARS消除rollout采样阶段的冗余，且MDAP的剪枝统计驱动ARS的采样调整。
AI.result:
在Geometry3K和GeoQA8K-R1V两个数据集上，使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct两个基模型：
- **训练效率**：FastRL集成到GRPO/DAPO/GSPO后，平均获得2.07倍训练加速（最高2.22倍），同时训练时间减半以上。
- **准确率**：在域内和4个域外基准（MathVerse/MathVision/MathVista/WeMath）上，平均准确率提升约1.64%。
- **消融实验**：移除MDAP导致加速从2.14×降至1.15×，准确率下降0.72-1.43%；移除ARS导致加速下降0.08-0.28×，准确率下降0.15-1.89%，证明两模块互补。
- **泛化性**：在纯文本MATH数据集上使用Llama3.1-8B-Instruct，FastRL获得2.30倍加速且准确率最高（73.04%）；Pass@16指标也优于所有基线，证明未压缩探索空间。
- **训练动态**：FastRL保持最低token消耗和最稳定的策略熵（避免熵崩溃），且收敛更快。
- **细粒度分析**：MDAP主要加速优化阶段（update_actor压缩约2.64×），ARS主要加速rollout生成阶段（timing_gen压缩1.09-1.31×）。
- **超参数τ的敏感性**：τ=0.8为最佳平衡点（最大加速下保持最高准确率）。
- **剪枝策略分析**：随机剪枝导致性能显著下降；仅按优势分组（每组保留1条）已达2.35×加速；叠加Jaccard剪枝后才达到52.63%的准确率，证明Jaccard剪枝防止误剪高价值但同优势的结构多样化轨迹。
AI.conclusion: FastRL通过"学习差异"的核心洞察，有效解决了GRPO变体中效率-性能的权衡问题。其结构化剪枝策略保留最具信息量的轨迹，自适应采样机制平衡探索与效率。实验证明该框架在多模型、多数据集、多模态（视觉和文本）设置下均具有广泛的适用性和鲁棒性。未来工作需将MDAP扩展至连续奖励函数场景（需通过分段离散化等任务特定设计实现）。

title: VLALight: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Traffic Signal Control
summary: Traffic signal control (TSC) is essential for improving urban mobility and reducing congestion. Although roadside cameras are widely deployed at signalized intersections and provide rich visual observations of evolving traffic, existing TSC methods typically rely on manually engineered traffic states or separate perception modules, creating a gap between physical observations and control decisions. We present VLALight, the first vision-language-action (VLA) model for end-to-end traffic signal control from multi-view roadside videos. VLALight directly maps visual observations to coordinated signal actions through multi-target spatiotemporal traffic reasoning and topology-aware cooperative perception across intersections. To establish this capability, we develop a two-stage supervised cold-start training strategy for visual traffic understanding and signal decision-making, followed by cooperative agentic reinforcement learning that jointly optimizes local control and network-wide traffic efficiency. Furthermore, VLALight introduces adaptive fast and slow reasoning modes, enabling the policy to allocate deeper reasoning only when additional deliberation provides sufficient control benefits. Through balanced mode-aware rollouts and relative advantage optimization, VLALight learns to trade off decision quality and inference cost. Extensive experiments on seven real-world traffic-flow datasets across three urban networks demonstrate that VLALight consistently outperforms transportation-based, RL-based, and LLM/VLM-based baselines. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of cooperative perception, network-level optimization, and adaptive reasoning. These results demonstrate the potential of VLA models for real-world physical traffic control. Our project is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: VLALight是首个面向交通信号控制的端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，直接从多视角路侧视频推理时空交通状态并生成协同信号相位决策。其采用两阶段监督冷启动训练（视觉感知+决策）+协同智能体强化学习，并引入自适应快/慢推理模式以平衡决策质量与推理开销，在七个真实交通流数据集上全面优于交通工程、RL及LLM/VLM基线。
AI.motivation: 现有交通信号控制方法依赖手工构造的交通状态（如排队长度、车辆计数）或分离的感知模块，导致物理观测与控制决策之间存在鸿沟；同时现成的视觉语言模型缺乏交通时空推理能力，限制了从原始路侧视频进行端到端控制的可行性。
AI.method: VLALight基于Qwen3.5-4B构建，包含：(1)多目标时空交通感知模块，从四方向视频提取车道级车辆数、排队长度及变化量；(2)拓扑感知的协同感知，沿路网有向图路由邻接交叉口的感知结果（直接协调帧+邻居方向压力）；(3)两阶段监督冷启动——第一阶段学习视觉感知，第二阶段利用DeepSeek教师生成推理轨迹并按队列差异标注Fast/Slow模式；(4)协同智能体RL，采用GDPO式维度独立归一化融合局部奖励、网络奖励、格式奖励与推理成本惩罚，并通过人为平衡的Fast/Slow rollout实现自适应模式选择。
AI.result: 在济南（12路口）、杭州（16路口）、纽约（196路口）三个城市网络的7个真实交通流数据集上，VLALight在21项数据集-指标对比中取得16项最优，纽约网络AQL和AWT相对SOTA基线分别降低5.5–13.0%和6.7–12.1%；消融实验验证协同信息、网络级奖励、平衡Fast/Slow rollout的必要性；自适应推理使平均延迟降至3.936s（比Pure Slow低12.7%），且慢模式比例随队列负载从38.86%单调升至63.14%。
AI.conclusion: VLALight证明了VLA模型在物理交通信号控制中的可行性，通过端到端视觉输入+协同时空推理+自适应推理效率，在大规模城市路网中实现了优于现有交通工程、RL及LLM控制器的网络级交通效率，为真实部署中的视觉驱动交通控制奠定了基础。

title: CoEM: Empowering Long-Context Reasoning with Commit-on-Evidence Memory
comment: 38 pages, 13 figures. Code repository: this https URL
summary: Long-context reasoning is essential for complex and long-horizon tasks, yet the performance of large language models (LLMs) degrades as context length increases. Recent approaches address this by processing input chunk by chunk while maintaining a bounded textual memory in model context. However, premature information compression can discard critical details essential for subsequent reasoning. In this paper, we introduce Commit-on-Evidence Memory (CoEM), which learns when to convert source evidence into compact memory facts. Specifically, under a fixed context-memory budget, CoEM preserves potentially useful source excerpts verbatim in a pending set, allowing subsequent context to clarify their relevance before irreversible compression. As new context arrives, a learned policy revisits each pending excerpt and decides whether to promote it to the committed memory, retain it for further consideration, or discard it. A frozen verifier ensures proposed facts are accepted only if supported by retained excerpts and current context. To further guide effective memory management, we train this policy using reinforcement learning by combining fine-grained, step-level evidence rewards with final answer rewards. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoEM consistently improves long-context reasoning. When evaluated on 6,400 documents long-context input, CoEM outperforms the strongest memory baseline by 10.4-11.4 F1 points on Qwen3.5-9B. Code repository: this https URL .

AI.tldr: CoEM提出了一种新的递归记忆机制，通过"承诺-基于证据"的策略，将固定上下文记忆预算划分为已提交记忆和待定证据集，允许在后续上下文明确相关性后再进行不可逆压缩，从而解决长上下文推理中过早压缩导致关键信息丢失的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有递归记忆方法在处理长上下文时面临"过早信息压缩"的关键缺陷：当证据在初次观察时看似无关，但后续上下文出现后才变得关键时，立即压缩会不可逆地丢弃这些重要信息。论文通过诊断分析发现32.03%-44.53%的多跳问答问题存在延迟证据相关性现象。
AI.method: CoEM将固定上下文记忆预算分为两部分：(1)已提交记忆M_t存储压缩事实；(2)待定集P_t保留原文片段。策略对新证据执行Promote、Keep、Drop三种操作，Keep允许证据保留直至后续上下文澄清其相关性。冻结的NLI验证器（DeBERTaV3-small）在承诺前检查事实是否有源支持。采用强化学习训练策略，结合步级证据奖励和最终答案奖励，并使用return-to-go机制将后续验证反馈传递给早期记忆决策。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue三个多跳问答基准上，使用Qwen3.5-4B和Qwen3.5-9B骨干网络，CoEM在所有上下文长度（50-6400文档）上均优于预算匹配的基线方法。在6400文档长输入下，CoEM（Qwen3.5-9B）相比最强基线ReMemR1提升10.4-11.4 F1点，且在128块证据间隔下比最强基线高25.3 F1点。验证器仅需4.3 ms/对的延迟（比Qwen3.5-9B验证器快约69倍），忠实度达97.2%。
AI.conclusion: CoEM通过将证据支持与相关性判断解耦，有效解决了长上下文推理中延迟证据相关性问题。核心贡献在于：自适应保留未解决证据直到后续上下文澄清、源验证确保记忆质量、步级证据奖励提供中间监督。实验证明长上下文记忆应同时决定"记住什么"和"何时压缩"，未来可扩展至代码和科学文档场景。

title: SCA: Spatial Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning of GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents automate tasks on digital devices by grounding language instructions in visual interfaces. Existing group-relative reinforcement learning improves GUI action prediction by comparing the rewards of multiple responses sampled from the same GUI state. However, binary evaluation treats spatially different failed clicks as identical and provides no relative signal when all sampled clicks fail. To address these limitations, we propose Spatial Credit Assignment (SCA), which uses the screen coordinates of sampled clicks to refine group-relative credit. Specifically, SCA predicts each held-out response's reward from the other responses in groups containing both successes and failures, then uses the prediction residual to adjust credit. When all sampled clicks fail, SCA instead orders them by distance to the annotated target. These spatial references are used only to construct the training update; the deployed policy remains unchanged. We evaluate whether this correction improves the policy update itself by comparing its error and directional alignment with the exact return gradient in a controlled synthetic study. Across GUI grounding and offline action-prediction benchmarks, SCA improves grounding across professional domains and achieves the strongest results among reinforcement-fine-tuned models on most action-prediction metrics, with consistent gains across the reported GUI suites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出空间信用分配（SCA），一种针对GUI智能体分组强化学习的新型信用分配方法。SCA利用采样点击的屏幕坐标来细化组相对信用，解决了二元评估将空间上不同的失败点击视为相同以及全失败组无相对信号的问题。SCA包含两个分支：Residual（通过留一法预测混合命中组的奖励残差）和Prox（全失败组按距目标距离排序）。在ScreenSpot-Pro和多个动作预测基准上取得最佳RFT结果，并通过精确梯度分析验证了其机制有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的分组相对强化学习（如GRPO、RLOO）通过比较同一GUI状态下多个采样响应的奖励来改进GUI动作预测。然而，二元评估存在两个问题：(1)将空间上不同的失败点击视为相同，未利用点击位置的空间信息；(2)当所有采样点击都失败时，组优势为零，丢弃了有用的空间证据。这限制了强化微调在GUI任务中的效果。
AI.method: 方法核心：SCA基于采样点击的屏幕坐标，在三种奖励机制下路由信用分配：(1)混合命中组：SCA-Residual将坐标投影到四个轴（水平、垂直、两个对角线），用Theil-Sen估计器在每个轴上拟合留一坐标-奖励趋势，预测胜出响应并形成残差信用，与原始组优势混合；(2)全失败组：SCA-Prox使用到标注目标的指数衰减距离度量来排序点击，按接近度分配信用；(3)全命中组：保留原始组优势。空间参考仅用于构造训练更新，不改变部署策略。方法在控制合成设置下通过精确梯度分析（MSE、余弦相似度、范数比）验证更新方向的正确性。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) GUI grounding：SCA-3B在ScreenSpot-Pro全部16个接地子列上超过GUI-R1，差异0.3-1.7个百分点；ScreenSpot-Pro十二子列算术平均26.1 vs GUI-R1 25.2；ScreenSpot Web Text 90.5±0.30，Desktop Text 94.8±0.28。(2) 动作预测：GUI-Act-Web GR 89.0±0.42，OmniAct-Web GR 77.0±0.45，OmniAct-Desktop GR 80.5±0.41；低级整体82.0±0.36；在十个低级动作预测指标上获得最佳RFT结果；GUI-Odyssey 66.0±0.52。(3) 精确梯度分析：SCA-Residual梯度MSE 0.14825（vs GRPO 0.16201），余弦相似度0.99985；Full SCA梯度MSE 0.14754，余弦相似度0.99997。(4) ScreenSpot-Pro六个领域均提升0.70-1.10个百分点，文本目标提升1.23点，图标目标提升0.48点。
AI.conclusion: SCA利用邻近rollout几何为GUI点击分配信用：Residual用交叉拟合残差处理混合命中组，Prox为全失败组提供接近度信号。在报告的离线评估中，三种子均值在接地和动作预测套件上均高于GUI-R1点估计。合成研究衡量了更新方向和误差。分支控制、在线交互和更大骨干模型留待未来评估。

title: Dual-Channel Robust Group-Relative Policy Optimization via Advantage and Sequence-Weight Estimation
summary: Group-relative policy optimization relies on reward-derived advantages and sequence-level likelihood weights, both of which can be sensitive to localized outliers. Extreme rewards can collapse the contrast among clean responses after group normalization, while token-level log-ratio perturbations can alter sequence weights and clipping decisions. We introduce RoVR-GSPO, a dual-channel robust optimizer that addresses these failure modes separately. Its reward channel combines robust reference estimation with bounded residual credit, while its ratio channel uses differentiable SoftRoVR aggregation to construct robust sequence weights. We provide stability and efficiency analyses for both channels. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, long-context summarization, and tool-call annotation show consistent improvements over GSPO, while controlled perturbation studies demonstrate stronger robustness to reward contamination and token-ratio anomalies.

AI.tldr: RoVR-GSPO 提出了一种双通道鲁棒的 GSPO 优化器，分别在奖励通道（用 RoVR 鲁棒参考估计 + 有界残差信用）和比率通道（用可微的 SoftRoVR 聚合生成鲁棒序列权重）解决 GRPO 类方法中两类失效模式（极端奖励擦除干净响应间的优势对比、token 级对数比扰动改变序列权重与裁剪分支）。
AI.motivation: 现有的 GRPO/GSPO 类组相对策略优化方法在小样本统计下存在两类敏感性问题：(1) 奖励侧——一个极端奖励经过组内归一化后会使得所有干净响应的两两优势差趋于零；(2) 比率侧——局部 token 对数比扰动会改变序列级似然权重和裁剪分支。论文指出二者具有不同的设计自由度，但现有方法未将其区分开。
AI.method: RoVR-GSPO 包含两个独立通道。奖励通道：先用块状凸 M-估计（Barron α=1，pseudo-Huber）构造有界分数局部中心，再用复合分位数（tie-neutral，J0 中位约定）做外层一步校正，形成鲁棒参考 θ̂_RoVR；再用有界奇映射 χ_κ(u)=u/√(1+(u/κ)²) 限制单点杠杆并保留干净响应间的优势对比，得到 Â_i^credit。比率通道：把 token 对数比 ℓ_i,t 通过 SoftRoVR（有限温度 logistic 指标 H_γ + 平滑中位 smed_η 初始化 + 解算器迭代）可微地聚合成一个鲁棒序列权重 q_i^SoftRoVR = exp(SoftRoVR(ℓ))。理论部分给出了有限组鲁棒参考+信用稳定界（Theorem 4.1）、干净外层效率（Theorem 4.2，√(Bn) 渐近正态，外层因子 V_K→π/3 优于中位数 π/2）、SoftRoVR 的标定与裁剪分支稳定命题（Proposition 4.3），并讨论了块预算 B≥2q+1、n_min≥2s+1 的双层保护分辨率。
AI.result: 在三个下游任务上一致优于匹配条件下的 GSPO 基线：数学推理（Qwen3-4B-Base 与 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct，rule 与 InternLM2 两种奖励共 20 个设置下 RoVR-GSPO 的均值都更高，五项基准平均提升 2.08%/3.97% 与 1.27%/1.96%）；长文摘要 GovReport（ROUGE-1/2/L 双 backbone 都提升）；离线工具调用注释（最高验证 Total reward 1.924→2.009）。通道消融显示完整 RoVR-GSPO 优于仅 RoVR-Adv（奖励通道）和仅 SoftRoVR（比率通道）。受控扰动实验：在 α=16σ 的奖励污染下，鲁棒参考位移从 1.000σ 降到 0.060σ，有界信用将尺度膨胀从 28.194× 降到 1.911×、干净对比保留从 0.035 升到 0.520；在 20% 的连续 token 突发扰动下 SoftRoVR 把对数权重位移降低约 87%，强单点尖峰下降低约 26% 并降低剪裁翻转。标量参考估计器比较中 RoVR 在 Gaussian、t₃、点污染、整块污染下综合表现良好，外层因子 V_K=1.0691（K=9，理论）与经验 1.0747 吻合。
AI.conclusion: RoVR-GSPO 把组相对策略优化中的奖励优势与序列似然权重视为两个可独立分析、可独立替换的统计接口。块状 M-估计加 tie-neutral 复合分位数聚合给出鲁棒参考，有界信用映射在保留干净响应对比的同时控制单点杠杆，可微 SoftRoVR 聚合减少局部 token 扰动对序列权重与裁剪分支的影响。理论、通道消融与受控扰动共同支持鲁棒优势估计与序列权重估计是面向 LLM 后训练的一个实用统计接口。论文明确说明有界信用是代理选择而非无偏梯度，SoftRoVR 也非精确重要性比，部署仍需独立的奖励审计与分布外评估。

title: REALHOP: Rethinking Multi-Hop Reasoning Evaluation via Behavioral Auditing
summary: Complex questions often require multi-hop reasoning that connects facts distributed across sources or distant regions of a long context through intermediate steps. Benchmarks commonly evaluate this ability with questions built around predefined reasoning chains, treating a correct answer as evidence that the intended composition was used. Yet answer correctness alone leaves open whether success depends on the evidence associated with each intended step: models may instead rely on memorized associations, shorter paths, or partial evidence. We examine this dependence using the Behavioral Necessity Rate (BNR), which measures how often targeted evidence removal prevents answer recovery on initially correct instances. Across five existing benchmarks, panel-mean BNR ranges from 16.6% to 48.9%, exposing a substantial gap between annotated structure and observed dependence. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce REALHOP, a diagnose-construct-verify framework that rebinds entities, factorizes selected relations, adds complete competing paths, and places evidence at traceable locations. Structural and semantic checks precede freezing; behavioral interventions follow. On 790 paired MuSiQue questions, REALHOP raises panel-mean BNR from 27.4% to 94.4% while retaining high Full accuracy. It also yields high BNR on REALHOP-FRAMES and REALHOP-LONGBENCH. On 216 long-context questions, the matched multiple-choice spread across 16 models grows from 13.9 to 59.2 points and persists under repeated open-ended evaluation. Together, these results show that a conceptually coherent chain and a correct final answer do not by themselves establish multi-hop reasoning. Verifying that success depends on every intended hop is therefore as fundamental to multi-hop evaluation as measuring answer accuracy itself.

AI.tldr: REALHOP 指出当前多跳问答基准中"标注的推理链≠模型实际依赖的证据",通过行为审计指标 BNR 揭示这一鸿沟,并提出 diagnose-construct-verify 框架重建基准,使每个推理步骤成为回答所必需。
AI.motivation: 现有多跳QA基准假设正确答案意味着模型执行了标注的推理链,但模型可能通过记忆答案、更短路径或表层线索绕过关键证据,导致答案正确性无法证明真正的多跳推理能力。需要一种直接测量证据必要性的方法,并构建使每步推理都不可或缺的基准。
AI.method: 提出 BNR 指标:在 Full 正确样本上定向删除某个标注证据,观察答案是否无法恢复;采用 matched-background Control 区分证据特异性失败与一般删除敏感性。REALHOP 框架包含诊断(BNR审计)、构造(实体重绑、关系分解、添加竞争路径、事实路由至可追踪位置)和验证(结构/语义/行为检查)。在 MuSiQue、FRAMES、LongBench v2 三个场景适配。
AI.result: 五个现有基准 panel-mean BNR 仅 16.6–48.9%。REALHOP-MuSiQue(790对配对问题)将 panel-mean BNR 从 27.4% 提升至 94.4%,Full 准确率保持 68.5–83.5%。REALHOP-FRAMES BNR 达 88.9–89.9%。REALHOP-LongBench(216题)在 16 个模型上的多选准确率离散度从 13.9 扩展至 59.2 点,开放回答中 BNR 达 96.5–98.1%。消融表明竞争路径插入贡献了大部分难度提升和行为必要性提升。
AI.conclusion: 概念上连贯的推理链与正确的最终答案本身不足以证明多跳推理能力。验证每个目标 hop 的行为必要性应与测量答案准确性同等重要,作为多跳评估的基本设计准则。

title: CF-LoRA: Decoupled Factor Aggregation and Adaptation-Aware Client Clustering for Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: Federated LoRA fine-tuning enables parameter-efficient adaptation of pre-trained models without sharing private data, but suffers from two fundamental mismatches under heterogeneous client data: a structural aggregation mismatch caused by independently averaging LoRA factors, and a statistical collaboration mismatch caused by enforcing a single global adapter across divergent clients. To address these issues, we propose CF-LoRA, a clustered federated LoRA fine-tuning framework that combines decoupled factor aggregation with adaptation-aware client clustering. CF-LoRA first learns a globally shared $A$ factor while retaining personalized $B_i$ factors, then identifies clients with similar adaptation patterns based on the cosine similarity of their learned $B_i$ factors, and finally performs intra-cluster $B$-factor aggregation with a frozen $A$ factor. By decoupling LoRA factor aggregation, CF-LoRA preserves the low-rank structure and mitigates the structural aggregation mismatch, while adaptation-aware clustering promotes collaboration among clients with similar adaptation patterns and reduces negative transfer caused by statistical heterogeneity. Experiments on four language tasks and four vision datasets with RoBERTa and ViT show that CF-LoRA achieves the highest average accuracy in both modalities while communicating only one LoRA factor per optimization round.

AI.tldr: CF-LoRA是一个用于联邦LoRA微调的聚类框架，通过解耦因子聚合（仅在每个阶段聚合A或B其中一个矩阵）和基于B矩阵相似度的自适应客户端聚类，联合解决了结构聚合失配和统计协作问题，在语言和视觉任务上以单因子通信开销实现了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 联邦LoRA微调在非IID数据下面临两类根本性不匹配：(1)结构聚合失配——独立平均客户端的LoRA因子A和B后相乘会产生虚假的跨客户端乘积B_i·A_j（i≠j），与理想的聚合更新不一致；(2)统计协作失配——在异构数据下强制使用单一全局适配器会导致负迁移。现有方法如FFA-LoRA、FedEx-LoRA只解决聚合一致性问题，FedSA-LoRA、PACFL只解决异构性问题，缺乏联合解决方案。
AI.method: CF-LoRA是一个三阶段框架：(I)全局A聚合与本地B个性化（仅上传聚合A，B保持本地，进行T₁轮）；(II)基于学习到的B矩阵余弦相似度，采用层次聚类将客户端划分为K个簇；(III)簇内联邦微调——冻结共享的A，仅在簇内聚合B矩阵，再进行T₂轮。每个阶段仅聚合一个低秩因子，避免了两个因子独立平均后相乘带来的失配。
AI.result: 在RoBERTa-base（5个GLUE数据集）和ViT-B/16（4个视觉数据集）上的实验表明，CF-LoRA在所有数据集上均达到最高平均准确率（语言90.51%，视觉84.77%），相比FL-LoRA提升1.6-3.3个百分点，且每轮仅传输一个LoRA因子（通信开销降低50%）；在强异构（α=0.1）和大规模联邦（50客户端）下保持鲁棒；层次聚类优于K-means、谱聚类和随机分组。
AI.conclusion: CF-LoRA通过解耦因子聚合和基于B的自适应聚类有效解决了联邦LoRA微调中的双重不匹配问题，在跨模态任务上以单因子通信开销取得了最优精度-通信权衡；但当前使用预定义簇数K和单次聚类，未来可探索自适应聚类方法。

title: ImbalancE: Inference-Time Latent Search Against Degree Imbalance in Link Prediction
summary: Knowledge Graph Embedding models have been extensively used to learn representations of entities and relations in Knowledge Graphs for predicting missing links. However, the quality of the learned representations varies a lot across different areas of the graph. If previous research has loosely linked the problem to relation types or degree bias, we show that it is more widespread and it correlates with the degree imbalance of the entities in test triples. In particular, the prediction of a target entity that has a degree much smaller than the degree of the anchor entity is extremely problematic. This is critical in recommender systems and other use cases, where these triples represent important corner cases. To address this issue, we propose an inference-time latent search optimization method capable of significantly improving model predictions on the most imbalanced triples. Built on top of a pre-trained model, it explores the embedding space at evaluation time, blending known and out-of-band information to mitigate the degree imbalance bias. We show the value of our approach on imbalanced triples from common benchmark datasets, where we outperform conventional methods, opening the door to the successful adoption of Knowledge Graph Embedding models on these critical corner cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ImbalancE的推理时潜在搜索方法，用于缓解知识图谱嵌入（KGE）模型在链接预测中因实体间度（degree）不均衡导致的低度实体预测质量低下问题。该方法在推理阶段通过结合训练上下文和外部预言机（如LLM）信息，对锚定实体及相关实体嵌入进行细粒度微调，在多个基准数据集上显著提升了高度不平衡三元组的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有KGE模型在链接预测任务中，聚合指标虽高，但对低度实体的预测质量极差。已有研究将此问题归因于关系类型或度偏差，但缺乏系统性定义和有效解决方案。该研究旨在系统性地揭示"度不均衡"（degree imbalance）问题——即测试三元组中头尾实体度差异对预测质量的影响——并提出一种推理时（无需重新训练）的轻量级优化方法来解决此问题。
AI.method:
1. **问题定义**：提出归一化度差异度量Δ̂，定量刻画三元组中头尾实体的度不均衡程度，并揭示低度实体存在两种学习失效模式：过拟合和无法收敛。
2. **ImbalancE方法**：在预训练KGE模型之上，对每个查询q=(s,p,?)进行推理时潜在搜索，优化一个双项损失函数：
   - **训练上下文项（Training Context Term）**：利用训练集中与查询共享锚点实体和关系的已知三元组𝒞_q，仅优化锚点实体嵌入，使其更好地适配该查询。
   - **预言机增强项（Oracle-Enhanced Term）**：利用外部预言机（如基于LLM编码实体描述的相似度）生成额外的候选三元组Ω_q，同时优化锚点和目标实体嵌入，将低度目标实体的表征偏向查询。
3. **技术细节**：冻结关系嵌入和训练上下文目标实体嵌入，无需负采样，作为正则化器防止嵌入坍塌。算法在T次迭代内通过梯度更新完成。
AI.result:
在FB15k-237、WN18RR、YAGO3-10三个基准数据集上的实验表明：
- **FB15k-237**：ImbalancE使ComplEx-N3和RotatE在High-Low split上MRR提升超过4倍（H@10从0.06→0.28），Low-High split上提升约2-3倍。
- **WN18RR**：各指标均有一致提升，但因度极化程度较低，改善幅度有限。
- **YAGO3-10**：因预言机仅用实体标签（缺少描述）导致质量受限，仅H@10有提升。
- **基线对比**：显著优于KG-Mixup，并在高度不平衡三元组上匹配甚至超越计算量远大的CSProm-KG。
- **消融实验**：两项损失互补，预言机项贡献更大。
- **效率**：单查询约0.9-1.4秒，全测试集440秒（FB15k-237），远低于重新训练（935秒）。
- **普适性**：适用于TransE、DistMult、ComplEx、RotatE等多种KGE模型；NBFNet因实体嵌入纠缠无法受益。
- **稳定性**：100轮内无坍塌，不同种子结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究系统揭示了KGE模型中度不均衡导致的双重学习失效问题（低度实体过拟合与无法收敛），并提出ImbalancE作为首个应用于KGE模型的推理时潜在搜索方法。该方法作为预训练模型的插件，无需重新训练，计算开销极低，能在关键的高度不平衡三元组上显著提升预测质量，使轻量级KGE模型达到与计算密集型LLM增强方法相当的水平，为推荐系统等关注长尾实体的实际应用提供了可靠解决方案。

title: CADOC: Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: For a long-horizon agent, context is the bottleneck: the history is resent with every request, the window caps task length, and reasoning degrades as the history grows. Replacing structured objects with compact retrieval Cards shortens the prompt and keeps the exact originals retrievable, but editing the history can break prefix-cache reuse, and prior recoverable methods time their edits by forecasts of future reuse or by preset intervals. We propose CADOC (Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context), an online algorithm that replaces structured objects with compact Cards while preserving exact, on-demand retrieval of their original contents. CADOC schedules replacements in batches by balancing accumulated waiting cost against shared cache-reconstruction cost. Its scheduling rule follows from an economic order quantity trade-off, recovers the optimal integer batch under stationary assumptions. Across evaluation, CADOC consistently achieves the lowest aggregate input cost among the compared configurations, which reduces input cost by approximately 40\% on average while maintaining task performance close to full context. CADOC thus provides a cost-derived approach to compressible context management, demonstrating that efficient compression depends not only on shortening prompts but also on scheduling edits to preserve cache reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CADOC（Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context），一种面向长程智能体的在线可恢复上下文管理算法。该算法通过将结构化对象替换为紧凑的检索 Card 来缩短提示词长度，并在批量提交时权衡累积等待成本与共享缓存重建成本，从而在不破坏前缀缓存复用的前提下实现高效压缩。实验表明，CADOC 在多个基准上比其他策略平均降低约 40% 的输入成本，同时保持接近完整上下文的任务性能。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体面临上下文瓶颈问题：每次请求需重新发送历史记录、上下文窗口限制任务长度、长历史降低推理质量。现有的可恢复压缩方法依赖对未来重用量的预测或预设时间间隔，无法仅依据当前可观测信息做出最优决策。此外，立即替换虽能减少 token，但可能因破坏前缀缓存而实际增加成本。
AI.method: CADOC 的核心是将结构化对象替换为可按需检索原始内容的 Card，并引入一种基于经济订货量（EOQ）权衡的批量调度规则。具体而言：算法维护一个"待处理序列"，通过"经济穿越"条件 W_t + w_r·G_t ≥ Q_t 决定何时批量提交替换，其中 W_t 为累积等待成本、G_t 为潜在缩短量、Q_t 为共享缓存重建成本。该规则在平稳假设下可恢复最优整数批量大小，在线运行无需未来信息或额外 LLM 调用。文章还证明了该规则在等待-建立目标下具有 2-竞争的有限时界界。
AI.result: 在固定历史回放实验中，CADOC 在所有热尾设置（h∈{2,4,8,16}）下均取得最低聚合输入成本，相对完整上下文节省 11.56%–30.65%，并优于固定批量、立即替换和 token 阈值等基线。在三条基准链（Terminal-Bench 2.1、LongMemEval-V2、SWE-bench）的端到端评估中，CADOC 降低输入成本 34.12%–47.13%、输入 token 44.72%–80.60%，任务完成率仅下降最多 4 个百分点。在不同缓存读权重（w_r∈{0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1}）的敏感性测试中，CADOC 在 15 种基准-权重组合中均达到最低成本。
AI.conclusion: CADOC 提供了一种基于成本推导的可压缩上下文管理方法，证明高效压缩不仅取决于缩短提示词，还取决于调度编辑以保留缓存复用。该算法无需未来信息、LLM 调度调用或逐场景批量大小调优，在保持接近完整上下文性能的同时显著降低长程智能体的输入成本，为长程上下文管理开辟了新的思路。

title: Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination for Hospital Patient Flow Optimization
comment: Accepted to PRIMA 2026 (Full paper). 16 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Efficient patient flow coordination across autonomous hospital departments is critical for mitigating overcrowding and balancing resource utilization. While classical queueing theory, specifically open Baskett--Chandy--Muntz--Palacios (BCMP) networks, provides an interpretable mathematical topology for healthcare operations, analytical models rely on stationary assumptions and fixed routing matrices that degrade under state-dependent real-world dynamics. Conversely, centralized reinforcement learning approaches struggle to accommodate the decentralized structure of hospital governance, where individual clinical departments function with localized observations, heterogeneous resources, and divergent operational objectives. In this paper, we present a Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) framework titled \emph{Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination}, which embeds empirically calibrated BCMP queueing topologies as physical priors within a decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning architecture. Formulated as a Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP) under coupled resource constraints, our method enables autonomous departmental agents to cooperatively negotiate patient routing and dynamic service scaling.
