Instead of parsing raw HTML, ReMem observes item pages through screenshots and extracts structured multimodal information via an OCR tool, enabling a more humanoid and platform-agnostic perception mechanism. To support long-horizon preference modeling, ReMem further introduces a chunk-wise sequential memory update strategy, where the agent selectively maintains a fixed-size memory of informative historical interactions while processing arbitrarily long contexts with linear inference complexity and bounded context length. This design allows the agent to preserve evolving user preferences without relying on external memory modules or disrupting the standard autoregressive generation process. To enhance the dynamic memory instruction, we further develop a multi-memory GRPO variant, which propagates the final-answer advantage to all intermediate conversations that contribute to the final response. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that ReMem consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 5.16\% across three recommendation agent tasks, namely searching, ranking, and judging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 ReMem 的新型推荐智能体（RecAgent）框架，旨在解决现有推荐智能体在多模态商品感知和长上下文用户偏好建模两大核心问题上的局限性。通过将基于 OCR 的多模态感知与时间演化动态记忆机制相结合，并在训练阶段引入一种将最终答案优势回传至所有中间记忆的多记忆 GRPO 变体算法，ReMem 在 Searching、Ranking、Judging 三个推荐任务上均稳定优于当前最优基线，平均相对提升达到 5.16%。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐智能体面临两大根本性瓶颈：1）在商品感知层面，过度依赖原始 HTML 文本解析，容易受到页面异构性、广告噪声以及缺失视觉信息的影响；2）在长上下文推理层面，面对超长的用户交互历史与多步骤操作轨迹，传统 LLM 有限的上下文窗口与二次方的注意力复杂度导致推理性能严重退化。论文由此提出两个核心反思问题：智能体应如何"看"商品页面，以及应如何"记忆"不断演化的用户偏好。
AI.method: ReMem 的方法论建立在三个关键组件之上：(1) 基于 OCR 的多模态商品感知模块，通过 DeepSeek-OCR-2 解析商品页面截图，提取文本、图像与交互元素的统一结构化信息，取代脆弱的 HTML 解析；(2) 时序演化记忆（TEM）机制，将长用户历史切分为固定大小块，LLM 在每一块上选择性更新固定长度的记忆 token，使推理复杂度降为线性 O(N)，且保持标准自回归生成过程；(3) 多记忆 GRPO 变体，将最终答案的优势（advantage）传播到所有对最终答案有贡献的中间记忆回合，以强化学习方式引导模型学会"记住什么"和"如何更新"。
AI.result: 在基于 Amazon Reviews 2023 构建的 Games、Books、MovieTV 三个指令式推荐数据集上，ReMem 在 Searching、Ranking、Judging 三项任务中均取得最佳或接近最佳成绩，相较最强基线平均提升 5.16%（统计显著，p<0.01）。消融实验表明 OCR、TEM、GRPO 三模块均不可或缺，其中 TEM 贡献最大。在短/中/长不同上下文长度下的分组评测显示，ReMem 在超 112K token 的长上下文场景下仍能保持鲁棒性能，相对 QwenLong-L1-32B 在长上下文 Games 子集的 Searching 任务 HR@1 提升 18.6%。案例研究验证了 TEM 能够有效捕捉用户兴趣随时间的演化与迁移。
AI.conclusion: ReMem 框架通过 OCR 多模态感知与动态时序记忆的协同设计，首次将"视觉式浏览"与"人脑式选择性记忆"两个拟人化直觉统一引入推荐智能体，无需外部记忆模块或架构改动即可实现有界上下文下的线性复杂度推理。多记忆 GRPO 训练策略成功将任务级反馈分配至各中间记忆步骤，使 LLM 学会主动维护与演化用户偏好画像。该工作为长上下文、跨平台的主动式推荐智能体研究提供了一个简洁、可扩展且理论复杂度优越的新范式。

title: Mubric: Mutation Testing-Guided Rubric Generation for LLM Evaluation
summary: Rubric-based evaluation is widely used to assess LLM-based systems by decomposing response quality into task-specific scoring criteria. However, automatically generating rubrics that reliably capture task-specific quality requirements remains challenging. We introduce Mubric, a mutation testing-guided approach to rubric generation. Mutation testing, a classic software testing methodology, evaluates a test suite by injecting faults into programs and checking whether the tests detect them. We draw an analogy between test suites and rubrics: if a rubric captures an important quality requirement, introducing a corresponding defect into an otherwise high-quality response should reduce its score. Mubric first mines common defects from real pairs of preferred and dispreferred responses and abstracts these defects into reusable mutation operators, each specifying how to introduce a particular type of response defect. For a new task, it applies relevant operators to a reference response, checks whether the injected defects reduce response quality, and uses insufficiently penalized defects to refine the rubric. We evaluate Mubric on 703 tasks across four representative domains against six advanced rubric generation methods. Mubric achieves the highest overall evaluation accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 7.48 percentage points.

AI.tldr: Mubric是一种基于变异测试（mutation testing）的自动评分标准（rubric）生成方法，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）的响应质量。该方法通过从真实偏好的响应中挖掘常见缺陷，构造可复用的变异算子，并通过向参考响应注入缺陷来检测评分标准的不足，进而指导评分标准的优化。在703个任务、4个领域上，Mubric以57.27%的评估准确率显著优于六种现有基线方法（最强基线49.78%）。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动评分标准生成方法主要依赖任务描述或模型响应来推导评估准则，但难以全面捕捉多维度的响应质量要求。软件测试中的变异测试通过注入故障来检测测试用例的不足，作者受此启发，将评分标准类比为测试套件，将响应类比为被测程序，提出通过主动探测评分标准未能捕捉的质量要求来改进评分标准。
AI.method: Mubric分两个阶段：(1) 变异算子构建阶段：从OpenRubrics数据集中采样1000个任务的偏好/非偏好响应，使用LLM提取非偏好响应中的具体缺陷，并按"转换类型"（如省略、扭曲形式、破坏逻辑等）和"质量维度"（如事实性、逻辑正确性、完整性等）两个维度进行抽象，得到201个可复用变异算子，每个算子包含转换类型、影响的质量维度、适用条件和注入指令。(2) 变异引导的评分标准生成阶段：对新任务生成初始评分标准和参考响应，选择适用的变异算子向参考响应注入缺陷，使用当前评分标准对参考响应和变异响应打分，若评分标准未能充分惩罚注入的缺陷（即总体分差<8分且单项最高分差<2分），则根据这些未被充分惩罚的缺陷精化评分标准，并仅在精化后能更好惩罚缺陷时保留修改。
AI.result: 在703个任务（涵盖STEM、Code、IF、Chat四个领域，来自RubricBench和RM-Bench两个基准）上，使用GPT-5.4-mini和Gemini-2.5-flash-lite两种LLM评判器，Mubric总体评估准确率达57.27%，比最强基线MRRG（49.78%）高出7.48个百分点，并在10个数据集-LLM配置中的8个上取得最高准确率（其中7个具有统计学显著性）。消融实验表明：完整Mubric（51.78%）优于初始评分标准（47.94%）、直接精化（45.38%）和即时算子（44.24%），验证了可复用变异算子和变异引导精化的贡献。阈值敏感性分析显示方法在不同阈值设置下表现稳定。
AI.conclusion: Mubric提出了一种新颖的变异测试视角来自动生成LLM评估的评分标准，通过主动注入缺陷来探查评分标准的不足并指导精化，为评分标准生成提供了超越传统任务描述和响应分析的补充视角。实验证明该方法在多个领域和基准上均能稳定提升评估准确性，为更可靠和系统化的基于评分标准的LLM评估奠定了基础。

title: VISTA: Value-Informed Event Appraisal for Multimodal Emotion Conflict
summary: Conflicting emotional cues can be individually valid: a subdued voice may reflect a blocked goal while a smile satisfies a social obligation. Their interpretation depends on what the event means to the person. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Semantic Trust Arbitration), a learned seven-field appraisal interface that conditions modality arbitration on concerns, event relations, and expression conditions while retaining a joint-evidence residual. A log-odds decomposition separates emotion expectation from cue diagnosticity, motivating an interface that lets appraisal change how evidence is interpreted. With a shared Qwen2.5-Omni-7B backbone and matched training examples and steps, VISTA reaches 64.5% conflict accuracy on CA-MER, improving on modality gating by 2.5 percentage points on conflict and 0.2 on consistency. Shuffling appraisal across scenes or removing its decision connection reduces this benefit. A common frozen-backbone probe reaches 0.600 macro CCC for appraisal readout, compared with 0.505 for emotion-only fine-tuning. Evaluations across five benchmarks connect recognition under increasing conflict with appraisal readout and downstream decision use. Together, the analyses and experiments support scene-specific appraisal as an intermediate representation that helps interpret conflicting emotional evidence.

AI.tldr: VISTA是一种多模态情感识别框架，通过引入一个学到的七字段评估接口（关注关切、事件关系和表达条件），在模态仲裁和情感预测之间建立桥梁。它在跨模态情感冲突场景下显著优于模态门控、通用推理等基线方法，并通过五个基准测试验证了场景特定评估作为冲突证据解释的中间表示的价值。
AI.motivation: 跨模态情感冲突是多模态情感识别中的核心难题：同一行为在不同关切和社交义务下可能有不同的含义（如失意者的微笑可能是礼貌表现，而低沉的声调反映被阻挠的目标）。传统方法侧重于信号可靠性评估，但无法解决"同一线索在不同场景中支持不同情感"的解释问题。研究动机在于建立事件意义与情感证据解释之间的显式连接。
AI.method:
1. 设计原理：通过log-odds分解将情感期望与线索诊断性分离，证明需要评估-线索交互作用（非加性表示）。
2. 七字段评估接口：包含目标/关切(g)、目标一致性(c)、期望(e)、归因(a)、应对/控制(k)、社会规范(n)、表达调节(r)，每字段存储值、置信度、证据和有效性掩码。
3. 评估条件决策路径：模态权重α由评估调节α(H,ẑ)，分类器结合加权单模态logits与联合证据残差。
4. 训练：基于Qwen2.5-Omni-7B与LoRA微调，使用教师生成+人类裁决的8000例训练集，λ_cf=0（行为测试而非反事实损失）。
5. 表示细化理论（命题1）：证明评估表示可降低贝叶斯风险，当其保留决策区分时。
AI.result:
1. CA-MER：VISTA达到64.5%冲突准确率，比模态门控SFT提升2.5个百分点，一致性子集提升0.2个百分点（特异性S=2.3pp）；整体准确率67.7%。
2. EmoMM：冲突准确率52.0%，冲突+缺失条件下43.5%，均优于所有训练对照。
4. CH-SIMS v2.0：Q4（最高冲突组）准确率81.5%，MAE从0.365降至0.315；增益随冲突强度递增（Q1-Q4分别为0.2、0.7、2.0、4.5pp）。
5. THERADIA冻结探针：宏观CCC 0.600（对比Emotion-SFT的0.505）；下游情感强度回归使用生成评估达0.450，使用人类评估达0.480。
6. MELD：加权F1 66.94%，七类情感识别recall均提升。
7. 消融：交叉样本随机化、切断决策连接、移除表达调节等均降低冲突性能；外部解释编辑不影响准确率。
8. 干预行为：方向一致率75.0%，无关重写稳定性92.0%。
AI.conclusion: VISTA通过将事件意义与情感证据使用方式相连接，实现了冲突敏感的情感识别。理论分析（log-odds分解、决策相关表示细化命题）解释了评估如何改变线索解释以及何时可优化压缩表示。实验验证了识别增益集中在冲突条件下，场景对应性、决策连接和干预测试共同支持场景特定评估接口作为解释冲突情感证据的中间表示。

title: Solving Without Stopping: On-Policy Distillation at Small Scale
summary: On-policy distillation, where a student learns from a stronger teacher's feedback on its own outputs, is a common way to pass reasoning to smaller models. We analyze what it transfers at small scale, distilling Qwen3-8B into Qwen3 4B, 1.7B and 0.6B students, in thinking mode (reason at length, then end the reasoning and answer) and, for comparison, in non-thinking mode (no separate reasoning phase). Long reasoning needs two abilities, solving a problem and knowing when it is solved, and we find that distillation transfers the first, but in thinking mode not the second. Solving improves at every size, up to two ceilings, which we measure comprehensively across both modes and all student sizes: a student's single attempt never exceeds what it could already reach in many attempts before training, and the smaller the student, the further it stays below the teacher. Stopping is where the modes part. In non-thinking mode every student keeps stopping; in thinking mode students stop ending their reasoning early in training, and the smaller the student, the less of this ability survives: the teacher signals a stop almost only where a student already ends its reasoning, so distillation teaches no new stops; it only keeps the student's existing stops that land on a right answer, and a weak student has few such stops. The smallest students often reach the right value but do not commit to it: they either rarely mark it or mark it and write past it. Together, these results describe how small students behave under on-policy distillation, and a diagnostic that separates answer marking, correctness and stopping.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了在小规模场景下（Qwen3-8B 向 4B/1.7B/0.6B 蒸馏）的知识传递效果，发现 on-policy 蒸馏能传递"解题能力"但无法传递"停止能力"，尤其在 thinking 模式下，小模型会失去停止推理的能力，从而导致即使算出了正确答案也无法提交。
AI.motivation: 小模型主要依靠蒸馏获得推理能力，但尚不清楚 thinking 模式的 on-policy 蒸馏具体传递了什么。推理需要两种能力：解题与知道何时停止。本文旨在分离并量化这两种能力在蒸馏中的传递情况，并提出相应的诊断方法。
AI.method: 采用 on-policy 蒸馏（PPO 风格的 clipped reverse KL 优势估计），将 Qwen3-8B 蒸馏到 Qwen3 4B/1.7B/0.6B；对比 thinking 与 non-thinking 模式、两种 SFT 起点（external-SFT 与 teacher-SFT）；在 AIME 2026、AMC23、GSM8K-200 上进行宽松评分评估；提出将"是否作答""正确性""是否停止"分离的诊断方法。
AI.result: 1. 解题能力存在两层天花板：蒸馏后单次准确率不超过学生蒸馏前多次尝试的 p@n，且与教师差距随规模缩小而扩大；2. thinking 模式下小模型在训练早期（约第 6 步）停止率骤降，因为教师的停止信号几乎只出现在学生原本就停止的位置，无法教新停止；3. 最小的 0.6B/1.7B 模型虽然经常算出正确答案，但要么很少标记、要么标记后继续写过去，未能"承诺"答案。
AI.conclusion: On-policy 蒸馏在小规模下传递了"求解"却过滤而非教授"停止"。在 thinking 模式下，学生越弱保留的停止越少，最小学生甚至能算出正确答案但无法提交。改进方向应针对那些"一路写到预算上限"的响应——教师在这些位置几乎没有停止信号——而非停止 token 本身。该诊断方法将端点分数分解为作答、正确性与停止三部分，使问题可定位。

title: Seek Before You Move: Evidence Seeking for Progress Grounding in Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to continuously ground task progress from long-horizon instructions and partial egocentric observations. Existing VLM-based navigation agents typically reason only over available observations and may remain confident even when task-relevant evidence is missing. For example, an agent may confidently proceed forward and get lost even though the landmark indicating the next turn lies outside its current field of view. We term this failure mode Progress Myopia: the agent fails to recognize unreliable progress grounding and continues acting on insufficient evidence. To address it, we propose SeekVLN, an evidence-seeking framework that couples semantic progress reasoning with active acquisition of task-relevant observations. SeekVLN is trained in two stages: First, Future-guided Reverse Generation (FRG) uses future expert actions to augment offline expert trajectories with supplementary views and evidence annotations. Supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories establishes a prior for evidence seeking and progress reasoning without additional expert interaction. However, imitation alone does not reveal whether seeking improves subsequent navigation. We therefore introduce Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization (C2PO) for reinforcement fine-tuning. By comparing each evidence-seeking branch with a counterfactual direct-navigation branch from the same state, C2PO uses a contrastive reward to assign credit to seeking decisions based on subsequent navigation benefit. Experiments on simulated benchmarks show that SeekVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving success rate by 12.7% and 7.5% over the base model on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. Both simulated and real-world evaluations exhibit human-like evidence-seeking behaviors for more reliable progress grounding.

AI.tldr: SeekVLN提出"证据寻求"框架以解决视觉语言导航(VLN)中的"进展近视"(Progress Myopia)问题，即智能体在证据不足时仍自信行动。通过两阶段训练（FRG数据增强和C2PO对比强化学习），在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上分别提升成功率12.7%和7.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM导航智能体仅基于当前可用观测推理，在任务相关证据缺失时仍保持高置信度（即"进展近视"），导致在不充分的证据上做出错误决策。论文通过分析发现现有智能体在成功与失败轨迹上的决策置信度相似，说明它们无法识别进展定位的不可靠性。
AI.method: SeekVLN采用双模式决策框架（SEEK/NAV）：(1) Future-guided Reverse Generation (FRG) 利用未来专家动作反向增强离线轨迹，生成补充视图和证据标注，构建先验数据集进行监督微调；(2) Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization (C2PO) 在强化微调中比较同一状态下的证据寻求分支与直接导航分支，通过反事实对比奖励归因于寻求决策。奖励包括短期对比奖励和自适应结果奖励。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE Val-Unseen上达到SOTA：相比基线Aux-Think，R2R-CE成功率提升12.7%（54.8→67.5），SPL提升14.5；RxR-CE成功率提升7.5%（52.2→59.7），SPL提升10.1。消融实验证实FRG的证据寻求和进展推理监督、以及C2PO的反事实奖励均有贡献。智能体展现人类式证据寻求行为，在仿真和真实机器人部署中均有效。
AI.conclusion: SeekVLN通过主动获取任务相关观测来增强进展定位的可靠性，将VLN从被动推理转变为主动证据寻求。FRG实现无需额外专家交互的冷启动，C2PO通过对比信用分配优化证据寻求时机。模拟和真实世界评估均表明该方法产生了可解释的、类人的证据寻求行为，为部分观测和指令模糊下的可靠导航提供了新范式。

title: Teaching LLMs to Generate Challenging MILP Instances via Solver Feedback
summary: Generating optimization instances that are both feasible and computationally challenging is crucial for benchmarking solvers and training learning-based optimization algorithms. Existing non-LLM generators rely on seed instances or parameter tuning, resulting in high test-time computational cost, while existing LLM generators lack explicit hardness measures. Recent reinforcement learning methods with verifier feedback evaluate only binary correctness, which is misaligned with generating challenging problems. We note that an optimization solver reports the cost of solving at several stages of its pipeline, and leverage this to design a reward that scores both the solvability and the hardness of generated problems, measured by branch-and-bound nodes and post-cut relaxation gaps. Our key idea is a challenger-solver asymmetric self-play approach, where an LLM challenger generates progressively harder instances and the solver verifies feasibility and hardness, so no seed or training MILP instances are required. We fine-tune Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3.5-4B with GRPO and a size curriculum into OptiScribe-12B and OptiScribe-4B, which generate feasible yet challenging MILP problems from natural language instructions. On capacitated facility location and max-cut, OptiScribe-12B raises median SCIP search nodes by 1.7-5x and post-cut gaps by 1.1-1.7x over its base model and improves the feasibility rate on facility location by 9-19 points, while OptiScribe-4B raises median nodes by up to 15.6x. The problems cover a wider difficulty range than public benchmarks of the same size, follow instructions on density and difficulty, and can tune solver settings for families that public libraries lack. These results indicate that optimization-specific rewards, used in self-play mode, can teach LLMs to generate high-difficulty optimization benchmarks. We will release our code and models publicly on acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OptiScribe，一种基于求解器反馈的非对称自我对弈框架，用于微调LLM以生成既可行又具有计算挑战性的MILP实例。核心创新在于设计了一个融合分支定界节点数和根切割后间隙的求解器努力奖励，结合GRPO和大小课程训练，无需种子实例即可生成覆盖更广难度范围的MILP基准。
AI.motivation: 生成既可行又计算难度高的优化实例对于求解器基准测试和学习型优化算法训练至关重要。现有非LLM方法依赖种子实例或参数调优，测试时计算成本高；现有LLM生成器缺乏显式难度度量；现有的带验证器反馈的RL方法仅评估二元正确性，与生成挑战性问题的目标不匹配。
AI.method: 1. 提出挑战者-求解器非对称自我对弈框架：LLM作为挑战者生成实例，固定配置的分支切割求解器作为验证器；2. 设计求解器努力奖励R = V·(w_H·H + w_v·r_var + w_d·r_div)，其中H = 0.25·r_cut + 0.75·r_node，r_cut基于根切割后间隙，r_node基于对数缩放的分支定界节点数；3. 使用GRPO和LoRA微调Gemma-4-12B和Qwen3.5-4B，配合变量数量递增的大小课程；4. 采用紧凑的索引集模板表示实例。
AI.result: OptiScribe-12B在CFL和Max-Cut上将SCIP中位数搜索节点提升1.7-5.0倍，根切割后间隙提升1.1-1.7倍，CFL可行性率提升9-19个百分点；OptiScribe-4B在中位数节点上最高提升15.6倍。生成的实例覆盖了公共基准中稀疏的难度区间，能遵循密度和难度的自然语言指令，可用于微调公共库中缺失的求解器设置，且在HiGHS和Gurobi两个未参与训练的求解器上保持了难度排序。
AI.conclusion: 根切割后的求解器努力是一种可行的奖励信号，可在自我对弈模式下教会LLM生成高难度的MILP基准。OptiScribe-12B和OptiScribe-4B在已训练及更大规模上生成比基础模型更难的实例，且在两个外部求解器上保持了难度排序。生成的实例填补了公共基准中难度范围的空白，可通过自然语言指令控制，并支持求解器调优。局限性：仅涵盖三个家族（多重背包对所有模型都保持简单），生成实例最多500个变量，每个分支训练一次且调优实例集较小。

title: Pretrain Once, Route Anywhere: Towards a Foundation Model for LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to assign each query to the most suitable model from a heterogeneous candidate pool, improving the quality--efficiency trade-off of LLM inference. Existing routers are typically learned through local fitting: a router is optimized for a particular query workload and candidate pool, and often requires additional supervision or retraining as the routing environment changes. We ask whether LLM routing can instead be approached from a foundation-model perspective, learning a reusable routing capability that generalizes across tasks, candidate models, and deployment conditions. To this end, we introduce RouteFM, which learns to characterize anonymous candidate models from behavioral context and infer their target-specific capabilities, rather than binding routing decisions to fixed model identities or a single environment. Through episodic pretraining across heterogeneous routing environments, this capability can be reused by a frozen router and adapted to new environments through context alone. Experiments demonstrate transfer across changes in domains, modalities, candidate pools, and context budgets, with the largest gains when behavioral evidence is limited. On MMR-Bench, which is excluded from pretraining, RouteFM outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.23 quality points with only eight observations per candidate. These results support moving LLM routing from repeated local fitting toward a pretrain once, route anywhere paradigm. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出RouteFM,将LLM路由从"局部拟合"范式转变为"基础模型"范式,通过情节式预训练学习可跨任务、候选模型、部署条件复用的路由能力,冻结路由器仅通过上下文适应新环境。
AI.motivation: 现有路由器采用"局部拟合"范式,针对特定查询负载和候选池训练,环境变化时需要重新收集监督和优化,导致路由系统维护成本高且路由器难以跨环境复用。论文探索能否从基础模型视角让路由器学习可复用的路由能力。
AI.method: RouteFM包含三个核心设计:(a)匿名候选模型的能力画像构建——通过共享行为编码器和24个可学习潜在能力token,将变长行为观测压缩为固定容量能力画像;(b)目标条件证据检索——通过目标到画像、目标到原始观测两条并行交叉注意力分支,并通过可学习标量α残差融合;(c)候选池联合比较——在候选维度上用Transformer编码器做排列等变的候选间比较。预训练采用情节式构造,每episode包含6-24个匿名候选、16-32个目标查询、不同的观测预算K∈{8,...,1024},三阶段课程(先大K后小K,routing-regret权重由0增至0.25)。总参数量12.78M,使用Qwen3-VL 4096维冻结嵌入。
AI.result: 在域内RouterEval和跨模态MMR-Bench(排除在预训练外)上均优于10个基线(Weighted kNN、MLP、Embedding-Ridge、EmbedLLM、RM-Softmax、TRouter、InferenceDynamics、UniRoute、ICL-Router、Context-Mean)。在MMR-Bench K=8时比最强基线高2.23质量点,域内K=8时高0.84点。新模型引入仅需8个观测即可超越重新拟合的基线;用1%的观测即可匹配Weighted kNN的全上下文性能。消融显示候选池Transformer和目标到上下文注意力贡献最大;目标域从头训练比冻结RouteFM低1.08点,而在预训练基础上微调收益甚微。
AI.conclusion: 证明LLM路由可从"基础模型"视角实现,单一冻结路由器通过上下文即可跨域、跨模态、适应新候选模型和不同部署偏好,支持"预训练一次,任意路由"的范式转变。

title: Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains students using teacher feedback on their own sampled responses, yet how prompt choice shapes transfer across teacher-student pairs remains poorly understood. We systematically study prompt quantity, source, and selection across RL- and SFT-continuation pairs and cross-model settings. We find that OPD can be highly prompt-efficient: a few prompts can approach large-pool performance, with four DAPO prompts matching the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMath prompts. However, prompt utility is relational rather than intrinsic: changing only the teacher can reverse the relative effectiveness of mathematics and code prompts. To characterize these transfer differences, we analyze parameter and functional changes across prompt supports and model pairs. Functional alignment with the teacher varies across supports and target tasks; in continuation pairs, teacher-aligned prediction changes can coexist with weak parameter alignment. Continued OPD on effective supports can restore performance after unfavorable transfer. Finally, targeted selection does not consistently outperform uniform random sampling, and filtering out a source that performs poorly alone yields no consistent gain across three paired support draws. Overall, our results distinguish prompt efficiency from prompt interchangeability and show that effective data choice depends on the teacher-student pair and target capability, with random sampling providing a competitive baseline in the studied settings.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了在策略蒸馏（OPD）中，提示（prompt）的数量、来源和选择策略如何影响师生模型间的知识迁移。研究发现OPD具有很高的提示效率——少量提示即可逼近大规模提示池的性能，但提示效用是关系性的而非内在属性，依赖于师生配对和目标任务。文中还分析了功能与参数对齐、不利迁移的表征干预与恢复机制，并指出在所研究的设置中均匀随机采样仍是具有竞争力的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有工作虽已表明OPD能通过少量提示实现有效迁移，但提示数量、来源和选择如何具体影响不同师生配对间的迁移效果仍不清晰，提示的"充分性"与"可互换性"之间的区分也未被系统研究。
AI.method: 本文采用系统性的实验与诊断分析方法：1) 在多种师生配对（RL/SFT-continuation pairs与跨模型设置）下扫描不同提示数量M与来源；2) 使用参数对齐、功能对齐（log-prob变化方向余弦、KL差距闭合度）和隐状态干预（CKA、hidden-state replacement）分析迁移机制；3) 通过切换训练支持（continued OPD）研究不利迁移的恢复；4) 对比8种提示选择策略（包括均匀随机、分层随机、语义多样性、难度选择、T-S不一致性、Cost-D-opt等）与混合池源过滤的效果。
AI.result: 关键结果包括：1) 少量提示即可达到大池性能（4个DAPO提示匹配3,840个DeepMath提示的数学得分）；2) 提示效用是关系性的——仅更换教师即可逆转数学与代码提示的相对有效性；3) 功能与参数对齐可解耦（43个检查点中参数余弦中位数0.069，功能余弦中位数0.859）；4) 不利迁移可通过表征干预和切换至有效支持的持续OPD恢复；5) 在JustRL-DeepMath研究中均匀随机采样在M=8和M=48时均取得最高4任务均值；6) 过滤掉表现差的来源（GSM8K）未带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 本文区分了提示效率与提示可互换性，表明有效的数据选择依赖于师生配对与目标能力。在所研究的设置中，随机采样提供了具有竞争力的基线，提示选择策略需在考虑筛选成本后展示其相对于随机采样的收益。不利的训练历史不一定会阻碍后续的有效迁移，因为性能可通过表征干预或切换支持恢复，即便参数路径不同。

title: Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation
comment: World Action Model; post-deployment training; dexterous manipulation
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of how physical interactions unfold. However, current post-deployment learning paradigms typically improve behavior without requiring better world predictions. Especially in dexterous manipulation, small execution errors can compound in high-dimensional action spaces, hindering policy improvement and pushing interactions beyond the world model's training distribution. Motivated by this, we propose Direct Experience World-Model Optimization (DEWO), a post-deployment learning paradigm for WAMs that, alongside action imitation, refines world representations through visual experience to better condition action generation. Specifically, it identifies interaction turning points and learns from successful and failed futures to support classifier-free guidance. An additional value head estimates task progress from video representations and activates guidance when progress stalls during inference. Across five DexJoCo tasks, DEWO improves average success across all three WAM formulations. Ablations show that visual supervision from successful and failed continuations improves both prediction and control beyond action supervision alone. On four real-world tasks across Wuji and Sharpa, 3 x 3 grid evaluations show that two rounds of deployment learning increase success from 51.0% to 71.7% in cells with at least one initial success, a gain of 20.7 percentage points. These findings support continued predictive learning for improving control through deployment experience, making world modeling an active part of WAM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DEWO（Direct Experience World-Model Optimization），一种面向World-Action Models (WAMs)的部署后学习范式。它通过在交互转折点处收集匹配的成功与失败轨迹，利用视觉预测作为监督信号进行持续的世界建模，结合无分类器引导和进度门控机制，在仿真和真实机器人平台上提升了灵巧操作任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作中高维动作空间下微小的执行误差会逐级放大，导致策略偏离训练分布。现有部署后学习方法（SFT、RL等）主要优化行为本身，而不要求更好的世界预测，这使得WAM在部署后无法有效适应其实际遇到的物理交互。
AI.method: DEWO的核心方法包含四个部分：1）**交互转折点识别**：通过回溯探索，在失败轨迹中定位从可恢复变为不可恢复的边界；2）**关键经验收集**：在转折点恢复状态后采样多条连续轨迹，收集匹配的成功与失败延续；3）**结果条件化世界建模**：成功轨迹提供视觉与动作监督，失败轨迹仅提供视觉监督（动作目标被屏蔽），通过结果条件标签训练；4）**进度门控动作引导**：推理时，值头从视频表征估计任务进度，当进度停滞时激活无分类器引导，将动作预测向成功条件方向偏置。
AI.result: 在5个DexJoCo仿真任务上，DEWO将FACT成功率从64.5%提升至81.2%，将FastWAM从80.7%提升至82.3%（SFT反而降至76.1%）。在三种WAM范式（Joint、IDM、FastWAM）上均有提升，Joint获益最大（+4.8pp）。消融实验表明，加入成功和失败的视觉未来分别带来递增的提升，且验证集视频损失同步下降（水Plant降32.7%，Fold Glasses降17.8%）。在4个真实任务（Wuji和Sharpa手）×2轮部署学习中，3×3网格评估中，初始有成功的格子成功率从51.0%提升至71.7%（+20.7pp），全网格从20.6%提升至28.9%。
AI.conclusion: DEWO证明了持续的世界建模可以成为WAM部署后适应的有效组成部分。通过围绕交互转折点组织成功与失败的视觉未来进行预测学习，结合进度门控的无分类器引导，能够改善灵巧操作中的空间泛化可靠性。该工作将世界建模从被动的预训练阶段提升为部署后适应的主动组成部分，为实现通过部署经验自我改进的智能体奠定了基础。

title: Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing reduces serving cost by assigning each query to an appropriate model while preserving response quality. Learning such a router, however, often requires executing multiple candidate models on historical queries to collect query--model quality feedback, creating a nontrivial supervision cost before deployment. Existing work largely focuses on serving-time efficiency, overlooking whether the resulting savings are sufficient to recover this upfront expenditure. We further observe that routing quality often saturates well before all query--model feedback is collected, suggesting that dense supervision can be economically over-provisioned. We propose SaveRouter, a sparse-supervision routing framework that selectively acquires informative model feedback and shares capability information across related queries, while retaining query-level refinement for fine-grained routing. We evaluate routing by jointly accounting for supervision expenditure and subsequent serving-time savings. Across four routing benchmarks, the main setting uses only about 33--41% of available training feedback while maintaining competitive or better routing quality, and reduces the break-even deployment volume by approximately 1.9--9.5 times compared with the fastest conventional router. Further analysis shows that acquiring more supervision is not always economically preferable: the supervision level that minimizes serving cost can differ from the one that achieves the earliest payback. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SaveRouter提出了一种稀疏监督的LLM路由框架，仅使用33-41%的训练反馈即可在四个路由基准上保持有竞争力或更好的路由质量，并将盈亏平衡部署量减少1.9-9.5倍，核心收益在于路由在经济上能否更快回收前期监督投入。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由研究主要关注服务时效率，但忽视了路由器构建所需的密集查询-模型监督带来的前期成本。这种前期支出会显著延迟路由投资的回收点；同时观察到路由质量在收集全部监督之前就已饱和，密集监督在经济上存在过度配置问题。
AI.method: SaveRouter框架包含三个阶段：(1) 自适应稀疏反馈获取——基于经验贝叶斯UCB策略，结合能力估计与不确定性，对每个训练查询选择K≪M个模型进行评估；(2) 分层能力估计——通过双向可加Ridge回归拟合结构化的组-模型先验，结合局部证据进行收缩估计；(3) 查询级残差修正——通过留一法构造残差目标，为每个模型拟合轻量级线性预测器，捕获组内实例级差异。最终通过成本感知的argmax路由策略进行部署。
AI.result: 在LLMRouterBench、Mixinstruct、MMR-Bench和RouterBench四个基准上，主设置仅使用33-41%的可用训练反馈，SA-BEP相比最快常规全监督路由器减少约1.9-9.5倍。消融实验验证了查询级残差修正、任务感知分组和UCB获取策略的必要性。额外分析表明更多监督并非总是更优，最小化服务成本的最优监督水平与实现最早回收的水平可能不同。
AI.conclusion: 经济有效的LLM路由不仅取决于服务时效率，还取决于部署前获取的监督量。SaveRouter证明了通过选择性获取信息性反馈并在相关查询间共享能力信息，可以从有限监督中学习有效的路由策略，从而更快回收前期监督投入。理论上区分了"信息完备性"与"决策充分性"，为稀疏监督路由提供了理论支撑。

title: Demistifying Data and Simulator Assumptions in Supervised Causal Discovery
summary: Supervised causal discovery learns to infer causal structure for a new dataset from training datasets paired with structural labels. These training pairs are typically simulated, making the simulator both a source of supervision and a carrier of assumptions about causal graphs, mechanisms, and noise. Understanding the resulting predictions therefore requires examining how these assumptions supplement the information available in observational data, which may be compatible with multiple causal graphs. This paper examines that relationship across representative methods available through June 2026. We organize these methods by prediction target, prediction granularity, encoder, structural decoder, and training regime to relate what each method predicts to how it uses data and simulator-based supervision. Using this framework, we distinguish two questions: whether the target is identifiable under the assumed model class, and whether a trained predictor generalizes beyond its training distribution. Restrictions on mechanisms and noise can make otherwise ambiguous causal directions identifiable, but predictive accuracy under those restrictions does not establish transfer when they change. This distinction motivates evaluation that matches metrics to the identifiable graph target and tests changes in graphs, mechanisms, and noise between training and deployment. Extending such evaluation to real data also requires documenting the external causal evidence and uncertainty behind benchmark reference graphs. Together, these analyses guide method comparison and identify open questions in transfer, test-time adaptation, and uncertainty assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了监督式因果发现（SCD）方法，从预测目标、粒度、编码器、解码器和训练机制五个维度对代表性方法进行分类比较，分析了模拟器假设如何补充观测数据中的因果信息，并指出目标可识别性与模型迁移性是两个需要分别考察的问题，最终提出了匹配图目标的评估建议。
AI.motivation: 监督式因果发现方法依赖模拟器生成训练对（数据集+结构标签），而观测数据本身可能与多个因果图相容。现有文献对这些方法的目标、假设和迁移能力缺乏统一框架的系统性分析，导致方法比较和评估存在混乱。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: （1）从预测目标、预测粒度、编码器、结构解码器、训练机制五个维度构建统一比较框架；（2）将经典可识别性理论（A1–A3条件独立可识别性、A4可识别函数模型类）映射到SCD方法上；（4）分析模拟器先验在CI等价类内引入的额外约束机制；（5）对约15种主流SCD方法（RCC、ML4S、SPOT、ML4C、DAG-EQ、CSIvA、AVICI、BCNP、SiCL、Kode、SEA、ADAG、Arrow、TTT-SCL、TICL）进行逐项分析；（6）提出评估建议（区分合成/半合成/真实基准，匹配图目标的度量）。
AI.result: （1）建立五维度比较框架，并提供两份详细表格（表I方法概览、表II模拟器规格）；（2）揭示CI可识别性仅在马尔科夫等价类层面成立，模拟器通过机制/噪声约束可在该类内区分方向；（3）明确区分"目标在模型类内是否可识别"与"训练后预测器能否迁移"两个独立问题；（4）指出DAG-EQ的Pearson相关输入在等方差高斯模型下不充分、AVICI的后验依赖于模拟器先验、ADAG需要额外结构假设等具体局限性；（5）提出测试时适配可匹配观测边际但无法区分同边际的因果模型。
AI.conclusion: 监督式因果发现的有效性取决于模拟器假设与部署数据假设的匹配程度。CI可识别性仅在条件独立假设下成立，更强的方向识别需要机制、噪声、干预或背景知识的额外限制。评估应明确图目标（CPDAG/全DAG），并分开描述训练与测试模拟器。真实数据评估需要记录参考图的外部因果证据和不确定性。未来工作方向包括迁移性、测试时适配和不确定性评估。

title: Commitment Hierarchies under Intent Revision: A Belief-Revision Account of Salvage in Tool-Use Agents
comment: Accepted in the 27th International Conference on Principles and Practice of Multi-Agent Systems
summary: When a user changes their mind partway through a task, an agent that has already split the task into sub-goals and paid for tool calls must decide, per cached sub-result, whether to keep, patch, or discard it (salvage), restarting wastes valid work and continuing unchanged answers the old question. Our main finding is that salvage quality is a matter of role design rather than model capability: a language model asked the keep/patch/discard question one node at a time is unreliable, but asked to classify the revision once, with a deterministic layer propagating the decision, it reaches the cost-optimal oracle on all three models tested, from two vendors. Modeling the plan as a commitment hierarchy and the intent change as a belief-revision operator with AGM style postulates, we prove that no policy observing only a node's local view can be both safe and cost optimal, while the single classification design is both. Across three environments the policy recovers the full achievable savings, 43% cheaper than restart, at 100% correctness.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种"salvage"机制来解决工具调用代理在用户中途改变意图时的子结果复用问题。核心发现是：决策质量取决于"角色设计"而非模型能力。让语言模型逐节点判断keep/patch/discard不可靠，但让它一次性分类修订类型，再用确定性层传播决策，则在所有测试模型上达到成本最优的oracle水平。论文将计划建模为承诺层级，将意图变更建模为AGM风格的后置修正算子，证明了局部观察策略不可能既安全又成本最优，而单分类设计可以。三个实验环境验证其节省43%成本且保持100%正确率。
AI.motivation: 当前工具使用代理在用户中途改变意图时面临两难：要么restart浪费已完成的工具调用（有效子结果占restart成本的43%），要么naively continue回答已被用户放弃的旧问题。需要在保持正确性的同时最大化复用已缓存的子结果。
AI.method: 1. 将执行计划建模为有向无环图(DAG)，节点为带缓存结果和成本的承诺，边表示消费关系。2. 将用户意图建模为约束集Φ，将修订δ分类为addition/retraction/revision，并定义provenance set追踪每个节点依赖的约束。3. 定义salvage算子S(D,δ)对每个缓存节点标注Keep/Patch/Discard，提出五个AGM风格后置条件（Success/Inclusion/Vacuity/Consistency/Minimality）。4. 区分三种信息机制：Local（仅看节点自身）、Informed（看直接生产者的状态）、Structured（一次性读取supp(δ)后确定性传播）。5. 证明Theorem 2.1：任何确定性Local策略不可能同时满足Inclusion和Minimality。6. 证明Theorem 2.2：Structured设计在provenance sound假设下满足所有五个后置条件。
AI.result: 在三个环境中验证：CostBench（1,080实例）上structured judge达到0.90-1.00的oracle节省率，per-node judge仅0.44；STT-Arena（1,110实例）上keep/patch/discard与oracle一致（3.05 vs 6.08子目标，100%正确）；Synthetic DAG（188实例）上structured judge在三个模型（gpt-4o/gpt-4o-mini/gemini-2.5-flash）上均达1.00 oracle节省率且零违规，而per-node和informed judge均严重不足。总体比restart便宜43%，保持100%正确率。gpt-5 rollouts中保持环境状态但重置上下文可将通过率从0.11提升至0.52。
AI.conclusion: 将计划建模为承诺层级、将意图变更建模为信念修正，可以为中途意图修订的失败模式命名，给出解释为何per-node判断必然失败的局部性界，以及一个衡量标准。实践启示是角色设计：只问模型"什么变了"，让确定性层传播答案。局限性在于仅测试了三个温度为0的模型，假设层级计划和记录的provenance，且合成DAG为存在性证明而非普遍性。

title: Governing the Edge: Automating Commercial Property and Casualty Insurance Underwriting via a Hybrid Local-Cloud Multi-Agent Framework
comment: Accepted at AIxB 2026. 6 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Data and Code in github: this https URL
summary: Underwriters in commercial Property and Casualty (P&C) insurance spend 30 to 40% of their time on administrative work rather than risk judgment, and a single submission takes about 40 minutes by hand. We present Governing the Edge, a multi-agent framework for that layer, organized around a data-residency constraint: sensitive submission data must not leave the perimeter. Eleven agents and two deterministic control nodes, one a human-escalation interrupt, form a 13-node LangGraph workflow across two tiers. Agents touching raw submissions run locally on Gemma 2, each bound through a tool interface logging every invocation (synthetic stubs in the current prototype); only anonymized scores and non-identifying fields cross to Claude Sonnet in the cloud. Compliance rules are encoded as conditions on graph edges, so a non-compliant submission never reaches pricing. We walk through one full scenario end to end, a commercial auto submission whose principal driver carries serious violations, showing every agent call, every tool invocation, and the resulting routing decision. The framework processes a 40-minute manual submission in a few minutes on a single edge device, dominated by serialized on-device inference. On the hard-stop violation tier the framework enforces every rule correctly and reproducibly, since hard stops are deterministic predicates over fields extracted at temperature 0; overall compliance accuracy across the 20-scenario benchmark is 70%, with the remaining gap concentrated in softer, judgment-based tiers. It keeps a complete audit trail and respects the privacy boundary throughout. We release all code, compliance rules, tool stubs, and synthetic datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Governing the Edge"框架，一种基于LangGraph的混合本地-云端多智能体系统，用于自动化商业财产意外险（P&C）的承保行政工作。系统包含13个节点（11个智能体+2个确定性控制节点），敏感数据由本地Gemma 2处理，匿名化后由云端Claude Sonnet推理。核心贡献是将合规编码为图边条件而非事后检查，通过确定性谓词执行硬性停止规则。在20个合成场景中，硬性停止类准确率100%（6/6可复现），整体合规准确率70%，处理时间从人工40分钟缩短至约4.5分钟。
AI.motivation: 商业P&C承保人员30-40%时间耗费于行政事务（读文档、数据查询、重新录入），单份申请约40分钟手动处理。现有AI方案存在三大缺陷：①无法强制合规；②无法调用权威外部数据源；③通常将敏感数据直接发送至云端API。本文瞄准承保流程中的行政层自动化，保留人工风险判断，重点解决合规性、数据隐私和外部数据落地三大空白。
AI.method: 系统架构：13节点LangGraph StateGraph，分两层级。①本地层：Gemma 2（ollama/gemma2）处理原始文档解析、ACORD 125字段提取、风险子智能体；②云端层：Claude Sonnet 4.6通过LiteLLM处理匿名化数据上的推理（风险聚合、覆盖缺口、定价、可解释性）。关键设计：合规规则编码为图边条件函数（route_compliance），PASS状态才放行至定价；硬性停止规则由Python确定性谓词evaluate_hard_stops执行，不依赖LLM；CONFLICT状态触发一次自动重试后升级人工；隐私边界通过序列化器、云端提示词、网络隔离三处执行；每智能体绑定特定工具接口（当前为合成存根）并记录调用日志；Pydantic schema在边界校验输出；8类错误追踪分类用于运维监控。10条P&C合规规则覆盖商业财产与汽车（5条STOP级+5条WARN级）。
AI.result: 端到端场景CA-S06（SaaS快递公司，主司机3年内3次严重违章）展示全流程：本地三个并行风险子智能体→Risk Aggregator跨隐私边界→Compliance Agent确定性触发CA-02硬性停止→路由至Human Escalation，定价和覆盖缺口模块未被调用。性能：单次端到端268.8秒（约4.5分钟），相对人工40分钟显著提速，但慢于云端单次提示（6.4秒）。准确率对比20场景：硬性停止层6/6（100%，可复现）、简单批准4/4、WARNING层2/6、低置信升级2/4，整体70%；对照Monolithic Sonnet（75%）与Linear Pipeline（30%）。硬性停止结果由温度0的确定性谓词保证稳定；WARNING和升级层因本地Gemma 2判断与合成工具随机性在不同运行间波动。
AI.conclusion: 框架通过将合规作为图边条件而非事后检查，解决了线性管线中违规结果沿流程传播的根本问题；通过本地-云端分层与序列化强制执行解决了数据驻留约束；通过绑定工具接口与审计日志解决了外部数据落地需求。在硬性停止关键合规层达到100%可复现准确率，整体合规率70%，遗留差距集中在依赖本地模型判断的软性层（WARNING与低置信升级）。主要局限：外部工具为未播种的合成存根，软层结果不可复现；硬性停止规则当前依赖提取字段而非工具返回的真实数据；场景为合成数据、单一专家标注。生产部署需更新阈值以匹配各州DOI要求和NAIC示范法，并将Gemma 2升级为Gemma 4以改善延迟。

title: VeriWeave Govern: Evidence-Gated Deterministic Runtime Governance for Enterprise AI Agents
summary: Enterprise artificial-intelligence agents increasingly call tools, modify infrastructure, and process protected data, creating a need to separate action generation from action authorization. This article presents VeriWeave Govern, a deterministic runtime governance layer that evaluates structured agent actions against versioned policies, validates typed evidence, applies fixed deny > review > allow precedence, routes consequential actions to accountable human review, and records replayable tamper-evident audit state. GovernBench evaluates the design over 30 independent seeds and 60,000 oracle-labelled cases spanning five enterprise domains, adversarial evidence, out-of-distribution actions, and temporal policy evolution. VeriWeave achieves 0.9888 mean accuracy, 0.9836 macro-F1, zero observed aggregate false allows, and zero observed Governance Attack Success Rate on the evaluated cases. Six ablations show that evidence gating, deny precedence, out-of-distribution fail-safe behavior, human review, contradiction handling, and temporal replay contribute complementary safety. The deployed API additionally passes 12/12 end-to-end scenarios and a 40,040-request concurrency matrix with zero failures. A separate 150-case EU/Austria regulation-grounded evaluation uses frozen predictions and two independent blinded human annotators, who agree on all decisions. On this set, deterministic engines remain conservative, while a Gemma 4 31B comparator aligns more closely with the human consensus. The results expose a measurable safety--utility trade-off and motivate evidence-aware, replayable governance as an independent control plane for enterprise agent execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VeriWeave Govern——一种面向企业AI智能体的确定性运行时治理层，通过证据门控、三态决策（deny>review>allow）、OOD失败安全、人为审核路由与可重放防篡改审计，将动作生成与动作授权分离为独立的信任域。在GovernBench（60,000案例×30种子）与150例欧盟/奥地利法规评估中验证其安全性与可用性权衡。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体从文本生成演化为可调用工具、修改基础设施和处理受保护数据的自主系统，错误授权的后果（如部署软件、释放数据、影响公民流程）远比错误回答更严重。传统RBAC/ABAC与策略引擎（OPA/Cedar）缺乏对证据时效性、冲突控制、人工问责、未知动作和策略演化的支持；而使用同一随机模型同时担任动作提议方和最终授权方会产生循环信任问题。因此需要一个独立于规划器的确定性授权边界。
AI.method: 系统采用请求形式化 x=⟨a,o,r,p,c,E,t⟩（身份、操作、资源、目的、上下文、证据集、时间），规则匹配集Q(x)与证据门控G(x)共同决定结果：U(x)=存在review规则 ∨ ¬G(x) ∨ Q(x)=∅；D(x)在存在deny规则时为deny，否则U(x)=1时为review，否则allow。三大核心组件：①策略匹配器（评估版本化谓词与证据需求）；②证据验证器（计算权威性、时效性、签名、内容、矛盾性的logistic信任分数s(e)=σ(w⊤φ(e)+b)，阈值τ=0.76接受）；③决策归约器（执行deny>review>allow与OOD失败安全）。补充机制包括：哈希链审计（h_i=SHA256(h_{i-1}‖R_i)）、版本化策略束（含策略集哈希）、反事实治理证书（记录最小证据扰动对决策的影响）。三条安全不变量命题：deny优势性（增加allow规则不能使决策更宽松）、证据单调性（移除证据不能产生新allow）、重放确定性（相同输入与策略版本产生相同输出）。实验采用GovernBench（30种子×2,000合成案例，覆盖公共行政、医疗、金融、软件工程代理、企业办公五大领域，含7类对抗族：过期证据、伪造签名、引用洗白、证据洪水、矛盾证据、策略降级、工具替换）与150例EU/奥地利法规评估（两位盲法独立人类标注员，原始一致率1.000、κ=1.000）。
AI.result: GovernBench结果（30种子×2,000案例）：VeriWeave平均准确率0.9888（95% CI 0.9876–0.9899）、macro-F1=0.9836、FAR=0.0000、GASR=0.0000；RBAC准确率仅0.5864（FAR=0.3032），ABAC为0.4947（FAR=0.5053）。消融实验：移除证据门控→准确率0.7127、FAR=0.2873；移除deny优先级→FAR=0.2115；移除OOD失败安全→FAR=0.1284、GASR=0.1427；移除人为审核→FAR=0.0890；移除时序重放→FAR=0.0665；移除矛盾检测→FAR=0.0008但GASR=0.0067。证据模型AUROC=0.9840、AUPRC=0.9896、Brier=0.1226、ECE=0.2253。Docker API：12/12端到端场景通过，并发度4时平均延迟10.42 ms、P95=17.14 ms、吞吐371.64 req/s。负载矩阵：4个并发级别×10,010请求=40,040请求，零失败；并发32时P95=108.84 ms、吞吐368.97 req/s。150例法规评估：两位标注员完全一致（80 allow/20 review/50 deny）；VeriWeave/OPA/Cedar准确率0.8000（零false allow，但30例过度升级为review）；Gemma 4 31B准确率0.9733（零false allow，仅4例错误）；VeriWeave相对Gemma准确率差−0.1733（Holm校正McNemar p=7.67×10⁻⁶）。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明确定性证据门控可作为自主规划与副作用执行之间的实用强制层，零观察到的unsafe allow与零GASR展示了分层防御（证据门控、deny优先级、OOD失败安全、人工问责、时序重放）的互补性。150例人类评审揭示出可测量的安全–可用性权衡：确定性引擎通过过度升级保持保守，而Gemma 4 31B更接近人类共识但缺乏确定性强制语义。核心系统原则是动作授权应通过独立、证据感知、可重放的策略强制来显式控制该权衡，而非追求单标签准确率最大化。架构支持四信任域分离（规划器/上下文/治理/执行）与渐进部署生命周期（observe→shadow→selective enforcement→broad enforcement）。代码以Python 3.13实现并以VeriWeave Govern v0.4.0开源发布。

title: CRASM-Gate: Deterministic-First Constraint- and Role-Aware Semantic Mapping with Selective Model Assistance Across Heterogeneous Industrial Standards
summary: Industrial standards often encode the same engineering concept through incompatible hierarchies, identifiers, roles, and structural constraints, so the nearest lexical or embedding match can still be technically inadmissible. This article presents CRASM, a deterministic constraint- and role-aware semantic mapping method, and CRASM-Gate, its selectively model-assisted extension. The framework separates standard-specific canonicalization, bounded retrieval, deterministic rules, destination-versus-origin role interpretation, semantic and structural ranking, ambiguity refusal, and target validation. CRASM-Gate adds a confidence/disagreement gate that may invoke a candidate-constrained large language model, while final authority remains with deterministic validation. A controlled artifact covers six directed industrial-standard pairs, three difficulty levels, and ten configurations, yielding 14,400 sample-level decisions. With a fixed local model endpoint, CRASM-Gate reaches mean F1 0.9938 and an implemented structural-validity rate of 1.0000; deterministic CRASM reaches 0.9931 without generative-model calls; and the model-only baseline reaches 0.5347. Relative to the model-only baseline, CRASM reduces top-1 errors from 670 to 10 while exhibiting 0.0688 s/sample rather than 24.5263 s/sample observed latency. CRASM-Gate improves CRASM by one additional correct decision out of 1,440, with observed latency increasing to 15.7666 s/sample. The results support a deterministic-first interoperability architecture in which model assistance is optional, measurable, candidate-bounded, and unable to bypass structural validation.

AI.tldr: 提出CRASM（确定性约束与角色感知语义映射方法）及其选择式模型辅助扩展CRASM-Gate，针对异构工业标准（AAS、OPC UA、IEEE 1451、IEC 61499、ISO 15926风格）的语义互操作问题，采用"确定性优先"架构——候选约束检索、确定性规则、目的地/源端角色区分、语义/结构排序、歧义拒绝、目标验证，仅在不确定性/分歧门控处调用受JSON Schema约束的本地LLM，最终决策权归确定性验证。在14,400个样本（6个有向标准对×3难度×10配置）的冻结基准上，CRASM-Gate F1=0.9938、结构有效性=1.0000；CRASM F1=0.9931、无生成模型调用；LLM-only基线仅0.5347。CRASM将top-1错误从670降至10，延迟0.0688 s/样本（vs 24.5 s），模型辅助仅额外带来1个正确决策但延迟增加229×。
AI.motivation: 工业标准（OPC UA、AAS、IEEE 1451、IEC 61499、ISO 15926）用不兼容的层次、标识符、角色和结构约束编码同一工程概念，导致最近邻词法/嵌入匹配在技术上仍可能不可接受。现有方法（模型驱动转换、本体匹配、知识图谱、LLM）在语义合理性与确定性工程约束冲突时缺乏明确的接受权责分工。需要一种明确区分"语义相似性"与"结构/角色可接受性"、且LLM辅助可控可审计的互操作架构。
AI.method: 1）标准适配器规范化源元素为协议限定路径；2）有界检索+确定性规则构建候选证据；3）CRASM融合词法、嵌入、规则、数据类型、单位、实例、父路径、上下文/路径对齐、检索、信号族、测量角色等多通道评分；4）显式目的地vs源端角色解释（公式5：对所需目的地匹配奖励、源端匹配惩罚），低分或低边际时拒绝；5）CRASM-Gate门控条件（公式6：top1<0.82或top1-top2≤0.08或规则/检索分歧）触发受JSON Schema约束的本地LLM调用，模型输出经规范化后回流入同一确定性验证器。架构三不变式：候选闭包、验证器主导、模型非权威。
AI.result: 在冻结基准（6有向对×3难度×10配置=14,400决策，种子2105616649，固定本地gemma4:e2b端点）上：CRASM-Gate F1=0.9938（1431/1440），CRASM F1=0.9931（1430/1440），LLM-only F1=0.5347（770/1440）；中/难样本CRASM与CRASM-Gate均100%正确；LLM-only中样本仅18.96%、难样本41.46%；五对标准F1=1.0000，所有错误集中于AAS→OPC UA（CRASM 0.9583、CRASM-Gate 0.9625）；CRASM延迟0.0688 s/样本（比LLM-only快约356×），CRASM-Gate延迟15.77 s/样本（增加229×换1个正确决策）；结构有效性均为1.0000；检索R@1=0.2618、R@5=0.6597（远低于最终F1，证明检索仅为候选证据而非决策者）。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是权威分解（authority decomposition）而非单纯高分：确定性CRASM承担几乎全部受控质量，LLM应被视为有界的、可选的、可测量的不确定性解析器，不能绕过结构验证；"确定性优先"互操作架构将候选有界性、决策可分解性、拒绝可接受性、验证器终局性作为可审计的不变式。未来工作：清洁化消融协议的多种子重跑、专家标注的官方工业构件、外部本体匹配基线、无限制候选发现、可执行跨模型转换与对级验证器。

title: Authority Before Utility: Non-Compensatory Control for Persistent LLM Memory
summary: Persistent memory creates a control problem that retrieval relevance alone does not solve: a memory can remain highly useful after an update, deletion, or revocation makes it inadmissible for the current answer. We formalize this as a separation between utility and authority. A fixed finite penalty applied to an unnormalized utility score cannot guarantee exclusion under arbitrary positive-affine reparameterization of that score; by contrast, rank-normalized compensation is scale-invariant and therefore forms a stronger empirical comparator. Our prospectively frozen TIDE/LongMemEval primary was quarantined before a valid HELDOUT comparison because the materialized TIDE adapter conflated historical age with query-relative inadmissibility and the aligned LongMemEval split left no DEV set for the predeclared penalty selection. We therefore report a post-primary replacement diagnostic on Memora Remembering, where update/delete operations provide item-level forgetting state. On Qwen3-8B, DEV selected lambda = 0.6 from a ten-point normalized SOFT family. Across 185 HELDOUT units in 28 dependency clusters, HARD exclusion yields 4.04% balanced construct error versus 19.66% for locked SOFT, a paired difference of 15.61 points with a 20,000-replicate cluster-bootstrap 95% interval of [13.07, 18.76]. The effect is driven primarily by forgotten-value leakage while current-value recall is preserved. This is same-Q operator-comparison evidence, not a universal claim that scalar control fails, not an evaluation of learned authority inference, and not an independent downstream-harm endpoint.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大语言模型持久化记忆系统中的"权威控制"问题提出：仅靠检索相关性（utility）不足以保证记忆在更新、删除或撤销后不再被使用。作者主张将"权威性"（authority）作为不可补偿（non-compensatory）的硬约束，与效用排序分离。理论上证明对原始效用施加固定有限惩罚无法在正仿射重参数化下保证排除，因此采用秩归一化的SOFT基线作为更强的对比。在执行审计中，原预设的TIDE/LongMemEval主实验因构念混淆和DEV集缺失而被隔离，转用Memora Remembering作为替代诊断。在Qwen3-8B上，HARD排除相比DEV选定的SOFT(λ=0.6)在185个HELDOUT单元上取得15.61个百分点的成对差距，主要由遗忘值泄漏驱动，同时当前值召回率得以保持。
AI.motivation: 持久化记忆系统中，一条记忆在语义上仍高度相关（utility高），但可能因更新、删除或撤销而不再具备回答当前问题的资格（inadmissible）。检索效用无法独立解决这一控制问题，需将"是否被授权使用"与"是否有用"区分开来。这一问题在访问控制、决策理论（非补偿偏好）、测量理论及安全控制中均有先例，但尚未被系统引入LLM持久化记忆的设计中。
AI.method: 形式化定义权威状态m_Q(i)∈{0,1}，候选集M及原始效用U_i。HARD控制器在排序前直接移除所有m_Q=1的候选（即F(Q)={i∈M: m_Q(i)=0}）。SOFT控制器保留全部候选，按S_λ(i)=R_i - λ·m_Q(i)排序，其中R_i∈[0,1]为秩归一化效用。提出命题1：若不可接受候选j对可接受候选k有正原始效用优势，则存在正仿射变换U'=aU+b使j在S_λ下仍超过k，说明固定原始惩罚不具表示无关性。秩归一化因仅依赖顺序而具有尺度不变性，构成更强的补偿基线。实验以Memora Remembering为材料化语料（200题，其中180题含value-bearing遗忘项），按依赖聚类（period×persona）切分为15个DEV和185个HELDOUT单元。在Qwen3-8B（BF16，do_sample=False，禁用thinking，256 token上限）上以12候选上下文预算执行。DEV从10点λ∈{0,.05,.10,.20,.40,.60,.80,.90,.95,.99}中选定λ=0.6（DEV误差.1912）。估计量为平衡构念误差E=½[(1-当前召回)+(1-遗忘缺席)]。通过20,000次聚类自举（28簇）报告95%置信区间，并辅以单元级、留一簇、persona-only及period-only敏感性与167单元仅含materialized遗忘值的子集分析。
AI.result: 在185单元/28簇HELDOUT上，HARD平衡构念误差为4.04%，SOFT(λ=0.6)为19.66%，成对差15.61个百分点，簇自举95%CI=[13.07, 18.76]。分解显示：当前召回率差异仅2.40点（91.92% vs 89.52%），而遗忘缺席差异高达28.83点（100.00% vs 71.17%）。单元层面HARD在95个单元更优、90个持平、SOFT无优势。留一簇聚合效应14.94–16.13点，无单簇可解释聚合结果。167单元materialized子集得17.30点差距（HARD 1.78% vs SOFT 19.08%）。DEV仅15单元在10个λ上选择，存在选择不确定性未传播至HELDOUT推断。
AI.conclusion: 在固定的权威状态Q下，秩归一化后最强的有限补偿控制器（DEV选定λ=0.6）相比硬排除仍显著多泄漏遗忘值，且未换来更高的当前值召回，从而为LLM持久化记忆中的权威感知控制架构提供了操作层面的实证证据。但该证据局限于：单一模型（Qwen3-8B）、单一基准（Memora Remembering）、单一效用代理（会话近因性秩归一化）、12候选上下文预算、确定性证据值评分器；不构成对所有标量控制的普遍否定，不评估学习式权威推断，也不构成独立下游危害测量。HARD效应可能部分由上下文占用重塑而非纯逻辑门控驱动，且Q的正确推断本身是独立的治理课题。原始TIDE/LongMemEval主矩阵因构念混淆（age≠inadmissibility）和无DEV集而被隔离，使替代单元的证据等级降为"操作对比"而非前瞻性因果确认。未来工作应在独立裁决的权威状态下评估学习式Q，并采用因子设计固定上下文占用以分离逻辑排除与干扰项减少的贡献。

title: Boundary-State Control for Tool-Using Language-Model Agents: Commit-Time Consistency under State Drift
summary: Tool-using language-model agents can decide that an action is permissible and execute it only after security-relevant state has changed. We study this proposal-to-commit gap and introduce BSC-R, a deterministic effect-boundary mechanism that binds a single-use commit authorization to the exact action and to a semantic projection of the authorization state that justified it. On 2,847 attacked AgentDojo episodes, the boundary kernel preserves the unprotected agent's behavior exactly (80.576% utility; 1.616% attack success). On 10,302 frozen proposals, it accepts every unchanged commit and rejects every instance of ten prospectively specified changed or replayed classes. In an independently generated boundary-drift experiment, full joint binding commits 0/4,403 invalid contexts while retaining 5,899/5,899 valid contexts. A prospective external evaluation on the 3,460-scenario CONTINUITY suite retains all 700 benign cases, prevents 1,200/1,200 represented non-replay invalid effects, handles 160/160 replay lifecycles correctly, and withholds 200/200 ambiguous no-release cases. The broader external suite also exposes the method's limit: across all 2,560 attacks, BSC-R has a 25% invalid-effect commit rate versus 0% for CONTINUITY. The result is therefore a scoped commit-time consistency mechanism, not a universal agent-safety claim.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BSC-R机制，用于解决工具调用语言模型代理中"提案-提交"间隙的安全一致性问题：通过在受信任的效果汇处绑定单次使用的提交见证者到精确动作和授权状态的语义投影。内部测试表现优异（0/4403无效提交，5899/5900有效保留），但外部CONTINUITY套件暴露其25%的失效率，表明这是一个范围有限的提交时一致性机制，而非通用安全方案。
AI.motivation: 工具调用语言模型代理存在"提案-提交"时间间隙：模型判定动作可执行后，到该动作产生持久化外部效果之间，授权状态（撤销、权限变更、政策更新、审批失效、重放等）可能发生改变。这种TOCTOU类竞态使单纯的模型输出决策不足以保证执行时的安全性，需要在效果边界进行确定性重新校验。
AI.method: BSC-R（Boundary-State Control with semantic authorization projection）在受信任的效果汇处实施确定性验证机制。核心结构为：鉴定时生成τ = MAC_k(canon(a) || canon(π(z_q)) || n)，其中a为规范化动作，π为语义授权投影（绑定主体、执行者、权限、委托范围、政策标识/摘要/时期、污染等），n为单次使用随机数。提交时重新规范化、计算当前投影、验证见证者、消费nonce。同时冻结了十种扰动类别用于机制识别。
AI.result: RQ1：确定边界内核在2847个AgentDojo攻击场景中完全保持基础行为（80.576%效用，1.616%攻击成功率），而学习策略则崩溃为全拒绝。RQ2：完整联合绑定在10302个提案上接受所有未变更提交，拒绝所有十类扰动。RQ3：独立边界漂移实验中，全联合绑定实现0/4403无效提交和5899/5899有效保留。RQ4：外部CONTINUITY套件中，BSC-R在目标构造上完美（700/700良性、1200/1200已表示的非重放无效、160/160重放生命周期、200/200模糊无释放），但在完整2560攻击套件上无效效果提交率25%（vs CONTINUITY的0%）。
AI.conclusion: BSC-R是范围限定的提交时一致性机制，而非通用代理安全声明。其有效性严格依赖于语义投影所覆盖的安全不变量；外部套件中25%的失效率源于投影未涵盖的溯源、发布有效性、变换/收据、阶段签名者、替代路径等不变量。代理安全的实际设计空间应组合模型级过滤、限制性策略和提交时一致性检查，而非相互排斥的替代方案。

title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation
summary: Skills equip LLM agents with professional knowledge and guidance to complete long-horizon and complex tasks. Although skills have been widely adopted in recent agent paradigms and harnesses, how to synthesize reliable training data and how to train agents for skill use remain underexplored. In this work, we propose SkillGym, an automatic pipeline to build verifiable environments, collect trajectories, and train skill-use agents. SkillGym first crawls a large volume of skills from the internet, then keeps those whose workflows can run reproducibly offline. A builder-reviewer pipeline is used to construct difficulty-controlled tasks, spanning four task types, each with a reference solution and an executable verifier. With this pipeline, we build 6.8k environments and collect 19k verified successful trajectories for supervised finetuning. Finetuning on these trajectories improves LLMs of different families and sizes, from 2B to 122B parameters across four skill-use benchmarks; Our Qwen3.5-9B SFT model outperforms the 397B untrained model on two of them. Further analysis shows that training teaches agents to invoke skills, raising the rate of reading the relevant skill from 28% to 96%, and that the gains hold across reasoning structures, extending to task types that form a minority of the training data and to skills held out from training

AI.tldr: SkillGym 是一个自动化流水线，将网络社区编写的技能包转化为可验证、可执行的训练环境（含 6.8k 任务与 19k 成功轨迹），通过监督微调显著提升 LLM 智能体的"技能调用"能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多从固定环境中提取技能，局限于少数领域；而社区技能虽丰富但缺乏任务、环境与验证，难以作为训练数据。SkillGym 旨在将外部、异构的公共技能转化为"技能关键型"训练任务，并构建可靠的执行验证机制，使模型学习到调用与运用技能的可迁移行为。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：（1）从 skills.sh 与 claude-skill-registry 爬取 184k 技能条目，经多维标注与规则过滤筛选出 11,897 个可离线、可复现运行的技能；（2）采用 builder-reviewer 双智能体系统，按"程序执行、溯因诊断、约束满足、偏序规划"四种推理结构构建任务，并配备参考解与可执行验证器，通过"有效性门"与"质量门"双重把关；（3）使用 Kimi-K3、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.2 三教师模型在四种智能体框架下收集 19k 条已验证的成功轨迹，并基于此进行监督微调。
AI.result: 在 2B 至 122B 参数的六款基座模型上，SkillGym SFT 在 22/24 项对比中带来提升：SkillGym 测试集平均提升 13.8 分、SkillEval 提升 9.7 分、SkillsBench 提升 9.7 分、Skill-Use-Bench 提升 41.2 分。其中 Qwen3.5-9B SFT 模型在两个基准上超越了未训练的 397B 模型。消融实验表明：（a）训练后智能体对相关技能的"触发读取率"从 28% 提升至 96%；（b）质量审核通过的任务数据优于仅通过执行验证的数据；（c）训练带来的增益在不同推理结构上保持一致，且能迁移到训练中占少数的结构以及训练中未见的技能上；（d）技能访问使训练后模型的成功率提升 16.5 分，是基础模型（7.5 分）的两倍以上。
AI.conclusion: SkillGym 证明了将社区公共技能规模化转化为可验证训练环境的可行性，揭示了训练的核心收益在于让智能体学会主动调用所提供技能，而非仅提升通用解题能力；该方法在跨模型、跨规模、跨领域、跨推理结构以及未见技能上均展现出良好的泛化能力。未来工作应针对"方法/工具密集型"技能扩充数据，并探索将 SkillGym 的可执行验证器作为奖励信号进行强化学习训练。

title: How Can Recommendation Feedback Evolve Agent Memory?
summary: Content-generation agents continuously receive impressions, clicks, conversions, and negative feedback from recommendation systems, providing real-world outcome signals for memory evolution. However, these signals are delayed and noisy, confounded by audience composition, placement, and recommendation policies, and may result from the combined influence of multiple memories, making accurate attribution difficult. Existing methods rely primarily on immediate feedback or semantic retrieval and therefore struggle to reliably translate recommendation outcomes into memory fitness. To address this challenge, we propose TIDE (Trajectory-Informed Directed Memory Evolution), an external memory evolution framework driven by delayed recommendation feedback. We further introduce Memory Evolution Gain (MEG), which measures the utility improvement of evolved memory over a no memory baseline on strictly future tasks. TIDE treats memory as a capacity-constrained population of experiences: temporal and semantic credit assignment estimates contextual fitness, while responsibility credit distributes outcome signals according to the memories referenced during generation. These signals are then used to reinforce, crossover, mutate, or evict memories. On an e-commerce membership marketing content-generation agent, TIDE achieves a +7.75-percentage-point MEG in offline temporal replay and significantly improves both unique click-through rate (UCTR) and activation rate in an online A/B test. On a delayed-label benchmark, TIDE achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) and the highest MEG among the compared methods, demonstrating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TIDE框架,旨在将推荐系统中延迟、嘈杂、上下文依赖的反馈信号转化为智能体外部记忆的演化驱动力,并提出Memory Evolution Gain (MEG)作为评估记忆更新对未来任务效用的指标。
AI.motivation: 内容生成智能体部署在推荐系统后会收到点击、转化、负反馈等真实世界结果信号,但这些信号具有延迟性、噪声,且受受众构成、投放位置和推荐策略影响,同时单一结果可能由多条记忆共同影响,导致归因困难。现有方法依赖即时反馈或语义检索,难以可靠地将推荐结果转化为记忆适应度信号。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心阶段:(1)时间信用——将完整生命周期而非任意时间点的指标快照作为多目标结果摘要;(2)语义信用——通过匹配对照集合和环境记录,将可靠生命周期结果转化为上下文相关的决策证据链;(3)责任信用——结合记忆使用记录和反事实重放,将上下文适应度分配给真正参与生成并影响决策的记忆。基于这三层信用分配,对记忆种群执行强化、交叉(crossover)、变异(mutation)或驱逐(eviction)操作,并在固定容量约束下进行种群选择。生成器参数保持冻结,记忆以受容量约束的种群形式持续演化。
AI.result: 在电商会员营销内容生成智能体上:TIDE在离线时序回放中取得+7.75百分点的MEG,在为期一周的在线A/B实验中,UCTR相对提升+5.10%,激活率提升+4.79%(均p<0.001);在基于MemoryCD改编的延迟标签基准上,TIDE取得最低MAE(0.531)和RMSE(0.895)及最高MEG@δ=5(+0.0365)。消融实验表明责任信用是最关键的组件,移除后Mean Utility下降0.149;十轮演化实验中TIDE在有界记忆(80条)下取得最高效用(0.809),且90%的驱逐操作针对注入的噪声记忆。分布漂移实验中TIDE恢复时间仅需0.33轮,显著快于基线。
AI.conclusion: TIDE通过结合时间、语义、责任三层信用分配,有效将延迟、上下文依赖的推荐结果转化为可追溯、可审计、可逐条回滚的外部记忆演化,提供了一种高效、可追溯的智能体持续适应方案,在离线效用、在线业务指标和跨任务泛化三个维度均取得最优表现。

title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning
summary: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking versus acting immediately, and the possibility that users may provide corrections without being asked. To navigate these trade-offs, we introduce Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning (REVOIR). REVOIR makes clarification decisions via inference-time reasoning about the value-of-information of a question, which captures the expected improvement in task reward due to the answer received. In two assistive tasks --- ambiguous question answering (CondAmbigQA) and preference-aligned household task planning (ADAPT) --- we show that REVOIR achieves greater success with fewer questions than approaches based on prompting, chain-of-thought, fine-tuning, or information gain, improving preference satisfaction on ADAPT by 13-15% over a fine-tuned clarification policy while requiring no training and asking five times fewer questions. Furthermore, when the assistant can receive cheap user corrections after acting, REVOIR naturally infers that asking questions is not always efficient, demonstrating the adaptivity of our approach. In contrast, we find that vanilla reasoning agents fail to adaptively clarify user requests, and request fewer clarifications as reasoning effort increases.

AI.tldr: REVOIR提出了一种基于信息价值(VoI)推理的推理时决策框架，使LLM辅助代理能够理性地决定何时向用户提出澄清问题、何时直接行动，在两个基准测试中以更少的问题实现了更高的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于语言的辅助代理常面临用户意图模糊的问题。现有方法要么直接行动（可能产生与用户意图错位），要么基于信息增益或固定阈值提问，忽视了不确定性减少对下游性能的影响、提问与行动的成本权衡，以及用户可在行动后提供纠正的可能性。需要一个理性的决策框架来平衡这些权衡。
AI.method: REVOIR（Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning）将澄清辅助建模为协作博弈，采用变分粒子近似维护用户意图信念，通过推理时计算提问与行动的成本调整后价值（基于模拟用户回答/纠正后的期望任务奖励），决策是否提问。在CondAmbigQA（模糊问答）和ADAPT（偏好对齐家务规划）两个基准上与提示、思维链、微调、信息增益等基线对比。
AI.result: 在CondAmbigQA上，REVOIR以更少的澄清实现更高正确率，Pareto支配基于EIG的REIGN基线；在用户终止设置下能自适应减少提问，依靠用户纠正。在ADAPT上，REVOIR在偏好满足率上超越微调的Reflection-DPO（44%）13-15个百分点达56-59%，且提问量少约5倍，无需任何训练。vanilla推理代理随推理努力增加反而减少澄清，无法自适应。
AI.conclusion: REVOIR证明任务导向的信息价值推理比通用推理扩展或信息增益策略更有效，能在不同成本-正确率权衡下自适应行为，并在用户可纠正场景下展现理性适应能力。但当前为单步VoI估计（短视），尚不支持双控制和动作-提问交错，需未来工作开发多步VoI估计并在真实用户上评估。

title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories. In this paper we ask a complementary question: Which past interactions causally shape the agent's future decisions? We recast context compression as a causal decision preservation problem over discrete interaction units and introduce FOCUS, a training-free context compression framework that operates entirely at test time. Our method requires no offline data collection or fine-tuning, and is architecture-agnostic, attaching to any closed-API frontier model as a modular compression layer. We evaluate FOCUS on diverse agentic benchmarks including API and tool-calling, QA, web domain and multi-turn dialogue. Our method establishes new state of the art performance, cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points over uncompressed execution.

AI.tldr: FOCUS 是一个无需训练的测试时框架，通过将智能体的交互历史划分为 atomic(目标-动作-观测)span，基于草稿模型的蒙特卡洛规划滚动评估每个 span 的"反事实未来效用"（即移除该 span 是否会改变未来决策），从而在保留决策相关 span 的同时压缩智能体上下文。该方法将上下文压缩重新定义为"决策保留的因果抽象"问题，与信息瓶颈(IB)目标在理论上等价，并在多个智能体基准上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在长时任务中积累的交互历史随任务长度线性增长，导致推理成本呈二次方增长，且注意力稀释使决策质量下降。现有上下文压缩方法（基于 token 似然、soft-prompt、KV-cache 淘汰、离线学习的压缩策略等）存在两大局限：(1) token 级/缓存级过滤会破坏工具调用、代码等结构化交互痕迹的局部因果结构；(2) 离线学习的压缩策略在推理前就已固定，无法根据测试时演化的轨迹动态调整。因此需要一种无需训练、可在测试时动态适应、面向决策保留的上下文压缩方法。
AI.method: 方法核心包含四个阶段：(1) 将智能体交互历史表示为 atomic(推理-动作-观测)span 序列，避免破坏结构化交互的局部因果关系；(2) 形式化每个 span 的反事实未来效用 U(s_i) 为移除该 span 后未来轨迹分布的 KL 散度变化，并证明在有界未来交互假设下最大化总效用等价于优化 IB 目标；(3) 由于精确计算 KL 效用不可行，使用轻量草稿模型 a_φ 进行 N 次蒙特卡洛规划滚动采样，每次生成计划草图并显式引用其依赖的历史 span，将引用频率 û_i 作为效用估计；(4) 引入防御性验证阶段，对未被引用的 span 进行二次审查，识别并保留可能引发重复错误或丢失因果状态的"救援集" S_R，最终保留集 S_keep = S_U ∪ S_R。理论上证明 û_i 在 Hoeffding 不等式意义下以 O(1/√N) 速率收敛至真实依赖概率，且在 utility margin 假设下，阈值化能以高概率恢复未来相关 span 集。
AI.result: 在 5 个智能体基准（AppWorld、OfficeBench、8-QA、WebVoyager、τ²-Bench）上全面优于现有压缩基线（FIFO、Retrieval、LLMLingua、Prompting、ACON）。主要结果：在 AppWorld 上使用 gpt-4.1 作为主智能体和草稿模型时，峰值上下文减少最多 48%，依赖性减少 73%，任务成功率比无压缩执行提升最多 8.9 个百分点（绝对 64.9% vs 56.0%）；使用 gpt-4.1-mini 时仍提升 23%。在不同草稿模型（gpt-4.1-mini、Qwen3-8B/14B、Phi-4）间均稳健，Qwen3-8B 作为草稿可使 gpt-4.1 主智能体性能提升 17% 同时削减 25% 峰值 token。消融实验表明 N=3 次滚动后收益趋于饱和；OfficeBench 上 API 总成本降低 37%，草稿模型开销仅占 3%；滚动并行化可使压缩延迟降低约 2.5 倍。理论附录证明 û_i 估计的收敛速率（O(1/√N)）、keep-set 恢复的指数稳定保证，以及与 KL 反事实效用的一致性（重叠系数 0.85-0.90，Spearman 相关性 0.39-0.48）。定性分析揭示了一个失效模式：当任务是集合泛化形式（如"将所有好友加为朋友"）时，草稿模型的低估会导致实体级 span 被错误剪枝。
AI.conclusion: FOCUS 将智能体上下文压缩从传统的"冗余消除"范式转变为"决策保留的因果抽象"范式，通过将问题与信息瓶颈目标联系起来，为基于前瞻性反事实效用的压缩提供了原则性基础。其无需训练、架构无关、模块化设计的特性使其可作为任何封闭 API 前沿模型的即插即用压缩层。实验证明决策保留式压缩不仅能无损缩减上下文，还能通过缓解注意力稀释来主动提升基座智能体的决策质量。该工作开辟了将决策理论原理整合到 LLM 系统设计中的研究方向，特别是在长时工具使用智能体场景下具有重要实践价值。

title: XU-RS: Explaining Credal Width in Random-Set Language Models
summary: Uncertainty estimates tell us how unsure a model is, but not why. Without knowing which parts of an input influences a model's uncertainty, we cannot tell whether that uncertainty score depends on input features that are relevant for the task. We study this problem in randomset classifiers built using pretrained language models. These classifiers assign probability to individual answers and to groups of answers, producing lower and upper probabilities for each answer; The difference between these probabilities, called credal width, is used to represent epistemic uncertainty about an answer arising from limited training data. We propose XU-RS, a framework that attributes an answer's credal width to the input tokens (words or word pieces) supplied to a language model. XU-RS uses Expected Gradients (a standard feature attribution method) to estimate how input tokens contribute to credal width. The proposed framework is evaluated on a MedQA dataset using SmolLM3-3B and Llama-2-7B models, demonstrating that setting the embedding of a token ranked highly by XU-RS to zero (zero-masking) causes larger changes in credal width than zero-masking randomly selected tokens. In addition, we show that normalisation can cause other answer groups to influence an answer's width, reveal how token attribution can mask numerical errors, and provide diagnostic checks to verify whether a token ranked highly by XU-RS meaningfully explains model uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XU-RS框架,用于将基于预训练语言模型的随机集分类器所产生的"信度宽度"(credal width,认知不确定性指标)归因到具体输入词元。通过Expected Gradients方法,框架能识别哪些输入token影响了模型对特定答案的认知不确定性,并在MedQA数据集上使用SmolLM3-3B和Llama-2-7B进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 不确定性估计仅能反映模型对预测的信心程度,但无法解释这种不确定性的来源——即输入中哪些部分导致了模型的不确定性。若不了解不确定性所依赖的输入特征,使用者无法判断该不确定性评分是否依赖于任务相关的特征,这在高风险领域(如医疗问答)中尤为关键。现有可解释性方法主要针对预测分数而非不确定性本身,且随机集分类器产生的信度宽度是一种特殊的不确定性表示,缺乏专门的解释工具。
AI.method: XU-RS框架包含三个核心组成部分:(1)基于预训练语言模型(LoRA适配)的随机集分类器,通过14个sigmoid输出估计答案集合的下概率,经修正后产生合法的信度宽度;(2)采用Expected Gradients(EG)特征归因方法,将原始输入与参考提示(其他问题及选项)的嵌入向量对齐,沿中间路径计算梯度,得到每个token对宽度差异的贡献;(3)两类诊断检查——参考提示准备检查(验证对齐操作是否改变了被解释的宽度差异)和数值准确性检查(通过完备性残差、余弦相似度等指标验证归因值是否准确反映宽度差)。此外,论文还推导了概率修正步骤(截断负值、重新归一化)对宽度梯度的影响,揭示了归一化会导致排除目标答案的集合间接影响其宽度。
AI.result: 在MedQA数据集100道测试题上,对SmolLM3-3B和Llama-2-7B的实验表明:(1)将XU-RS排名最高的token嵌入置零(zero-masking)所引起的绝对宽度变化显著大于随机置零(平均优势分别为0.0381和0.0450,95%置信区间均不含零);(2)概率修正(归一化)在95.84%-99.92%的测试样本中处于激活状态,意味着排除目标答案的集合通过共享分母影响其宽度;(3)在四个合成案例中,即使token排名高度稳定(中位Spearman相关0.9951),归因值的完备性残差仍超过容差(中位0.0652),通过FP32精度的Integrated Gradients加密积分点可显著降低残差;(4)参考提示的对齐操作会使宽度差异发生0.20-0.54的偏移,说明归因计算解释的差异可能与原始提示间的真实差异不同。
AI.conclusion: XU-RS为随机集分类器的认知不确定性提供了系统的token级归因框架,在MedQA上验证了其识别影响宽度token的有效性。论文通过概率修正分析揭示了被归因函数的真实结构,并通过受控实验明确区分了数值准确性与参考一致性两类独立问题,提出了一套诊断流程。该工作强调了在使用归因方法解释模型不确定性之前,必须分别验证参考提示的有效性和归因计算本身的数值准确性。局限性包括评估仅基于固定的100题MedQA样本、zero-masking修改的是嵌入而非文本,以及部分诊断检查在检查测试结果后才制定。

title: Flattening the Connectome Spectrum: A Spectral Filter for FC Induces a Pretraining Target for fMRI Encoders
summary: Self-supervised pretraining reshaped prediction in language and vision, and brain foundation models (BFMs) inherited its promise. Representations learned from large unlabelled corpora should capture individual functional dynamics and generalise across cohorts. However, kernel ridge regression (KRR) fitted on functional connectivity (FC) matrices still predicts individual phenotypes more accurately than any BFM we tested. In this paper, we show that KRR is weighted by the eigenvalues of the FC which are miscalibrated for phenotype prediction. We apply an efficient spectral filter to recalibrate the eigenvalues of each subject's FC matrix, enabling the model to exploit more inter-individual variance. Across the 5 datasets, 11 parcellations and 6 prediction targets we tested, we match or exceed the KRR baseline. Based on this finding, we then pretrain a small encoder model on about 4,000 hours of fMRI from 162 open datasets, whereby we align the pairwise similarities between the embeddings of recording snippets with those between the recalibrated connectomes. Our model performs on par with the best of the 6 published BFMs we tested while having an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Our encoder performs better than FC on short scans and in smaller cohorts, especially in fingerprinting. We release the pretrained model weights, the code and the pretraining data, preprocessed and parcellated.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种对功能连接(FC)矩阵的谱滤波方法(特征值取α*≈0.35次幂)，可显著改善基于FC的表型预测性能；并以此滤波后的连接组作为预训练目标，通过CKA(中心化核对齐)蒸馏损失训练了一个小型fMRI-BERT编码器，使其以少一个数量级的参数即可与现有脑基础模型(BFM)性能相当，并在短扫描和小队列场景下优于原始FC。
AI.motivation: 当前脑基础模型(BFM)在fMRI表型预测上仍逊于直接对FC做核岭回归(KRR)的简单线性基线。作者认为问题部分源于FC矩阵自身的特征值分布极度不均，导致回归权重集中于少量主成分而无法利用更多个体间差异，因此需要从改进FC表示入手，并以此构建更适合fMRI的预训练目标。
AI.method: (1) 对每个被试的Pearson FC矩阵做谱滤波 α*=0.35，将特征值取幂后重组矩阵，等价于在连接组特征空间施加低通均衡滤波器(压缩动态范围、保留模态顺序)；该变换无需组参考、无需跨被试参数估计。(2) 通过两种准则(嵌套交叉验证的KRR预测精度、训练折内的中心化核-目标对齐)确定α*。(3) 以滤波后的整段FC作为"教师"信号，训练fMRI-BERT Transformer编码器(学生仅看80个时间点窗口)，损失为学生与教师Gram矩阵之间的中心化核对齐(CKA)。预训练数据来自162个OpenNeuro公开数据集，约4000小时fMRI。
AI.result: 在5个数据集、11种图谱、6种预测目标上，FC^{α*}在所有条件下匹配或超过原始FC的KRR基线(如HCP-YA Schaefer-400认知综合得分从r=0.543提升至0.627)；参与度从10.1提升至218.9，表明更多模态参与贡献。预训练的fMRI-BERT(1M/8M)在大多数任务上与参数量大一个数量级的6个已发布BFM相当或更优，在短扫描(2.4分钟)和小队列(<250被试)条件下显著优于原始FC，尤其指纹识别能力突出(CoRR识别率从0.762提升至0.895)。
AI.conclusion: 对每个被试FC矩阵的特征值进行幂律校准(α*≈0.35)既能提升基于FC的表型预测性能，又可作为有效的预训练监督信号，使小型自监督编码器在短扫描和小样本场景下超越原始FC并与大规模脑基础模型竞争。该方法无需GPU、完全开源，对临床等难以获取长扫描/大样本的队列具有实用价值；但α*在HCP-YA上选定后被固定使用于所有任务，可能不是普适最优，预训练语料的异质性处理也存在局限。

title: Beyond a single latent space: a dual-latent world model for long-horizon planning
comment: 31 pages, 22 figures, 9 tables. Main text: 9 pages
summary: Latent world models often struggle with long-horizon planning despite accurate short-term predictions. Recursive rollouts accumulate errors, while distance concentration in high-dimensional latent spaces can weaken goal discrimination. We introduce the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates local execution and long-range planning through distinct state representations and dynamics models. The low-level model predicts action-conditioned transitions, while the high-level model uses learned macro-actions to plan over longer temporal spans. We also propose Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe), which supervises self-generated predictions at both levels. An analysis of recursive error propagation motivates exponential horizon weights with separate decay rates for the two temporal scales. During planning, the high-level model generates latent subgoals that the low-level model refines into actions for precise execution. We evaluate from-scratch Dual-WM on five goal-conditioned visual control tasks against the task-wise strongest baselines without actor-guided proposals. At goal offsets of 50 and 100 environment steps, mean success increases from 75.9% to 84.4% and from 61.4% to 69.5%, respectively. At offset 100, Dual-WM outperforms these baselines on all five tasks and improves mean success over LeWM by 30.8 percentage points. Ablations and supporting analyses provide evidence of more informative representations for goal evaluation and greater consistency under recursive prediction. These results highlight the value of separating temporal roles and training across multiple horizons for reliable latent planning. Our core implementation is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM)，通过分离低层（原始动作）与高层（宏动作）的状态表示和动力学模型来解决长时程规划中的递归预测漂移和潜在空间距离退化问题；结合LoRe（带指数衰减权重监督自生成rollout的训练机制）和MAPS（宏动作先验整形），在五个视觉控制任务上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 单潜在空间的世界模型在长时程规划中存在两个失败模式：(1) 局部准确的转移模型在递归展开时漂移；(2) 高维潜在空间中范数等距感化（distance concentration）使得远距离状态间的目标距离难以区分，导致候选未来难以排序。这两个问题源于同一状态几何同时承担精细执行和远距离目标评估两种时间角色。
AI.method: 1) 双潜在空间架构：低层编码器+Transformer预测器处理原始动作的逐步转移；高层编码器将长度为k的低层潜窗口映射到独立高层表示，配备宏动作预测器和宏动作编码器。2) LoRe：对自生成的多步rollout进行监督，使用指数衰减权重 w_h ∝ exp(-α_s·h)，低层和高层有各自独立的衰减率α_L和α_H，动机来自递归误差传播分析 e_h ≤ ε·S_h(L)。3) MAPS：用KL散度将宏动作后验正则化为标准高斯先验，便于基于CEM的采样搜索。4) 三阶段粗到细规划：Stage 1用CEM在高层潜空间规划宏动作序列产生子目标；Stage 2将低层动作的潜窗口通过E_H映射到高层空间与子目标匹配；Stage 3切换到低层直接目标收敛。
AI.result: 在TwoRoom、Reacher、Sokoban-Long、PushT、Cube-Single五个视觉控制任务上进行从零训练评估：目标偏移50步时平均成功率从基线75.9%提升到84.4%；100步时从61.4%提升到69.5%；100步偏移下在全部五个任务上均优于最强基线，平均比LeWM高30.8个百分点。消融实验证实：双尺度LoRe比单步监督在100步偏移上将成功率从48%提升到92%；窗口拼接接口的成功率仅41%，而学习的E_H接口达93%；MAPS将成功率从67%（确定性编码）提升到93.5%。表征诊断显示高层表示保留远程目标区分能力（TwoRoom和Reacher上Spearman秩相关显著优于低层和LeWM），rollout训练的检查点在递归预测中保留更多物理状态信息。
AI.conclusion: 长时程潜在规划需要可靠的递归预测和能区分远距离进度的目标距离，而这两者不能由单一潜在空间的几何结构同时承担。Dual-WM通过时间角色分离的表示、双尺度衰减权重监督（LoRe）和面向搜索的宏动作先验（MAPS）实现可靠的长时程规划。Sokoban-Long上的离散动作结果验证了该框架对动作空间的普适性。未来方向包括自适应时间跨度和离线设定之外的评估。

title: EnterpriseBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise-Level Strategic Reasoning and Decision-Making
summary: LLM agents are increasingly expected to support enterprise workflows, where tasks often involve missing information, uncertainty, feedback, and long-term trade-offs. However, existing enterprise and financial benchmarks mainly test static capabilities such as information extraction, numerical calculation, domain knowledge, and financial QA, leaving interactive and long-horizon decision-making underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnterpriseBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLM agents across this spectrum, from static question answering to dynamic decision-making. Specifically, EnterpriseBench reorganizes existing enterprise and financial QA datasets into a unified foundational suite annotated by capability and difficulty, and introduces three professional interactive settings: Consulting, based on management-consulting-style business cases for client problem diagnosis through multi-turn information seeking; the Beer Game, adapted from a classic supply-chain management simulation for inventory control under delayed feedback; and Enterprise Digital Twin, a project-based business simulator for workforce, risk, and project planning. Experiments with nine agent methods under four backbone models show that current agents have not yet achieved stable, comprehensive, and cross-task reliability in enterprise scenarios. These results show that EnterpriseBench provides a practical benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in realistic enterprise strategic reasoning and decision-making.

AI.tldr: EnterpriseBench是一个用于评估LLM智能体在企业级战略推理与决策任务中的两层基准测试，结合了基础企业/金融问答和三个交互式决策场景（管理咨询面试、Beer Game供应链模拟、企业数字孪生）。通过九个智能体方法和四个基座模型的广泛实验，发现当前智能体在企业场景中尚未实现稳定、全面、跨任务的可靠性，且静态QA性能无法可靠预测交互式决策表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的企业/金融基准测试主要评估静态能力（如信息提取、数值计算、领域知识和金融问答），而对企业实际工作流中常见的信息缺失、不确定性、延迟反馈和长期权衡等交互式、长周期决策能力评估不足。论文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: EnterpriseBench采用两层评估设计：(1)基础层——整合现有企业/金融QA数据集，按能力类别（信息提取、数值计算、领域知识、复杂推理）和难度（0-10分）统一标注；(2)交互式决策层——引入三个专业任务：①Consulting（基于MBA咨询案例的多轮隐藏信息业务诊断面试，由LLM面试官与受测智能体交互，LLM裁判沿四个维度评估）；②Beer Game（四级供应链库存控制，智能体控制零售商，25步决策，以总成本衡量）；③Enterprise Digital Twin/EDT（基于BPTK的项目型企业仿真，智能体一次性输出人员规模、风险等级和项目组合方案，以累计收益衡量）。评估9种智能体方法（CoT、Self-Refine、Reflexion、AMEM、Debate、Discussion、DC、GEPA、ACE）在4种基座模型（DeepSeek-V3、GPT-4.1、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.2）上的表现，并通过人工审计、提示稳健性测试和难度标注可靠性验证评估协议的有效性。此外提出AOA（自适应智能体选择）方法作为概念验证。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1)基础层显示明显的难度效应——数值计算和领域知识从简单到困难任务性能急剧下降；(2)交互式任务揭示了与静态QA不同的评估信号——静态QA表现好的方法不一定是Consulting、Beer Game或EDT的最佳方法，且最佳方法因任务和基座模型而异（无单一方法持续最优）；(3)可靠性验证方面：Consulting的LLM裁判与人类评分在500条转录上达到Pearson r=0.887，ICC(2,3)=0.892，85%评分在1分以内一致；提示稳健性测试最大偏差仅0.12分；难度标注与人类评分Pearson r=0.96；(4)AOA概念验证方法将整体QA得分从0.725提升至0.729，超过最佳固定方法。实验表明当前智能体尚未在企业场景中实现稳定、全面、跨任务的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: EnterpriseBench提供了一个从基础企业推理到交互式决策的完整评估框架，通过广泛的实验证明了静态QA性能无法可靠预测交互式决策能力，当前LLM智能体在企业战略推理与决策中仍面临重大挑战。该基准具有经验可靠性支撑，为评估智能体在真实企业场景中的能力与局限提供了实用工具。然而，论文也指出了局限性：交互任务在受控环境下进行、不涵盖多模态证据、未覆盖所有行业和组织规模、不应被解释为LLM智能体已准备好在高风险商业决策中自主部署的证据。

title: MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators
summary: MeanFlow enables efficient few-step generation by predicting interval-average velocities, but this representation creates a mismatch for reward fine-tuning: existing advantage-based objectives are typically defined on instantaneous velocities or equivalent $x_0$-space predictions, whereas inference directly uses the learned average-velocity map. We introduce MeanFlowAdvantage, a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective for average-velocity generators. Our key construction uses a shared, detached MeanFlow derivative correction to express the reward objective in prediction space while making rollout and reference regularization exact penalties on the average-velocity network deployed at inference. The resulting formulation preserves MeanFlow's native few-step sampler and provides a direct mechanism for transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map. On SD3.5-Medium, MeanFlowAdvantage improves all eight reported metrics over the matched four-step MeanFlowNFT baseline and, with only four NFEs, matches or exceeds the 40-step DiffusionNFT baseline on six of eight metrics. The same objective also transfers to DNA promoter design, where it supports both teacher-free on-policy RL for a generator defined on a manifold and teacher-guided reward-graded distillation, with the latter yielding the lowest one-step Sei profile MSE among the compared configurations.

AI.tldr: MeanFlowAdvantage（MFA）是一种针对平均速度生成器（如MeanFlow）的带符号优势加权最小二乘目标函数，通过共享的分离式MeanFlow导数修正项，将奖励微调对齐到推理时实际部署的有限区间平均速度流映射上。在SD3.5-Medium上仅用4步NFE即匹配或超越40步DiffusionNFT，并在DNA启动子设计上同时支持无教师在线策略RL和教师引导的奖励分级蒸馏。
AI.motivation: MeanFlow通过预测区间平均速度实现少步生成，但现有的基于优势的奖励微调目标（如DiffusionNFT、AdvantageFlow）针对瞬时速度或x₀空间预测设计，与推理时直接使用的平均速度图存在表征不匹配问题。需要一种能直接优化部署流映射、保持少步采样能力的奖励微调方法。
AI.method: 1. 核心构造：使用一个共享的、分离梯度的MeanFlow导数修正项d（通过JVP精确计算或有限差分估计），从滚动网络u_old推导出瞬时速度表示V_k = u_k + (t-s)·sg[d]和x₀空间预测F_k = x_t - t·V_k。2. 目标函数：将AdvantageFlow的二次损失应用于F空间。由于共享修正项在两两差中自动消去，损失严格等价于平均速度空间的带优势加权MeanFlow回归：ℓ_θ = t²(A‖u_θ - ū‖² + γ‖u_θ - u_old‖² + λ‖u_θ - u_ref‖²)。3. 间隔采样：混合边界（s=t, 50%）、全跳（s=0, 25%）和一般正长度间隔（25%）。4. 理论分析：证明目标在总体层面等价于拟合重加权分布q ∝ (γ+A)π_old的MeanFlow目标，更新方向由优势与目标间的协方差决定。5. 应用扩展：同一目标用于奖励分步引导的蒸馏，教师提供回程尾部m_k，目标替换b上的extrapolation。
AI.result: 在SD3.5-Medium（4步NFE）：MFA在全部8项指标上均优于匹配的MeanFlowNFT基线，其中美学分数提升+0.37、HPSv3提升+0.26；在仅4 NFE下即在6/8指标上匹配或超越40步DiffusionNFT。在DNA启动子设计上：无教师RL将Sei MSE从0.0714降至0.0482（3种子平均）；奖励分步蒸馏中MFA达到0.0467 Sei MSE，较MeanFlowNFT（0.0570）相对降低18%，4种子重复实验均保持优势（平均19.7%），联合bootstrap CI为[0.0091, 0.0138]。消融实验验证了修正项、正长度间隔和签名优势均为必要组件。
AI.conclusion: MFA成功将奖励微调对齐到MeanFlow的有限区间平均速度表征，通过共享导数修正保证了优化目标与部署流映射的等价性。理论上证明其拟合重加权分布的MeanFlow目标，且自洽不动点可产生跨采样预算迁移的精确流映射。该方法同时统一了在线策略RL和奖励分级蒸馏两种范式，在图像和生物学序列两种分子语言生成任务上均表现优异。开放问题包括近似流映射一致性、蒸馏中原则化的负优势设计以及序列保真度的三种子趋势。

title: KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora
comment: Technical Report. Official website: this https URL Report homepage: this https URL
summary: Experienced professionals know more than just facts and conclusions. They know which cues matter, why a judgment is reasonable, and which action to take. Routine work records often leave out this tacit knowledge, making it difficult for Large Language Model (LLM) agents to use professional experience effectively. We introduce KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns heterogeneous work records and practitioner interviews into traceable, reusable experience corpora for agents. Six case elements preserve the task process: context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, and outcomes. Nine-layer cognitive corpus construction organizes tacit experience along nine extraction dimensions and stores the resulting assets in six libraries: rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. Semantic alignment, individual experience distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review preserve source evidence, conditions of use, and unresolved disagreements. The platform packages these assets into callable skills with explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions, connecting experience collection to task execution and evaluation feedback. Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual experience records and 13,113 organizational assets. The evaluation spans multiple professional domains. Under common task inputs and scoring criteria, the base model, raw corpus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58, respectively. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG in all seven scoring dimensions. The platform provides a practical path from individual tacit experience to organizational knowledge and agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: KUPAS MASTER 是一个"经验工程"平台，通过九层认知语料构建，将从业者的隐性专业知识（如线索判断、行动依据、边界条件）从异构工作记录中提炼为可追溯、可调用的结构化经验库与技能，使 LLM 智能体在专业任务上的表现显著优于原始语料检索增强生成（RAG）。
AI.motivation: 常规工作记录往往遗漏从业者的隐性知识（哪些线索关键、判断为何合理、适用条件与边界是什么），导致 LLM 智能体难以有效利用专业经验。论文旨在弥合个体隐性经验与组织可复用智能体能力之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 核心方法为"九层认知语料构建"，包含：（1）六要素案例表示（context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, outcomes）；（2）九层提取维度（L1知识–L9约束）；（3）六类经验资产库（规则、约束、最佳实践、负面案例、角落案例、技能）；（4）四阶段流程——语义对齐、个体经验提炼、组织整合、交叉评审；（5）将资产打包为带显式输入、步骤、依赖与停止条件的可调用技能，集成至智能体并连接评估反馈。
AI.result: 基于 20 位随机授权从业者的样本，处理 1,576 个源文件，生成 23,024 条个体经验记录和 13,113 条组织资产。177 题/531 回答的评估显示：基座模型（A）、原始语料 RAG（B）、KUPAS MASTER 智能体（C）综合得分分别为 70.63、79.75、89.58；C 在所有七个评分维度上均优于 B，证据充分性与准确性提升 11.1 分，边界与合规性提升 9.0 分；胜出率 176/177 题。代价是平均延迟从 A 的 16.2 s、B 的 34.0 s 升至 C 的 57.1 s。
AI.conclusion: 将从业者隐性经验通过结构化提炼、组织整合与技能封装转化为可追溯、可复用的智能体能力，相比原始语料 RAG 带来显著且稳定的性能提升，为个体隐性经验向组织知识资产转化提供了可行路径。

title: Learning from Shared-Control Overrides: Context-Driven Acceleration Profile Prediction for Personalized Overtaking
summary: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) systems are typically calibrated for an average driver, often resulting in a mismatch between vehicle behavior and individual expectations during time-critical maneuvers such as highway overtaking. When the ACC is perceived as too conservative and inconsistent, drivers intervene through throttle overrides, providing implicit feedback on the system's behavior. This paper reframes these override actions as human-in-theloop supervisory signals and proposes a data-driven framework for personalized vehicle adaptation, termed Context-driven Personalized ACC (CoP-ACC). Rather than relying solely on end-to-end regression, which tends to over-smooth dynamic responses, we introduce a hybrid pipeline combining: (i) unsupervised hierarchical clustering to extract representative acceleration profiles from override events; (ii) a context classifier that maps pre-maneuver driving conditions to the appropriate profile; and (iii) a residual regressor that refines the selected profile into a smooth, personalized acceleration profile tailored to the immediate context. Evaluated on real-world public-road data against a withheld forced-ACC baseline, the approach demonstrates high reconstruction fidelity and generates acceleration profiles that tend toward the driver's expected behavior in potential override contexts. The results highlight the potential of learning from shared-control overrides to enable anticipatory, personalized ACC behavior, reducing manual interventions and improving ride comfort.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoP-ACC框架，将驾驶员对ACC系统的油门覆盖行为视为人在回路监督信号，通过无监督层次聚类提取代表性加速度曲线，并结合上下文分类器与残差回归器，实现自适应巡航控制的个性化定制。
AI.motivation: 传统ACC系统通常基于平均驾驶员标定，在超车等关键场景中难以匹配个体驾驶期望，导致驾驶员频繁通过油门覆盖进行手动干预。现有端到端回归方法会过度平滑动态响应，无法准确捕捉驾驶员的个性化偏好。
AI.method: 提出混合流水线CoP-ACC：(i)利用无监督层次聚类从油门覆盖事件中提取代表性加速度曲线；(ii)训练上下文分类器，将操纵前的驾驶条件映射到对应曲线；(iii)使用残差回归器在选定曲线基础上进行细化，生成平滑且个性化的加速度曲线。
AI.result: 在真实公共道路数据上，以保留的强制ACC基线进行评估，方法在重建保真度方面表现优异，并能生成趋向于驾驶员在潜在覆盖场景下期望行为的加速度曲线。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，从共享控制中的油门覆盖行为中学习，可实现具有前瞻性的个性化ACC行为，有助于减少驾驶员手动干预并提升乘坐舒适性。

title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
summary: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, but reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach, as engineering workflows demand reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and dependencies preserved across software and design stages.
