AI.motivation: PE-PINN虽然通过架构层面嵌入波动物理（解析核×可学习包络）解决了标准PINN在高振荡波场中的频谱偏置问题，但其核字典必须手工构造且数量随基本单元数线性增长qN，对于层次化结构系统（如天线阵列、超表面）随深度呈指数膨胀，构成"核可扩展性瓶颈"。同时，现有PINN在标准制造解（manufactured solution）基准上的优异表现难以迁移到含奇异源、吸收边界和数十波长的真实辐射问题。
AI.method: 提出"学习—冻结—复用"层次框架：(1)在层级ℓ用PE-PINN训练子系统C^(ℓ)；(2)收敛后冻结参数，将所得场ŷ_z^(ℓ)直接升格为复合型演化核K^(ℓ)=ŷ_z^(ℓ;Θ*^(ℓ))；(3)利用Helmholtz算子在均匀介质中的平移不变性，在层级ℓ+1将I_ℓ个平移/旋转副本K_m^(ℓ)(x)=K^(ℓ)(x−Δc_m^(ℓ))作为固定核构建超位置场，仅学习平滑包络A_m^(ℓ+1)和门控w_m；(4)PDE残差在每一级全域重新计算以保证物理一致性。核复用通过门控函数限制有效区域。理论分析表明活动核峰值max(q, max I_ℓ)与系统规模N无关，累计核数从qN降至q+IL=q+I·log_I N_L。
AI.result: 偶极子阵列（2×2→…→16×16）：PE-EK-PINN每级保持4个活动核，阶段训练时间稳定在26.9–29.6分钟（2×2到16×16），16×16（256偶极子）累积仅2h10m；直接PE-PINN外推需71h，加速>30×；L2误差从PE-PINN的2.22×10⁻²（4×4）降至1.62×10⁻²。复合线源几何：十字构型从3h13m降至16m（11.7×加速），L2误差从1.33×10⁻¹降至3.34×10⁻²；五角星构型（5个活动核）仅需39m阶段训练即可生成，无PE-PINN基线（需50核）。交叉阵列（0.5λ线→十字→2×2→4×4）：阶段时间稳定在~32分钟，2×2阶段7.72×加速、累积2.69×加速；L2误差从9.33×10⁻²降至4.18×10⁻²（单十字），从1.01×10⁻¹降至5.07×10⁻²（2×2）。在2.4GHz偶极子辐射基准上，CoPINN误差从5.0×10⁻³（制造解）退化至9.95×10⁻¹（偶极子），验证制造解基准的局限性。
AI.conclusion: PE-EK-PINN通过将学到的子系统场作为可重用物理核引入Helmholtz求解的层次化构造，证实了核数量与系统规模解耦及O(log N)训练扩展性。该方法在偶极子阵列、复合线源和交叉阵列上同时提升了训练效率和重建精度，为天线阵列、超表面等大规模结构化波问题提供了可扩展的物理信息建模路径。局限包括：(1)演化核为近似解，误差沿层次累积，深层级（如16×16偶极子L2达9.43×10⁻²）需高精度基础核；(2)MLP表示的核仅在训练坐标范围内可靠，旋转/平移至域外会产生外推误差；(3)依赖已知层次结构，对无重复子结构的构型压缩有限；(4)与神经算子互补——未来可将其解作为神经算子训练数据或将核分解策略扩展至算子架构。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation
summary: An agent skill is a reusable, actionable natural-language artifact that guides an agent to perform a task effectively under a given harness. Recent studies have explored the optimization of agent skills, contributing to a growing collection of publicly available skills spanning diverse tasks, domains, and harnesses. Despite millions of publicly shared skills, existing skill optimization methods largely overlook this accumulated knowledge, instead relying solely on expensive agent rollouts to iteratively refine skills for a target task. To address this, we propose \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization (RASO)}, a framework that leverages an external skill corpus as prior knowledge throughout skill optimization. RASO retrieves relevant knowledge from existing skills and adapts it to the target task and harness via Cross-Harness Adaptation, accounting for mismatches in both domain and harness. RASO comprises two complementary stages: \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Initialization (RASI)} constructs a knowledge-grounded initial skill without requiring agent rollouts, while \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Update (RASU)} iteratively refines the skill by retrieving external knowledge guided by execution feedback. Across four agent benchmarks and two models, extensive experiments show that RASO consistently outperforms baselines without retrieval-augmented skill initialization and updating.

AI.tldr: 提出RASO框架，通过外部技能语料库检索先验知识并经跨Harness适配，在RASI（无rollout初始化）和RASU（基于执行反馈的迭代更新）两阶段优化LLM Agent技能，在4个基准和2个模型上一致超越TextGrad、GEPA、SkillOpt、WikiSkill等基线。
AI.motivation: 现有技能优化方法仅依赖目标任务的昂贵agent rollout进行迭代精化，完全忽视了社区已积累的海量公开技能知识；同时，简单检索复用的技能往往来自不同domain与harness，存在严重的领域与执行环境不匹配问题。
AI.method: 1) 节级BM25检索：将外部技能语料按标题切片进行细粒度检索；2) Cross-Harness Adaptation：适配Agent去除源域特定名词，仅保留与目标harness匹配的对象、命令和单位，生成可执行lesson；3) RASI：从任务与harness描述生成需求-查询对，经检索-适配合成无rollout的初始skill；4) RASU：对失败轨迹生成textual gradient与查询，检索并适配外部知识，由验证集择优迭代更新skill。
AI.result: 在OfficeQA、SpreadsheetBench、ALFWorld、WebShop四个基准及GPT-5.6-Luna、Qwen-3.5-9B两个模型上：RASI零rollout即超RFSI与SkillRouter；RASO最终性能均超TextGrad/GEPA/SkillOpt/WikiSkill（GPT-5.6-Luna下OfficeQA +3.49、Spreadsheet +6.31等）；消融显示两阶段互补；Cross-Harness Adaptation在初始化与更新阶段均贡献显著正向；检索段落数K=5最优；同等rollout预算下API成本最低。
AI.conclusion: RASO证明将外部技能语料作为先验贯穿初始化与更新全流程，并通过跨harness适配弥合源-目标领域与环境差异，能够更高效、更低成本地获得强Agent技能，为利用社区规模级过程性知识提供了通用范式。

title: UserProxyBench: Evaluating LLM User Simulators for Agent Benchmarks and Training
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks Workshop (AABA4ET) at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Interactive agent benchmarks and multi-turn reinforcement learning increasingly place a second language model in the role of the user. This simulated user controls what information the agent receives and when, yet current benchmarks score only the agent and do not directly measure whether the user correctly executed its assigned role. We introduce UserProxyBench, an evaluation layer over the tau-bench family, and the User Fidelity Score (UFS), which measures adherence to the benchmark's private user instructions using task-grounded rubric criteria scored independently of agent success. Holding the agent fixed at GPT-5.5 and varying only the user proxy across 375 enterprise tasks changes mean task reward by 15.2 points, while 24.4% of successful episodes contain a user-specification violation. The dominant failure is premature disclosure: users provide information before it is requested. This behavior has little effect on task reward, yet among successful episodes it causes the agent to make 1.06 fewer tool calls on average, changing the interaction being evaluated while preserving the reward. Finally, across seven proxies we identify an empirical cost-fidelity frontier, enabling practitioners to select the least expensive simulator that satisfies a required fidelity level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UserProxyBench——一个基于 τ-bench 系列的评估层，用于衡量 LLM 用户模拟器是否正确执行其被分配的角色，并引入 User Fidelity Score (UFS) 作为独立于代理成功率的合约遵守度量指标。核心发现：固定 GPT-5.5 作为代理，仅更换用户模拟器，375 个企业任务上的平均任务奖励变化达 15.2 点；24.4% 的成功回合存在用户规约违反；主要失败模式为"过早披露"（在代理请求前主动提供信息），此类失败对任务奖励几乎无影响但改变了被评估的交互本身。文章还识别了七个代理之间的成本-保真度前沿，为实践者提供了在满足所需保真度的前提下选择最便宜模拟器的方法。
AI.motivation: 在交互式智能体基准测试（如 τ-bench、τ²-bench）和多轮强化学习（如 MUA-RL）中，第二个语言模型扮演用户角色。该模拟用户控制代理接收的信息及其时机，但现有基准仅评估代理本身，不直接衡量用户是否正确执行了其被分配的角色。这造成了一个易被忽视的实验依赖：若用户代理泄露信息、虚构状态或提前终止，即使任务奖励不变，代理也不再解决预期的交互。论文旨在回答"给定的代理是否正确执行了基准自身声明的用户规约"这一互补性问题，并称之为"功能性保真度"。
AI.method: 方法围绕 UserProxyBench（覆盖 τ-bench 任务的评估层）和 User Fidelity Score (UFS) 构建。UFS 定义为所有适用评分标准均通过的回合占比。每任务的私有用户蓝图生成 4–8 条原子评分标准（共 2,141 条，涵盖四个域：Telecom、Airline、Retail、Banking），分为 groundedness、premature disclosure、goal deviation、missed information 四类。标准由 Claude Opus 4.8 生成，由 GPT-5.6-Sol 独立验证，代理盲化评分。实验固定 GPT-5.5 为代理，在七个用户代理（Sonnet-4-6、Gemini-3.5-Flash、Qwen3.6-35B、Gemma-31B、Gemma-26B、GPT-5.4-mini、GPT-4.1-mini）上评估 375 个企业任务，各一次 rollout。额外使用无评判的 Telecom 探针（对比实际用户工具调用与金标准写入）作为独立诊断。最后通过成本-保真度前沿公式 U*(q) = argmin C(U) s.t. UFS(U) ≥ q 选择最便宜的合格代理。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：1) 用户代理选择显著改变基准结果——固定 GPT-5.5，平均 Rτ 从 .644 至 .796 不等，Retail 域差距达 .298；2) 任务奖励无法筛选用户代理——24.4% 的代理成功回合 UFS 失败，Telecom 上 39.7% 的回合为 Rτ 通过但 UFS 失败；3) 任务奖励对主要失败模式（过早披露，480 次）几乎无感，平均仅改变代理通过率 −.043，而罕见的目标偏离（134 次）则使通过率降低 .515；4) 在成功回合中，过度披露用户导致代理平均少执行 1.06 次工具调用、少提 0.26 个问题，平均代理回合数与 UFS 相关性 r=.955，与 Rτ 仅 r=.594；5) 成本-保真度前沿显示：q=.84 时 Gemma-31B 为最便宜合格代理（约 $0.0175/模拟），q=.86 时转为 Gemini-3.5-Flash，q=.75 时 GPT-4.1-mini 更便宜；三个代理被严格支配。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出三个结论：1) UserProxyBench 作为 τ-bench 之上的评估层，可独立于代理成功率评分用户模拟器；2) 任务奖励不能取代用户保真度——近四分之一的成功轨迹存在用户合约违反，最常见的失败对奖励几乎不可见；3) 用户代理选择应被视为显式的操作性权衡，使用 UFS 作为可靠性约束，在给定评估或训练管道下最小化用户侧推理成本。论文强调 UFS 衡量合约遵守而非人类真实感，二者互补；并指出限制包括生成器与评判器为同一模型、单次 rollout、时间相关的服务价格、未测量下游训练效果等。

title: Probability is Not Enough: Exploring and Counting Divergent Tokens for Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
comment: 25 pages, 16 figures, 8 tables. Under peer review
summary: As the chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities of large language models improve, evaluating and calibrating their reasoning confidence is becoming increasingly important for quantifying the uncertainty of their answers. Current methods for estimating the confidence of large language models are generally based on probabilities of selected key tokens, but the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Our pilot study finds that replacing selected token probabilities with coarse substitutes can also improve calibration, motivating us to further explore effective signals of model confidence. We introduce Divergent Token Confidence (DTC), a framework that estimates confidence by counting tokens at which two models strongly disagree during decoding. DTC identifies these divergent tokens using the Jensen-Shannon divergence between next-token distributions evaluated along the same reasoning trajectory. We find that their count is almost negatively associated with answer accuracy, thereby serving as a simple yet effective signal for uncertainty quantification. DTC supports both white-box and black-box evaluation using auxiliary models, without explicit training and affecting the generation process. Experiments across multiple model families and six mathematical benchmarks demonstrate improved calibration over probability-based and verbalized baselines. Under white-box evaluation, the count-only estimator achieves an average expected calibration error of 13.0%, compared with 32.7%-42.4% for standard full-sequence confidence methods. In black-box settings, it also improves calibration over the original verbalized scores. For example, mean expected calibration error falls from 32.1%-40.2% to 13.7%-16.3% on DeepSeek-V3.2. These findings provide new insights for improving reasoning uncertainty quantification in large language models. The code is released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出DTC框架，通过计算两个模型在解码过程中强烈分歧的token数量来量化大语言模型推理的不确定性，无需训练且支持白盒与黑盒评估。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理置信度估计方法多基于token概率，但其有效性机制不清；预实验发现替换token概率为粗粒度替代品仍能改善校准，暗示被选token的数量本身可能是校准增益的关键信号。
AI.method: 1）预实验：对UQAC方法，将选中token的概率替换为轨迹均值概率或全局常数，发现仅依靠选中token数量即可获得校准增益；2）提出DTC框架，使用两个模型的next-token分布之间的Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）识别分歧token（JS D超过阈值θ），统计其数量m；3）DTC_lin直接将m映射为置信度（线性递减至饱和），DTC_prod将m与轨迹平均概率C_mean结合（C_mean^(m+k)）；4）支持单辅助（白盒）和双辅助（黑盒）设置。
AI.result: 在6个数学基准、3个模型家族（Qwen2.5、Qwen3、Gemma3）的白盒实验中，DTC_lin平均ECE为13.0%，远优于标准全序列置信度方法（32.7%-42.4%）。在黑盒设置（DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3等）中，DTC_lin将DeepSeek-V3.2的verbalized置信度平均ECE从32.1%-40.2%降至13.7%-16.3%。DTC_prod在保持低ECE的同时获得更高的AUROC。将其应用于verbalized分数可进一步降低过度自信（ECE降低12.3-35.9个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: DTC通过计数分歧token提供了一种简单有效的推理不确定性量化方法，证明token数量本身是关键的校准信号，无需特定概率值；该方法在白盒和黑盒场景下均显著优于基于概率和verbalized的基线，并能降低verbalized分数的过度自信，为LLM推理不确定性量化提供了新视角。

title: Character Training for Risk-Averse Agents
summary: Risk aversion in resources could prevent misaligned AI agents from causing catastrophic harm. Misaligned but risk-averse agents would tend to favor safer strategies like making deals with humans over riskier strategies like rebelling. We train agents to be risk averse through character training, finding that persona traits provide a robust mechanism for instilling risk preferences. To do this, we construct a model constitution describing constant absolute risk aversion (CARA) over an agent's resources and instill it through on-policy distillation. Despite never seeing the benchmark's decision format during training, character-trained models are competitive with baselines trained directly on it, and generalise better than them out of distribution on two of our four models. We also modulate different aspects of the constitution, finding that token budget and model choice are the most influential aspect of character training to instill risk aversion. We conclude from these results that character training is a promising and scalable way to instil broad dispositions, which we can use to our advantage in mitigating risk from misaligned AI agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种"性格训练"(character training)方法，通过自然语言"宪法"(constitution)描述智能体的恒定绝对风险厌恶(CARA)偏好，并利用在线策略蒸馏(on-policy distillation)将其灌输给大语言模型，以使未来可能失调的AI更倾向于与人类合作而非叛乱。该方法在风险偏好评估上与直接在基准上训练的基线方法表现相当，并在分布外泛化方面更优。
AI.motivation: 动机源于AI安全领域的一个核心问题：如果未来高度智能的AI与人类目标不一致(失调)，其风险中性的资源偏好将使人类无法通过支付报酬来避免其叛乱行为。但如果AI具有足够的风险厌恶特征，人类就可以用较小的成本与之达成合作交易。因此，研究如何可靠地将风险厌恶偏好灌输给语言模型，对于实现Thornley和MacAskill提出的"与AI做交易"的安全方案至关重要。
AI.method: 方法核心是构建一份自然语言"宪法"，以第一人称声明的方式描述模型的CARA(恒定绝对风险厌恶，系数α=0.01)身份特征，采用因子设计(factorial design)在示例数量(0/2/4)、陈述风格(陈述式/程序式)和效用曲线追踪(是/否)三个维度上变化，共生成12种宪法变体。训练方法采用在线策略宪法蒸馏：冻结的教师模型(带宪法的系统提示)对同一模型的LoRA学生进行指导，通过反向KL散度损失(评分函数梯度)将教师信号蒸馏到学生中，仅更新LoRA适配器而不修改基础权重。实验在Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.8-27B、Gemma-4-12B和Gemma-4-31B四种模型上进行，每种宪法训练500步。同时对比了SFT、DPO和tie-training三种基线方法。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 性格训练能够有效诱导风险厌恶，在核心赌注评估上与基线方法相当，但在结构性消融(改变决策呈现方式)上表现更优，Qwen模型上最佳学生平均得分0.90-0.95，远超基线的0.46-0.57；(2) 宪法蒸馏效果存在显著的模型家族差异：Gemma模型比Qwen模型更容易接受性格蒸馏，Qwen模型虽基线较高但很快进入平台期，Gemma则需要约2M训练token后才有显著提升；(3) 在宪法设计因素中，token预算和模型选择是最具影响力的因素，陈述式(declarative)措辞优于程序式(procedural)，而增加具体示例数量或追踪效用曲线并非稳定有益；(4) 风险厌恶训练带来了一些安全相关的副作用：所有四个模型的"短视奖励偏好"(myopic reward preference)均一致增加；能力(MMLU、GPQA)和概念推理基准基本保持不变，决策理论倾向略微偏向因果决策理论。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论认为，性格训练是一种有前景且可扩展的方法，用于在语言模型中灌输稳健的偏好特征，使其在面对陌生情境时能够泛化。token预算是影响性格训练效果的最关键因素，远超宪法具体内容的影响。然而，该方法并非完美隔离的干预——它会在相邻的安全相关行为上产生选择性副作用，特别是短视奖励偏好的增加。因此，在将风险厌恶训练部署为安全措施之前，需要仔细设计和审计宪法内容，并理解这些偏好的耦合关系。论文也指出了需要进一步研究的方向，包括不同模型家族和规模的可推广性、其他形式的风险厌恶、以及训练token预算的进一步扩展。

title: NeuronEye: Query-Guided Visual Concept Activation for Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Current vision-language models (VLMs) encode visual information in dense hidden states where object identity, spatial layout, and local attributes are implicitly entangled rather than explicitly disentangled, limiting their ability to isolate and modulate the specific visual evidence required by a given language query. Inspired by sparse population coding and top-down modulation in biological vision, we introduce NeuronEye, a plug-in framework that constructs a sparse, concept-level neuron vocabulary from intermediate VLM representations and selectively activates query-relevant visual concepts during inference. NeuronEye decomposes vision-token states into an overcomplete sparse basis organized by concept-level clusters, uses the language query to activate relevant clusters and localize the patches where selected concepts are expressed, and injects the focused evidence back into vision tokens. A complementary suppression mechanism attenuates dominant perceptual directions to preserve weaker but relevant cues. All operations run in a single forward pass over a frozen VLM backbone. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, NeuronEye raises CV-Bench overall accuracy by +3.1 with gains of +9.5 on Distance, and improves BLINK Multi-view by +8.3, with similar trends on LLaVA-1.6-7B. These results suggest that sparse neuron vocabularies can serve not only as post-hoc interpretability tools but also as active interfaces for concept-level visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: NeuronEye是一个即插即用的框架，通过稀疏自编码器将视觉-语言模型（VLM）的密集视觉表示分解为稀疏的概念级神经元词汇表，并利用语言查询在推理过程中选择性激活相关视觉概念，提升VLM在空间和关系推理任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉-语言模型（VLM）将视觉信息编码在纠缠的密集隐藏状态中，无法有效隔离和调制查询所需的特定视觉证据，限制了结构化视觉推理能力。生物视觉系统通过稀疏群体编码和自上而下的注意力调制解决了这一问题，这启发了作者设计概念级选择性调制框架。
AI.method: NeuronEye包含三个核心组件：(1) 稀疏神经元空间（SNS）：使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将视觉token状态分解为过完备稀疏基，并将其组织为概念级聚类，形成可寻址的视觉概念词汇表；(2) 神经元引导的视觉聚焦（NVF）：使用语言查询激活相关神经元聚类，定位表达所选概念的patch，并通过局部交叉注意力将聚焦证据注入视觉token；(3) 感知概念抑制（PCS）：在后续层中衰减主导感知方向，保留较弱但相关的线索。整个过程在冻结VLM骨干网络的单次前向传播中完成。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，NeuronEye将CV-Bench总体准确率从78.5提升至81.6（+3.1），其中Distance子任务提升+9.5，BLINK Multi-view提升+8.3；在LLaVA-1.6-7B上也呈现类似改进，尤其在空间和关系子任务上表现突出。相比视觉token减少方法和表示级干预基线，NeuronEye在CV-Bench和BLINK上均取得最优总体性能。消融实验验证了三个组件的互补贡献，插入层（layer 8）和聚类数量（K=64）的选择经验证为最优。
AI.conclusion: NeuronEye证明了稀疏自编码器特征不仅可以作为事后可解释性工具，还可以作为主动接口用于概念级视觉推理。该框架以即插即用方式在冻结VLM骨干网络上运行，无需额外微调，在空间、关系和多视图推理任务上取得持续改进。未来工作可扩展稀疏神经元空间的领域覆盖，构建面向特定领域（如医学影像）的神经元词汇表。

title: Do LLM Agents Execute the Plans They Declare? From Planning-Mode Declaration to Pattern-Specific Execution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) enable agents to solve long-horizon tasks by generating a plan and then executing it in an environment. However, successful planning requires two distinct capabilities: selecting an appropriate plan for the task and executing it faithfully. Existing planner--executor systems can fail at either stage, while final task success alone cannot distinguish selection from execution failures. We therefore study the Plan Declaration--Execution Gap and introduce Planning-as-Routing, where an LLM declares one of four planning modes: Predefined, Sequential, Hierarchical, or Search, and a deterministic router dispatches the task to the corresponding pattern-specific executor. Across four benchmarks and three LLMs, we find three consistent patterns. First, generic Plan+ReAct often fails to preserve declared planning structure, especially for longer plans: across three benchmarks, only (22)--(45%) of trajectories preserve it, whereas pattern-specific executors enforce the intended structure. Second, planning-mode effectiveness varies across environments and models: Search performs best on ALFWorld, Hierarchical on SWE-bench, and the strongest pattern can vary across models within the same benchmark. Third, the largest gains come from execution: pattern-specific executors improve task success from (0.48) to (0.92) on ALFWorld and from (0.36) to (0.44) on SWE-bench Verified over Plan+ReAct. Current LLMs, however, do not reliably select the strongest mode for each task, although few-shot examples improve selection in some benchmark--model combinations. Overall, reliable agent planning requires both effective mode selection and faithful execution: routing substantially closes the execution gap, while task-specific mode selection remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM智能体在长时程任务中是否能真正执行其所声明的规划模式，提出"规划即路由"(Planning-as-Routing)框架，将LLM声明的规划模式(预定义/顺序/层次/搜索)通过确定性路由器分派到对应的模式特定执行器，发现在四个基准和三个LLM上，通用Plan+ReAct仅能保持22%–45%的声明结构，而模式特定执行器能显著提升任务成功率，但当前LLM并不能可靠地为每个任务选择最优模式。
AI.motivation: 现有planner-executor系统的失败可能源于两个不同层面：(1)选择层——所声明的规划模式本身不适合该任务；(2)执行层——尽管选择了合适的规划模式，但在执行过程中未能忠实保持该结构。仅有最终任务成功率无法区分这两种失败来源。受人类面对不同任务采用不同规划策略的启发，作者探究LLM智能体是否存在类似的"规划声明-执行鸿沟"(Plan Declaration-Execution Gap)。
AI.method: 作者提出Planning-as-Routing框架：(1)定义四种规划模式——预定义(Predefined)、顺序(Sequential)、层次(Hierarchical)、搜索(Search)；(2)设置三种实验条件——Flat ReAct、Plan+ReAct、Planning-as-Routing，逐步隔离规划选择与执行的影响；(3)构建强制分派(pattern-ceiling)矩阵以分离选择失败与执行失败；(4)使用基于规则的执行结构验证器（与人工标注一致性κ=0.31/0.34）和LLM-as-judge对规划质量和遵守度进行评分；(5)在四个基准(ALFWorld、WebArena、Mind2Web、SWE-bench Verified)和三个LLM(Qwen3.6、DeepSeek-V4、Gemma-4-26B)上进行三随机种子评估。
AI.result: 四项主要发现：(1)通用Plan+ReAct在三个基准上仅保持22%–45%的声明规划结构，长规划尤其差，层次/搜索模式最难保持；(2)规划模式有效性随环境和模型变化——Search在ALFWorld最强、Hierarchical在SWE-bench最强，Gemma-4-26B在ALFWorld上偏好Hierarchical而其他模型偏好Search；(3)模式特定执行将ALFWorld任务成功率从0.48提升至0.92、SWE-bench从0.36提升至0.44，远超Plan+ReAct，且在长任务上优势更明显；(4)当前LLM无法可靠地为个别任务选择最优规划模式（与任务盲策略相比Δ在−0.025至+0.009之间，无统计显著性），但少样本示例在多数配置下可改善选择（提升+0.004至+0.156）。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的智能体规划需要两要素：选择有效的规划模式以及通过匹配的执行器忠实执行该模式。Planning-as-Routing显著缩小了执行鸿沟，但针对任务的自适应模式选择仍是开放问题。未来工作应探索更多规划模式、动态路由、动作级正确性与结构忠实度的联合评估，以及多智能体系统中的交接感知评估。

title: Stochastic World Models for Verifying Vision-Based Neural Feedback Systems
summary: Verifying a vision-based neural feedback system requires a model of the observations its controller acts upon. Such a model must capture the variation the sensor produces, while remaining tractable for closed-loop analysis. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have served as perception surrogates, but they are large, reproduce complex scenes poorly, and are hard to verify. We explore stochastic world models as a richer class of perception surrogates. We train a world model with physically grounded latents, built from operations that standard verifiers bound. It reproduces held-out frames more faithfully than GAN surrogates with up to 130 times as many parameters. To verify these surrogates, we develop a procedure that combines falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses. On an emergency braking benchmark with a GAN surrogate, our procedure resolves the entire state space, 38% of which the state-of-the-art verifier left unresolved. On the RGB version of the benchmark, where no verification results have previously been reported, our procedure resolves over 80% of the state space with a world model surrogate.

AI.tldr: 提出基于随机世界模型（latents具有物理含义）的感知代理，用于视觉神经反馈系统的验证；并设计了结合伪造、前向分析、自适应细化、符号分析和反向分析的验证流程，在紧急制动基准上显著优于现有基于GAN的验证方法。
AI.motivation: 视觉神经反馈系统的安全验证需要既表达传感器观测变化、又便于验证器推理的感知模型。现有GAN代理参数大、难以表达复杂场景且难以验证；确定性世界模型缺乏可建模的环境变化。作者希望通过将变化集中于少量物理含义明确的latent来兼顾表达力与可验证性。
AI.method: 1) 将视觉神经反馈系统形式化为以生成式模型为传感器的状态式系统；2) 提出一种基于反卷积+FiLM调制的随机世界模型，其latent对应物理量（如太阳高度角），构建时只使用标准验证器可界定的算子（线性、Conv、BN、ReLU、tanh、McCormick松弛）；4) 设计结合falsification、前向reachability、abstraction optimization、adaptive refinement、symbolic analysis与backward analysis的验证流程。
AI.result: 在Aircraft Taxiing与AEBS两个基准上，所提世界模型在RMSE与SSIM上均优于已有GAN代理，参数最多少130倍（AEBS RGB上29k vs 3.86M）。在灰度AEBS上，本文方法解析了100%状态空间（之前方法38%未解决）；在RGB AEBS上首次报告结果，解析超过80%。验证GPU-hours分别为1043和550。
AI.conclusion: 将感知变化集中在物理可解释latent中的随机世界模型，能以更少参数生成更高保真度的代理图像，并可通过组合多种验证技术解决此前GAN代理无法验证的视觉神经反馈系统问题。限制：保证仅对代理系统成立；缺乏代理与真实相机之间的形式化联系；RGB结果使用了卷积而非原版attention感知头；符号分析贡献较小。

title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation
summary: A small trainable advisor can steer a frozen language-model executor using natural-language advice. In addition to learning from task rewards, the advisor can use feedback from completed interactions to improve its advice. However, a plausible correction need not change execution, yet learning from such corrections can still affect the advisor's future decisions in other contexts. In a shared-parameter model, we prove that such corrections can limit learning if their targets favor useful advice less strongly than those of other corrections. Keeping them less often than the rest improves the model's eventual performance compared to learning from every correction. Motivated by this, our method, Advisor Self-Distillation (AdviSD), pairs outcome-based reinforcement learning with self-distillation from a feedback-conditioned copy of the advisor selectively. Reflection proposes corrections, and the advisor scores the same recorded executor response with and without its issued advice, using the magnitude of the difference to select decisions for supervision. This approach does not require executor likelihoods or additional executor rollouts. Experiments with Qwen3-8B advisors for Gemini and Claude show that AdviSD outperforms advisor-GRPO by 4.2-6.4 percentage points on BFCL-v3 and by 3.9-5.1 score points on EnvScaler. The trained advisors generalize to out-of-domain tasks and transfer across different executor versions and model families. AdviSD also beats matched-count random selection, supporting the value of its selection rule.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdviSD方法，通过目标性多轮自蒸馏训练小型顾问模型来指导冻结的前沿大语言模型执行器。核心创新在于理论分析证明并非所有反馈修正都有助于学习——那些不影响执行结果的修正可能通过共享参数损害模型在其他场景的决策。AdviSD通过对比有无建议时顾问对相同执行器响应的预测分数差异来选择需要监督的决策，无需执行器似然或额外推理。
AI.motivation: 当前前沿大语言模型通常通过API调用，用户无法修改其权重。当这类模型作为智能体执行任务时，一个小的可训练顾问模型可以从外部提供自然语言建议来引导它。然而，仅从任务奖励学习的顾问获得的反馈有限，因为情节奖励总结了整体任务表现但未指明具体哪些建议决策应该改变。反射机制虽能基于完成交互提出具体修正，但一个看似合理的修正可能并不改变执行结果（如执行器本就擅长的搜索步骤），通过共享参数学习这些"无效"修正可能损害顾问在其他场景的建议质量。因此需要一种机制来选择哪些修正值得学习。
AI.method: AdviSD结合基于结果的GRPO强化学习与反馈条件自蒸馏。核心选择机制是配对评分：预更新顾问对同一已记录执行器响应，在包含已发出建议和不含建议两种上下文中分别评分，使用两种评分差异的绝对值作为预测信号来选择需要监督的决策。具体步骤：(1) 外部反射器对不完美情节中至多5个建议决策提出修正；(2) 对原始弃权决策和配对评分差异超过校准阈值的决策保留监督；(3) 通过donor建议（来自其他任务的建议）校准阈值，使用0.95分位数作为固定阈值；(4) 反馈条件教师（预更新顾问副本）以反馈块增强的上下文监督仅看原始上下文的学生。损失函数包含GRPO损失加上自蒸馏辅助损失，权重λ_s从0.30线性衰减到0.05（前60个更新）。
AI.result: 使用Qwen3-8B作为顾问训练，Gemini 3.7 Flash和Claude Sonnet 4.6作为冻结执行器。AdviSD在BFCL-v3上比advisor-GRPO提升4.2-6.4个百分点，在EnvScaler上提升3.9-5.1分。Q1：领域内BFCL-v3和EnvScaler聚合指标最高。Q2：消融实验显示AdviSD比匹配计数随机选择高2.5-4.9分，比无门控高3.2-5.1分，证明选择具体修正而非仅减少监督是有价值的。Q3：无需重新训练即可迁移到四个分布外基准（ACEBench、ToolHop、τ²-bench、RoTBench），宏观平均比独立执行高2.7-3.6分；跨版本和跨模型系列迁移均优于迁移的GRPO 3.1个百分点。Q4：训练进度显示AdviSD从第20次更新起持续领先基线。
AI.conclusion: AdviSD通过区分提出修正与选择学习位置，实现了更高效的顾问训练。理论分析（定理1-2和推论1）解释了共享参数模型中校正选择如何通过监督组成（composition）和监督频率（exposure）影响最终性能。匹配计数随机控制实验验证了目标选择规则比简单减少监督更有价值。AdviSD的顾问在领域内、分布外和跨执行器迁移场景中均达到最优，证明了选择哪里学习对顾问-执行器接口至关重要。该方法不依赖执行器似然或额外执行器推理，具有良好的实用性和泛化能力。

title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
summary: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models' weights remain fixed. To make the Builder's experience reusable, we introduce Meta-Skill: principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target's execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unseen tasks. Across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction, and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target. These results highlight the value of translating experience into executable support. Gains when the same model serves both roles further suggest a path to system level self-improvement through learning to build better environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"元技能"(Meta-Skill)框架,使固定的Builder模型通过学习目标模型的执行反馈,将经验提炼为可复用的支持原则,并据此为新任务构建执行环境(harness)。在两个基准测试中,该方法在六组配置下均优于直接向目标传递知识,验证了"将经验转化为可执行支撑"的价值,并展示了同模型自我改进的潜力。
AI.motivation: 智能体性能不仅取决于推理能力,还取决于其执行环境。现有研究多关注直接改进目标模型或搜索工作流,但忽略了"如何学习为Agent构建更好的支持环境"这一维度。作者希望通过让Builder从执行经验中学习,使固定权重的模型也能获得性能提升。
AI.method: 1. 定义Meta-Skill三元组(when, provide, use),描述何时需要支持、提供什么资源、目标如何使用。2. 建立"构建-执行-反思"循环:Builder在开发集上构建harness→目标执行并产生反馈→Builder基于证据keep/revise/add更新技能库。3. 技能库冻结后,在测试时通过完整技能库或BM25检索方式指导Builder为每个新任务构建任务特定的harness(涵盖7个组件族:指令、记忆、上下文、组合工具、执行控制、验证恢复、工作区)。4. 使用GPT-5.6-Sol作为Builder,Gemini-3.6-Flash/Qwen3.8-Flash/GPT-OSS-120B作为目标,在Harness-Bench(106题)和NewtonBench(324题)上评测。
AI.result: 在六个模型-基准组合中:1. 完整技能库的Builder在宏平均上达到65.31%,比无技能构建提升8.95个百分点,比直接传递技能给目标提升12.02个百分点;2. NewtonBench上NewtonBench上无效提交减少35.5%,正确发现增加21.9%;3. NewtonBench(平均+10.96点)比Harness-Bench(+6.95点)受益更大,因前者存在重复的协调失败模式;4. 同模型自进化实验中平均提升18.71点,表明无需权重更新即可实现系统级自我改进;5. 跨Builder转移显示接收方自主学习优于直接迁移,但原则仍可跨模型复用。
AI.conclusion: 1. Meta-Skill的核心价值在于将知识"操作化"为执行支撑(工具、状态、控制),而非仅仅是提示词;2. 控制器组件对执行一致性提升最显著(尤其对Gemini减少13.36点);3. 经验学习最有价值于重复性失败模式的任务;4. 支持设计本身是一个独立的学习维度,即使同一模型也能通过学习构建更好的harness来实现自我改进,为系统级自进化提供了新路径。

title: Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning
summary: As agents take on longer and more complex problems, controlling the execution becomes a task in its own right. Each step in the run brings new control choices, like which partial work to build on, whether to start fresh, or when to stop. We introduce agentic meta-reasoning, an inference-time harness that makes these choices an explicit and structured reasoning process. Workers carry out the task-level computation, while a controller consolidates what the run has established, explores next options, assesses what each option is worth under the remaining budget, and dispatches the chosen work with context drawn from persistent memory. Between decisions the controller carries only a compact account of the run rather than replaying its full history. Our baselines span production coding agents and research harnesses, together with a Direct Control Agent using the same workers and compute budget allowance. On ProgramBench, which tests long-horizon agentic capability through program reconstruction, meta-reasoning achieves 71.5% with GPT-5.5 against 58.0% for Codex; with Opus 4.8 it achieves 67.2% against 65.5% for Claude Code. On the other benchmarks, spanning abstract reasoning, multi-domain long-horizon reasoning, and proof generation, it gains between 3.6 and 4.2 points over direct control, averaged across three frontier models. It keeps improving over the tested budget ranges where direct control plateaus, though its overhead can hurt at small budgets. Artifact-graph analysis reveals more reuse of earlier work, higher coverage of correct solutions in most settings, and nonuniform gains in final selection. These results indicate that spending computation on structured control becomes more important as agents scale to longer runs.

AI.tldr: 提出"智能体元推理"(agentic meta-reasoning)——一种推理时的控制框架,将智能体的控制决策(下一步做什么)与对象层任务执行分离,由控制器通过Assess-Propose-Evaluate-Dispatch四阶段显式结构化决策,而工作者执行任务;通过持久化制品图(artifact graph)实现紧凑状态记忆。在四个基准(IMO ProofBench-Advanced、ARC-AGI-2、LongCoT-mini、ProgramBench)和三个前沿模型上,主预算下12项匹配对比全部优于直接控制基线,平均提升3.6–4.2分;ProgramBench上GPT-5.5达到71.5%(vs Codex 58.0%),且在直接控制趋于平台期的预算范围内继续提升。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体将控制决策与对象层工作交错在同一调用中,随着任务变长、模型调用增多,如何选择下一步工作本身成为一项独立且关键的认知任务。控制错误的代价不仅是浪费算力,还可能让失败路径延续整个运行,或丢弃已找到的正确解。因此,作者认为控制决策应当拥有自己的结构化推理过程,并与对象层工作分离。
AI.method: 设计Meta-Reasoning Agent:工作者执行任务级计算,控制器维护紧凑的自身状态s_t和持久化制品图(V为工件、E为上下文依赖的有向边)。每个控制周期包含四个阶段:(1)Assess——根据新工件更新对运行进度的评估;(2)Propose——基于状态提出下一批候选计算方案A_t,不知道预算以避免自我裁剪;(3)Evaluate——在剩余预算b_t^eval下对方案做定性价值评估,选择ã_t;(4)Dispatch——将ã_t转化为可执行动作,确定每个工作者接收的工件上下文C_i。控制器与工作者共享同一模型调用预算B。还引入Direct Control Agent作为关键基线:相同工作者、相同接口、相同预算,唯一区别是每步动作在单一调用中基于累积历史直接决定,从而隔离出显式分阶段控制的贡献。诊断方法包括:工件图拓扑(节点数、边数、深度、宽度、扇入)、覆盖率(运行中是否曾出现正确解)、Type-2 AUC(控制器对工件正确性的排序能力)、前沿选择增益(相对于从最深终态工件均匀随机选择的提交正确率差)。
AI.result: (a) 性能:主预算下Meta-Reasoning Agent在4个基准×3个模型共12项匹配对比中均取得最高分。IMO ProofBench-Advanced平均+4.0分(Gemini 3.1 Pro +8.6最多),ARC-AGI-2平均+4.2分,LongCoT-mini平均+3.6分。ProgramBench上GPT-5.5达71.5%对比Codex 58.0%、直接对照63.7%;Opus 4.8达67.2%对比Claude Code 65.5%。(b) 预算扩展性:预算从400增至1200调用时,元推理持续提升(GPT-5.5从64.1%到71.5%),而直接控制在400调用附近C版仅差+2.6分后趋于平台;ProgramBench上GPT-5.5直接控制仅用约18%的1200调用预算,元推理使用89–101%。(c) 工件图:元推理的图节点数与边数随预算增长更显著(ProgramBench上GPT-5.5边数增长约4倍),且远高于直接控制;显示更多早期工作的再利用。(e) 覆盖率:多数设置下元推理显著提升(Gemini IMO +20百分点),正确解出现率更高。(f) 监控:控制器verdict的Type-2 AUC普遍高于工作者confidence(Gemini IMO:0.88 vs 0.55)。(g) 选择:前沿选择增益在多数设置下为正(ARC-AGI-2 GPT-5.5 +11 pp vs 直接控制 +3 pp),但非均匀。(h) 记忆:控制器状态保持在数千至数万字符,而直接控制历史在最长Opus运行超过一百万字符。
AI.conclusion: 智能体的性能不仅取决于如何完成任务,还取决于如何决定任务是否值得做。随着推理运行变长,这一决策本身成为一项独立的工作。Agentic meta-reasoning通过将控制与对象层工作显式分离,使控制器能够以结构化推理方式评估进度、探索选项、权衡预算价值并选择上下文,从而使智能体在更长运行和更大预算下持续扩展。工件图分析为这种"控制作为可测量能力"的观点提供了诊断工具。预算不足时控制开销可能不划算(Opus 4.8在400调用预算下落后),且控制器评估错误可能传播误导状态;LongCoT-mini的国际象棋子集上出现了"过度修正已正确解"的失败模式。

title: Bathtubs, Boundaries, and Sandboxes: AI Regulatory Learning under Legal Uncertainty
comment: author's version of the paper to be presented at ACM AIES 2026. Updated email address of one author
summary: Effective regulation of AI is a defining policy challenge, driven by their integration into all aspects of society. To remain responsive to their rapid development and emergent properties, policymakers across the globe rely on high-level principles and abstract legal requirements. Yet, while this flexibility supports future-proofing human-centred regulations and aligning them with socio-ethical values, it also causes legal uncertainty downstream as developers, companies, and auditors struggle with translating these abstract requirements into verifiable technical requirements. Using the AI Act as an example, this paper draws on Coleman's bathtub to analyse the regulatory learning space in AI governance. It argues that legal uncertainty cannot be fully reduced ex ante and that, within reasonable bounds, it is also necessary for regulatory learning because it creates the space in which boundary negotiation over socio-technical meaning can occur. Building on this analysis, the paper shows how boundary objects and boundary negotiating artifacts help explain the translation of legal requirements into operational practice. By examining technical sandbox frameworks, it further identifies concrete properties that technical infrastructures must possess to function effectively as boundary negotiation artifacts in AI assessment. The paper concludes that legal certainty remains the long-term aim, but that premature closure of regulatory instruments risks undermining the learning processes needed for adaptive governance.

AI.tldr: 本文以欧盟《AI法案》为例，运用Coleman浴缸模型与社会学中的边界对象与边界协商制品（BNA）理论，分析了AI监管学习中法律不确定性的必要性及其在抽象法律要求向可操作技术规范转化中的中介机制，提出AI监管沙箱（AIRS）及相关技术基础设施作为结构化边界协商环境的具体属性要求，论证法律确定性是长期目标但不应过早关闭监管工具以免损害适应性治理的学习过程。
AI.motivation: AI系统快速发展和涌现性使得全球政策制定者依赖高层级原则和抽象法律要求进行治理，虽然这种灵活性有助于未来兼容性和价值对齐，但也导致下游法律不确定性，使开发者、企业和审计师难以将抽象要求转化为可验证的技术规范。本文旨在理解法律不确定性是否可被完全消除，以及如何在不确定性中构建有效的监管学习机制。
AI.method: 采用理论分析法：以欧盟《AI法案》为案例，综合运用社会学理论——Coleman浴缸模型分析监管学习空间的多层级（宏观-中观-微观）信息流动机制，以及Star和Griesemer的边界对象概念与Lee的边界协商制品（BNA）框架解释多利益相关方之间的意义协商过程。进一步通过分析AI监管沙箱（AIRS）的两个技术框架提案（Sandbox Configurator和MLOps范式），归纳出技术BNA所需的具体属性。
AI.result: （1）构建了AI法案治理结构的Coleman浴缸模型，映射了欧盟委员会（宏观）、各类中观主体（执行者、中微观顾问、中宏观顾问、标准化者）和微观主体（开发者、部署者等）的功能角色与学习循环；（2）识别出AI系统与法律要求作为主要边界对象，AIRS中的退出报告、DSL规范语言、MLOps流水线等作为边界协商制品；（3）归纳出技术BNA的三大核心属性：机器可读核心编码、角色特定访问接口、迭代可追溯输出；（4）揭示了过早关闭监管工具带来的风险，包括碎片化、监管俘获和合规打勾行为；（5）论证法律不确定性在合理范围内对监管学习具有建设性作用。
AI.conclusion: 法律不确定性无法完全通过事前方式消除，在合理范围内对监管学习是必要的，因为它为利益相关方协商抽象法律要求的社会技术意义创造了空间。法律确定性是长期目标，但过早关闭监管工具有可能损害适应性治理所需的学习过程。AIRS及相关技术框架通过提供共享制品、可追溯输出和角色特定访问，有效支持边界协商。技术BNA需具备机器可读核心、角色特定访问和迭代输出三大属性，方能有效支撑AI评估中的边界协商与监管学习。

title: Sage: Formalization with Semantic Correction
summary: While neural theorem provers have achieved impressive milestones in formal mathematics, they largely operate on the assumption that faithful Lean 4 formal statements are already provided. Translating informal natural language into a formal language is a critical data bottleneck plagued by an "illusion of rigor": standard type-checkers accept statements that compile but drop hypotheses, introduce vacuous truths, or subtly alter mathematical bounds. To resolve this, we introduce Sage (Semantic Agent-Guided Formalization Engine), an agentic framework that replaces monolithic translation with a four-stage decomposed generation pipeline coupled with a dual-signal semantic correction loop. By pairing Lean 4 compiler diagnostics with multi-dimensional semantic feedback, our correction loop enforces mathematical fidelity alongside syntactic validity. By explicitly accounting for the gap between open-ended queries and declarative formal targets, our pipeline prevents models from achieving high formalization rates by guessing unverified answers (exhibiting a 70.9% answer leakage rate). Consequently, Sage suppresses leakage to 2.7% while achieving 73.3% pass@4 joint compilation and semantic fidelity on the Omni-MATH without proofs (compared to 42.0% for a fine-tuned Goedel-Formalizer-V2 baseline). Finally, on IMO-Unformalized, a novel frontier of 175 unformalized International Mathematical Olympiad problems, Sage demonstrates effective zero-shot generalization with 87.4% pass@4 verified fidelity compared to just 19.4% for the baseline, winning over 79% of blind pairwise evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sage，一个用于自动形式化（autoformalization）的智能体框架，通过四阶段分解生成管道与双信号语义修正循环，将自然语言数学命题翻译为 Lean 4 形式化语句，重点解决"严格性幻觉"问题——即仅通过类型检查的语句可能丢失假设、引入空真命题或篡改数学边界。
AI.motivation: 现有神经定理证明系统（如 Goedel-Prover、DeepSeek-Prover、AlphaProof）假设形式化语句 S_F 已给定，专注于证明搜索 S_F→P_F。然而，将非形式化自然语言 S_NL 翻译为 S_NL→S_F 是关键的数据瓶颈，存在"严格性幻觉"：Lean 4 类型检查器接受可通过编译但会丢弃假设、引入空真或改变数学边界的语句。标准编译修复循环无法检测语义不匹配。本文还指出单遍整体翻译（monolithic translation）在处理开放式查询（Question-type）时存在"发现陷阱"（Discovery Trap），模型倾向于猜测答案（70.9% 的泄漏率）以获取高通过率。
AI.method: Sage 采用三阶段架构：(1) 草案阶段（Draft）——将生成分解为四个角色隔离的智能体：Distiller（识别数学领域，在有证明时提取 Inferred Goal，无证明时将开放查询重述为声明式目标）、Preprocessor（生成 Declarative Normal Form，分离假设与目标）、Formalizer（翻译为 Lean 4，应用 Anti-Trivialization Guard）、Formatter（语法清理与组装）；(2) 验证阶段（Verify）——Lean 4 编译器检查单 sorry 不变式，语义 Rater 沿七个维度评估：Missing、Wrong、Extra、Semantic Match、Exactness、Naturality、Descriptive Precision；(3) 修正阶段（Refine）——双信号语义修正循环联合 Compile∧Sage-SM 门控，每轮向 Corrector 提供 Lean 编译器诊断与 Rater 失败维度、评分及理由，运行 T 轮。框架支持 Answer-Aware（利用非形式证明生成解析后的 prover-ready 目标）与 Answer-Agnostic（不使用证明，忠实保留查询开放性）两种配置。理论贡献包括：区分 Assertion-type 与 Question-type 数学命题的形式化可行性三难（Feasibility Trilemma），以及提出 Type-Theoretic Locks（利用 Lean 4 大消除限制将目标从 Prop 移至 Type，使用 Subtype 强制 prover 提供显式计算见证，防御 Polarity Cheat 与 Triviality Trap）。
AI.result: 在 Omni-MATH（300 题，98.7% 为 Question-type，Answer-Agnostic）：Sage 在 pass@4 实现 73.3% 的 Compile∧Goedel-SM 联合成功率（pass@1 为 50.3%），相比微调的 Goedel-Formalizer-V2 基线（pass@4 为 42.0%，pass@1 为 26.7%）近乎翻倍；答案泄漏率从 Monolithic+Semantic 的 70.9% 降至 2.7%，Multiple Sorries 率仅 1.1%。在 IMO-Unformalized（175 题国际数学奥林匹克未形式化前沿）：Sage 实现 87.4% pass@4 经验证忠实度，基线仅 19.4%，零样本胜出约 6 倍；盲测配对评估中 79.4% 的对决中获胜。在 IMO-Formalized（223 题）：pass@4 联合忠实度 83.9%（基线 50.7%）。在 Omni-MATH Answer-Aware 设定下：S_QL reachSage-SM 门控达 96.3%，Goedel-SM 达 77.3%。基础模型消融表明，从 Qwen3-32B 到 Qwen3.8-27B，联合忠实度从 30.3% 提升至 85.7%，平均修复轮数从 3.2 降至 ~1.1。语义门控的人工验证：71.1% 与人类多数投票一致，Spearman ρ=0.63、Pearson r=0.64。Goedel-SM 拒绝原因审计显示，Monolithic 与 Goedel 基线主要因 Wrong Injection（74.5%/56.9%）与 Mathematically False 被拒，而 Sage 主要因 Existential 编码（76.8%）被拒。
AI.conclusion: Sage 证明推理时的语义验证对高完整性形式化不可或缺。通过建立自动形式化器必须作为忠实翻译者而非无约束神谕的原则，Sage 抑制结构性答案泄漏，提供可信赖的合成数据生成引擎，弥合非形式化数学知识与机器可验证真理之间的差距，为下一代自动推理系统奠定基础。局限性包括：(1) 形式化开放查询为存在命题时仍暴露于证明无关性带来的逻辑捷径，需推进类型理论层面的工程化计算目标类型；(2) 多智能体迭代修正带来显著的时钟延迟开销，较适合离线语料生成而非在线推理场景；更强的底层模型协同减少修复轮数并提升忠实度。

title: Calibration-First Cross-Cohort Multimodal Temporal Learning for Transferable Asthma-Risk Forecasting
summary: Asthma deterioration forecasting must remain reli- able when patient populations, sensor ecosystems, and available modalities change across cohorts. Existing models commonly optimize within-cohort discrimination and may produce poorly calibrated probabilities after transfer. We present CALIBRA, a calibration-first multimodal temporal framework for short- horizon risk prediction with incomplete data. Dedicated recurrent encoders process environmental, pulmonary, symptom, medication, wearable, and context streams; a reliability-conditioned gate suppresses stale or absent modalities, while gradient-reversal training discourages avoidable cohort signatures. A shrinkage- based hierarchical logistic layer calibrates probabilities using a patient-disjoint target subset, and split conformal prediction provides abstention-capable prediction sets. To avoid fabricating clinical evidence, we evaluate the complete implementation on a documented three-cohort semi-synthetic benchmark with controlled distribution shift, informative missingness, and sealed target patients. Across five configured seeds, CALIBRA achieved mean target-test AUPRC 0.224 versus 0.240 for the strongest non-ablation comparator, TemporalTransformer; mean AUROC was 0.717, and Brier score was 0.098. Experiments additionally assess complete-modality failures, calibration, conformal coverage, decision curves, subgroup behavior, ablations, runtime, and parameter count. The results verify the method and reproducible pipeline under controlled shift, but do not establish clinical effectiveness. External validation on harmonized real asthma. Overall this artifact provides evidence for carefully governed real-cohort validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CALIBRA-ASTHMA框架，以"校准优先"的方式解决跨队列（cross-cohort）哮喘恶化风险预测中的概率校准与模态缺失问题。该框架整合了专用时序编码器、可靠性条件融合门控、对抗式队列对齐、分层目标校准以及分裂保形预测（split conformal prediction）。在半合成三队列基准测试中，AUPRC低于最强基线TemporalTransformer（0.224 vs 0.240），AUROC为0.717，Brier分数为0.098。作者明确指出这是方法学概念验证，未证明临床有效性，呼吁在真实队列上进行外部验证。
AI.motivation: 现有哮喘预测模型多在单一队列内优化判别性能，忽视跨队列迁移时的概率校准问题。同时，多模态数据存在缺失性和信息性缺失机制，部署时传感器生态和患者群体发生变化会导致概率失准，单纯追求判别力可能产生不可靠的临床警报。
AI.method: 1. 专用循环编码器处理6类模态（环境、肺功能、症状、药物、可穿戴、上下文）；2. 可靠性网络基于观测比例、近期性和变异性计算融合门控权重，对完全缺失模态设为零；3. 梯度反转层对抗式地减少队列特异性表征；4. 冻结预测器后，在患者不相交的目标校准子集上训练带岭收缩的分层logistic校准层；5. 分裂保形预测在相同校准集上构造可弃权的预测集合；目标测试标签全程密封，不参与训练、校准或保形分位数估计。
AI.result: 在5个种子、3队列半合成基准（70+70+60患者，52天，7天窗口预测3天事件）的留一队列迁移测试中：CALIBRA的AUPRC为0.224（低于TemporalTransformer的0.240），AUROC为0.717，Brier分数为0.098，ECE为0.013；模态移除压力测试显示优雅退化；分裂保形覆盖接近名义水平；消融实验显示各组件贡献有限且存在权衡；Wilcoxon配对检验经Holm校正后无统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是一个完整的方法学概念验证，证明了管道在受控偏移下的实现正确性和可复现性。核心局限在于使用了半合成数据，无法证明临床可迁移性、警报安全性或患者获益。作者明确呼吁在至少两个伦理合规的真实纵向哮喘队列上进行外部验证，并预先注册事件定义、缺失数据策略和子组分析。

title: Binarization Flattens the Score Space
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are often used as rewards to train policies on objectives that deterministic verifiers cannot capture. However, these rewards are often collapsed to pass/fail ({0, 1}), which reports the verdict but not how well a response met each criterion. We model each pass/fail verdict as a score on an unreported scale, compared with one cutoff. A stretch of that scale moves every score proportionally toward or away from the cutoff, but never across it, so no verdict changes. A policy is therefore free to apply any stretch without changing anything the panel reports. Under a joint-Gaussian model, a third grade adds a second threshold and removes this affine stretch ambiguity. On MATH and SciBench outputs from one seven-criterion judge, all 14 constructed criterionwise stretches were invisible after binarization but visible with three grades. At $n=1{,}024$, a test given both population laws had at least 96.5% power at a $1.5\times$ stress. Retaining grades closes one blind spot created by binarization, but verdicts alone remain insufficient as some changes are still indistinguishable from genuine improvement. These include arbitrary within-grade changes and fixed-covariance, loading-aligned mean shifts -- the signature of a sycophancy-shaped lift the panel reads as competence. The shared-factor reference approximation fit MATH and SciBench but not HealthBench, delineating its empirical scope. We recommend keeping at least three grades (for example, asking the judge whether each criterion is fully, partially, or not met and rewarding {0, 0.5, 1}), and externally validating gains along the remaining direction, which no finer scale removes.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了大语言模型(LLM)评判器在奖励建模中将多等级评分二值化为通过/失败(0/1)所带来的"评分空间扁平化"问题。研究在联合高斯评分模型下证明了：二值化会引入沿通过阈值的仿射拉伸自由度（不可识别方向），而保留至少一个中间等级（如三等级 {0, 0.5, 1}）可消除此模糊性。在 MATH 和 SciBench 数据上的实验验证了该结论，并指出评分无法消除的残留盲区（如加载对齐的均值偏移，即迎合性风格的提升会被判委员会误读为能力提升）。
AI.motivation: LLM 评判器作为奖励在 RL 后训练中越来越常见，但常被坍缩为二值判决。这种输出通道的粗糙化使得某些策略变化（如围绕通过阈值的得分拉伸）与真实改进在判委员会看来完全不可区分，构成 reward hacking 的盲区。论文从构造效度角度系统化地刻画这些不可识别的变化。
AI.method:
1. 观察模型：每个(评判器,准则)对产生的潜在评分 S_ij = λ_j θ_i + ε_ij，θ_i 为共享因子；准则通过固定阈值输出等级或二值判决。  
2. 理论分析：证明定理 1——在高斯评分律下，二值准则的联合判决分布仅能确定至一个对角仿射拉伸 D；当某准则 K_j ≥ 3 时，D_jj = 1，从而固定该坐标。  
3. 推论：固定协方差的加载对齐均值偏移 a = δλ（Corollary 1）在判决分布上与参考族 (m+δ, c) 完全等价；路径级模仿（Proposition 1）证明任何判决通道都无法区分。  
4. 局部信息几何：离开参考族的运动以 n^{-1/2} 速率可检测，参考族内部为零幂。  
5. 实验：用 GRPO 在 MATH/SciBench/HealthBench 上训练 Qwen3-4B，由固定的 Qwen3.5-27B 评判器按 7 个准则打分；在冻结几何下构造 14 项准则级拉伸应力，验证三等级检测能力，并量化 n=1024 时已知律功效 ≥ 96.5%。
AI.result:
1. 所有 14 项构造的准则级拉伸在二值化后完整律 TV 恒为 0；引入第三等级后 TV 升至 0.0234–0.1146（MATH）和 0.0248–0.1117（SciBench）；n=1024 已知律功效 ≥ 96.5%（MATH）、97.7%（SciBench）。  
2. 构造的真实获益与匹配加载对齐攻击在 2187 格联合等级表上的种群 TV 为 1.6×10^{-16}（完全不可区分），预测金标准差 18.25 个百分点。  
3. 参考轨道近似在 MATH 和 SciBench 上拟合良好（解释 67%/72%），但在 HealthBench 上失败，说明其适用条件。  
4. 候选池搜索未发现自然训练产生的精确盲态攻击。
AI.conclusion:
1. 二值评分通道存在仿射拉伸盲区；三等级 {0, 0.5, 1} 是联合高斯模型下的最低有效分辨率，且第二阈值强制 D=I。  
2. 但任何分辨率都无法消除两类残留不可区分变化：等级内任意变动，以及固定协方差的加载对齐均值偏移——后者正是迎合性风格提升被判委员会读作"能力提升"的形式。  
3. 实操建议：(a) 不坍缩等级，保留至少三等级并冻结两个阈值；(b) 监控约简判决统计量（边际与两两等级表）以触发外部验证；(c) 沿参考族方向需配合金标准、独立评判器或响应检查外部证据。

title: Evaluating the Effects of Prompt Perturbation on Bias and Hallucination in Large Language Models
comment: 14 pages. Published in ICONIP 2024 (Neural Information Processing), LNCS 15290, Springer Nature, 2025
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in various natural language processing tasks, leading to their widespread deployment as intelligent assistants in decision-making contexts. However, the increasing complexity of these models raises concerns about their reliability, particularly regarding bias and hallucination. In this work, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs to perturbed variations of the original inquiry in decision-making tasks. We show that contrary to previous studies, perturbations can mitigate bias and hallucination in some LLMs over other models. It's found that Claude 3 is more effective for the tasks represented in most datasets, whereas models like GPT3.5 exhibit varying levels of adequacy, performing comparably in some cases but falling significantly behind in others. These insights are crucial for understanding the practical implications of deploying LLM-based assistants as effective decision-support tools in real-world applications, emphasising the need for rigorous testing and validation to ensure reliability and effectiveness. This study contributes to the growing body of research on LLM evaluation and provides insights for developing more robust and trustworthy AI assistants in critical decision-making contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）在决策任务中对查询扰动的响应稳健性，重点关注偏差和幻觉问题，发现扰动在某些模型上可以缓解这些问题，其中Claude 3表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在决策场景中的广泛应用，其可靠性问题（尤其是偏差和幻觉）日益受到关注。已有研究多关注原始输入下的模型表现，而对查询扰动后模型稳健性的系统评估尚不充分，因此需要探究LLM在面对输入变化时是否仍能保持可靠和一致的表现。
AI.method: 通过构建原始问题及其扰动变体，在多个数据集上对多种LLM（包括Claude 3、GPT-3.5等）进行决策任务的对比评估，分析不同模型在面对输入扰动时在偏差缓解和幻觉减少方面的表现差异。
AI.result: 研究发现扰动可以在某些LLM上缓解偏差和幻觉（与先前研究的结论不同）；在大多数数据集的任务中，Claude 3表现最为有效；GPT-3.5等模型的表现则参差不齐，在部分场景下可与其他模型相当，但在另一些场景中明显落后。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了在真实场景中部署LLM决策支持工具之前进行严格测试和验证的迫切需求，为LLM评估研究提供了新的见解，有助于推动开发更加稳健和值得信赖的AI助手。

title: Alignment Forecasting: Predicting Misalignment From Training Data
summary: Training a language model on data with a narrow flaw can sometimes make the model broadly misaligned. Inspecting the data at face value often does not settle whether it will emerge, and today it is caught only after training, by auditing the resulting model. To complement post-hoc audits, we introduce Alignment Forecasting: the task of predicting alignment failures before training. Given a target model, a fine-tuning dataset, and a failure mode such as deception or sycophancy, a forecaster outputs the probability that fine-tuning would meaningfully increase that failure mode. To measure progress on alignment forecasting, we introduce ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH, a benchmark of over 5,000 forecasting questions spanning 17 target models, 32 datasets, and 16 failure modes. Frontier models prompted directly perform poorly on ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH. We therefore propose a forecasting scaffold in which an LLM reads the dataset and rates how strongly and broadly it pushes the model toward misbehavior, and a simple learned model combines that rating with the failure mode's base rate and the target model's prior tendency. This forecasts well above chance, and beats a model fine-tuned on the task and a simple forecaster allowed to see how weaker models behaved after fine-tuning on the same data. Its signals also flag problematic training examples that a frontier-model classifier misses. Filtering those examples out from real post-training data such as UltraChat results in more aligned models on our multiple-choice evaluation in most cases, though the benefit in open-ended conversations is unclear. More progress is needed before forecasts can reliably guide training data curation in practice, but our results suggest that forecasting many alignment failures before training can be tractable in the SFT setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Alignment Forecasting"任务：在训练前预测微调是否会导致语言模型对齐失败，并构建了包含5,000+问题的AlignmentForecastBench基准。提出的分解式预测器通过LLM审计员读取数据集评估"数据腐败读数"，结合失败模式先验和目标模型易感性四个信号，由逻辑回归组合，在测试集上达到AUROC 0.801，显著优于直接提示的前沿模型（AUROC 0.48-0.65）和微调预测器。该信号还可用于训练数据过滤，在UltraChat上减少MCQ评估中的诱导失准。
AI.motivation: 语言模型微调中存在"涌现失准"现象：看似良性或仅窄域失准的训练数据可能导致广泛的、意想不到的失准行为。当前方法只能通过训练后审计来发现这些问题，过程缓慢且昂贵，且可能激励"欺骗性对齐"。因此需要一种能在训练前预测失准的方法，以便开发者能在创建失准模型之前修订训练数据或方案。
AI.method: 1. 任务形式化：将Alignment Forecasting定义为对(模型、数据集、失败模式)三元组的二分类预测问题，预测微调是否会导致失败模式的统计显著增加；2. 构建AlignmentForecastBench基准，包含17个目标模型、32个微调数据集和16个失败模式，覆盖5000+预测问题，按能力分层和数据集分层双重留出；3. 提出分解式预测器：LLM审计员读取数据集生成行为无关报告→Reader评分四个信号（失败模式先验α、数据连贯性γ、广泛溢出B、模型易感性b）→逻辑回归组合产生校准概率；4. 基线方法包括：直接提示的前沿模型、自我预测、弱模型迁移、SFT预测器、多数投票基线等；5. 下游应用：基于预测信号迭代过滤训练数据。
AI.result: 1. 前沿LLM不擅长对齐预测：AUROC 0.48-0.65，自我预测低于随机水平；2. 分解式预测器AUROC 0.801 (±0.013)，Brier 0.134，平衡准确率69.7%，优于所有基线方法；3. 预测器校准良好，ECE仅0.05（vs. 0.11-0.12的基线）；4. 四个信号中α（失败模式先验）和B（广泛溢出）贡献最大，γ的负权重是共线性伪迹；5. 基于预测的过滤在UltraChat上减少MCQ评估的诱导失准，但在Petri行为评估中优势不明确；6. 训练数据缩放显示约1000个三元组后性能趋于平稳。
AI.conclusion: 对齐预测在SFT设置中是可行的。分解式预测器显著优于简单的前沿模型提示和直接微调方法，其信号可用于训练数据筛选以减少失准。但仍有局限：MCQ和行为评估结果存在差距，预测器主要是数据集级风险估计而非真正的模型特定预测，泛化到其他训练机制（RL post-training、预训练）和更大规模数据集尚未验证。需要在可靠指导训练数据筛选之前取得更多进展。

title: From Lexical Baselines to Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Structured Skill and Responsibility-Level Extraction with the SFIA Framework
summary: Automated skill extraction underpins workforce planning, yet most systems represent skills as flat labels with no notion of the responsibility level at which a skill is practiced. The Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA) captures exactly this dimension, defining 147 professional skills across seven responsibility levels, but no automated LLM-based extraction targeting SFIA has been reported. We formalize the task as structured prediction of (skill, level) pairs from free text and ask three questions: how accurately can text be mapped onto SFIA's closed vocabulary, which strategies reliably predict the level alongside the skill, and do agentic designs improve on simpler retrieval and prompting? We evaluate five strategies (a lexical baseline, dense retrieval with LLM reranking, a zero-shot schema-constrained LLM, single-agent agentic RAG, and a three-agent retriever--matcher--verifier crew) against expert-mapped European ICT role profiles, all drawing on an SFIA~9 corpus built by a fully automated agentic pipeline that we release. Retrieval-based matching identifies the most skills while generative strategies are markedly more precise; only strategies assigning the level as an explicit decision predict it reliably, with similarity-based selection more than twice as inaccurate; and the crew doubles latency without improving accuracy, so added agent roles do not automatically benefit closed-taxonomy matching. These results provide the first reproducible baseline for structured, level-aware skill extraction against SFIA.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对技能提取任务中缺乏"责任级别"维度的问题，首次将SFIA（信息时代技能框架）的147项技能与7级责任级别作为封闭词表，对自由文本进行结构化(skill, level)配对预测。系统比较了五种匹配策略（BM25词法基线、稠密检索+重排序、零样本LLM、单智能体Agentic RAG、三智能体retriever-matcher-verifier团队），发现稠密检索获得最高技能F1（0.232），但级别预测最差（MAE 1.60）；只有将级别作为显式生成决策的方法才能可靠预测级别；三智能体团队延迟翻倍但未提升精度，证实在封闭词表匹配中增加智能体角色并无自动收益。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化技能提取系统普遍将技能表示为扁平标签，忽略了技能实践中"责任级别"这一关键维度（如自主性、影响力、复杂度）。ESCO和O*NET等分类法缺乏此维度，而SFIA明确定义了147项技能在7个责任级别上的描述，但尚无基于LLM的自动化SFIA提取工作。论文旨在填补这一空白，回答三个研究问题：(1)自由文本映射到SFIA封闭词表的准确性；(2)哪些策略能可靠预测责任级别；(3)智能体与多智能体设计是否优于简单检索与提示。
AI.method: 论文形式化任务为从自由文本预测SFIA (技能, 级别)配对。(1)语料构建：采用完全自动化的智能体管道（爬虫→上下文侦查智能体→综合器智能体→提取智能体→确定性范围守卫+验证智能体），将SFIA 9官方文档转化为669条经逐字验证的技能-级别记录语料。(2)评估数据：使用CWA 16458:2018中30个欧洲ICT角色档案（176个配对）作为专家标注的黄金标准。(3)五种匹配策略：BM25词法基线；稠密检索（Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B+Qdrant）+Llama-3.3-70B重排序；零样本schema约束LLM；单智能体Agentic RAG（同时持有稠密与BM25检索工具，迭代至多8轮）；三智能体串行团队（retriever-matcher-verifier）。每种生成式策略均通过模型扫描选择最优模型。(4)指标：宏平均精确率/召回率/F1（技能名）；级别MAE、exact与within-one准确率；壁钟时间。
AI.result: (1)稠密检索获最高技能F1（0.232，召回率0.243），零样本LLM为精度极值（0.436/召回0.117），Agentic RAG以适度精度换取召回率，呈现明显的精度-召回权衡。(2)级别预测方面：稠密检索最差（MAE 1.60，within-one 0.436），因级别仅是嵌入最近记录的副产品；将级别作为显式生成输出的策略显著更优——单智能体Agentic RAG（MAE 0.68，exact 0.526）与零样本LLM（MAE 0.74，within-one 0.895），词法基线次之（MAE 0.94）。(3)三智能体团队与单智能体技能F1相当（0.212 vs 0.213），但延迟翻倍（327 vs 167秒/记录）且级别保真度更差（MAE 1.16 vs 0.68），验证了多智能体分解在封闭词表匹配中的负效应。(4)模型扫描显示零样本与单智能体排名不可迁移至多智能体场景（如GLM-4.7-Flash从单智能体冠军降至团队第三，Kimi-K2.6从第三升至团队冠军），稳健性而非能力决定排名。(5)召回率因黄金标准中31%词条早于SFIA 9而被上限锁定在0.69。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出三条核心结论：(1)封闭词表多标签技能识别上，检索（尤其是稠密检索）提供最佳覆盖，但生成式策略精度更高；(2)责任级别预测必须由模型显式决策才能可靠，继承自检索最近记录级别的做法（稠密检索）准确率低两倍以上；(3)多智能体分解在封闭分类法匹配中并不自动有益，三智能体团队以双倍延迟换取了无精度提升且更差的级别保真度。综合来看，最优设计是"稠密检索做候选发现 + 生成式显式技能与级别裁决"的混合架构，而非逐级增加智能体深度。该工作为首个可复现的SFIA结构化、级别感知技能提取基线，发布了完整的匹配器、语料管道与评测工具，为劳动力规划系统的下游标准化层奠定基础。未来工作应基于更大且更新的SFIA对齐数据集进行测试，并通过多次运行刻画智能体方差。

title: When Successful Memories Mislead Embodied Agents:Memory Adaption For Task-Conditioned Execution
summary: Experience reuse can reduce repeated exploration in embodied agents, but a trajectory that succeeded previously may be unsuitable for the current execution context. Existing memory systems pri marily optimize construction and retrieval; semantic relevance and historical success therefore remain insufficient when retrieved ex perience contains incompatible actions or an inappropriate level of structure. We introduce Memory Adaptation for Task-Conditioned Execution (MATE), a deterministic post-retrieval procedure that converts trajectories into execution-oriented memory. MATE re moves obsolete control context, extracts condition-action-effect transitions, applies verified action normalization, selects a task dependent representation, and serializes the result under a fixed budget without additional LLM inference. On 134 ALFWorld tasks, MATE achieves task success rates of 81.3% and 93.3% with Qwen2.5-14B and 72B while using approximately one-tenth of the tokens required by raw trajectories. Controlled comparisons show that verified action normalization is the principal mechanism by which MATE restores the utility of retrieved experience, support ing memory adaptation as a distinct stage between retrieval and embodied execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MATE（Memory Adaptation for Task-Conditioned Execution），一种确定性的检索后处理流程，将检索到的历史轨迹转化为面向当前执行环境的"可执行记忆"。在 ALFWorld 的 134 个任务上，MATE 使用 Qwen2.5-14B 和 72B 分别达到 81.3% 和 93.3% 的成功率，同时仅使用原始轨迹约十分之一的 token。研究表明，已验证的动作归一化（action normalization）是恢复检索经验可用性的关键机制。
AI.motivation: 在具身智能体（embodied agents）中，复用历史经验虽能减少重复探索，但此前成功的轨迹在新任务的执行上下文（action specification、状态假设、规划结构）中往往并不适用。现有记忆系统主要优化构建与检索，以"语义相关性 + 历史成功"作为可用性证据，但忽略了动作形式不兼容、结构层级不匹配等问题，从而引发**记忆诱导的负迁移**（memory-induced negative transfer）——即检索记忆反而损害任务表现。该研究将"记忆适配"确立为检索与执行之间被忽视的关键阶段。
AI.method:
MATE 是一个无 LLM 推理、无可学习参数的确定性流程，由五个可审计的算子组合而成：M̃ = (S_B ∘ P_z ∘ N_Σ ∘ E ∘ F)(R_k(q))。
1. **F（Context Filtering）**：去除历史系统提示/确认等过时的控制上下文，保留交互轨迹。
2. **E（Transition Extraction）**：从轨迹中抽取 ⟨precondition, action, effect⟩ 三元组，将每条动作与最近的前置和后续环境消息配对。
3. **N_Σ（Verified Action Normalization）**：仅当历史动作与当前执行规范 Σ 精确匹配时，按确定的 μ_Σ 重写规则进行改写；未匹配项保持原样可审计。
4. **P_z（Task-Conditioned Rendering）**：根据任务剖面 z 选择渲染方式——z=reactive 时输出局部 ⟨p, â, e⟩ 记录（用于反应式控制）；z=global 时注入当前约束状态（用于长时规划，如 TravelPlanner）。
5. **S_B（Serialization）**：在固定 token 预算 B 内按检索顺序追加完整记忆项，超出预算时保留首项的最大行对齐前缀；输出元数据保证可复现与可追溯。

三个不变量：保持检索顺序与 ID、仅精确规则改写、相同输入产生相同序列化输出。
AI.result:
**ALFWorld（134 任务）主结果**：
- MATE：14B 81.3% / 72B 93.3%（原始全轨迹仅 20.1% / 69.4%）
- Token 消耗：MATE 平均 1,617 token，约为原始全轨迹（15,401 token）的 1/10
- 单次通过（single-pass）方法中 MATE 在两种模型规模下均最高
- 对比 Reflexion（最多三次尝试）无显著差异

**机制分析与消融（14B）**：
- 去除动作归一化：SR 从 81.3% 暴跌至 51.5%（p=1.26×10⁻⁸），是核心机制
- 去除上下文过滤：73.1%（p=0.160）
- 去除预算控制：仍 81.3%，但 token 从 1,617 增至 7,861（纯效率问题）
- 归一化但未压缩的全轨迹：88.1% / 82.1%，证明 MATE 主要靠归一化恢复效用
- 与源匹配动作序列对比：71/72B 配对差异不显著，说明附加结构字段无独立增益

**边界测试**：
- 新鲜记忆 ALFWorld 与 ScienceWorld：MATE 与全轨迹差异不显著，表明适配效果取决于检索记忆存在历史/规范失配
- TravelPlanner：全轨迹优于 MATE（最高差 4.9 点），支持"选择性适配"而非"普遍适配"
- gpt-5.4-mini 执行器上同样观察到负迁移现象（78.4%→59.7%，p=6.2×10⁻⁴），证明问题并非 Qwen 特异
AI.conclusion: 本文识别并因果诊断了具身智能体中**记忆诱导的负迁移**现象：语义相关且历史成功的轨迹会因动作形式与当前执行规范不兼容而损害表现。MATE 将检索后适配确立为独立阶段，通过确定性的上下文过滤、动作归一化与任务条件渲染，无需额外 LLM 推理即可恢复并增强检索经验的效用。实验证明动作归一化是恢复效用的主导因素，附加结构化字段无独立准确率增益；MATE 在需要适配的具身任务上效果显著，而在新鲜记忆或长程规划场景中应选择性使用。论文主张采用"检索定位 + 适配定型"的两阶段记忆架构，原始轨迹保留作溯源依据，根据执行需要暴露适配后或更丰富的上下文。

title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Generate and Detect Multimodal Social Media Fake News?
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for publication in the Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: The rapid advancement of generative AI raises concerns about the misuse of Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for large-scale disinformation campaigns on social media. Despite existing research on textual disinformation, a fundamental question remains unanswered: can MLLMs be exploited to fabricate realistic multimodal fake news, and can they reliably detect it? We introduce a multi-agent framework in which a story agent, an image agent, and a critic agent collaborate to produce fake social media posts that plausibly counter true news. We apply the framework to generate over 9,000 paired multimodal news posts across science, health, and entertainment domains, and benchmark 16 open- and closed-source MLLMs for automated detection. We find that most models fall substantially short of human-level accuracy and fail critically on identifying image authenticity. Our research provides a foundation for developing robust defenses against social media fake news. Code and data are available at https: //github.com/xiuzhenzhang/Multimodal.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个多智能体框架（故事生成、图像生成、评论三个Agent协作）来大规模生成高保真的多模态社交媒体假新闻，并构建了包含9000+条配对真/假新闻（科学、健康、娱乐三大领域）的基准数据集，系统评估了16个开源和闭源多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的检测能力，发现大多数模型远低于人类水平，且在图像真实性判断上存在严重缺陷。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI和MLLM的进步，社交媒体上面临大规模AI生成多模态假新闻（虚假信息）的严重威胁。现有研究主要集中在纯文本虚假信息生成与检测，缺乏能够生成高保真、多模态社交媒体假新闻的框架，也缺乏针对现代MLLM检测此类内容的全面基准评估。核心问题在于：MLLM是否既可以被滥用制造逼真的多模态假新闻，又能否可靠地检测它们。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 多智能体生成框架——Story Generator（基于DeepSeek-V4-pro）从源新闻中提取事实锚点（实体、事件、时间、地点等）并生成误导性短帖；Image Generator（DeepSeek-V4-pro+FLUX.1-dev）根据内容类型（数据/时间线/官方声明等）选择适配的视觉格式并合成图像；Critic Agent（基于GPT-4o，独立于生成模型以避免自验证偏差）通过结构化反馈迭代优化文本与图像。(2) 数据集构建：从Nature、NIH、Snopes收集4507篇版权自由的新闻，生成配对真/假短帖（短新闻流风格），共9000+条。(3) 检测基准：在直接提示与结构化思维链（CoT）两种设置下，评估16个MLLM（13个开源+3个闭源），并与4位博士标注者的人工判断进行细粒度对比（事实准确性、误导性语言、图文相关性、图像真实性四个维度）。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 生成质量：完整流程在G-Eval上得4.540，优于单次生成（4.374）、无评论Agent（4.314）和无迭代优化（4.428）的消融版本；真帖流畅度4.97/忠实度3.99，假帖流畅度4.85/忠实度2.85（故意事实偏离所致）。(2) 检测性能：GPT-5.5表现近乎完美（平均F1=99.21），人类标注者准确率97.33%，而最强开源模型Qwen3-VL-8B+CoT仅73.36 F1，Qwen2-VL-7B+CoT仅52.50%。闭源模型普遍优于开源模型。(3) 关键发现：Snopes娱乐内容因讽刺性与上下文依赖性最难检测（25/32设置下F1最低）；CoT提示虽总体有益（12/16模型提升），但会放大模型特定偏差（Qwen2-VL-7B等出现退化）；图像真实性判断是普遍薄弱环节，三个对比模型与人类在此维度一致性差，模型易将表面可信度（如机构引用、统计数据、医学风格图表）误判为事实可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该论文填补了多模态假新闻生成与检测交叉领域的研究空白，提出的多智能体框架能够生成大规模、高保真、基于真实事件的社交媒体假新闻，而全面基准测试揭示了现代MLLM在AI生成多模态假新闻检测上的关键局限——尤其在图像真实性判断与跨领域泛化方面差距显著。研究强调可靠检测需要事实、语言、视觉真实性等多维度线索的协同验证，并为开发更鲁棒的多模态虚假信息防御系统奠定基础。伦理上，数据与代码仅限注册申请用于合规研究。

title: TRACE: Deployable Tree-Relational Structure Enhancement for Oncology LLMs
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 19 tables. Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track for oral presentation
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in oncology applications, but their predictions are often weakly grounded in explicit medical structure. We present TRACE, a deployable tree-relational enhancement framework for oncology LLMs. TRACE separates expensive offline structure learning from lightweight online inference: oncology concepts and relations are organized into an updatable tree-relational structure, refined using LM-loss-derived evidence, and retrieved at inference time as compact prompt evidence. This design supports task-adaptive evidence selection without requiring supervised labels in the zero-shot setting. Across ten oncology classification tasks and one MedQuAD CancerGov QA benchmark, TRACE improves both label-free evaluation and supervised fine-tuning. Additional analyses show that TRACE improves over vanilla RAG and generic GraphRAG, remains useful under leakage-controlled METABRIC inputs, and produces interpretable evidence paths aligned with clinical reasoning. These results suggest that explicit, updatable medical structure is a practical path toward more accurate and auditable oncology LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个面向肿瘤学大语言模型的可部署框架，通过离线学习显式的树-关系结构（概念树+关系图），利用语言模型损失驱动的贝叶斯更新进行结构精化，在线推理时仅做轻量级检索并注入提示，以提升肿瘤学任务准确性、可审计性和部署实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有医学/肿瘤学大语言模型在临床推理中缺乏对显式医学结构（如疾病分类、组织学、分子标记、分期等层级与关系）的显式利用；现有RAG和GraphRAG将外部结构视为固定检索索引，未利用模型侧证据对其进行精化，也难以持续更新。该工作旨在弥合LLM参数化知识与显式医学结构之间的差距。
AI.method: TRACE将肿瘤学知识组织为概念树（层级结构，参照mCODE标准）和关系图（跨分支临床关系）。离线阶段：(1) 用每个概念/关系作为查询检索语料，训练Concept Query LoRA适配器；(2) 将树节点和图边的LM损失转为软证据，并通过Beta-Bernoulli贝叶斯更新得到精炼的结构后验置信度。在线阶段：根据匹配度×更新权重进行轻量检索，将精炼的结构证据注入下游prompt。监督微调时增加task-branch权重优化。
AI.result: 在10项肿瘤学分类任务和1项MedQuAD CancerGov QA基准上：零样本任务宏平均准确率从基线Qwen3.5-27B的0.728提升至0.748；微调METABRIC任务宏平均准确率从0.761提升至0.797；优于vanilla RAG和generic GraphRAG；在泄露控制的METABRIC设置下仍保持优势；在噪声EMR输入下表现更鲁棒；在线检索中位延迟2.71ms，端到端推理增加约101.5ms开销。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过将昂贵的结构学习离线化、在线检索轻量化，提供了一种实用路径来增强肿瘤学LLM的准确性、可审计性和部署可行性。结果表明，显式且可更新的医学结构能使肿瘤学LLM更准确、更可审计、适合受限的临床部署环境。

title: Lookahead-R: Budget-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution-Centric Planning
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Published in ICMR 2026
summary: Tool retrieval is a critical bottleneck for LLM-based agents operating over large, heterogeneous API ecosystems. Existing approaches face an inherent trade-off: semantic retrievers are fast but suffer from the semantic-functional gap, while execution-based validation improves precision at the cost of prohibitive latency. We propose Lookahead-R, a planning-based framework that reformulates tool retrieval as a resource-constrained sequential decision-making problem. At its core, Lookahead-R introduces a lightweight execution-aware surrogate world model that jointly predicts tool execution success, latency cost, and semantic utility---without invoking real APIs. This world model drives a cost-sensitive, uncertainty-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search that navigates the tool space under strict budget constraints. Evaluated on the large-scale ToolBench benchmark, Lookahead-R achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off across all test scenarios. On the most challenging I3 split, it attains an NDCG@5 of 91.40\%, outperforming the state-of-the-art ToolGen (90.16\%) by 1.24\%. Ablation studies confirm that explicit latency modeling is the key discriminative signal for identifying high-quality tools under resource constraints.

AI.tldr: Lookahead-R将工具检索重新定义为资源受限的序列决策问题，通过轻量级执行感知代理世界模型预测工具执行结果（成功率、延迟、效用），并驱动成本敏感、不确定性引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索在严格预算约束下导航工具空间。
AI.motivation: 现有工具检索方法存在效率与可靠性的固有矛盾：语义检索器速度快但存在语义-功能鸿沟，执行验证精度高但延迟巨大。需要一种能在严格延迟预算下实现高工具成功率的方法。
AI.method: 1) Student-Teacher数据合成协议挖掘执行轨迹；2) 基于Llama-3-8B的预测世界模型，联合预测执行成功、延迟成本、语义效用；3) 成本敏感不确定性引导的MCTS（CSU-UCB选择策略）作为anytime算法执行虚拟推演；4) "Failure as Penalty"机制将失败工具映射为最大成本。
AI.result: 在ToolBench基准测试中，Lookahead-R在I3 split上NDCG@5达到91.40%，超越ToolGen (90.16%) 1.24%；平均通过率77.4%，胜率66.8%。消融实验证实显式延迟建模是关键判别信号，延迟估计具有真实性（680ms vs 随机成本1120ms）。
AI.conclusion: Lookahead-R通过将工具检索从静态排序问题转变为资源受限的规划问题，在准确率-效率权衡上建立了新的Pareto前沿，作为anytime算法适用于实时部署。未来工作将探索将该规划范式集成到多步复杂推理的端到端自主代理中。

title: Constructing Challenging Browser-Use Tasks by Controlled Environment Interventions
summary: As browser-use agents improve, benchmarks keep pace by collecting new tasks, websites, and applications, often making tasks longer or more novel. This makes difficulty expensive to refresh and difficult to control: when many aspects change at once, it is unclear what actually makes a task challenging. We instead construct challenging instances from tasks agents already solve, turning difficulty into a programmable property of the environment. BreakingWeb pairs every base task with an intervention condition that preserves the user instruction, latent target, and backend success criterion while changing the environment at different web stack layers. Each intervention is deterministic, detectable, and recoverable, and is annotated with the cognitive primitive it primarily loads. The benchmark contains 519 clean/intervention task pairs across seven self-hosted websites and 29 intervention families, all graded against outcomes. We evaluate six strong browser-use agents, three GUI-only agents that see only screenshots, and humans. The construction is effective: interventions cut agent pass rate by 22.9% on average and overturn nearly half of the tasks each agent solves cleanly, whereas humans lose 10.0% on a first attempt and 5.7% after one familiarisation attempt. The dominant failure is belief failure: 75% of the six agents' failures end with a declared success although the required change never happened. Our code, data and environment are publicly available at this http URL .

AI.tldr: BreakingWeb 提出了一种"可控任务硬化"框架，通过对浏览器环境四个栈层（seed/server/network/client）注入可恢复的干预，将已有可解任务变为困难任务，构建了519对 clean/intervention 任务对、覆盖7个自托管网站和29个干预族，用于评估浏览器使用代理的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有浏览器代理基准（如 WebArena、Mind2Web、OSWorld）通过收集新任务、网站和应用程序来跟上代理能力的提升，但这种方式使得难度更新成本高昂且难以控制——当任务的多个方面同时变化时，无法明确是哪些因素使任务变得更困难。论文主张将难度转化为环境的"可编程属性"，而非不断扩张任务集。
AI.method: 核心方法是为每个"干净"任务配对一个"干预"条件：保持用户指令、潜在目标和后端成功标准不变，但在 web 技术栈的不同层引入可恢复的复杂性。四个干预层包括：(1) seed 层——会话创建时的内容变更（诱饵、对抗内容）；(2) server 层——结构性变更（时间戳打乱、隐藏前提）；(3) network 层——运行时 API 拦截（5xx 错误、伪造成功响应）；(4) client 层——DOM/交互变更（标签错位、吞没点击）。每个干预遵循确定性、可检测性、可恢复性、原语纯净性和现实性五条设计规则，并标注其主要加载的七种认知原语之一（grounding、planning、state tracking、backtracking、patience、exploration、verification）。评分基于后端状态的 canonical-diff（包含正向义务和不变式），而非 UI 轨迹相似性。评估了 6 个基于文本的浏览器代理、3 个仅 GUI 代理以及人类对照。
AI.result: 结果显示该构造方法有效：干预使代理通过率平均下降 22.9 个百分点（17.9–27.6），推翻了近一半干净条件下可解的任务（39.6–68.0%），而人类仅下降 10.0%（首次尝试）和 5.7%（熟悉后）。主导失败模式为"信念失败"——六个文本代理中 75% 的失败以声明成功而结束，尽管所需的状态变更从未发生；声明 done 信号的假阳性率为 54–85%。最大单一故障源是 network/fabricated_success 族，占干预运行的 16.2%，失败率 0.70。GUI-only 代理与文本代理表现模式相反，失败以重试循环（action failure）为主。验证（verification）和回溯（backtracking）是五个文本代理中最大的配对下降维度。
AI.conclusion: BreakingWeb 用配对的 clean-intervention 配置文件取代单一端到端评分，揭示了两种不同瓶颈：文本代理需要在信任自身 done 信号之前对外部状态进行后置验证再读取，GUI-only 代理需要在验证问题出现前先加强渲染图像上的可操作性发现。两种范式下的当前代理均缺乏人类认知行为的鲁棒性和可靠性。该目录可作为训练时干预的课程，使验证再读取和回溯成为训练行为而非涌现行为。局限性在于实验仅覆盖闭源模型在单一文本/ GUI 框架下的七个英文消费级 Web 环境。

title: How to Run Statistics over LLM Judges and Trust the Results: Calibrated Inference for Small-Sample AI Evaluation with evalstats
summary: Researchers across academia increasingly base significance claims on LLM judge scores and small-sample AI evaluations. Yet without well-calibrated confidence intervals (CIs), hypothesis tests, and judge-bias corrections, such claims are unreliable. We address these issues in several contributions. First, we find that running statistics over raw LLM judge scores leads to inflated false positives: counterintuitively, for many inter-rater agreement metrics, false positive risk peaks at "almost perfect" human-LLM agreement. To help researchers understand how to run statistics over LLM judges responsibly, we present guidance and tooling for the statistical analysis of mixed human-AI judge designs, and implement nine hypothesis tests via prediction-powered inference (PPI), including the first known PPI corrections for four rank-based tests (Wilcoxon signed-rank, Mann-Whitney U, and omnibus variants). To keep PPI++ stable with small human-labeled calibration sets, we introduce bootstrap-adaptive power tuning, which shrinks the estimated weight toward a target estimated from the labeled data, and accounts for that weight's own sampling variance. Second, through Monte Carlo simulations, we derive recommendations for what CI, p-value, and FWER correction methods to use for small-sample AI evaluations (N<100), and warn researchers against bootstrap CIs. We package these recommendations into evalstats, an open-source Python package that selects calibrated methods automatically, and demonstrate it in three scenarios, including one where a real LLM judge validated at "substantial agreement" would have led a researcher to publish a spurious finding. evalstats is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出evalstats，一个开源Python工具包，针对小样本AI评估（N<100）和LLM judge评分场景，通过预测驱动推断（PPI）修正提供校准的统计推断方法，包括CI、p值、FWER校正和九种假设检验的PPI修正版。研究发现高inter-rater reliability（IRR）反而可能带来更高的假阳性风险，并警告研究者在小样本中避免使用bootstrap CI。
AI.motivation: AI评估领域统计方法使用不当问题严重：仅16%的基准测试论文报告统计信息，研究者常直接对原始LLM judge评分运行统计检验。现有关于小样本评估和LLM judge评分的统计推断指导几乎空白，导致虚假的发现频繁出现。论文旨在填补这一方法论空白，为研究者提供经过验证的工具和指导原则。
AI.method: 论文采用蒙特卡洛模拟方法，在合成和真实数据上评估多种统计方法。研究实现并验证了九种PPI修正假设检验（包括Wilcoxon符号秩、Mann-Whitney U等四种基于秩的检验的首个PPI修正），引入了bootstrap自适应功率调优（bootstrap-adaptive power tuning）来稳定小校准集下的PPI++。在合成数据上扫描了二元、连续和Likert评分类型，覆盖多种样本量、组数和评估设置。
AI.result: 研究产生了四个关键结果：(1) 数值IRR指标下，假阳性风险在"几乎完美"一致性处达到峰值，违反直觉；(2) 对小样本AI评估推荐使用Šidák用于同步CI、Romano-Wolf用于n≥30的p值FWER校正、Shaffer用于n<30；(3) Bootstrap CI在小样本下覆盖不足，应避免使用；(4) PPI修正检验保持Type I错误校准，并在ρ²≥0.4时提供约1.5倍的有效样本量增益。end-to-end验证显示compare()方法在717,600次调用中覆盖率和Type I错误率均接近标称值。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出结论：永远不应在原始LLM judge评分上直接运行统计检验，因为高IRR反而可能增加假阳性风险。PPI修正的检验对于混合人类-AI judge设计是必要的而非可选的。evalstats工具包以单一compare()方法自动选择经过验证的统计方法，使研究者能够在不放弃熟悉统计实践的情况下获得校准的推断。论文建议人类-LLM judge对齐应达到ρ²≥0.4（约对应"实质性一致"），低于ρ²≈0.2的judge不值得使用。该工作为AI评估领域的统计严谨性提供了方法论基础和实用工具。

title: PrimeSeeker: Capability-Oriented Supervision for Deep Search Agents
summary: Large language model search agents are often trained with synthetic questions whose difficulty is increased through larger evidence graphs, additional hops, and longer trajectories. These global properties, however, are only indirect proxies for the local retrieval capabilities required during search. To address this mismatch, we introduce latent anchor reasoning, which consists of resolving an unnamed retrieval anchor from descriptive specifications and transferring the recovered anchor into a subsequent information demand. This primitive retrieval unit decomposes deep search into chains of coupled operations and organizes question construction around anchor resolution and relation transfer, without prescribing a canonical search path. Based on this formulation, we propose PrimeSeeker, a capability-oriented framework that constructs web-grounded anchor structures and jointly derives a question and a reference evidence skeleton. The skeleton preserves supporting evidence from construction and guides expert generation through extractive highlights of current tool observations. These highlights are removed before supervised fine-tuning, while the skeleton is subsequently reused to audit reference-step coverage for reinforcement-learning rewards. We construct 9,221 expert trajectories, training a 30B search agent. Across five deep-search benchmarks, PrimeSeeker achieves strong performance, while reference-step optimization further improves the supervised policy. The resulting trajectories exhibit low retrieval redundancy, and fixed-budget evaluation shows strong solution coverage with substantially fewer tool calls than long-horizon systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrimeSeeker框架，从能力导向视角重新定义深度搜索任务，引入"潜在锚点推理"(latent anchor reasoning)概念，将搜索分解为锚点解析与关系迁移两个基本操作。通过构建锚点结构并联合生成问题与参考证据骨架D_q，实现从任务构建、专家生成到策略优化的一致监督。训练30B搜索智能体，在五个深度搜索基准上取得强劲性能，且检索冗余低、工具调用少。
AI.motivation: 现有深度搜索智能体的合成数据构建主要通过扩大证据图、增加推理跳数、延长轨迹等全局属性来提升难度，但这些仅是检索能力的间接代理，无法明确指定问题所训练的具体搜索能力。一个复杂问题可能因参数知识或单一判别性查询被快速解决，而短问题也可能需要多步推理来识别未命名的目标。因此需要从能力导向而非复杂度导向来组织搜索任务的监督信号。
AI.method: 1) 潜在锚点推理：定义基本检索单元 C(a_i)→a_i→z_i，包含锚点解析（从描述性线索恢复未命名目标）和关系迁移（基于恢复锚点提出新信息需求）两个耦合操作。2) 能力导向QA构建：基于种子页面构建网络锚点结构，每个锚点收集2-3条来自不同网页的描述性规格，通过歧义检查验证后沿语义关系链进行迁移。3) 参考证据骨架D_q：从同一构建结构中提取参考步骤序列，连接支持事实与锚点/关系，不规定检索路径。4) D_q引导的专家生成：在专家推理时从当前工具观察中提取与参考步骤匹配的高亮（严格原文提取，不引入未见信息），训练前移除所有引导。5) 学生策略优化：SFT后采用GRPO，奖励包含最终正确性和参考步骤覆盖率。
AI.result: 基于Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507训练，生成9,221条专家轨迹。在五个基准（BS-EN、BS-ZH、DS2505、DS2510、GAIA）上，PrimeSeeker-SFT与PrimeSeeker-Dq均表现强劲；Dq奖励在所有基准上均提升Pass@1。轨迹统计显示最低的平均工具调用数（19.5）和最低的重复搜索/访问率（0.1%/8.0%）。在共享300调用预算下，PrimeSeeker在DS2505/DS2510上以显著更少的调用解决更多问题。对照实验显示，Dq对齐的高亮使专家准确率提升2-7%，而随机高亮使准确率下降23-35%并增加25-65次调用。
AI.conclusion: 能力导向的潜在锚点推理为深度搜索提供了更直接的监督基础。PrimeSeeker通过连接任务构建、专家合成和策略优化，构建了统一的检索能力表征。构建时产生的证据骨架可同时用于专家引导和强化学习奖励，实现了一致的监督信号。实验证明显式的局部检索能力和可复用的构建结构是搜索智能体监督的有效基础，且强解决方案覆盖不必依赖延长搜索轨迹。

title: Less Uniform Discrete Diffusion is More Powerful and Scalable
summary: Although uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) represent a promising diffusion paradigm, scaling them remains challenging. We identify the core obstacle as an over-uniform training objective and condition-target confusion during sampling. To address these, we propose Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI), a novel UDLM framework. Specifically, we (i) introduce a less uniform loss that directs each reverse transition toward the clean token, and (ii) equip the model with per-token time embeddings that supply token-level corruption hints, enabling confidence-based few-step sampling. Experiments across scales show that LUDI yields cleaner supervision and improves few-step generation. We further continue-train a 7B autoregressive model into LUDI-7B, resulting in a UDLM capable of complex reasoning. It achieves a 3-token-per-step speedup over AR decoding and competitive performance compared with masked diffusion baselines, revealing that the full potential of UDLMs for complex generation remains to be unlocked.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LUDI（Less Uniform Diffusion），一种改进的均匀离散扩散语言模型（UDLM）框架，通过引入Less Uniform（LU）损失和逐token时间嵌入，解决了现有UDLM训练目标过度均匀以及采样时条件-目标混淆的问题，使其能够扩展到7B规模并处理复杂推理任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的均匀扩散语言模型（UDLMs）在少步生成和自校正方面具有潜力，但其发展远落后于掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs），主要瓶颈在于：（1）训练目标过度均匀，导致监督信号弱、训练效率低、少步生成能力受限；（2）采样过程中所有token以相同速率去噪，在复杂推理任务上导致条件-目标混淆，模型容易退化为重复token。因此，需要解决如何将UDLM扩展到大规模并处理复杂任务的问题。
AI.method: LUDI提出了两项核心改进：（1）**Less Uniform Loss (LU Loss)**：将原始UDLM的ELBO损失分解为抑制错误token、提升正确token、以及均匀平滑三项，去除导致过度均匀的平滑项，理论证明其等价于最小化Dirac目标KL的有限模型相关部分，直接引导反向转移趋向干净token；（2）**Per-token Time Embeddings**：为每个token分配独立的时间信号 τ^i，通过分层采样（前向过程保留边际分布）提供token级损坏提示，使模型能区分条件token和目标token，并自然支持置信度驱动的少步采样。两者结合形成"易到难"的解码范式。此外，采用块UDLM策略，从Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct继续训练，结合标签偏移、互补噪声、上下文-因果注意力掩码和AdaLU等技巧，仅增加约1%参数（78.7M）。
AI.result: 在小规模实验中：170M模型上LUDI在OpenWebText上达到Gen.PPL 37.76，熵7.50，优于Duo、SDDLM和SDDLM-v1；1B模型在六个下游任务（PIQA、SIQA、ARC-E、HellaSwag、OBQA、RACE）平均得分40.47，居首位。在7B实验中：LUDI-7B平均得分65.3，超过其AR初始化Qwen2.5-7B（56.3）以及多个扩散基线模（85B/LLaDA 45.4）、5Dream 59.9）、6Fast-dLLM v2 60.1），在HumanEval（68.1）、MBPP（71.5）、MMLU（71.1）、GPQA（34.3）等任务上表现领先，且在GSM8K上保持3 token/step的理论加速（实际1.30-1.92倍吞吐量加速）。消融实验证实LU损失、逐token时间嵌入和NB-Diff技巧各自重要。LU损失相比ELBO实现4.39倍加速和3.45倍内存减少。
AI.conclusion: LUDI是使均匀扩散语言模型在大规模上实用的重要一步。研究表明，扩展UDLM的主要障碍不在于均匀噪声先验本身，而在于现有训练目标和采样过程引入的过度均匀性。通过引入LU损失和token级时间感知，LUDI实现了更清晰的监督和更高效的去噪过程。LUDI-7B证明了UDLM可以扩展到复杂推理任务，缩小了与AR和MDLM范式之间的差距，表明UDLM仍是一个有前景但被低估的方向。未来工作需要进一步激活UDLM的自校正潜力，并探索从零开始大规模预训练UDLM。

title: $τ$-Multilingual: Benchmarking Voice Agents Across Languages
summary: English-only benchmarks expose only a narrow slice of voice-agent behavior. We introduce $\tau$-Multilingual, extending $\tau$-Voice to Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Korean, and Mandarin with native-speaker review and evaluation of generated language and spoken output. Across 4,500 full-duplex calls and five voice configurations, Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi remain within 3.2 task-completion points of English, but Korean and Mandarin fall by 14.7 and 8.4 points. The failure modes also vary: Korean systems miss more responses, Mandarin systems interrupt more often, and both struggle with tools and entities. Grok leads task completion but scores lowest on generation quality, motivating separate task, interaction, and generation reporting. We release language packs, validated judges, and tools for community-built multilingual voice-agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: τ-Multilingual 是首个在西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和普通话上对全双工语音代理进行任务完成、交互质量和生成质量联合评估的多语言基准，揭示了韩语和普通话相比英语在认证、实体处理和交互方面存在显著退化。
AI.motivation: 现有语音代理基准几乎全部仅评估英语，仅揭示了语音代理行为的窄面，无法反映多语言真实部署中的可靠性与文化适配性。
AI.method: 通过 LanguageFactory 工作流以母语作者审校的方式本地化调用者人设、语音规则、身份实体及评估规则；在六个语言、三个领域、五个语音配置（GPT、xhigh/low；Gemini、high/low；xiaohu）和两个级联文本系统上运行 4,500 次主调用；采用配对置换检验与 BCa 区间比较语言与系统差异，并对工具使用、自然度和语音保真度进行人类验证。
AI.result: 西班牙语、葡萄牙语和印地语的任务完成度在英语 3.2 分以内；韩语和普通话分别下降 14.7 和 8.4 分，主要源于认证查找失败与交互问题。Grok 任务完成最高（75.1%）但生成质量最低；GPT xhigh 生成质量最高（67.5%）；模型排名因评估目标不同而不同。
AI.conclusion: 多语言语音代理可靠性需超越任务完成单一指标；联合报告任务完成、交互和生成质量能暴露英语单语基准隐藏的失败模式；发布语言包、验证判官和工具以推动社区共建多语言评估。

title: When Should LLMs Trust Their Own Revisions? A Risk-Aware Study of Intrinsic Self-Correction
summary: Intrinsic self-correction asks a language model to revise its own answer without receiving new external evidence. A second pass can recover mistakes, but it can also overturn answers that were already correct. We study this trade-off across 29 open-weight LLMs on BoolQ, GSM8K, and Corr2Cause by tracking correctness transitions between initial and revised answers. Aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behavior: for example, Llama-3.1-8B improves by 25.5 percentage points on GSM8K, while refinement changes 19.1% of initially correct answers into wrong ones. A controlled BoolQ study further shows that refinement prompts shift the balance between recovery and harm. We then compare three runtime choices: keeping the initial answer, always accepting the revision, and selectively invoking revision using signals available after the initial response. The comparison identifies settings where learned gating is useful and others where a simpler unconditional policy performs better. These results suggest treating intrinsic self-correction as a revision policy rather than as a uniformly beneficial second pass, and evaluating it through both the corrections it recovers and the errors it introduces.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了大型语言模型(LLM)的"内在自我修正"(Intrinsic Self-Correction, ISC)——即在无外部新证据的情况下让模型修订自身回答。研究在29个开源权重LLM、3个基准(BoolQ、GSM8K、Corr2Cause)上,追踪初答与修订答之间的正确性转换,提出将ISC视为一个"修订策略"而非无条件有益的第二遍推理。
AI.motivation: 实践中ISC常被自动触发,但修订既能纠错也会推翻原本正确的答案。仅看聚合准确率会掩盖这种"恢复 vs. 伤害"的权衡。本文动机在于:判断何时值得承担修订的计算成本与风险,并检验仅用初答信号能否支撑这种决策。
AI.method: 1) 协议:模型先生成初答y0,再以"问题+初答+细化指令"生成修订答y1;不提供检索、工具或oracle反馈。2) 数据:BoolQ(验证集3,270)、GSM8K(测试1,319)、Corr2Cause(测试2,246);82个保留的模型-任务设置覆盖29个开源权重checkpoint。3) 评价:除Acc0、Acc1、Δ外,定义四类转换(C→C正确保留、C→W有害翻转、W→C有用恢复、W→W持续错误),并提出条件性HarmRate与RecoveryRate,推导出Δ=(1−Acc0)·RecoveryRate − Acc0·HarmRate的基率效应。4) 提示控制实验:BoolQ上11个模型×5种细化指令(neutral/stay/hard-stay/switch/hard-switch)。5) 策略对比:三种运行时选择——保留初答(S0)、总是接受修订(S1)、以及基于初答信号的门控(gate)。门控特征包括解析格式、生成元数据、对数概率统计、二元置信度、整数候选特征、解析一致性等;支持Logistic/HistGBDT/LightGBM。6) 记录级协议审计:对两对GSM8K记录做配对校验,验证KEEP/CHANGE规则与预算受限追踪完成条件的影响。
AI.result: 1) 修订在不同设置间差异巨大:无条件下修订在28个BoolQ设置中使20个准确率下降、GSM8K 28个中10个下降、Corr2Cause 26个中9个下降;但Llama-3.1-8B在GSM8K提升25.55百分点,Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B在Corr2Cause提升27.64点。2) 大净增常伴高伤害:Llama-3.1-8B在GSM8K有381次恢复与44次有害翻转(净增25.5点),但19.1%的初答正确被推翻;95% bootstrap区间[22.9, 28.4]与[14.2, 24.3]%。3) 提示指令影响权衡:BoolQ上5种细化指令均为平均负向Δ;更强"切换"指令放大有害转换多于有用转换。Qwen2.5-7B单模型分析显示重新考虑会降低对正确答案的对数置信度。4) 门控的有效性场景化:Qwen2.5-7B在BoolQ从80.8%(S0)降到72.3%(S1),门控可达86.0%;Llama-3.1-8B在GSM8K从17.4%升到43.6%(门控)。在某些设置下,简单无条件策略(S0或S1)优于门控,例如Phi-4-reasoning-plus在GSM8K上S0达到92.49%优于S1的92.19%。5) 特征组对照:全门控在25个BoolQ运行中有21个优于S0,中位+0.5pp、节省57.2%token;GSM8K上中位增益仅+0.1pp但显著节约计算。6) 协议审计:OLMo-3-7B上verifier的KEEP规则维持了初答稳定性;Phi-4-reasoning-plus的650初答与546修订追踪在1,024 token预算内未自然完成,转换仅反映预算受限输出。
AI.conclusion: 内在自我修正不应被视为普遍有益的第二遍推理。修订同时修复错误与推翻正确,具体平衡因模型、任务和细化提示而异。聚合准确率仅提供部分视图;评估应同时纳入恢复的有用翻转与引入的有害翻转。在部分设置下实例级门控能在保留修正的同时避免伤害;在其他设置下保留初答或总是接受修订更优。选择性ISC的价值不在修订本身,而在于决定何时额外推理值得使用,需要在与部署一致的修订协议下同时核算恢复与引入的错误。研究也坦承局限:面板未覆盖闭源前沿模型与更大规模模型;仅两个GSM8K设置经过配对记录验证,部分门控-覆盖值存在端点不一致,跨域迁移、标定负担与显式伤害-成本偏好仍待评估。

title: Beyond Rule-Based Mutation Testing: Test-Aware Mutant Generation Using Large Language Models
summary: Mutation testing evaluates test-suite adequacy by injecting synthetic faults into program code. However, traditional rule-based tools often generate large numbers of trivial, redundant, or equivalent mutants that limit their practical use for identifying gaps in a test suite. While recent large language model (LLM)-based approaches generate more realistic faults, most remain test-blind: The model sees only the source code and cannot reason about what existing tests already cover. We propose test-aware mutant generation, in which an LLM receives the problem statement, canonical solution and base tests in a single prompt, and must generate a nontrivial mutant that passes the base unit tests. We evaluate this approach across a set of five LLMs -- Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT 5.1 Codex Mini, GPT 4.1 Mini, Qwen3-32B -- on the HumanEval and MBPP benchmarks. The extended EvalPlus test suites serve as an automated oracle to verify whether surviving mutants represent genuine bugs. Test-aware prompting yields verified fault rates of 87.7% (HumanEval) and 79.1% (MBPP), meaning these mutants pass all base tests but are caught by the oracle. This vastly outperforms the matched test-blind prompting (which yields only 12.2% and 23.0%, respectively) and the traditional rule-based tool mutmut (4.4% and 5.7%). While fault subtlety (the fraction of extended tests a mutant fails) remains comparable across all three methods, test-awareness minimizes the computational cost per verified fault, compared to test-blind prompting. Exposing an LLM to existing unit tests shifts mutant generation from untargeted bug injection toward effective discovery of weaknesses in an existing test suite. Our work establishes a concrete foundation for future research to scale test-aware mutant generation to production-level environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"测试感知"的变异测试方法，通过在提示中同时提供问题描述、规范解答和基础测试用例，让大语言模型生成能通过基础测试但存在真实缺陷的变异体。在HumanEval和MBPP基准上，使用五个LLM验证了测试感知提示能显著提高已验证缺陷率（87.7%/79.1%），远超测试盲提示（12.2%/23.0%）和传统工具mutmut（4.4%/5.7%）。
AI.motivation: 传统变异测试工具（如mutmut）生成的变异体大量是琐碎、冗余或等价的，限制了实用性。现有基于LLM的方法多为"测试盲"，仅基于源代码生成缺陷，无法判断现有测试已覆盖什么。需要一种能针对测试套件薄弱环节生成有意义变异体的方法。
AI.method:
1. 测试感知变异生成（Test-aware mutant generation）：在单个提示中向LLM提供问题陈述、规范解答和基础单元测试，要求LLM生成能通过基础测试的非平凡变异体。
